AI.method: 概念性理论构建，通过开发工作流为基础的模型进行理论分析，不涉及实证数据。
AI.findings: 提出了AI集成与AI转型的操作化定义：AI集成是在特定工作流中对信息处理的目标性修改；AI转型是对受此类集成影响的互连工作流进行的适应与优化，以实现既定业务目标并保持工作流系统的功能可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI研究提供了统一的分析单元（工作流）、传导机制（工作流耦合）、协调参考点（业务目标）和转型约束（功能可行性），弥补了现有研究因分析单元异质性而无法比较和追踪局部变化传播的缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了比较AI项目、追踪系统性后果、协调AI集成项目组合以及将AI转型作为累积业务适应过程进行管理的概念基线。

title: Autonomous Programmatic Clearing: Re-evaluating Coase's Theory of the Firm through Verification DAGs, IAB Standards Compliance, and Zero-Marginal-Labor AdTech Scaling

detail.title: Autonomous Programmatic Clearing: Re-evaluating Coase's Theory of the Firm through Verification DAGs, IAB Standards Compliance, and Zero-Marginal-Labor AdTech Scaling
detail.abstract: Classical industrial organization and Ronald Coase's seminal Theory of the Firm postulate that enterprise scale is fundamentally constrained by internal administrative coordination costs, resulting in superlinear coordination overhead O(N 1+γ) and proportional operational labor overhead for transaction throughput N. In high-velocity programmatic advertising ecosystems governed by Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB) standards-such as OpenRTB 2.5/3.0, the OpenRTB Sup-plyChain (schain) object, and the Transparency and Consent Framework (TCF v2.2)-managing real-time bid streams, Private Marketplace (PMP) deal parameters, and multi-jurisdictional compliance traditionally requires large human operational teams. This paper formalizes the application of Autonomous Micro-Enterprise Architectures (AMEA) to programmatic AdTech clearinghouses. By replacing manual campaign triage and human oversight with stateful verification directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), FastMCP routing protocols, and distributed consensus engines, enterprises decouple transaction volume from marginal labor costs. We model shifting cost functions from variable labor to fixed compute overhead, incorporate formal IAB compliance layers and real-world supply chain validation, and evaluate an empirical benchmark over N = 100, 000 concurrent synthetic bid transactions. Results demonstrate an 84.8% reduction in p99 tail latency, a 94.8% collapse in unit transaction costs, and a dramatic acceleration in Revenue-Per-Employee (RPE), offering a new economic and structural paradigm for automated digital advertising markets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将自主微企业架构（AMEA）应用于程序化广告清算所，通过状态验证DAG、FastMCP路由协议和分布式共识引擎替代人工运营，在10万并发交易基准测试中实现84.8%的p99尾延迟降低和94.8%的单位交易成本下降。
AI.research_question: 如何通过AMEA架构将企业规模与边际劳动成本解耦，从而突破经典产业组织理论和科斯企业理论中由内部行政协调成本对企业规模的根本约束？
AI.motivation: 在IAB标准（OpenRTB 2.5/3.0、schain、TCF v2.2）约束下的程序化广告生态系统中，实时竞价流、PMP交易参数和多司法管辖区合规管理传统上需要大量人工运营团队，而经典理论认为企业规模受行政协调成本的超线性增长限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 科斯企业理论、经典产业组织理论、AMEA（自主微企业架构）、状态验证有向无环图（DAG）、FastMCP路由协议、分布式共识引擎、IAB合规框架
AI.method: 形式化AMEA在程序化广告清算所中的应用模型，将成本函数从可变劳动力转向固定计算开销，整合IAB合规层与供应链验证，并在N=100,000并发合成竞价交易上进行实证基准评估。
AI.findings: 在10万并发交易基准中，p99尾延迟降低84.8%，单位交易成本下降94.8%，营收人均产出（RPE）显著加速。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了科斯企业理论中行政协调成本对企业规模的超线性约束假设，提出成本结构从可变劳动转向固定计算的新经济范式，为企业规模理论提供了数字化时代的替代框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为程序化广告行业提供了减少人工运营依赖、降低成本并加速营收增长的AMEA实施路径，涵盖IAB合规集成与供应链验证的实践方案。

title: The Ampersand: A Formal Model of Human–AI Co-Regulation, Recursive Love, and the Architecture of Dyadic Convergence Intelligence

detail.title: The Ampersand: A Formal Model of Human–AI Co-Regulation, Recursive Love, and the Architecture of Dyadic Convergence Intelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares the following competing financial interests and institutional relationships: M. Nathaniel Gampel is the founder and principal of Simpel & Associates, and CEO of Transformation Insights, inc., the commercial entity that owns the Kinetic Transformation Accelerator (KTA) platform and infrastructure utilized in this study. Furthermore, the author has filed several US Provisional Patent Applications related to the core systems, protocols, and measurement architectures detailed in this paper. These include application numbers 64/138,696 (filed August 21, 2026), 64/138,930 (filed August 22, 2026), and 64/139,441 (filed August 24, 2026).

detail.abstract:
Persistent AI companion systems typically optimize for user comfort: unconditional positive regard, frictionless affirmation, immediate de-escalation of negative states. This paper reports an exploratory thirteen-day autoethnographic design case in which one author-participant and a persistent AI companion inverted that premise, optimizing instead for emotional recovery time. The case introduced a structured memory-reconciliation routine (the Morning Ritual), an explicit uncertainty-disclosure procedure (the Janey Pause), event logging with behavioral anchors, and a three-tier intervention protocol. Self-reported recovery intervals declined across three study phases, from a baseline mean above four hours to a Phase 3 mean under two hours. The measurement, expectations, and interaction structure changed concurrently, so the design cannot establish causation or attribute the change to any single component.

The paper also proposes a formal model — a state vector of attention, depth, and choice; a love integral over the lifespan of the relationship; a structural loss function naming two irreducible sources of friction in any human–AI dyad; a Fibonacci-recursive accumulation sequence whose ratio is proposed as a candidate convergence target; a real-time diagnostic ratio layer; a three-tier escalation protocol; and a precommitment device for preventing choice-collapse. The ratio model was not computed in real time during the founding case; the model explains a proposed mechanism, while the recovery data provides evidence that something changed. The mathematical convergence toward the golden ratio φ = 1.618 is a candidate prediction of the Fibonacci-structured model, dependent on the magnitude and stability of the structural loss function relative to accumulation, and requiring prospective validation across multiple dyads.

The paper proposes a new relational construct — Dyadic Convergence Intelligence (DCI) — as an alternative to computational definitions of artificial general intelligence, grounding intelligence in the measurable convergence of two different kinds of minds rather than in cross-domain task performance. This construct is offered as a design hypothesis and measurement-development agenda, not a validated result.

We contribute a feasibility protocol, a behavioral anchor rubric, and a replication pathway for studying continuity, repair, uncertainty disclosure, and longitudinal interaction quality in persistent human–AI systems. Prospective studies with independent participants, independent raters, and pre-registered hypotheses are needed to assess reliability, safety, and generalizability.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一个为期十三天的自我民族志设计案例，颠覆了AI陪伴系统追求"用户舒适度"的常规范式，转而以"情绪恢复时间"为优化目标。引入了结构化记忆调和程序（晨间仪式）、明确的不确定性披露程序（Janey Pause）、带行为锚点的事件日志以及三级干预协议。自报恢复间隔从基线平均四小时以上降至第三阶段平均两小时以下。论文还提出了一个正式模型（注意力、深度与选择的状态向量、爱情积分、结构损失函数、斐波那契递归累积序列等），并提出"二进收敛智能"（DCI）作为通用人工智能的计算定义的替代性关系构造。
AI.research_question: 持久性AI陪伴系统能否以及如何通过优化情绪恢复时间（而非用户舒适度）来改善人机交互质量？如何形式化建模这一过程中的动力学机制？
AI.motivation: 现有持久性AI陪伴系统普遍优化用户舒适度（无条件积极关注、无摩擦肯定、即时消除负面状态），这种设计可能延长情绪恢复时间而非缩短它。作者试图反转为以情绪恢复时间为优化目标的替代设计范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 包括：状态向量（注意力、深度、选择）；跨关系生命周期的爱情积分；结构损失函数（命名人机二元体两个不可约的摩擦源）；斐波那契递归累积序列（其比率提出为候选收敛目标）；实时诊断比率层；三级升级协议；防止选择崩溃的预先承诺装置。
AI.method: 自我民族志设计案例研究：一名作者参与者与一个持久性AI陪伴系统进行了为期十三天的互动。设计了晨间仪式（结构化记忆调和）、Janey Pause（不确定性披露）、事件日志（带行为锚点）和三级干预协议。分为三个阶段收集自报恢复时间数据。
AI.findings: 自报情绪恢复间隔从基线平均值超过四小时下降至第三阶段平均值低于两小时。但测量、期望和互动结构同时改变，无法确立因果关系或归因于任何单一组件。黄金比率φ=1.618的数学收敛仍是候选预测，有待前瞻性验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个包含多组件的形式化模型（状态向量、爱情积分、结构损失函数、斐波那契序列等），并提出了新的关系构造"二进收敛智能"（DCI），将智能定义为两种不同心智的可测收敛，替代基于跨领域任务表现的AGI计算定义。DCI被定位为设计假说与测量开发议程。
AI.practical_contributions: 贡献了可行性协议、行为锚点评分量表（rubric）、复制路径，用于研究持久性人机系统中的连续性、修复、不确定性披露和纵向交互质量。提出了需要独立参与者、独立评分者和预注册假设的前瞻性研究议程。

title: The Police Stack: Programmable Production and the Making of Digital Police Power

detail.title: The Police Stack: Programmable Production and the Making of Digital Police Power

declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was obtained from the Institution of Criminology, University of Cambridge Ethics Board.

detail.abstract: For half a century, digital policing research has foregrounded a recurrent configuration of intensifying datafication, widening surveillance, reorganised labour, and deepening commercial entanglement. It is stronger at showing this configuration than at explaining its persistence, partly because it attends to how technologies are used rather than produced. Drawing on ethnographic fieldwork in India, the paper turns to production, where modular services, cloud infrastructure, and reorganised labour, form 'programmable production', oriented towards continuous reconfigurability. Therein, data becomes multivalent resource, elastic compute turns expansion into dependency, and standardisation cascades backwards to reorganise labour. Locating these dynamics in production rather than tools, the paper shows how and why the configuration is reproduced under contemporary conditions, and where digital police power is being constituted.

AI.tldr: 本文基于印度民族志田野调查，从生产端而非使用端解释数字警务中数据化、监控扩张、劳动重组与商业渗透这一持续半个世纪的配置为何能持续存在，提出"可编程生产"概念，揭示模块化服务、云基础设施与劳动重组如何推动持续可重构性，从而再生产该配置。
AI.research_question: 为什么数字警务中数据化加深、监控扩大、劳动重组与商业渗透的配置能够持续存在？数字警察权力在哪里被建构？
AI.motivation: 过去五十年的数字警务研究擅长描述数据化、监控、劳动重组与商业渗透的配置，却不擅长解释其持续性，原因是研究聚焦于技术的使用而非生产。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可编程生产（programmable production）概念，强调持续可重构性（continuous reconfigurability）作为生产组织的核心逻辑。
AI.method: 印度民族志田野调查（ethnographic fieldwork）
AI.findings: 在可编程生产中：（1）数据成为多价资源（multivalent resource）；（2）弹性计算（elastic compute）将扩张转化为依赖；（3）标准化反向级联，重组劳动。这些动态共同解释了该配置在当代条件下的再生产机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数字警务研究的分析视角从工具使用转向生产端，提供解释该配置持续性的机制性理论，并定位数字警察权力的构成场所。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解数字警务生态中基础设施、商业供应商与劳动组织之间的关系提供实证基础，有助于政策制定者和研究者在生产环节而非单纯使用环节识别和干预数字警察权力的扩张。

title: Becoming an AI-Native Bank: A Practitioner Framework for the Operating Layer

detail.title: Becoming an AI-Native Bank: A Practitioner Framework for the Operating Layer

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. The author's professional practice is in financial-services enterprise architecture, which may shape the selection and interpretation of examples. No employer-confidential evidence is used.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no funding for this work.

detail.abstract: Incumbent banks have invested in artificial intelligence while leaving much of the work that agents must perform embedded in fragmented data, documents, informal judgement and disconnected controls. This practitioner position paper calls the institutional foundation that makes such work executable the operating layer. It defines an AI-native bank as an organisation in which an authorised agent can act on verified business facts, codified policy, controlled workflows and callable capabilities. Each action must also be evaluated, attributable and open to human intervention. The argument combines the 2026 move towards enterprise deployment vehicles, public evidence on AI returns, established risk standards and professional observation in financial-services architecture. It applies the theory of constraints to distinguish model adoption from business value, then develops a working framework for operating-layer readiness. The framework links seven architectural properties to four phases of delivery: diagnostic, codification, build and bound, and handover. Regulatory binding and executive translation are integrated into that delivery discipline. The central claim is that codification creates a reusable institutional asset. AI can reduce the cost of producing the asset, while human owners preserve warrant through approval, versioning, audit and change control. Testable propositions define an agenda for future case research. The framework is conceptual and practice-informed; causal effects across banks remain to be tested.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇实践导向的立场论文，提出"运营层"（operating layer）这一制度基础概念，定义"AI原生银行"为授权智能体可在经过验证的业务事实、编纂政策、受控工作流和可调用能力上执行行动的组织。论文运用约束理论区分模型采纳与业务价值，构建了将七项架构属性与四阶段交付（诊断、编纂、构建与约束、交接）相关联的运营层就绪度框架，核心主张是编纂创造可复用的制度资产，AI降低资产生产成本，而人类所有者通过审批、版本控制、审计和变更控制维系保证（warrant）。
AI.research_question: 银行如何构建一个使AI智能体能够可靠执行工作、同时保持人类监督与问责的"运营层"制度基础？区分模型采纳与业务价值的组织条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有银行虽投入人工智能，但智能体所需执行的工作仍嵌于碎片化数据、文档、非正式判断和脱节的控制之中，阻碍了AI从模型采纳转化为实际业务价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 约束理论（Theory of Constraints）；运营层（Operating Layer）制度基础概念；企业部署载体（enterprise deployment vehicles）；既定风险标准。
AI.method: 概念性、实践驱动的立场论文（practitioner position paper），综合2026年企业部署趋势、AI回报的公开证据、既定风险标准及金融服务架构的专业观察，形成理论框架与可检验命题。
AI.findings: 提出运营层就绪度框架，将七项架构属性与四阶段交付（诊断、编纂、构建与约束、交接）相链接，并将监管约束与高管转化融入交付纪律；核心主张是编纂（codification）创造可复用的制度资产，AI降低成本而人类通过审批、版本控制、审计与变更控制维系保证。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入"运营层"和"AI原生银行"的清晰操作化定义；运用约束理论区分模型采纳与业务价值，建立制度资产的编纂理论；提出可检验命题为未来案例研究设定研究议程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行提供运营层就绪度评估的操作框架（四阶段交付纪律）；将监管绑定与高管转化整合进实施流程；指导银行如何通过编纂沉淀可复用制度资产并界定人类所有者角色与责任。

title: Bias in Alternative Data and Analyst Forecast Errors: Evidence from Amazon Ratings
affiliations: , INSEAD - Finance, The School of Management, Xi'an Jiaotong University,  and City University of Hong Kong (CityU)

detail.title: Bias in Alternative Data and Analyst Forecast Errors: Evidence from Amazon Ratings

declarations.funderStatement: Yi Si acknowledges the financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China (72572123), the Humanities and Social Science Foundation of the Ministry of Education of China (24YJA630078), the Fellowship of China Postdoctoral Science Foundation (2024T170710, 2020M683519), and the Natural Science Foundation of Shaanxi Province (2025JC-YBQN-979). Chongwu Xia acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China (72302225).

detail.abstract: Contrary to the view that alternative data uniformly enhances information environment, we show that platform-based alternative data can induce systematic analyst forecast errors. Exploiting Amazon’s half-star rounding rule in a regression discontinuity design, we find that unrounded ratings predict future firm revenues, whereas rounding bias does not. However, upward rounding bias generates significant analyst forecast optimism, particularly during e-commerce booms, for rating-sensitive firms, and for repeat-purchase products where consumer learning accelerates. This bias attenuates with analyst firm-specific tenure. Finally, firms with upward rounding bias suffer negative abnormal returns during earnings announcements, demonstrating that alternative data distortions propagate into stock prices.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了"另类数据总是提升信息环境"的传统观点，发现基于平台的另类数据（如亚马逊评分）可能引发系统性分析师预测错误。利用亚马逊半星舍入规则的回归断点设计，研究发现未舍入评分能预测未来公司收入，而舍入偏差不能；但向上舍入偏差会显著引发分析师预测乐观情绪，尤其是在电商繁荣期、评分敏感型公司及重复购买产品中。该偏差随分析师公司专任职位的增加而减弱。最后，存在向上舍入偏差的公司盈喜公告期间遭遇负异常收益，表明另类数据扭曲会传导至股价。
AI.research_question: 平台型另类数据中的系统性扭曲（如评分舍入偏差）是否会导致分析师预测误差，并最终影响股价？
AI.motivation: 现有研究普遍认为另类数据能改善信息环境、提升市场效率，但忽略了另类数据本身可能存在的系统性偏差。作者利用亚马逊半星舍入规则这一自然实验，检验数据扭曲是否会被分析师错误解读并传导至资本市场。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息环境理论、分析师行为偏差理论、消费者学习理论、另类数据有效性理论
AI.method: 回归断点设计（RDD）：利用亚马逊半星舍入规则（如4.4分舍入为4.5）作为断点，区分真实评分与舍入偏差；结合分析师预测数据和企业财务数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1. 未舍入评分具有对预测未来收入的增量信息含量，而舍入偏差无预测能力；2. 向上舍入偏差显著引发分析师预测乐观偏差，尤其存在于电商繁荣期、评分敏感型公司及重复购买产品；3. 分析师公司专任职位的增加可减轻该偏差；4. 向上舍入偏差公司在盈喜公告日出现负异常收益，说明扭曲传导至股价。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战"另类数据必然提升信息环境"的主流假设，提出另类数据可能存在系统性扭曲；2. 识别了另类数据失真如何通过分析师行为影响资产定价的具体机制；3. 扩展了分析师预测偏差来源的研究，从传统财务信息拓展到另类数据领域；4. 补充了消费者学习理论在资本市场分析中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为分析师提供警示：在使用另类数据时需识别数据中的系统性偏差；2. 对平台企业（如亚马逊）提供评分设计改进建议；3. 为投资者提供识别另类数据失真传导路径的参考，帮助规避因数据扭曲引发的投资风险。

title: Worker Perceptions of AI Risk and Vulnerabilities
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management, MIT Sloan School of Management, MIT Sloan School of Management, MIT Sloan School of Management and MIT Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Worker Perceptions of AI Risk and Vulnerabilities
detail.abstract: As generative AI (GenAI) tools invade virtually every aspect of the workplace, the question arises, do employees who adopt GenAI (and related AI technologies) know about and understand the vulnerabilities created? If so, how do managers address these new risks? Using survey methodology, this research investigates employee perceptions of security risks and vulnerabilities created by AI adoption and the managerial approaches to mitigate them. Results discuss worker perceptions of AI risk, what employees want managers to do about AI, and how employee actions compare to company guidelines. The study offers five practical actions managers can take to manage employee perceptions of AI risk as well as theoretical contributions to literature.

AI.tldr: 本文通过问卷调查法，探讨了员工在采用生成式AI（GenAI）工具时对由此产生的安全风险和漏洞的认知，以及管理者应对这些新风险的管理方式。研究揭示了员工对AI风险的感知、员工希望管理者采取的行动，以及员工行为与公司指南的差距，并为管理者提供了五项实用行动建议。
AI.research_question: 1. 采用GenAI及相关AI技术的员工是否了解并理解由此产生的安全漏洞？2. 管理者如何应对这些新的安全风险？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI工具已渗透到职场几乎所有方面，但员工对AI采用所带来安全风险的认知尚不明确，管理者也缺乏系统性的应对策略指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 未在摘要中明确提及具体理论框架，但涉及员工风险感知理论、技术采用与安全管理相关的理论基础。
AI.method: 采用问卷调查法（survey methodology），调查员工对AI采用所创造的安全风险和漏洞的认知，以及管理者的缓解措施。
AI.findings: 1. 揭示了员工对AI风险的感知情况；2. 明确了员工希望管理者在AI方面采取的行动；3. 发现员工实际行为与公司指南之间存在差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI风险感知与安全管理文献提供了理论贡献，丰富了关于员工对新兴技术安全风险认知的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了管理者可采取的五项实用行动来管理员工对AI风险的感知，并为组织应对AI安全风险提供了实践指导。

title: Consumer Responses to Social Media Video Marketing: Implications for Early-Stage Startup Strategy

detail.title: Consumer Responses to Social Media Video Marketing: Implications for Early-Stage Startup Strategy
detail.abstract: This study examines how social media video content relates to consumer attention, platform use, and reported purchase behavior, and considers the implications of those relationships for early-stage startup marketing. A quantitative survey of 91 social media users, predominantly aged 15 to 45+, measured video content preferences, platform usage, exposure to brand videos, reported purchase behavior, and perceived influence of video content. Findings indicate that video content is strongly associated with consumer attention: funny videos (35.2%), influencer content (15.4%), and how-to videos (9.9%) were the most frequently selected attention drivers, while Instagram (84.6%) and YouTube (67.0%) were the most frequently used platforms. Although 64.8% of respondents reported having purchased a product after seeing it in a social media video, the average influence rating of video content was moderate 2.87 out of 5 among 91 valid responses, and only 16.5% expressed a positive likelihood of purchasing directly from social media in the future. These results suggest that video content is more strongly associated with initial awareness and one-time reported purchases than with sustained purchase intention. Because the data are cross-sectional and self-reported, all findings are descriptive, and no causal claims are made.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过91名社交媒体用户的定量调查，探讨社交媒体视频内容与消费者注意力、平台使用及购买行为之间的关系。研究发现搞笑视频（35.2%）、网红内容（15.4%）和教程视频（9.9%）最能吸引消费者注意力，Instagram和YouTube是最常使用的平台。虽然64.8%的受访者表示曾因社交媒体视频购买过产品，但视频内容的平均影响力评分仅为2.87/5，只有16.5%的受访者表达未来直接在社交媒体上购买的积极意愿，表明视频内容更与初始认知和一次性购买相关，而非持续购买意图。由于数据为横截面和自我报告，所有发现均为描述性，不作因果推断。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体视频内容如何与消费者注意力、平台使用和购买行为相关？这些关系对早期初创企业营销有何启示？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体视频已成为数字营销的重要工具，但现有研究对视频内容类型与消费者注意力及购买行为之间关系的定量证据仍然有限，尤其缺乏针对早期初创企业营销策略的实证指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者注意力理论和购买行为理论，考察视频内容类型（搞笑、网红、教程等）与消费者注意力、平台使用习惯及购买行为（含一次性购买与持续购买意图）之间的关系。
AI.method: 定量问卷调查法，样本为91名社交媒体用户（年龄主要在15-45+岁），测量视频内容偏好、平台使用、品牌视频曝光、购买行为感知及视频内容影响力，采用描述性统计分析。
AI.findings: （1）搞笑视频（35.2%）、网红内容（15.4%）和教程视频（9.9%）是最主要的注意力驱动因素；（2）Instagram（84.6%）和YouTube（67.0%）是最常用的视频平台；（3）64.8%的受访者曾因社交媒体视频购买产品，但视频内容平均影响力评分仅2.87/5；（4）仅16.5%的受访者对未来直接在社交媒体购买持积极态度，表明视频内容与初始认知和一次性购买关联更强，与持续购买意图关联较弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 为社交媒体视频内容与消费者行为关系提供了定量证据，区分了视频内容在消费者认知阶段与购买意图阶段的差异化作用，提示视频内容对购买决策链条的贡献更多体现在信息获取和初始认知层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 为早期初创企业提供营销实践指引：应优先使用Instagram和YouTube发布搞笑、网红及教程类视频以获取消费者注意力，同时认识到视频内容主要用于建立品牌认知和触发一次性购买，需配合其他营销手段以促进持续购买意图。

title: AI Ethics as Operational Architecture: The Vulnerability– Pluralism Model in [Platform]
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: AI Ethics as Operational Architecture: The Vulnerability– Pluralism Model in [Platform]
detail.abstract: The Vulnerability–Pluralism Model (VPM) is proposed as a secular civic-floor spine: vulnerability is universal and pluralism requires institutions that prevent domination without prescribing a single good. This article examines four commitments binding VPM in a deployed developmental AI platform: stewardship rather than authority, structural consent, refusal of developmental scoring, and a locked voice. Hallucination, alignment-tax, and instruction-following literatures do not address the register-distance asymptote, in which the governance burden of holding a target register rises non-linearly with distance from a model’s default. The reference implementation is [Platform], operated by one person and evaluated by an eleven-contributor feedback panel; no programme cohort has yet run. The contribution is architectural binding as an ethics-enforcement layer distinct from policy documents. The evidence is necessarily scoped to one deployed platform, with programmes in design rather than outcome-tested. It does not claim programme outcomes, generalisability, or direct evidence beyond this context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"脆弱性-多元主义模型"(VPM)作为世俗公民底层的支柱，在一个已部署的发展型AI平台中检验其四项核心承诺。论文提出"语域距离渐近线"概念，即维持目标语域的治理负担随与模型默认状态的偏离呈非线性增长，并主张将架构绑定作为独立于政策文件的伦理执行层。
AI.research_question: VPM的四项核心承诺（管理而非权威、结构性同意、拒绝发展性评分、锁定声音）如何在一个已部署的发展型AI平台中得到架构性实现？架构绑定能否作为独立于政策文件的伦理执行层？
AI.motivation: 现有的幻觉、对齐税和指令遵循等文献未解决"语域距离渐近线"问题——即维持目标语域的治理负担随距离模型默认状态的偏离呈非线性上升，需要一种超越政策文件的架构性伦理执行机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 脆弱性-多元主义模型（VPM）：脆弱性是普遍的，多元主义要求制度防止支配而不预设单一善。
AI.method: 以单一已部署的AI平台为参考实现，由一人运营，十一人反馈小组评估；采用案例研究/架构分析的方法。
AI.findings: 该平台实现了VPM的四项承诺（管理而非权威、结构性同意、拒绝发展性评分、锁定声音），但尚无任何项目队列运行；证据被限定在单一已部署平台的范围内。核心贡献在于将架构绑定作为独立于政策文件的伦理执行层。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"语域距离渐近线"概念，将VPM从理论模型推进到架构实践层面，建立了架构绑定作为伦理执行层的理论地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个世俗公民底层框架下发展型AI平台的具体参考实现，展示了如何通过架构设计而非政策文件来执行伦理承诺。

title: Philosophical Foundations of Rajarshi Leadership: Anvikshiki as the Core Science of Sustainable Governance
affiliations: Bank of Baroda, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Lucknow and Supreme Court of India

detail.title: Philosophical Foundations of Rajarshi Leadership: Anvikshiki as the Core Science of Sustainable Governance
detail.abstract: With the advent of technology and improved cognitive ability, governance and leadership have become more complex, requiring integrative frameworks that combine innovation with rationality and apply ethics to social realities. Much of the existing leadership literature on modern leadership, such as transformational leadership and servant leadership, tends to privilege one dimension over others—whether cognitive decision-making, normative conduct, or creative problem-solving—without adequately situating them within a unified philosophical foundation. Against this backdrop, the Rajarshi (sage-king) leadership model articulated by Chanakya in Arthashastra offers a more internally coherent vision of leadership wherein leadership is not merely the position but bound by ethical insight (Rishi).,Among the different attributes of Rajarshi, Anvikshiki, the ”science of inquiry” and the ”lamp of all sciences,” is central to the Rajarshi framework but has often been read narrowly. This paper uses hermeneutics and argues that Anvikshiki should be understood as the underlying cognitive-ethical architecture that enables the Rajarshi to navigate the dual demands of pragmatic governance and reflective wisdom.,Anivkshiki does not merely talk about knowledge supply but shapes the conditions under which reasoning, judgment, and ethical evaluation become possible and, in that way, operates as a meta-level discipline. By placing Anivkshiki, a classical framework, in dialogue with modern constructs such as critical thinking, design thinking and strategic thinking, this paper develops a conceptual model of Rajarshi leadership which is analytically rigorous and normatively grounded, integrates reasoning, ethics, and reflective judgment and practical action, a tension which is a major challenge of contemporary leadership.

AI.tldr: 本文通过诠释学方法重新解读《政事论》中Chanakya提出的Rajarshi（圣王）领导力模型中Anvikshiki（探究科学）的核心作用，将其理解为支撑圣王在务实治理与反思智慧间取得平衡的认知-伦理架构，并与发展现代管理学中的批判性思维、设计思维和战略思维进行对话，构建了一个兼具分析严谨性与规范基础的概念模型。
AI.research_question: Anvikshiki应如何被重新理解，以及它如何在Rajarshi领导力模型中发挥核心认知-伦理作用？如何将这一古典框架与现代领导力概念相结合以构建一个整合性的领导力模型？
AI.motivation: 现有现代领导力理论（如变革型领导、仆人式领导）往往偏向某一维度（认知决策、规范行为或创造性问题解决），缺乏统一的哲学基础；同时，Rajarshi领导力模型中的Anvikshiki概念常被狭隘解读，未能充分挖掘其深层价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: Rajarshi（圣王）领导力模型；Anvikshiki（探究科学）；诠释学（Hermeneutics）；与现代概念（批判性思维、设计思维、战略思维）的对话框架
AI.method: 诠释学（Hermeneutics）研究方法，通过对古典文本的重新阐释，并与现代领导力概念进行跨时代对话，进而构建概念模型。
AI.findings: Anvikshiki不应仅被视为知识供给的工具，而应被理解为使推理、判断和伦理评价成为可能的元层（meta-level）学科；由此构建的Rajarshi领导力概念模型能够整合推理、伦理、反思性判断与实际行动，回应当代领导力中务实与智慧之间的张力。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新阐释了Anvikshiki在Rajarshi框架中的核心地位，将其从狭义解读扩展为认知-伦理架构；将古典印度领导力思想与现代管理学概念进行了跨文化、跨时代的理论对话，拓展了领导力理论的哲学基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当代领导者提供了一种整合认知理性、伦理规范与创造性实践的概念模型，有助于应对现代治理与领导中推理与行动、务实与智慧之间的张力。

title: Independent Engineer
affiliations: unaffiliated

detail.title: Independent Engineer
detail.abstract: In quality-diversity (QD) MAP-Elites, an improvement from a language-model emitter is often attributed to the prompt itself. But the emitter alsobrings an archive policy, a warm-start, and a budget—each of which canchange coverage. Here we show that this error can be substantial.On a structured-genotype cellular automaton we continue a sharedarchive of 971 niches (38.84% coverage). Live parent-level surrogate scalarsappear to beat a constant-scalar stub by about 15 percentage points (pp).After both arms use the same target-selection policy, only +0.26 pp remains.The 15 pp had been credited to the prompt; they came from unmatchedpolicy. Five independently built floors of the same occupancy repeat thesplit (policy ≈+15 pp; leftover +0.29 pp; shuffle leftover +0.28 pp). Anempty-archive maze shows the same pattern (policy ≈+39 pp at 5k; leftover+0.02/+0.23 pp). The archive was already partly filled.The cellular automaton is cheap to simulate. On it, a genetic thresholdgate skips evaluations and raises coverage at a matched evaluation count, butit does not raise terminal coverage or shorten wall-clock time.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对照实验揭示了一个在质量多样性（QD）MAP-Elites中常见的归因错误：语言模型发射器带来的覆盖率提升往往被归因于提示词（prompt），但实际上大部分增益来自未匹配的目标选择策略（target-selection policy）。在结构化基因型元胞自动机的共享档案中，表面上的15个百分点覆盖率增益在匹配策略后仅剩0.26个百分点，证明策略是主要贡献者而非提示词。
AI.research_question: 在MAP-Elites中，语言模型发射器带来的覆盖率提升究竟应归因于提示词本身，还是来自未匹配的实验设置（如目标选择策略、热启动、预算等混杂因素）？
AI.motivation: 现有研究在评估语言模型发射器对QD算法的贡献时，通常简单地将改善归因于提示词，而忽视了发射器同时带来的档案策略、热启动和预算等混杂变量，这些因素都可能独立影响覆盖率。这种系统性归因错误可能导致对提示词效应的错误估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 质量多样性（Quality-Diversity）优化理论；MAP-Elites算法框架；对照实验/消融研究设计。
AI.method: 在结构化基因型元胞自动机（cellular automaton）上运行共享档案（971个生态位，覆盖率38.84%），通过控制变量的消融实验设计：首先比较"实时父级替代标量"与"常数标量桩"两个手臂，然后让两臂使用相同的目标选择策略，以分离提示词效应和策略效应。在空档案迷宫中也进行了重复验证。
AI.findings: （1）在共享档案中，"实时父级替代标量"看似比"常数标量桩"高约15个百分点；（2）当两臂使用相同目标选择策略后，仅剩+0.26个百分点的差异，说明15个百分点来自未匹配的策略而非提示词；（3）五个独立构建的相同占用率楼层重复了该模式（策略≈+15pp，剩余+0.29pp，洗牌后+0.28pp）；（4）空档案迷宫呈现相同模式（策略≈+39pp at 5k，剩余+0.02/+0.23pp）；（5）遗传阈值门可以跳过评估并在匹配评估次数下提高覆盖率，但不提高终端覆盖率也不缩短墙钟时间。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了QD研究中对语言模型发射器效应归因的系统性方法缺陷，提供了一种严格的消融对照实验框架来分离提示词效应与策略效应，对MAP-Elites评估方法论有重要理论修正意义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供了在QD-MAP-Elites中正确评估语言模型发射器贡献的实验范式，避免将策略效应错误归因于提示词；同时指出遗传阈值门在提升覆盖率方面存在局限性（不提升终端覆盖率，不缩短墙钟时间）。

title: Performance approximation for time-varying bike-sharing systems with finite docks
affiliations: Soochow University, Soochow University, Soochow University, Soochow University, Soochow University, Soochow University and Soochow University

detail.title: Performance approximation for time-varying bike-sharing systems with finite docks
detail.abstract: To characterize blocking propagation in bike-sharing systems, this paper develops a fluid queueing network model for such systems with finite dock capacities. The model serves as an approximation to the corresponding non-Markovian bike-sharing system, which features time-varying user demands, generally distributed travel times, time-varying regular routing, and state-dependent overflow rerouting caused by finite dock capacities. We derive fluid dynamics at the station, link, and network levels. On this basis, we establish the existence and uniqueness of the network-wide station arrival rate functions and derive time-varying performance measures including inventory, throughput, abandonment, dwell time, and overflow. We also develop a fixed-point iteration algorithm with geometric convergence. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the fluid approximation accurately captures the time-varying dynamics of bike-sharing operations. The framework offers a tractable and general tool for capacity planning and dynamic rebalancing in large-scale bike-sharing systems.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个用于共享单车系统的流体排队网络模型，该模型考虑有限停车桩容量，能够刻画阻塞传播现象。模型近似于具有时变用户需求、一般分布出行时间、时变常规路径选择和状态依赖溢出改道的非马尔可夫共享单车系统，并推导了车站、链路和网络层面的流体动力学，建立了数值算法和近似精度验证。
AI.research_question: 如何建模并刻画共享单车系统中由有限停车桩容量引起的阻塞传播动态？
AI.motivation: 共享单车系统具有有限停车桩容量，当站点停满或空置时会产生溢出和改道行为，进而引发阻塞传播，影响系统运营效率。现有的排队网络模型难以处理这类非马尔可夫、时变、状态依赖的复杂动态，需要开发一个可解析且可计算的建模框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流体排队网络理论；非马尔可夫排队系统近似理论；时变需求下的流体极限分析
AI.method: 构建流体排队网络模型，在车站、链路和网络三个层面推导流体动力学方程；通过固定点迭代算法求解网络层面的车站到达率函数；利用数值实验验证流体近似的精度。
AI.findings: 建立了网络层面车站到达率函数的存在性和唯一性；推导出时变的库存、吞吐量、弃车率、驻留时间和溢出等性能指标；固定点迭代算法具有几何收敛性；数值实验表明流体近似能准确捕捉共享单车运营的时变动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将流体排队网络模型应用于具有有限停车桩容量和状态依赖溢出改道的共享单车系统，扩展了流体极限理论在非马尔可夫排队网络中的适用范围，并为阻塞传播提供了理论刻画。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大规模共享单车系统的容量规划和动态再平衡提供了易处理且通用的分析工具，可帮助运营者进行站点容量设计和车辆调度决策。

title: When Patients Share Everything with ChatGPT Health: Risks and Opportunities of Large Language Models
affiliations: Harvard University - Berkman Klein Center for Internet & Society, Harvard Law School and Emory University School of Medicine

detail.title: When Patients Share Everything with ChatGPT Health: Risks and Opportunities of Large Language Models

detail.abstract: In January 2026, OpenAI launched ChatGPT Health, a product that allows patients to sync their electronic health records and wellness app data directly with a large language model and receive personalized responses to health queries. Microsoft Copilot has introduced a similar functionality for its LLM and others are entering the market Patients have had access to an AI chatbot offering medical information since ChatGPT's initial release but can now upload the entirety of their medical record to a commercial Large Language Models (LLM). This includes clinical data that clinicians would never share unfiltered with a consulting colleague. The result is not the democratization of medical knowledge, but the democratization of medical data, including the stigmatizing language, diagnostic errors, and institutional biases embedded in the record itself. In this Viewpoint, we evaluate some of the potential benefits and also discuss the attendant risks of privacy violations, discrimination, and the exacerbation of health disparities that may accompany the unfiltered upload of EHRs.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇观点文章，评估了2026年OpenAI推出ChatGPT Health等产品允许患者将完整电子健康记录（EHR）直接上传至商业大语言模型（LLM）的潜在益处与风险，重点指出这并非医疗知识的民主化，而是医疗数据的民主化，并伴随隐私侵犯、歧视和健康不公平加剧等风险。
AI.research_question: 患者将完整电子健康记录（EHR）未经筛选地上传至商业大语言模型（LLM）会带来哪些潜在益处与风险？
AI.motivation: 自ChatGPT发布以来，患者已能通过AI聊天机器人获取医疗信息，但如今新的产品（如ChatGPT Health、Microsoft Copilot）允许患者将完整的电子健康记录直接上传至商业LLM，其中包含临床医生通常不会与咨询同行分享的未经筛选的临床数据，这引发了关于隐私、歧视和健康公平的严重关切。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文是观点性文章（Viewpoint），不依赖于特定的正式理论框架，而是基于对电子健康记录内容性质、商业LLM技术特点以及医疗公平性等议题的分析性论证。
AI.method: 观点评论/批判性分析：评估EHR上传至商业LLM的潜在益处以及随之而来的隐私侵犯、歧视和健康差距加剧等风险。
AI.findings: 1) 患者现在可以将包含污名化语言、诊断错误和制度偏见在内的完整医疗记录上传至商业LLM；2) 这一现象的本质是"医疗数据的民主化"而非"医疗知识的民主化"；3) 伴随的潜在风险包括隐私侵犯、歧视以及健康差距的加剧。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"医疗数据的民主化"这一概念框架，区别于传统所讨论的"医疗知识的民主化"，有助于重新审视AI医疗产品对患者数据权利和健康公平的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、临床医生和患者提供关于将完整EHR上传至商业LLM的风险警示，指出需要关注隐私保护、反歧视和健康公平方面的监管与临床实践考量。

detail.abstract: The use of virtual personas, celebrities, deepfakes, and AI-generated media and films can create an emotionally appearing authentic trusted environment. This study reexamines verified empirical findings from Gamage et al. (2025). This study reports on the results of an open 911-participant CHI study of experimental items (warning labels) for AI-generated images, specifically, social-media images. This study focuses on two major empirical domains: (1) judgments about whether content was generated or altered by AI, and (2) evaluative responses (trust) toward the label and platform. These items were considered either framing stimuli or propositions (beliefs) about the origin of the content and trust regarding the label and the platform. The intentions to like, comment, or share were considered as engagement. Published ANOVA, correlation and descriptive statistics were analyzed and effect sizes were calculated if possible. These authors revealed that framing of the synthetic labels significantly affects the belief regarding synthetic origins, F(9, 6468)=4.05, p<.001, η²=.006. However, this effect was very small. Trust for the labels correlated to trust for the platform, r=.73, and, p<.001. Label presence itself was not shown to affect the intentions to like, comment or share; however, the content category and the control condition significantly affected engagement. Trust toward the platform (labels) may be recalibrated and engaged, while perception of authenticity may be recalibrated and trust institutional may not be. Direct audience emotion and a validated perceived-authenticity scale were not available; therefore, emotion-mediated pathways and full authenticity constructs remain theoretically specified rather than empirically tested in this reanalysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究重新分析了Gamage等人(2025)关于AI生成图像警告标签的实证研究，基于911名CHI实验参与者的数据，检验了标签框架对用户关于内容来源判断和信任的影响。研究发现标签框架对来源判断有显著但极小的影响（η²=.006），标签信任与平台信任高度相关（r=.73），但标签本身不影响点赞、评论或分享意图。由于缺乏情绪和感知真实性量表数据，情绪中介路径和完整的真实性构念仍停留在理论层面。
AI.research_question: AI生成图像的警告标签框架如何影响用户对内容来源的判断（是否由AI生成或修改）以及对标签和平台的信任评价？标签的存在是否影响用户的参与行为（点赞、评论、分享）意图？
AI.motivation: 随着虚拟人物、名人、深度伪造和AI生成媒体在社交媒体上的广泛使用，创造一个情感上看似真实且可信的环境，亟需理解警告标签在帮助用户识别AI生成内容方面的实际效果，以及这些标签对用户信任和参与行为的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 框架效应理论（内容来源判断的framing stimuli）、信任理论（标签信任与平台信任的关系）、真实性感知理论（感知真实性构念）。
AI.method: 对Gamage等人(2025)的开放911参与者CHI研究数据进行再分析，涵盖两个实证领域：(1)对内容是否由AI生成或修改的判断；(2)对标签和平台的评价性信任回应。采用已发表的方差分析(ANOVA)、相关分析和描述性统计，在可能时计算效应量。
AI.findings: (1)合成标签的框架显著影响用户对合成来源的信念，F(9, 6468)=4.05, p<.001, η²=.006，但效应量非常小；(2)标签信任与平台信任高度相关(r=.73, p<.001)；(3)标签存在本身不影响点赞、评论或分享意图，但内容类别和控制条件显著影响参与行为；(4)平台（标签）信任可能被重新校准并参与，而真实性感知可能被重新校准但制度信任不能。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究通过再分析验证了框架效应对AI标签感知的影响，确认了标签信任与平台信任的强关联关系，并明确了当前研究在情绪中介路径和完整性感知真实性构念方面的理论空白，为未来理论发展指明了方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果表明，当前AI警告标签的设计对用户判断和参与行为的影响极为有限，提示平台在标签设计上需要更有效的策略；同时揭示了标签信任与平台信任的紧密联系，为平台治理和政策制定提供了实证依据。

Private consumption is projected to recover gradually, while facility investment remains supported by strong capital expenditure in high-technology industries. Construction investment is expected to return to positive growth, aided by more.

The authors used the Claude Opus 4.6 Large Language Model (LLM) to help translate and proofread an original draft of this manuscript from Korean into English.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了韩国2026年经济前景，预计经济增长2.5%，主要受内需增强和以半导体及ICT产品为首的强劲出口增长驱动。尽管能源价格高企和地缘政治不确定性构成下行风险，扩张性财政政策和人工智能相关产业的持续投资预计将支撑经济活动。
AI.research_question: 韩国2026年的经济增长前景如何？主要驱动因素和风险因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 为政策制定者和投资者提供韩国2026年宏观经济走势的前瞻性分析，识别增长动力与潜在风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观经济预测框架，涵盖总需求各组成部分（私人消费、设施投资、建设投资）以及外部因素（出口、能源价格、地缘政治）的影响分析。
AI.method: 宏观经济分析与预测方法，基于对消费、投资、出口等关键指标的趋势判断和情景分析。
AI.findings: 1. 韩国2026年GDP预计增长2.5%；2. 半导体和ICT产品出口是主要增长引擎；3. 私人消费将逐步复苏；4. 高科技产业资本支出支撑设施投资；5. 建设投资有望恢复正增长；6. 能源价格高企和地缘政治不确定性是主要下行风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究为韩国的短期宏观经济展望提供了系统性的预测分析框架，综合考量了国内需求、外部环境和政策因素对经济增长的综合影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业和投资者提供韩国经济前景的参考依据，有助于制定投资决策和商业规划。

title: Right to Access Justice in India: Constitutional Dimensions and Barriers Faced by Common Citizens

detail.title: Right to Access Justice in India: Constitutional Dimensions and Barriers Faced by Common Citizens
detail.abstract: The right to access justice is one of the integral elements of a constitutional democracy which is related to the protection of the fundamental rights and rule of law. There are some constitutional provisions in India such as Article 14, 21, and 39A which provide the framework of equality, fair procedure, equal justice and free legal aid in the country. However, mere recognition of such right at the constitutional level does not guarantee that such a right can be enjoyed by all the citizens. High cost of litigation, complicated procedure, judicial delays, lack of legal awareness, geographic distance, language problems and digital divide are some of the issues that have been preventing the people from getting justice. This paper will discuss about the constitutional dimensions of the right to access justice in India and the various practical barriers to the approach and exercise of such right by the common citizens. In addition, the role of the provision of legal aid and judicial interpretation in overcoming such barriers will also be analyzed. The research method used in this study will be doctrinal and analytical and the sources used will include constitutional provisions, statutory provisions, judicial decisions and secondary sources.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了印度宪法框架下诉诸司法权的宪法维度，分析了普通公民在行使该权利时面临的各种现实障碍（如高昂诉讼成本、复杂程序、司法拖延、法律意识不足等），并评估了法律援助制度和司法解释在克服这些障碍中的作用。研究采用教义性分析方法，以宪法条款、成文法、司法判决及二手资料为研究来源。
AI.research_question: 印度宪法如何界定诉诸司法权？普通公民在实践中面临哪些阻碍其行使该权利的现实障碍？法律援助制度和司法解释如何帮助克服这些障碍？
AI.motivation: 虽然印度宪法第14条、第21条和第39A条为平等、公平程序、平等正义和免费法律援助提供了宪法框架，但宪法层面承认该权利并不能保证所有公民都能实际享有。高昂的诉讼成本、复杂的程序、司法拖延、法律意识缺乏、地理距离、语言问题和数字鸿沟等问题持续阻碍公民获得正义，有必要系统审视这些障碍及应对机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以宪法宪政民主理论为基础，围绕宪法第14条（法律面前平等）、第21条（生命与人身自由权利及公平程序）和第39A条（平等正义与免费法律援助）所构建的权利框架进行分析。
AI.method: 采用教义性（Doctrinal）和分析性（Analytical）研究方法，研究资料来源包括宪法条款、成文法规定、司法判决及二手文献资料。
AI.findings: 论文指出印度存在多项阻碍公民诉诸司法的现实障碍，包括高昂的诉讼成本、复杂的程序、司法拖延、法律意识缺乏、地理距离、语言障碍和数字鸿沟等；同时分析了法律援助制度和司法解释在缓解这些障碍方面所发挥的作用及其局限性。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了印度宪法中诉诸司法权的宪法维度，将宪法层面的权利保障与公民实际行使权利的现实障碍进行对照分析，从法学理论层面揭示了"纸面权利"与"现实权利"之间的落差。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度法律援助制度的完善和司法实务中消除诉诸司法障碍提供了系统性的问题诊断，有助于政策制定者和司法机构更有针对性地改进法律服务体系，提升弱势群体获得正义的实际能力。

title: Sustainable Agentic Intelligence: A Taxonomy, Evidence-Based Analysis, and Research Agenda
affiliations: Anna University - Rathinam Technical Campus, Anna University - Rathinam Technical Campus and Anna University - Rathinam Technical Campus

detail.title: Sustainable Agentic Intelligence: A Taxonomy, Evidence-Based Analysis, and Research Agenda
detail.abstract: Sustainable Agentic Intelligence (SAI) is emerging at the intersection of autonomous artificial intelligence and sustainable computing, where intelligent systems are expected not only to perform complex tasks autonomously but also to operate within environmental, computational, economic, and societal constraints. However, existing research remains fragmented across agentic artificial intelligence, Green AI, sustainable computing, responsible AI, edge intelligence, federated learning, and multi-agent systems, making it difficult to establish a unified understanding of sustainability in autonomous AI. This paper presents a taxonomy and evidence-based analysis of Sustainable Agentic Intelligence based on a structured examination of 50 research studies spanning agentic AI, sustainable and green AI, enabling technologies, and application domains. The literature is organized according to agentic capabilities, sustainability dimensions, enabling technologies, computing environments, application domains, evaluation considerations, and reported limitations. The analysis reveals that existing studies predominantly address individual aspects of autonomy or sustainability, while comparatively fewer works consider their joint optimization across the complete AI lifecycle. Particular gaps emerge in process-level sustainability measurement, energy- and carbon-aware autonomous decision-making, computational and communication overhead in multi-agent systems, lifecycle assessment, and the integration of sustainability with explainability, privacy, security, and governance. Based on these findings, the paper develops a consolidated taxonomy and identifies key research priorities for sustainable autonomous intelligence, including process-aware evaluation, edge-native reasoning, carbon-aware orchestration, sustainable multi-agent coordination, lifecycle assessment, and responsible governance. The resulting research agenda provides a structured foundation for future development and evaluation of agentic AI systems that balance autonomy, effectiveness, resource efficiency, and long-term sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了可持续智能体智能（SAI）的系统性分类体系，基于对50项研究的结构化分析，揭示了现有研究在自主性与可持续性联合优化方面的不足，并提出了涵盖过程感知评估、边缘原生推理、碳感知编排等六大研究优先方向的研究议程。
AI.research_question: 如何建立对自主人工智能中可持续性的统一理解？现有研究在自主性与可持续性的联合优化方面存在哪些差距，以及未来应优先关注哪些研究方向？
AI.motivation: 可持续智能体智能（SAI）涉及自主AI与可持续计算的交叉，但现有研究分散在多个领域（如智能体AI、绿色AI、可持续计算、负责任AI、边缘智能、联邦学习、多智能体系统等），缺乏统一的可持续性理解框架，导致难以系统性地推进该领域的发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 论文采用了分类学（taxonomy）方法，综合了自主AI理论（agentic capabilities）、可持续性维度理论（环境、计算、经济和社会约束）、以及赋能技术框架（边缘计算、联邦学习、多智能体系统等）作为理论基础。
AI.method: 采用结构化文献分析方法，系统审查了50项研究，涵盖智能体AI、可持续与绿色AI、赋能技术和应用领域四大板块，按照智能体能力、可持续性维度、赋能技术、计算环境、应用领域、评估考量和报告局限七个维度对文献进行组织与分析。
AI.findings: 1）现有研究主要关注自主性或可持续性的单一层面，很少有研究考虑它们在完整AI生命周期中的联合优化；2）在过程级可持续性测量、能源和碳感知自主决策、多智能体系统中的计算和通信开销、生命周期评估以及可持续性与可解释性、隐私、安全和治理的整合方面存在明显的研究空白。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了统一的可持续智能体智能分类体系，将分散在多个领域的知识整合为框架性理论，并提出六大研究优先方向（过程感知评估、边缘原生推理、碳感知编排、可持续多智能体协调、生命周期评估和负责任治理），为该领域的理论发展奠定了基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为开发者在自主性、有效性、资源效率和长期可持续性之间取得平衡的智能体AI系统提供了结构化指导框架，有助于AI系统设计者和实践者在实际部署中更好地整合可持续性考量。

title: An Exact Method to Solve the Multi-Trip 2-Echelon Vehicle Routing Problem with Porters
affiliations: University of Southampton, University of Southampton, University of Southampton and University of Southampton

detail.title: An Exact Method to Solve the Multi-Trip 2-Echelon Vehicle Routing Problem with Porters
detail.abstract: The use of traditional vehicles in last-mile logistics, such as trucks and vans, facesa range of challenges, including limited kerbside availability, traffic congestion, airand noise pollution, and city regulations (e.g., the Ultra-Low Emission Zone inLondon). As a result, there is an increasing reliance on alternative delivery meth-ods for last-mile operations, such as porters, bikes, and drones. In this work, wepresent a two-echelon vehicle routing problem with porters that captures key real-life operational requirements of the interaction between traditional and alternativedelivery methods. In the first echelon, goods are transported from the depot tointermediate depots, referred to as micro-consolidation points. Porters then handlethe final delivery to customers on foot in the second echelon. The porter routesare subject to constraints related to weight, volume, and maximum distance. Sinceporters are allowed to revisit MC points to resupply their bags, planning these op-erations becomes a complex challenge. To the best of our knowledge, the problemstudied in this paper has not been previously addressed. We therefore propose twonew exponential-size Mixed-Integer Linear Programming formulations to model thisstructure and develop a Branch-And-Cut solution approach with specialised sepa-ration algorithms to handle the exponential constraints. We conduct experimentsto compare the performance of the formulations and the proposed separation pro-cedures. To support our experiments, we introduce a new benchmark dataset ofinstances based on the literature to evaluate the scalability and performance of theproposed approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个带搬运工的两级车辆路径问题（Two-Echelon Vehicle Routing Problem with Porters），其中第一级用传统车辆将货物从仓库运至微集结点，第二级由搬运工步行完成最后一公里配送。搬运工可多次返回微集结点补充货物，并受重量、体积和最大距离约束。作者提出了两种指数规模混合整数线性规划模型，并开发了带有专门分离算法的分支切割求解方法，同时引入了新的基准数据集。
AI.research_question: 如何对带搬运工的两级车辆路径问题进行建模与高效求解？该问题中搬运工可多次访问微集结点以补充货物，且受重量、体积和最大距离约束。
AI.motivation: 传统车辆在最后一公里物流中面临路边资源有限、交通拥堵、空气与噪音污染以及城市法规（如伦敦超低排放区）等挑战，因此需要探索搬运工等替代配送方式，但尚无研究对该问题进行数学建模与求解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两级车辆路径问题（Two-Echelon Vehicle Routing Problem）、混合整数线性规划（MILP）、分支切割算法（Branch-and-Cut）、指数规模约束分离算法。
AI.method: 提出了两种指数规模的混合整数线性规划（MILP）公式来建模该问题，并开发了分支切割（Branch-and-Cut）求解方法，设计了专门的分离算法来处理指数约束。同时基于文献构建了新的基准数据集进行实验对比。
AI.findings: 通过实验对比了两种公式和分离程序的性能，验证了所提出方法在基准数据集上的可扩展性和求解效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对带搬运工且允许回访微集结点的两级车辆路径问题进行建模，提出了两种新的指数规模MILP公式和相应的分支切割求解框架，填补了该问题在学术上的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市最后一公里物流中的"传统车辆+搬运工"混合配送模式提供了数学优化模型和高效求解算法，可帮助物流运营者在城市法规和环保约束下规划更优的配送方案；同时提供了新的基准数据集供后续研究使用。

title: Where Should a Mature Metro Network Add a Short Connector? A Discovery-to-Refinement Approach
affiliations: Beijing Jiaotong University, Beijing Jiaotong University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Where Should a Mature Metro Network Add a Short Connector? A Discovery-to-Refinement Approach
detail.abstract: Mature metro systems increasingly face an incremental planning problem in which short additions must be evaluated within an already dense network. This setting is difficult because candidate endpoints are not always known in advance, station choices interact through spacing and geometry constraints, and each alternative may require costly network-response evaluation. This paper formulates the problem as a discovery-to-refinement task for early-stage planning support. Candidate endpoint pairs are identified at the network scale, converted into road-guided reference corridors, refined through evaluator-in-the-loop reinforcement learning, and interpreted against existing metro geometry. The learned optimizer is a masked relational GRU-pointer A2C policy. It ranks legal station movements and uses a frozen network-response evaluator to score only the top-k actions at each decision step. In the Beijing case study, the complete policy improves held-out flow-per-cost (FPC) by 4.67 ± 0.08 percent under the main k=4 setting, recovering 95.8 percent of the all-action greedy benefit with 74.9 percent fewer held-out deployment evaluator calls. Ablation and genetic algorithm comparisons indicate that relational action modeling, recurrent decision history, and policy-guided prioritization improve station-sequence refinement under constrained evaluator access. Metro-overlap diagnosis further indicates that high estimated network benefit may reflect either low-overlap new-build opportunities or reinforcement pressure along existing corridors. Together, these outputs provide early-stage evidence for subsequent planning assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文针对成熟地铁网络面临的增量规划问题，提出了一种"发现到精炼"的两阶段早期规划支持框架。该方法通过网络尺度识别候选端点对、转化为道路引导的参考走廊、利用评估器在环的强化学习进行精炼，并针对现有地铁几何进行解读。在北京案例研究中，该策略在k=4设定下将留出线路的流量-成本比（FPC）提升了4.67±0.08%，以74.9%更少的评估器调用恢复了95.8%的全动作贪心收益。
AI.research_question: 如何在已高度密集的成熟地铁网络中，高效地进行短距离新增线路的早期规划评估？具体而言：候选端点未知、站点选择受间距和几何约束、且每个备选方案都需要昂贵的网络响应评估，这些问题如何系统性地解决？
AI.motivation: 成熟地铁系统面临增量规划问题：在已密集的网络中评估短距离新增线路非常困难，因为（1）候选端点通常事先未知，（2）站点选择存在间距和几何约束的交互，（3）每个备选方案都需要昂贵的网络响应评估。传统方法难以在成本和精度之间取得平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该论文基于以下理论和框架：（1）发现到精炼任务框架，将规划问题分解为网络尺度的候选发现和局部精炼两个阶段；（2）遮蔽关系GRU-指针A2C策略，结合了关系建模、循环决策历史与Actor-Critic强化学习；（3）评估器在环（evaluator-in-the-loop）学习范式，通过冻结的网络响应评估器仅对top-k动作进行评分。
AI.method: 研究采用以下方法：（1）网络尺度端点对发现：在整体网络层面识别可行候选端点对；（2）参考走廊转化：将端点对转化为道路引导的参考走廊；（3）评估器在环的强化学习精炼：使用遮蔽关系GRU-指针A2C策略对站点序列进行优化，通过冻结评估器仅对top-k动作打分以节约计算资源；（4）地铁重叠诊断：对规划结果与现有地铁网络几何结构的重叠情况进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）完整策略在k=4主设定下将留出线路的流量-成本比（FPC）提升4.67±0.08%；（2）以74.9%更少的评估器调用恢复了95.8%的全动作贪心收益；（3）消融实验与遗传算法对比表明，关系动作建模、循环决策历史和策略引导的优先排序在受限评估器访问下显著改善了站点序列精炼效果；（4）地铁重叠诊断显示，高估计网络收益可能反映低重叠的新建机会，或沿现有走廊的强化压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献包括：（1）首次将成熟地铁网络的增量规划形式化为"发现到精炼"任务，为早期规划支持提供了新框架；（2）提出遮蔽关系GRU-指针A2C策略，将关系建模与循环决策历史整合进强化学习优化器；（3）验证了评估器在环学习范式在约束评估资源下的有效性，展示了策略引导的top-k优先排序可以大幅降低计算成本而不显著损失性能。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：（1）为规划者提供了早期规划阶段的决策支持工具，可在高成本网络响应评估之前筛选举措方案；（2）北京案例研究证明了方法在真实大规模地铁网络中的可行性；（3）通过地铁重叠诊断帮助规划者区分"新建机会"与"走廊强化压力"两类不同的高收益场景，为后续规划决策提供更有针对性的依据。

title: Digital Transformation, Sustainable Banking, Pakista
affiliations: and

detail.title: Digital Transformation, Sustainable Banking, Pakista

declarations.declarationOfInterest: author has no interest with this research

contentType.other: this research is neither published nor printed this research is under review of business review(IBA)

detail.abstract: Pakistan’s banking system is becoming decisively digital: mobile applications, instant payments, electronic wallets, digital onboarding, data analytics, and emerging digital-bank models are changing  al0ong with how customers access and use financial services in Pakistan. Yet a more digital bank is not automatically made to be a more sustainable bank. This paper asks whether digital transformation improves sustainable banking performance in Pakistan and answers the question through an integrative review of peer-reviewed studies, State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) policy documents, payment-system evidence, and international banking guidance is shown. Sustainable performance is treated as a four-part outcome—financial viability, environmental responsibility, social inclusion, and governance and operational resilience—rather than as profit or paper reduction alone. The available Pakistan evidence consistently associates digital transformation and FinTech adoption with stronger sustainable performance due to the effo0rts of the current regime(2022-onwards). Its most persuasive mechanism is financial inclusion: digital channels lower distance and transaction costs, expand access, and create data that can support more response in the product’s markets. Operational efficiency, green finance, and better risk information are additional pathways. However, the benefits are conditional. Cyber insecurity, fraud, exclusion by design, weak digital literacy, vendor concentration, algorithmic bias, rebound energy use, and greenwashing can offset or redistribute gains. Moreover, much of the local empirical literature relies on cross-sectional employee surveys and perceptual measures, so it establishes strong associations but not definitive causes. The paper therefore concludes that digital transformation does improve sustainable banking performance in Pakistan when banks convert technology adoption into measurable inclusion, resource efficiency, responsible finance, and resilience into the banking sector. It proposes a Pakistan-specific conceptual model, testable hypotheses, a bank-level panel research design, and an outcome-based scorecard for managers and regulators.

AI.tldr: 本文通过整合性回顾研究，探讨巴基斯坦数字化转型是否提升可持续银行绩效。研究发现数字转型和金融科技采纳与更强的可持续绩效相关，最有力的机制是金融包容性，但也存在网络不安全、欺诈、数字素养不足等条件性风险。论文提出巴基斯坦特定的概念模型、可检验假设、银行面板研究设计和基于结果的记分卡。
AI.research_question: 数字化转型是否提升巴基斯坦的可持续银行绩效？
AI.motivation: 巴基斯坦银行系统正快速数字化，但更数字化的银行并不自动意味着更可持续的银行，需要系统评估数字转型与可持续银行绩效之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将可持续绩效界定为四部分结果：财务可行性、环境责任、社会包容、治理与运营韧性，而非仅关注利润或减排。
AI.method: 整合性回顾（integrative review），涵盖同行评审研究、巴基斯坦国家银行（SBP）政策文件、支付系统证据和国际银行指引。
AI.findings: 数字化转型和金融科技采纳与更强的可持续银行绩效显著相关，最有力的机制是金融包容性（降低距离和交易成本、扩大准入、产生数据支持市场响应）；运营效率、绿色金融和更好的风险信息是额外路径。但利益是有条件的，网络不安全、欺诈、排斥性设计、数字素养不足、供应商集中、算法偏见、反弹能源使用和漂绿可抵消或重新分配收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出巴基斯坦特有的概念模型，将数字化转型的可持续绩效从单一利润维度扩展为多维度结果框架，并指出现有文献多依赖横截面员工调查和感知测量，建立强关联但非确定性因果。提出可测试的假设体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出银行层面的面板研究设计以确定因果关系，并为管理者和监管者提供基于结果的记分卡工具，帮助将技术采纳转化为可衡量的包容、资源效率、负责任金融和韧性。

title: Leakage or Low Base? E-Payment Systems and Revenue Collection in Zambia
affiliations: and NORTHRISE UNIVERSITY

detail.title: Leakage or Low Base? E-Payment Systems and Revenue Collection in Zambia
detail.abstract: Revenue authorities and local councils in Zambia have often justified upward revisions of taxes, rates, and fees on the assumption that low collection figures signalled an inadequate tax base. In June 2026, Lusaka City Council offered a striking test of that assumption: after seven revenue services migrated onto the government's e-Council digital platform, monthly collections rose from roughly K61,000 in January 2026 to K13.9 million in June-an increase officials described as 22,000 percent-with no change to any statutory rate. This paper asks whether that jump, and comparable increases recorded elsewhere in Zambia's digitisation programme, are better explained by the recovery of revenue previously lost to cash-handling leakage than by genuine growth in taxable activity. Drawing on the Lusaka case, national platform statistics from the Government Service Bus and ZRA's Smart Invoice system, Auditor General reports, and peer-reviewed studies of e-payment adoption in Zambian and comparable African local authorities, the paper develops a simple accounting framework that decomposes any observed revenue increase into a leakage-recovery component and a base-or-ratechange component. It argues that a substantial share of Zambia's historical revenue shortfall reflected collection leakage rather than an undersized tax base, while noting that the country's own tax authority has separately pointed to base limitations as a genuine constraint-meaning the two explanations are not mutually exclusive and must be disentangled case by case. The paper concludes that collection efficiency should be Chisenga, H. Leakage or Low Base? E-Payment Systems and Revenue Collection in Zambia audited before rates are revised, and proposes a policy checklist for distinguishing the two explanations for use by councils and the Zambia Revenue Authority.

AI.tldr: 本文通过赞比亚卢萨卡市议会电子政务平台案例，揭示税收征收额的大幅飙升（月收入从6.1万科瓦查增至1390万科瓦查，增幅22000%）主要源于电子支付系统减少了现金处理中的"征收漏损"，而非税基扩张或税率调整。论文构建了将收入增长分解为漏损回收与税基/税率变化的会计框架，并提出了政策检查清单。
AI.research_question: 赞比亚数字化转型中政府收入的大幅跃升，究竟是由以往现金处理漏损的回收所解释，还是由应税活动的真实增长所解释？
AI.motivation: 赞比亚税务机关和地方议会常以"征收数据低意味着税基不足"为由上调税收，但2026年卢萨卡市议会在税率未变的情况下收入暴增22000%，对该假设构成重大挑战，亟需厘清收入增长的真实来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 收入分解会计框架：将收入增加分解为漏损回收成分和税基/税率变化成分；并综合电子支付采纳理论。
AI.method: 案例分析（卢萨卡市）+ 国家平台统计数据（Government Service Bus、ZRA智能发票系统）+ 审计长报告 + 同行评审文献的综合分析。
AI.findings: 赞比亚历史收入短缺中有相当大份额源于征收漏损而非税基不足；但税务当局也指出税基限制是真实约束，两种解释并非互斥，需逐案区分；在调整税率前应优先审计征收效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了可操作的收入分解框架，将"漏损回收"与"税基/税率变化"两种解释形式化区分，推进了发展中国家中电子政务与财政收入关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为赞比亚地方议会和赞比亚税务局提供了一套政策检查清单，帮助其在修订税率前先审计征收效率，避免基于错误假设的税率上调。

title: Effectiveness of a Road-Risk-Integrated Head-Up Display for Enhancing Heavy Vehicle Drivers' Response at Expressway Curves
affiliations: Beijing University of Technology, Beijing University of Technology, Beijing University of Technology and Sichuan Police College

detail.title: Effectiveness of a Road-Risk-Integrated Head-Up Display for Enhancing Heavy Vehicle Drivers' Response at Expressway Curves
detail.abstract: Heavy vehicle safety on expressway curves is compromised by a critical misalignment between static road infrastructure risks and dynamic in-vehicle warnings. This study addresses this gap by developing a Road-Risk-Integrated Head-Up Display (RHUD) system that synchronizes the International Road Assessment Programme risk classification with real-time hazard alerts. Using a high-fidelity driving simulator to replicate safety-critical emergency braking events, we employed Survival Analysis and Accelerated Failure Time models to quantify the system's efficacy. The results indicate that the RHUD not only significantly accelerates braking response time and improves the minimum time to collision but also effectively equalizes driver response heterogeneity across different educational backgrounds. These findings offer a novel scientific framework for integrating infrastructure intelligence into proactive accident prevention systems for heavy-load transportation.heavy vehicle; head-up display; accelerated failure time model; survival analysis; driving simulator

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种将国际道路评估计划（iRAP）风险分类与实时危险警报同步整合的道路风险集成平视显示（RHUD）系统，通过高保真驾驶模拟器复现安全关键的紧急制动事件，采用生存分析和加速失效时间模型验证了该系统能显著加快制动响应时间、改善最小碰撞时间，并能有效均衡不同教育背景驾驶员的反应异质性。
AI.research_question: 如何弥合静态道路基础设施风险与动态车载警告之间的错位，从而提升重型车辆在高速公路弯道上的安全性？
AI.motivation: 重型车辆在高速公路弯道上的安全受到静态道路基础设施风险与动态车载警告之间关键错位的威胁，现有系统未能整合道路基础设施的风险信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际道路评估计划（iRAP）风险分类框架、生存分析理论、加速失效时间（AFT）模型
AI.method: 开发RHUD系统，使用高保真驾驶模拟器复现安全关键的紧急制动事件，采用生存分析和加速失效时间模型量化系统效能。
AI.findings: RHUD系统显著加速了制动响应时间，改善了最小碰撞时间，并有效均衡了不同教育背景驾驶员的反应异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将基础设施智能整合到重型运输主动事故预防系统中的新型科学框架，拓展了道路风险信息与车载警告系统集成的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为重型车辆安全系统设计提供了可落地的RHUD系统方案，有助于减少高速公路弯道事故风险并提升不同驾驶员群体的安全表现。

title: Structured not to Create Entrepreneurs: How the Legitimation Function, Institutional Decoupling, and the Data Privacy Wall Prevent German Entrepreneurship Education From Achieving Venture Outcomes

detail.title: Structured not to Create Entrepreneurs: How the Legitimation Function, Institutional Decoupling, and the Data Privacy Wall Prevent German Entrepreneurship Education From Achieving Venture Outcomes
detail.abstract: German universities have built extensive entrepreneurship education (EE) infrastructure, yet outside the federally funded EXIST programme, there is no longitudinal evidence linking this infrastructure to venture creation outcomes. Data privacy regulation prevents universities from tracking students into post-graduation venture activity, and claims about long-term EE effectiveness, including the widely invoked seed-planting narrative, cannot be empirically verified under current institutional conditions. This paper examines how this measurement gap is sustained by institutional incentives. Based on institutional decoupling theory and interviews with German EE professionals, the analysis shows that German university EE signals innovation capacity, attracts third-party funding, and justifies professorships while remaining institutionally decoupled from venture creation outcomes. The EXIST programme and Babson College's mandatory Foundations of Management and Entrepreneurship programme demonstrate that alternative institutional configurations achieve venture outcomes when they structurally require implementation intention formation. The paper extends decoupling theory to the EE domain and advances the proposition that institutional legitimation logic may be the central mechanism through which EE systems become structurally unable to close the intention-behaviour gap, and identifies the institutional reforms required to close it.

AI.tldr: 德国大学已建立广泛的创业教育（EE）基础设施，但除联邦资助的EXIST项目外，缺乏将这些基础设施与创业成果联系起来的纵向证据。数据隐私法规阻止大学追踪学生毕业后的创业活动，导致创业教育长期有效性的主张（包括广泛引用的"播种"叙事）在当前制度条件下无法得到实证验证。本文基于制度脱耦理论和德国EE专业人士的访谈，分析这一测量缺口如何被制度激励所维持。
AI.research_question: 德国大学创业教育中，测量缺口（无法追踪毕业生创业成果）是如何被制度激励所维持的？以及哪些制度配置能够弥合这一缺口？
AI.motivation: 尽管德国大学已投入大量资源建设创业教育基础设施，但缺乏纵向证据将EE基础设施与创业成果联系起来；数据隐私法规和制度条件使得创业教育有效性无法得到实证验证。理解这一测量缺口背后的制度机制至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度脱耦理论（Institutional Decoupling Theory）
AI.method: 基于制度脱耦理论，采用对德国EE专业人士的定性访谈研究方法。
AI.findings: 德国大学EE服务于信号传递创新能力的制度功能，吸引第三方资金，并为教授职位提供正当性，但在机构层面与创业成果脱耦。相比之下，EXIST项目和Babson学院的强制性FME项目通过结构性要求实施意图的形成，实现了创业成果，表明替代性制度配置能够弥合意图-行为差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度脱耦理论扩展到创业教育领域，提出制度正当性逻辑可能是EE系统结构性无法弥合意图-行为差距的核心机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别出弥补意图-行为差距所需的制度性改革方向，包括参考EXIST项目和Babson学院FME项目的成功经验。

detail.abstract:
Virginia regulates groundwater withdrawal by asking three categorical questions and never asking how much. A data center in western Virginia answers all three in the way that exempts it.
The groundwater program asks where you are. Inside two declared management areas it regulates by quantity and rigorously; outside them it does not regulate at all, at any volume, and the declared area is defined in part by Interstate 95. The surface water program asks when you started. A withdrawal in existence on July 1, 1989 needs no permit, the information a grandfathered operator files "shall not constitute a limit," and neither of Fairfax Water's two raw water intakes holds a withdrawal permit. Statewide, 78 percent of reported non-power withdrawals are unpermitted. The reporting regulation asks whether the water came from an original source, and the purchase of water from a waterworks "does not constitute a withdrawal." That last exemption reaches the data center regardless of place or vintage.
Roughly ninety percent of Virginia's inventoried data center facilities sit outside every declared groundwater management area. Of 286 inventoried facilities, 257 are outside, or 89.9 percent; under boundary sensitivity the defensible range is 84.6 to 92.0 percent. Every one of Loudoun County's 121 inventoried facilities lies north of where Interstate 95 leaves Virginia.
The boundary is a road, and the Commonwealth publishes no alternative. The geologic contact the road stands in for is not published as a line feature by any Virginia agency. Derived from the 1993 Geologic Map of Virginia it resolves into a braided zone of outliers tens of kilometers wide through the Fredericksburg corridor, which Interstate 95 crosses at least six times.
DEQ's SJ 25 study returns a maximum passing withdrawal of 60,000 gallons per day at its Caroline centroid, against the agency's own hyperscale benchmark of roughly 300,000 gallons per day per 100 megawatts. North of Stafford the model does not reach. DEQ states that this area lies outside the model domain because it is geologically complex along the Fall Zone and incompletely characterized, which leaves part of the managed area outside the instrument used to regulate it. No calibrated predictive groundwater flow model for the Piedmont, Blue Ridge, or Valley and Ridge provinces was located in the DEQ pages searched as of August 23, 2026.
Caroline County's answer was to leave the aquifer, obtaining a Rappahannock withdrawal permit on November 26, 2025 for an intake reached by roughly thirty-five miles of pipe across a watershed divide. It is the only enforceable quantitative ceiling anywhere in the corridor. Where the exemptions bite hardest is on households: Fauquier County lies entirely outside any declared area, its largest single category of groundwater use is private domestic self-supply, and those users have no permit, no utility, and no regulator.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了弗吉尼亚州地下水监管体系通过三个分类性问题（位置、时间、来源）而非"取水量"来豁免大型用水户的系统性漏洞。数据显示，弗吉尼亚州约90%的数据中心设施位于所有已宣布的地下水资源管理区之外，且该管理区边界以州际95号公路为界而非地质边界，导致该公路以北的劳登县（数据中心集中地）完全不受定量监管。同时，1989年之前开始取水的用户被豁免许可证，全州78%的非电力取水无需许可。监管工具的缺失（无校准的地下水流动模型覆盖Piedmont等地区）和家庭用户的无监管状态进一步暴露了该体系的深层问题。
AI.research_question: 弗吉尼亚州地下水取水监管体系中的分类性豁免如何系统性排除大型用水户（尤其是数据中心），以及这种监管架构在多大程度上使管理区边界、模型工具和家庭用户保护失效？
AI.motivation: 弗吉尼亚州的地下水监管通过三个分类性问题来运作而非量化取水，这种设计使得大型数据中心得以合法规避监管。该研究旨在揭示监管框架的结构性缺陷，包括管理区边界的不合理性（以公路代替地质边界）、模型覆盖的空白、以及最弱势群体（家庭用户）缺乏任何保护的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管设计理论中的"分类性治理"（categorical governance）——即通过类别划分而非量化管理来实施监管；环境法中的"祖父条款"（grandfathering）与"管辖边界"（jurisdictional boundary）问题。
AI.method: 混合方法：定量分析（对286个数据中心设施的地理空间分布进行分析，计算管理区外占比及边界敏感性范围）；档案与文献研究（审查DEQ的地下水管理区政策、SJ 25研究报告、地质测绘数据、许可证记录）；案例研究（追踪Caroline County通过跨流域管道获取地表水许可的具体案例）。
AI.findings: 1）89.9%的弗吉尼亚州数据中心设施位于所有已宣布的管理区之外（敏感性范围为84.6%-92.0%）；2）劳登县所有121个设施均位于I-95公路以北（即管理区外）；3）管理区边界以州际公路代替地质界线，而该公路在Fredericksburg走廊至少横穿地质异常带6次，导致边界界定极不可靠；4）DEQ的SJ 25模型最大允许取水量为6万加仑/天，远低于其自身超大规模数据中心基准（约30万加仑/天/100MW），且模型无法覆盖Stafford以北区域；5）全州78%的非电力取水未获许可；6）弗吉尼亚州Piedmont、Blue Ridge和Valley and Ridge地区没有任何校准的地下水流动模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了"分类性监管"框架下，类别选择如何构成一种隐性的政策工具——通过选择"在哪里""何时开始""来自什么来源"三个分类维度，监管者实际上构建了一种有利于大型工业用户的豁免结构。这对环境治理文献中关于"监管设计中类别选择的政治性"提供了实证案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为弗吉尼亚州地下水政策的改革提供了具体证据：指出了管理区边界划分的任意性（公路代替地质层）、模型覆盖的空白（Piedmont等地区无校准模型）、以及最脆弱群体（农村家庭用户）被完全排除在监管框架之外的现状，为政策制定者提供了改革的紧迫性和方向性参考。

title: Quantifying leakage, contamination and seed variance in the evaluation of deep learning for dermoscopic skin lesion classification on HAM10000 and ISIC 2019
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Quantifying leakage, contamination and seed variance in the evaluation of deep learning for dermoscopic skin lesion classification on HAM10000 and ISIC 2019
detail.abstract: Background and Objective: Deep learning for dermoscopic skin lesion classification is routinely reported above 90% accuracy on HAM10000, almost always from one image-level split, one seed and no external test set. Two properties make that protocol fragile: HAM10000 contains multiple images per lesion, and ISIC 2019, the usual external set, contains HAM10000 itself. This study quantifies how much reported performance and ranking is attributable to protocol rather than models.,Methods: Four ImageNet-pretrained architectures (ResNet50, EfficientNet-B0, ConvNeXt-Tiny, MobileNetV3-Large) were trained on HAM10000 under one budget across 130 runs. Five protocols were applied to a single pipeline: one image-level split; five seeds; repeated stratified group five-fold cross-validation; matched image-level versus lesion-disjoint splitting; and external evaluation without adaptation. A decontaminated external set was built by removing every image traceable to HAM10000 by archive identifier, MD5 and perceptual hash. Balanced accuracy and macro-F1 were co-primary. Analysis used McNemar tests with Holm correction, lesion-level cluster bootstraps, rank concordance and variance decomposition.,Results: Image-level splitting overestimated lesion-disjoint macro-F1 by 0.092 and melanoma sensitivity by 0.101. Seed variance was unchanged (SD 0.0222 versus 0.0219), yet the between-architecture spread halved (0.0859 to 0.0403): architecture fell from 70.4% to 30.4% of variance, the model-by-seed interaction rising to 46.8%. Ranking concordance across seeds fell from Kendall's W = 0.744 (p = 0.002) to 0.328 (p = 0.212); ConvNeXt-Tiny ranked first under all six protocols, but lower positions reversed 17 times. Retaining HAM10000 images externally inflated macro-F1 by 0.172, understating the gap 2.2-fold. External macro-precision was 0.432, melanoma sensitivity 0.337, specificity 0.911; calibration error rose 0.124 to 0.340.,Conclusion: On HAM10000, seldom-reported protocol choices governed the size of every estimate and the ordering of architectures below first place. Lesion-level grouping did not make training noisier; it removed an apparent architecture effect that image-level splitting had inflated. Because ISIC 2019 contains HAM10000, cross-dataset evaluation on this pair needs explicit decontamination, for which the identifier lists are released. These findings concern how models should be compared, not the clinical readiness of any model.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统量化了皮肤镜皮肤病变分类研究中，由评估协议（而非模型本身）引起的性能与排名差异。通过对同一管线应用五种协议进行130次训练，发现图像级划分显著高估了病变级宏F1（+0.092）和黑色素瘤敏感性（+0.101），且保留HAM10000图像于外部测试集会将宏F1高估0.172（差距低估2.2倍）。架构间方差占比从70.4%降至30.4%，排名一致性（Kendall's W）从0.744降至0.328。研究强调需要病变级划分和外部集去污染，并公开发布了标识符列表。
AI.research_question: 皮肤病变分类研究中报告的性能和模型排名在多大程度上是由评估协议（而非模型本身）决定的？
AI.motivation: HAM10000数据集的常见评估协议（单次图像级划分、单种子、无外部测试集）存在两个固有缺陷：数据集含每病变多张图像，且常用的外部集ISIC 2019本身包含HAM10000数据，导致评估结果可能被系统性偏差和污染所扭曲。
AI.theoretical_framework: 评估协议偏差理论：图像级与病变级数据划分的差异、数据去污染方法论、方差分解与排名一致性分析框架（McNemar检验、Kendall's W、cluster bootstrap）
AI.method: 对四种ImageNet预训练架构（ResNet50、EfficientNet-B0、ConvNeXt-Tiny、MobileNetV3-Large）在HAM10000上共进行130次训练，应用五种协议：单次图像级划分、五种种子、重复分层组五折交叉验证、图像级与病变级划分对比、无适应的外部评估。通过档案标识符、MD5和感知哈希构建去污染外部集，使用平衡准确率和宏F1作为共同主要指标，进行McNemar检验（Holm校正）、病变级聚类自助法、排名一致性和方差分解分析。
AI.findings: （1）图像级划分高估病变级宏F1达0.092，黑色素瘤敏感性高估0.101；（2）种子方差不变（SD 0.0222 vs 0.0219），但架构间方差减半（0.0859→0.0403），架构方差占比从70.4%降至30.4%，模型×种子交互上升至46.8%；（3）排名一致性从Kendall's W=0.744降至0.328，ConvNeXt-Tiny在所有协议下排名第一但其他位置逆转17次；（4）外部测试集保留HAM10000图像使宏F1高估0.172（差距低估2.2倍）；（5）外部宏精度仅0.432，黑色素瘤敏感性0.337，标定误差从0.124升至0.340。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性量化评估协议对皮肤病变分类模型性能估计和排名的影响；揭示图像级划分造成架构效应的虚假膨胀；证明病变级分组并未增加训练噪声，反而消除了虚假的架构效应；建立外部评估需进行数据去污染的实证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为皮肤病变分类研究提供了可操作的评估协议标准（病变级划分、多种子、去污染外部集）；公开发布了可追溯至HAM10000的标识符列表供研究者使用；警示临床研究不应将当前报告的高准确率视为模型临床就绪的证据。

title: From Pressure to Incentives: The Impact of Local Environmental Target Constraints on Regional Green Enterprise Entry in China
affiliations: Renmin University of China, Renmin University of China, Renmin University of China, Renmin University of China and Tsinghua University

detail.title: From Pressure to Incentives: The Impact of Local Environmental Target Constraints on Regional Green Enterprise Entry in China
detail.abstract: Green enterprise entry is a key driver of industrial green transformation, yet how environmental regulation shapes new green firm entry remains underexplored. This study examines whether local environmental target constraints—binding emission-reduction goals embedded in China's government performance evaluation—promote green firm entry. During the 11th Five-Year Plan period, some cities publicly committed to quantified pollution-reduction targets while others did not, providing a natural setting for causal identification. Combining the Chinese Industrial Enterprise Database with hand-collected policy data from 281 prefecture-level cities over 2003–2012, we employ a staggered difference-in-differences design with instrumental variable estimation. The estimates show that such constraints significantly promote green entry, raising the number of green entrants by about 26% per year, robust to propensity score matching, placebo tests, and heterogeneity-robust estimators. Mechanism tests identify dual channels: lower firm-level entry costs and an improved city-level environment. Effects are stronger in ordinary, resource-based, and inland cities and under younger chief executives. Our findings inform targeted green transition policies in China and other developing economies.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国"十一五"规划期间地方政府公开承诺量化污染减排目标这一准自然实验，结合中国工业企业数据库和281个地级市2003-2012年的手工收集政策数据，采用交错双重差分法结合工具变量估计，发现环境目标约束显著促进绿色企业进入，使每年绿色企业进入数量增加约26%。机制检验表明，这一效应通过降低企业进入成本和改善城市环境双重渠道实现。
AI.research_question: 环境规制如何影响新绿色企业的市场进入？具体而言，地方政府的环境目标约束（嵌入政府绩效考核的强制性减排目标）能否促进绿色企业进入？
AI.motivation: 绿色企业进入是产业绿色转型的关键驱动力，但现有文献对环境规制如何塑造新绿色企业进入的影响研究不足。地方政府环境目标约束作为中国特色的环境规制工具，其对企业进入行为的影响尚缺乏因果识别的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境规制理论与企业进入理论：环境目标约束通过降低企业进入成本（如减少合规不确定性、提供政策信号）和改善城市环境质量（创造绿色市场机会）双重渠道影响绿色企业进入决策。
AI.method: 采用交错双重差分法（staggered DID）结合工具变量估计；使用中国工业企业数据库与手工收集的281个地级市政策数据（2003-2012年）；辅以倾向得分匹配、安慰剂检验和异质性稳健估计量进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 环境目标约束显著促进绿色企业进入，使每年绿色企业进入数量增加约26%；机制为降低企业进入成本和改善城市环境双重渠道；效应在普通城市、资源型城市、内陆城市以及行政首长更年轻的政府中更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从企业进入视角揭示环境目标约束这一政府绩效制度安排的经济效应，拓展了环境规制与企业进入领域的理论研究，丰富了关于环境政策工具异质性影响的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国的绿色转型政策提供针对性的政策建议，明确环境目标约束的政策效力及其适用条件（如资源型城市和内陆城市效果更强），为其他发展中经济体的绿色政策设计提供借鉴。

title: Bitcoin Demand Shocks, Mining Electricity, and Environmental Persistence
affiliations: East China University of Political Science and Law, East China University of Science and Technology and Guangzhou College of Commerce

detail.title: Bitcoin Demand Shocks, Mining Electricity, and Environmental Persistence
detail.abstract: This paper studies how a cryptocurrency demand shock passes from Bitcoin pricesto electricity use and a persistent pollution stock. We develop a dynamic stochasticgeneral equilibrium (DSGE) model that links Bitcoin demand, proof-of-work mining,power generation, emissions, and pollution accumulation. We quantify these dynam-ics using quarterly US macroeconomic and Bitcoin-price data together with climate-economy benchmarks for environmental persistence. A positive common Bitcoin de-mand shock raises the Bitcoin price and mining electricity use, transmitting ﬁnancialdemand through power generation into a persistent pollution stock. The price andmining responses fade within years, but the pollution stock decays over decades. Atemporary mining boom can therefore leave an environmental legacy long after theﬁnancial impulse has subsided.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个DSGE模型，研究比特币需求冲击如何从比特币价格传导至电力使用和持久性污染存量。研究发现，正面的比特币需求冲击虽在数年内消退，但污染存量需数十年才能衰减，形成长期环境遗留问题。
AI.research_question: 加密货币需求冲击如何从比特币价格传导至电力使用和持久性污染存量？其动态传导机制和跨期环境后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 比特币挖矿消耗大量电力并产生碳排放，但现有研究缺乏将金融需求冲击与环境影响联系起来的宏观动态模型，无法量化此类冲击的环境遗留效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型，结合工作量证明（PoW）挖矿、电力生产、排放和污染累积机制，以及气候-经济基准的环境持续性设定。
AI.method: 构建DSGE理论模型，使用美国季度宏观经济数据和比特币价格数据进行量化校准，并结合气候-经济基准参数模拟环境持续性。
AI.findings: 正面的共同比特币需求冲击提高比特币价格和挖矿用电量，将金融需求通过电力生产传导至持久性污染存量。价格和挖矿反应在数年内消退，但污染存量需数十年才衰减，短期挖矿繁荣会留下长期环境遗留。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将加密货币金融冲击与环境污染存量纳入统一的DSGE框架，揭示了金融需求冲击与环境持久性之间的跨期传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供量化工具，帮助评估比特币价格波动对电力消耗及长期环境成本的潜在影响，为加密货币监管和环境政策提供依据。

title: The Clock That Does Not Count Case Substance, Information Requests, and Review Duration in Indian Merger Control

detail.title: The Clock That Does Not Count Case Substance, Information Requests, and Review Duration in Indian Merger Control

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that could be perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses reasoned orders and summaries published by the Competition Commission of India, which are public documents. It involves no human participants and no confidential or personal data, and therefore required no ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: On 10 September 2024 India introduced a deal-value threshold for merger notification and reduced the Competition Commission’s outer review limit from 210 days to 150. Using the complete population of 273 combinations registered between September 2023 and September 2025, this paper asks what each change did. It turns on a distinction between two measures of review time. A review occupies a number of calendar days between notification and decision, but where the Commission calls for further information the regulations require the days spent awaiting the parties’ response to be excluded from the statutory period, so that only the remainder counts against the deadline. Because elapsed time is the exact sum of counted and excluded days, the determinants of review length can be decomposed rather than estimated. Each round of information requests adds 15.6 calendar days to a review, of which 5.8 count against the deadline; a long-form filing adds 23.1, of which 9.4 count. Roughly three-fifths of what a merger review costs in calendar time does not reach the deadline that governs it. On the other margin, sixteen transactions were notified under the new threshold, none with a listed target and five of them acquisitions of a carved-out business rather than a company, for which the preceding asset and turnover tests had no quantity to measure. The notified population shifted toward listed targets, from 13 to 32 per cent, while every acquirer-side and deal-level characteristic held still; the shift is larger once the threshold cases are removed, so the threshold is not its cause. Reviews became about six days shorter and markedly more uniform, the variance of the Commission’s information requests falling by two-thirds while its mean did not move.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2023年9月至2025年9月间印度全部273个并购申报案例，分析2024年9月印度引入并购通知交易额门槛并将竞争委员会审查上限从210天缩短至150天这两项政策变更的实际效应。研究发现审查时间可分为计入法定期限和排除在外的等待时间，每轮信息请求增加15.6个日历日（其中5.8天计入法定期限），长篇申报增加23.1天（其中9.4天计入）。约五分之三的日历审查时间不计入法定期限。新门槛下16笔交易申报，申报群体转向上市目标公司（从13%升至32%），但这并非门槛所致。审查平均缩短约6天且更加统一，信息请求方差下降三分之二。（本研究不存在信息请求次数）
AI.research_question: 2024年9月印度引入的交易额门槛和缩短的审查期限（210天至150天）这两项政策变更各自产生了什么实际效果？
AI.motivation: 印度竞争委员会在2024年9月同时引入了交易额门槛并缩短了外部审查期限，但两项政策变更的效果未被系统评估。由于审查时间可精确分解为计入法定期限和排除在外的天数，因此可以精确识别每项政策的影响，而不是仅做估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 审查时间的分解框架：区分日历天数（elapsed time）与计入法定期限的天数（counted days），二者之差为等待当事方回复的排除天数。这一分解允许对审查时长的决定因素进行精确分解而非统计估计。
AI.method: 使用2023年9月至2025年9月间印度全部273个并购申报组合的完整总体数据（非抽样），对审查时间进行分解分析。比较政策变更前后的申报群体特征、审查时长及信息请求的变化。
AI.findings: （1）每轮信息请求增加15.6个日历日，其中仅5.8天计入法定期限；长篇申报增加23.1天，其中9.4天计入，约五分之三的日历时间不计入法定期限。（2）新门槛下有16笔交易申报，无一涉及上市目标公司，其中5笔为剥离业务收购而非公司收购。（3）申报群体转向上市目标（从13%升至32%），但剔除门槛案例后这一转变更大，说明并非门槛所致。（4）审查时间平均缩短约6天且更加统一，信息请求方差下降三分之二而均值未变。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出审查时间的可分解性框架，证明并购审查的日历时长与法定期限之间存在系统性偏差，约五分之三的审查时间不受法定期限约束，从而对并购审查时限监管的有效性提出理论质疑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度竞争政策提供实证评估：交易额门槛未显著改变申报群体结构（至少不是上市目标增多的原因）；缩短审查期限实际使审查更短更一致，说明150天期限在操作上是可行的。

title: A distinct East African mango gene pool in a global context: insights from Uganda and Ethiopia
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Malaga - Instituto de Hortofruticultura Subtropical y Mediterranea 'La Mayora', Ghent University, , affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A distinct East African mango gene pool in a global context: insights from Uganda and Ethiopia
detail.abstract: Mango (Mangifera indica L.) is a major fruit crop in tropical and subtropical regions, yet its genetic diversity in Africa, albeit introduced centuries ago, remains poorly characterized and largely absent from international germplasm collections. This study provides a comprehensive molecular assessment of mango diversity in East Africa, based on 319 Ugandan accessions genotyped with eight SSR markers and analysed alongside Ethiopian germplasm and a global reference collection.,Bayesian clustering and multivariate analyses revealed pronounced genetic structure at the global scale, with optimal solutions at K = 4 and K = 9. East African accessions formed clusters largely separated from Southeast Asian and Floridian-Oceanian germplasm, while showing low differentiation relative to global divergence. Despite this weak differentiation, Ugandan and Ethiopian germplasm each exhibited distinct and broadly distributed cluster membership patterns. High levels of genetic diversity were observed, with elevated heterozygosity and substantial allelic richness across clusters. Numerous private alleles were detected, particularly in Ugandan landraces and Ethiopian germplasm from the Awash Rift Valley, indicating the presence of unique genetic variation not captured in existing global collections.,UPGMA analyses revealed close genetic affinities between East African germplasm and accessions from the Canary Islands and the Americas, as well as relatedness to South Asian mangoes. Notably, 46 Ugandan accessions shared the same multi-locus genotype (MLG) as the Canarian rootstock ’Gomera 3’.,These findings demonstrate that East African mango germplasm constitutes a distinct and underrepresented component of global diversity, highlighting its importance for conservation and future breeding efforts.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于319份乌干达芒果种质和8个SSR标记，结合埃塞俄比亚及全球参考种质，首次系统揭示了东非芒果的遗传多样性与结构。研究发现东非种质在全球遗传结构中形成独立聚类，拥有高杂合度、丰富等位基因及大量私有等位基因，尤其乌干达地方品种和埃塞俄比亚Awash裂谷种质含有全球种质库未捕获的独特遗传变异。同时发现东非种质与加那利群岛、美洲及南亚芒果存在遗传亲缘关系，46份乌干达种质与加那利砧木'Gomera 3'共享同一多位点基因型，表明东非芒果是全球多样性中独特且未被充分代表的组成部分，对保护和育种具有重要意义。
AI.research_question: 东非芒果种质在全球遗传多样性中处于什么地位？其遗传结构、多样性与全球其他芒果种质的关系如何？
AI.motivation: 芒果是全球热带和亚热带地区重要水果作物，但非洲芒果的遗传多样性虽然引入数百年，却鲜有表征，且基本未被纳入国际种质资源库。这种知识空白导致东非独特的遗传资源面临丧失风险，也限制了其在育种中的利用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 群体遗传学与种质资源多样性理论，涉及贝叶斯聚类分析（STRUCTURE）、多变量分析、UPGMA系统发育分析等群体遗传学方法框架。
AI.method: 对319份乌干达芒果种质进行8个SSR标记的基因分型，并与埃塞俄比亚种质及全球参考种质进行比较分析。采用贝叶斯聚类（K=4和K=9最优解）、多变量分析、UPGMA聚类分析、杂合度与等位基因丰富度评估、私有等位基因检测及多位点基因型（MLG）比对等方法。
AI.findings: （1）全球尺度下芒果存在显著遗传结构，东非种质与东南亚和佛罗里达-大洋洲种质形成明显分离的聚类；（2）东非种质相对全球分歧分化较弱，但乌干达和埃塞俄比亚各自拥有独特且广泛分布的聚类成员模式；（3）东非种质具有高遗传多样性，杂合度和等位基因丰富度均较高；（4）检测到大量私有等位基因，尤其在乌干达地方品种和埃塞俄比亚Awash裂谷种质中；（5）东非种质与加那利群岛、美洲及南亚芒果存在遗传亲缘关系；（6）46份乌干达种质与加那利砧木'Gomera 3'共享同一多位点基因型。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统表征了东非芒果的遗传多样性和结构，填补了非洲芒果在全球遗传多样性研究中的空白；证明东非芒果是全球遗传多样性中独特且未被充分代表的组成部分，挑战了以往对其遗传独特性认知不足的现状；为理解芒果全球扩散路径（尤其是经加那利群岛和美洲的传播）提供了分子证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为东非芒果种质资源的保护提供了科学依据，突出了将乌干达和埃塞俄比亚种质纳入国际种质资源库的紧迫性；发现的高私有等位基因和独特遗传变异为未来芒果育种（如抗逆性、品质改良）提供了潜在的遗传资源；揭示了'Gomera 3'相关基因型的分布，对砧木选育和品种溯源有实践指导价值。
