title: The Discipline of Doubt: Root-Cause Rigour in Operations Management, with Evidence from Ghana's Business Process Outsourcing Sector

detail.title: The Discipline of Doubt: Root-Cause Rigour in Operations Management, with Evidence from Ghana's Business Process Outsourcing Sector
detail.abstract: Six Sigma's DMAIC methodology (Define, Measure, Analyse, Improve, Control) is widely adopted across industry, yet operations management scholars consider it under-theorised relative to its practical spread (Linderman et al., 2003). Most treatments of the methodology emphasis its statistical tools; fewer examine the epistemic discipline it imposes on organisational decisionmaking: requiring that a proposed cause be measured against evidence before action is taken. This paper argues that the Analyse phase of DMAIC functions primarily as a check against premature attribution, a pattern relevant well beyond manufacturing settings. It situates this argument within Ghana's rapidly expanding business process outsourcing (BPO) sector, where formal quality-management adoption has been studied mainly in manufacturing and pharmaceutical contexts (Tetteh et al., 2024) and remains comparatively undocumented in the country's fast-growing contact-centre industry. A stylised, composite case drawn from contactcentre operations illustrates the argument. The paper closes with implications for practitioners and an agenda for future empirical research on process-improvement adoption in Africa's outsourcing economies.

AI.tldr: 本文论证六西格玛DMAIC方法论的"分析（Analyse）"阶段本质上是对"过早归因"（premature attribution）的一种认知纪律约束，即要求在采取行动前必须用证据检验所提出的原因。作者将该论点置于加纳快速扩张的业务流程外包（BPO）领域，特别是联系中心行业，通过一个综合案例加以说明，并为非洲外包经济体的流程改进采纳研究提出未来议程。
AI.research_question: DMAIC方法论中的"分析"阶段如何在组织决策中发挥对"过早归因"的认知纪律约束作用？这一机制在加纳联系中心行业如何体现？
AI.motivation: 六西格玛DMAIC方法论在工业界被广泛采用，但运营管理学者认为其相对于实践传播而言理论化不足（Linderman et al., 2003）。大多数研究强调其统计工具，较少考察该方法论对组织决策施加的认知纪律。此外，加纳BPO部门的正式质量管理采纳在制造业和制药领域已有研究，但联系中心行业缺乏文献记录。
AI.theoretical_framework: 六西格玛DMAIC方法论（定义、测量、分析、改进、控制）；认知纪律与过早归因（premature attribution）概念；质量管理的认识论维度。
AI.method: 概念性论证辅以加纳联系中心运营的"风格化综合案例"（stylised composite case）。
AI.findings: DMAIC的分析阶段主要功能是防止过早归因——即在行动前要求用证据衡量所提出的原因，这一模式在制造业之外的场景（如服务外包）同样适用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将六西格玛方法论从统计工具视角转向认识论/认知纪律视角，为DMAIC分析阶段的理论化提供新解释；扩展了质量管理采纳研究的场景范围（从制造业到非洲服务外包）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为联系中心管理者和BPO从业者提供关于过程改进中认知约束的实践启示；为非洲外包经济体（特别是加纳）的流程改进采纳提供研究议程。

title: Local Volatility Extensions: Multi-Curve and Stochastic Volatility
affiliations: Lomonosov Moscow State University and

detail.title: Local Volatility Extensions: Multi-Curve and Stochastic Volatility
detail.abstract: This paper develops a practical local and local stochastic volatility framework for interest-rate derivatives. We derive an exact multicurve extension of the local volatility formula under a deterministic basis assumption that is consistent with distinct discounting and forward curves and preserves the calibration to the swaption implied volatility surface. We then introduce a local stochastic volatility extension that maintains the vanilla fit while providing richer forward smile dynamics. The proposed framework is particularly relevant for exotic interest-rate derivatives whose values are sensitive to the swaption smile and its evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个实用的本地和本地随机波动率框架，用于利率衍生品定价。在确定性基差假设下推导了精确的多曲线扩展的本地波动率公式，与不同的贴现曲线和远期曲线保持一致，并保留了掉期期权隐含波动率曲面的校准能力。随后引入本地随机波动率扩展，在保持香草期权拟合的同时提供更丰富的远期微笑动态。该框架特别适用于对掉期期权微笑及其演变敏感的外来利率衍生品。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个既实用又能精确校准利率衍生品市场（特别是多曲线环境下的掉期期权隐含波动率曲面）的本地波动率和本地随机波动率框架，同时能够提供丰富的远期微笑动态？
AI.motivation: 利率衍生品定价需要同时满足对掉期期权微笑曲面的精确校准，以及对远期微笑动态的合理刻画。现有本地波动率模型难以同时兼顾多曲线框架下的精确校准与前瞻性微笑动态，而随机波动率模型虽然能提供更丰富的动态，但常以牺牲香草校准精度为代价。因此需要开发一个统一的实用框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本地波动率模型（Local Volatility）、本地随机波动率模型（Local Stochastic Volatility, LSV）、多曲线利率框架（Multicurve Framework）、确定性基差假设（Deterministic Basis Assumption）、掉期期权隐含波动率校准理论
AI.method: 本文采用理论推导与建模方法：（1）在确定性基差假设下，推导精确的多曲线扩展本地波动率公式；（2）将该公式扩展至本地随机波动率框架；（3）验证所提框架在保持香草期权校准的同时，提供更丰富的远期微笑动态。
AI.findings: 该框架成功实现了在确定性基差假设下与多曲线框架（区分贴现曲线和远期曲线）的一致性，同时保持了掉期期权隐含波动率曲面的精确校准。本地随机波动率扩展在维持香草拟合的基础上，提供了更丰富的远期微笑动态，该框架对外来利率衍生品定价尤为有效。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次在确定性基差假设下推导了精确的多曲线扩展本地波动率公式，弥合了本地波动率理论与多曲线实践框架之间的缝隙；（2）将本地波动率扩展至本地随机波动率框架，在理论上实现了香草校准精度与丰富动态特征的统一；（3）为利率衍生品领域提供了从本地波动率到本地随机波动率的系统化扩展方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为实务中的利率衍生品定价提供了一个实用的综合框架，能够处理多曲线环境下的复杂性；（2）通过在保持香草校准的同时提供更丰富的远期微笑动态，提升了对风味/外来利率衍生品（如对掉期期权微笑敏感的奇异产品）的定价准确性；（3）框架具有实用性，便于在金融实务中直接部署应用。

title: Effects of U.S. LNG Exports on Gas Prices and Emission Levels
affiliations: University of Alberta

detail.title: Effects of U.S. LNG Exports on Gas Prices and Emission Levels

keywords: Natural Gas Prices and GHG Emissions

detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of U.S. liquefied natural gas (LNG) exports has raised questions about its effects on domestic energy markets and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. This study examines the relationship between U.S. LNG exports, domestic natural gas prices and production, and GHG emissions, while also considering major LNG-importing countries. Using vector autoregression (VAR) and panel VAR (PVAR) models, the results show that LNG exports have no statistically significant or persistent effect on U.S. natural gas prices or production. Impulse response and forecast error variance decomposition results indicate that most shocks are short-lived and largely driven by each variable’s own dynamics. Across LNG-importing countries, LNG-related shocks also have limited and temporary effects on electricity-sector GHG emissions, although responses vary across countries. Overall, the findings suggest that U.S. LNG export expansion has not created sustained pressures on domestic energy markets or emissions. Instead, the effects of LNG trade are shaped largely by country-specific energy mixes, fuel substitution, and broader market adjustment processes.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用VAR和PVAR模型分析美国LNG出口对国内天然气价格、产量及电力部门温室气体排放的影响。结果发现LNG出口对美国天然气价格和产量没有显著或持久的影响，对进口国的电力部门排放影响也有限且短暂，表明LNG出口扩张并未对国内能源市场或排放造成持续压力。
AI.research_question: 美国LNG出口扩张对国内天然气价格、产量以及温室气体排放有何影响？同时考虑主要LNG进口国的情况。
AI.motivation: 美国LNG出口的快速扩张引发了对国内能源市场和温室气体排放影响的质疑，需要实证检验这些潜在影响是否真实存在。
AI.theoretical_framework: 向量自回归（VAR）模型与面板向量自回归（PVAR）模型，包括脉冲响应函数和预测误差方差分解方法。
AI.method: 采用VAR和PVAR模型进行实证分析，通过脉冲响应分析和预测误差方差分解来评估LNG出口冲击对国内天然气价格、产量以及各国电力部门排放的影响。
AI.findings: 1) LNG出口对美国天然气价格和生产没有统计显著或持久的影响；2) 大多数冲击是短期的，主要由各变量自身动态驱动；3) 在LNG进口国，LNG相关冲击对电力部门排放影响有限且短暂，但各国反应存在差异；4) LNG出口扩张总体上未对国内能源市场或排放造成持续压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文从实证层面检验了能源贸易与国内市场价格和排放关系的理论假设，揭示了LNG贸易影响主要受各国能源结构、燃料替代和更广泛市场调整过程塑造，为能源贸易与排放关系的理论提供了新的经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估LNG出口政策对国内能源市场和气候目标的潜在影响提供了实证依据，有助于理解LNG贸易在不同国家能源转型中的实际角色。

title: Too Costly to Reform: Climate Shocks and the Fiscal Politics of Women's Legal Rights
affiliations: World Bank Group, , World Bank Group and World Bank Group

detail.title: Too Costly to Reform: Climate Shocks and the Fiscal Politics of Women's Legal Rights
detail.abstract: Climate shocks have well-documented effects on economic growth, poverty, and conflict—yet their relationship with the institutional foundations of gender equality remains largely unexplored. This paper provides the first global, long-run analysis of the relationship between temperature anomalies and legal gender equality, using the World Bank’s Women, Business and the Law dataset covering 190 economies from 1970 to 2023. Using a two-way fixed effects panel model, we document three consistent patterns. First, temperature anomalies are negatively correlated with progress in legal gender equality, with effects concentrated in low-income countries. Second, the negative association is driven by stalled progress on enabling provisions, reform efforts requiring fiscal resources such as paid maternity leave and pension access,rather than the removal of discriminatory restrictions. Third, these correlations persist for up to a decade. The findings point to a reinforcing cycle between climate stress and legal gender inequality in the countries least equipped to break it.

AI.tldr: 本文利用世界银行"妇女、商业与法律"数据库（覆盖1970-2023年190个经济体），首次从全球长期视角分析温度异常与法律性别平等之间的关系。通过双向固定效应面板模型，发现温度异常与法律性别平等进步呈负相关，且该效应集中在低收入国家，主要由需要财政资源的改革（如带薪产假和养老金）停滞所驱动，并可持续长达十年。
AI.research_question: 气候冲击（温度异常）与法律性别平等制度基础之间存在怎样的关系？这种关系在不同收入水平的国家中如何分布，其作用机制和持续时间如何？
AI.motivation: 已有文献充分记录了气候冲击对经济增长、贫困和冲突的影响，但气候冲击与性别平等的制度基础之间的关系尚未被探索。本文旨在填补这一空白，提供首个全球长期视角的证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于气候冲击与制度变迁的理论框架，认为气候压力可能通过资源约束渠道影响法律改革进程，尤其是需要财政投入的性别平等改革措施。
AI.method: 使用世界银行Women, Business and the Law数据库（覆盖190个经济体，1970-2023年），采用双向固定效应面板模型进行分析。
AI.findings: 第一，温度异常与法律性别平等进步呈负相关，效应集中在低收入国家；第二，负面关联主要由需要财政资源的改革（如带薪产假和养老金获取）的停滞所驱动，而非歧视性限制的移除；第三，这些相关性可持续长达十年。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文首次从全球长期视角建立了气候冲击与法律性别平等制度基础之间的实证关联，揭示了气候压力通过资源约束渠道阻碍性别平等制度建设的机制，提出了气候压力与法律性别不平等之间形成强化循环的理论观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究指出气候变暖可能加剧低收入国家性别不平等，提示政策制定者需要在气候适应与性别平等制度建设之间进行协同规划，特别是为需要财政资源的性别平等改革提供国际援助和支持。

title: Community identification promotes cooperation around shared natural resources: Field experimental evidence on communal land protection among agro-pastoralist communities in Northern Tanzania
affiliations: University of Sussex, University of Sussex, affiliation not provided to SSRN, The Nelson Mandela African Institution of Science and Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Sussex, University of Sussex, University of Sussex - Institute of Development Studies, Jimma University, Cranfield University, Cranfield University, University of Sussex and University of Sussex

detail.title: Community identification promotes cooperation around shared natural resources: Field experimental evidence on communal land protection among agro-pastoralist communities in Northern Tanzania
detail.abstract: Sustainable management of shared natural resources is one of the biggest challenges of our day, and addressing it requires sustained cooperation. Yet how to support such cooperation in specific field contexts is not well understood, as existing evidence is largely correlational and drawn from laboratory or Western settings. To address this gap, the present research conducted a field experiment with agro-pastoralist communities in Northern Tanzania facing the environmental threat of communal land degradation (N = 207). Drawing on the social identity framework, we tested whether an intervention strengthening community identification and perception of land degradation as a shared threat could foster communal land protection. When community (vs. individual household) identification was strengthened, participants allocated more of a valuable resource (fodder-grass seeds) to communal rather than household land. Community condition also affected participants’ intentions to cooperate around nature-based solutions (e.g., rotational grazing) to protect communal land, with this effect operating through a set of identity-based processes (i.e., community identification, collective efficacy, shared threat, perceived support, communal norms). Taken together, these findings provide experimental, behavioral evidence from a Global South field context for the role of community identification in cooperative responses to a shared environmental threat. The study also offers a viable example of a low-cost intervention that could complement policy-level approaches by engaging the social psychological dimension of communal cooperation.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过在坦桑尼亚北部农业-牧民社区（N=207）开展实地实验，基于社会认同框架检验了强化社区认同和土地退化共同威胁感知的干预措施能否促进公共土地保护。结果显示，强化社区（相对于个体家庭）认同时，参与者将更多宝贵资源（草籽）分配给公共土地而非家庭土地；社区条件还通过一系列认同导向的心理过程（社区认同、集体效能、共同威胁、感知支持、社区规范）影响参与者的合作意愿。该研究提供了来自全球南方实地情境的行为实验证据，并展示了低成本的干预方案。
AI.research_question: 强化社区认同和土地退化共同威胁感知的干预措施能否促进公共土地的合作保护行为？
AI.motivation: 共享自然资源可持续管理是当今重大挑战，但如何在具体领域情境中支持持续合作尚未被充分理解，现有证据多为相关性研究且主要来自实验室或西方情境，缺乏来自全球南方实地情境的实验证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会认同框架（Social Identity Framework）
AI.method: 实地实验（field experiment），样本为坦桑尼亚北部面临公共土地退化环境威胁的农业-牧民社区（N=207），通过干预强化社区认同与个体家庭认同进行对比测试。
AI.findings: （1）强化社区认同时，参与者将更多草籽分配给公共土地而非家庭土地；（2）社区条件通过社区认同、集体效能、共同威胁、感知支持、社区规范等认同导向的心理过程影响参与者围绕基于自然的解决方案（如轮牧）的合作意愿。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了来自全球南方实地情境的行为实验证据，验证了社会认同框架在共享环境威胁情境下促进合作的有效性，弥补了现有证据主要来自实验室和西方情境的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种低成本、可操作的干预方案示例，可补充政策层面的方法，通过激活公共合作的社会心理维度来促进公共资源保护。

title: Temporalizing Entrepreneurship in Agriculture: Reconnecting Nature, Culture, and Market in Business History

detail.title: Temporalizing Entrepreneurship in Agriculture: Reconnecting Nature, Culture, and Market in Business History

contentType.other: Working Paper , An earlier version of this paper was presented at the Third World Congress of Business History (WCBH 2026), Toronto, Canada, 29 July 2026.

detail.abstract: Research on organizational temporality has increasingly recognized multiple temporalities, but it has mainly examined socially organized temporal demands. Agriculture exposes a harder coordination problem: market and policy time interact with biological processes that cannot simply be rescheduled and with intergenerational livelihood horizons that cannot be reduced to short-term performance criteria. This paper asks how entrepreneurial action becomes possible under such temporal heterogeneity. It develops a historical sociology of farm management through a critical literature review and conceptual analysis, using seven Japanese cases as theoretically selected illustrations rather than as primary-data tests. The paper identifies a recurrent four-order core—cyclical, market, policy, and livelihood time—and conceptualizes partial synchronization as a provisional coordination in which no single temporal order systematically undermines the reproduction conditions of the others. Within this configuration, venturing projects a new arrangement among temporal orders, while essaying tests, adjusts, and reproduces that arrangement through repeated practice. Comparison across the seven illustrative cases generates the exploratory proposition that accumulated essaying increases the likelihood that venturing becomes institutionally durable. The paper extends research on multiple temporalities, Organization in Time (OiT), and Historical Organization Studies (HOS) by bringing biological irreversibility and intergenerational reproduction into the same analytical frame as market and administrative time. It also reconnects Chayanovian farm-household rationality with organization theory and re-reads the Japanese agrarian-problem debates as disputes over the temporal organization of agriculture.

AI.tldr: 本文通过历史社会学视角研究农业中的多时间性（周期、市场、政策与生计时间）异质性问题，提出"部分同步化"作为临时协调机制，并以日本七个农业案例进行理论阐释，提出创业行动在时间异质性下通过"筹划"（venturing）与"试练"（essaying）的反复实践而成为可能。
AI.research_question: 在时间异质性（生物过程不可重新安排、代际生计视野不可简化为短期绩效）的条件下，创业行动如何成为可能？
AI.motivation: 现有组织时间性研究虽然已认识到多重时间性，但主要关注社会组织化的时间需求，忽视了农业中市场与政策时间与不可调度的生物过程及代际生计视野之间的深层协调难题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多重时间性理论、组织时间（Organization in Time, OiT）、历史组织研究（Historical Organization Studies, HOS）、恰亚诺夫式农场家庭理性（Chayanovian farm-household rationality）
AI.method: 历史社会学方法，通过批判性文献综述与概念分析，结合七个日本案例作为理论选择性的例证（而非作为主要数据检验）。
AI.findings: 识别出四个反复出现的时序核心——周期、市场、政策与生计时间；提出"部分同步化"作为临时协调机制；通过七个案例比较得出探索性命题：累积的"试练"（essaying）增加"筹划"（venturing）在制度上持久化的可能性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将生物不可逆性与代际再生产纳入与市场和管理时间相同的分析框架，扩展了多重时间性、OiT与HOS研究；将恰亚诺夫式农场家庭理性重新与组织理论连接；重新解读日本农业问题争论为关于农业时间组织的争议。
AI.practical_contributions: 为农业创业实践提供了时间协调的概念工具，帮助理解在生物、市场、政策与代际等多重时间约束下创业行动的可行路径。

title: Consensus as Managed Disagreement in Cooperative Governance
affiliations: Conestoga College and Conestoga College

detail.title: Consensus as Managed Disagreement in Cooperative Governance
detail.abstract: This study examines how consensus is produced in cooperative board governance, challenging the assumption that it reflects shared agreement or naturally emerges from deliberation. Drawing on semi-structured interviews with board chairs, directors, and governance professionals in Canadian cooperatives and credit unions, the analysis conceptualises consensus as a socially and institutionally mediated accomplishment. The findings identify three mechanisms through which consensus is generated: alignment-building deliberation, acceptance-based agreement, and cultural norms of collegiality. Together, these mechanisms enable collective decision-making under conditions of interdependence, while shaping which forms of disagreement are recognised, incorporated, or excluded. Building on deliberative democracy and organisational theory, the study reframes consensus as a governance process that manages disagreement by translating it into actionable forms. This perspective highlights the trade-offs between participation, efficiency, and relational stability, suggesting that consensus simultaneously enables coordination and constrains contestation in democratic governance contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于对加拿大合作社和信用合作社的董事会主席、董事及治理专业人士的半结构化访谈，挑战了共识反映共同协议或从审议中自然产生的假设，将共识概念化为一种社会和制度中介的成就。研究发现共识通过三种机制产生：对齐构建的审议、基于接受的同意、以及同事关系的文化规范，这些机制共同在相互依存条件下实现集体决策，同时塑造了哪些分歧形式被认可、纳入或排除。
AI.research_question: 在合作制董事会治理中，共识是如何被生产和产生的？共识是否真的反映共享协议或从审议中自然涌现？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常将共识视为自发形成或自然达成的结果，忽视了共识产生过程中的社会与制度中介机制。作者旨在质疑这一假设，揭示共识作为治理过程的复杂性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 审议民主理论（deliberative democracy）与组织理论（organizational theory）
AI.method: 定性研究方法，采用半结构化访谈法，访谈对象包括加拿大合作社和信用合作社的董事会主席、董事和治理专业人士。
AI.findings: 识别出共识产生的三种机制：(1) 对齐构建的审议（alignment-building deliberation）；(2) 基于接受的同意（acceptance-based agreement）；(3) 同事关系的文化规范（cultural norms of collegiality）。这些机制共同使集体决策在相互依存的条件下得以实现，并塑造了哪些分歧被承认、纳入或排斥。
AI.theory_contributions: 将共识从结果重新框架为一种治理过程，即通过将分歧转化为可操作形式来管理分歧的过程；揭示了共识在民主治理中同时促成协调又限制争辩的双重属性，阐明了参与、效率与关系稳定性之间的权衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 为合作社和信用合作社等民主治理组织的治理实践提供了对共识产生机制的深入理解，有助于治理者认识到共识过程中的权衡（参与、效率与关系稳定性的取舍），并反思如何更有效地管理分歧。

title: Addendum 069 to the African Federation Treaty Framework©: The Continental Water Accord, Riparian Sovereignty, the Trans-boundary Water Tribunal, and the Continental Water Pipeline Network

detail.title: Addendum 069 to the African Federation Treaty Framework©: The Continental Water Accord, Riparian Sovereignty, the Trans-boundary Water Tribunal, and the Continental Water Pipeline Network

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the Founder and Chairman of Africa's Sovereign Development Trust® and the originating author of the African Federation Treaty Framework©, to which this instrument is an addendum. The institutional frameworks described herein are the author's original intellectual property. No financial conflict of interest exists with respect to the analysis or conclusions presented.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This is a policy and legal analysis article. No human subjects research, clinical data, or personal data were collected or used. No ethics board approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author through Africa's Sovereign Development Trust® and The Ndege Group®. No external grant funding was received in connection with this work.

detail.abstract: Africa holds approximately thirty per cent of the world's total freshwater reserves. The Nubian Sandstone Aquifer System, lying beneath 2.2 million square kilometres of Libya, Egypt, Sudan, and Chad, contains an estimated 150,000 cubic kilometres of water. The Congo River discharges 41,000 cubic metres into the Atlantic Ocean every second, a volume exceeding ten times Europe's total annual freshwater consumption, ungoverned, unmeasured, and unpriced. Against this abundance, 400 million Africans have no reliable access to clean water, the Lake Chad Basin has contracted by 90 per cent in sixty years, and the Nile is governed by a treaty written in 1929 by an empire that no longer exists. This article introduces the Continental Water Accord, a binding treaty instrument advancing under the African Federation Treaty Framework©, and its attendant institutional architecture: the Trans-boundary Water Tribunal constituted as a specialised chamber of the Pan African Court, the Continental Water Commission, the African Water Fund capitalised through the African Sovereign Development Finance Fund©, and the Continental Water Pipeline Network governed through tokenized Water Credits on the OmniGaza® platform. The Accord establishes hydrological sovereignty, a judicially enforceable continental right to a minimum of twenty litres of clean water per person per day, a riparian rights architecture that supersedes the 1929 Anglo-Egyptian Treaty by substitution, and a thirty-six month ratification pathway from technical working groups to entry into force upon twenty-eight ratifications. The pipeline architecture, modelled on the European natural gas network, converts the continent's hydrological abundance into sovereign infrastructure revenue. Water sovereignty is the precondition that every other dimension of African continental sovereignty, energy, land, finance, digital identity, assumes and none of them resolve. This Accord resolves it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出《大陆水协定》（Continental Water Accord），一个具有约束力的条约工具，旨在通过建立水文主权、跨国水法庭、大陆水委员会、非洲水基金及大陆输水管道网络等制度架构，解决非洲水资源丰富但分配不均的危机，并以管道网络和代币化水信用将水资源转化为主权基础设施收入。
AI.research_question: 如何通过一项具有约束力的洲际条约及其配套制度架构，从根本上解决非洲水资源分配不均、治理缺位和主权缺失的问题？
AI.motivation: 非洲拥有全球约30%的淡水储量，但仍有4亿人口无法获得可靠的清洁用水；乍得湖流域六十年间萎缩90%；尼罗河仍受1929年殖民时期条约管辖。丰富的水资源与严重的缺水危机并存，凸显了现有治理框架的根本性失效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 水文主权理论（Hydrological Sovereignty）、司法可执行性人权框架、替代性条约理论（以新约取代旧约）、主权基础设施收入模式（参照欧洲天然气网络）、非洲联盟条约框架
AI.method: 制度设计/条约建构方法：提出《大陆水协定》作为约束性法律文书，设计"非洲水法庭—大陆水委员会—非洲水基金—大陆输水管道网络"四位一体的制度架构，并设定36个月批准路径及28国批准生效的门槛条件。
AI.findings: 《大陆水协定》确立了水文主权、每人每日至少20升清洁水的可司法强制执行的大陆权利、通过替代方式取代1929年《盎格鲁-埃及条约》的河岸权利架构，并提供36个月批准路径。管道网络以欧洲天然气网络为模版，将非洲水文丰裕转化为主权基础设施收入。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"水文主权"作为非洲大陆主权的基础性概念，论证水主权是能源、土地、金融、数字身份等其他一切大陆主权的先决条件，并将水资源从公共物品重新定义为可产生主权收入的基础设施资产。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一套完整可操作的非洲水资源治理制度方案，包括条约文本框架、司法执行机构、融资机制（非洲水基金）、基础设施网络（大陆输水管道）以及数字治理工具（OmniGaza®平台的代币化水信用），并明确了从技术工作组到生效的具体时间路径。

title: Behind the Pseudonym and Inside the Editorial System: Undisclosed Overlap Between Anonymous Post-Publication Criticism and Journal Decision-Making
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: Behind the Pseudonym and Inside the Editorial System: Undisclosed Overlap Between Anonymous Post-Publication Criticism and Journal Decision-Making

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or non-financial competing interests relevant to this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The article does not identify anonymous commenters, infer account ownership from circumstantial similarities, or describe an allegation as an adjudicated finding. Any person-specific inquiry should preserve evidence, provide an opportunity to respond, and use an independent decision-maker.

detail.abstract: Anonymous and pseudonymous post-publication commenting creates an unresolved governance problem when the same individual may also serve as a journal editor, editorial-board member, peer reviewer, research-integrity adviser, or publisher employee. The public record cannot establish how often this overlap occurs. PubPeer states that it cannot identify anonymous commenters, protects their anonymity, and does not scientifically verify comments, while ordinary journal peer review frequently conceals reviewer identities from authors and readers. These two systems of opacity can intersect: a person may criticise a paper or author publicly under a pseudonym and later participate privately in reviewing a related manuscript, handling a correction or appeal, advising an integrity process, or making an editorial decision. The possibility is not evidence that any identified person has acted improperly, yet it exposes a material accountability gap because affected authors may be unable to recognise a prior adversarial relationship and the assigning journal may remain unaware unless the participant discloses it. This article presents a normative policy analysis based on current PubPeer rules, publication-ethics guidance, publisher policies, and empirical research on conflicts of interest in peer review. It distinguishes public anonymity from institutional non-disclosure and argues that substantial case-connected post-publication activity should be reported confidentially before accepting an editorial or reviewing assignment. Direct involvement as complainant, investigator, campaigner, or source in the same matter should ordinarily require recusal. The proposed rule does not authorise deanonymisation, infer misconduct from criticism, or treat every prior opinion as disqualifying. Instead, it requires an independent journal official to assess the nature, extent, timing, and overlap of the earlier role. A disclosure threshold, management framework, model declaration, and empirical research agenda are proposed.

AI.tldr: 本文针对匿名/化名发表后评论与期刊编辑、审稿等角色重叠所产生的治理空白问题，提出规范性政策分析：主张在承担编辑或审稿任务前，应保密报告实质性的事后评论活动，并对直接涉入同一事项（如投诉人、调查者、活动家或信源）的情况实行回避。该规则不授权去匿名化，也不将批评视为不当行为，而是要求期刊独立官员评估先前角色的性质、程度、时间与重叠。
AI.research_question: 当同一人既以匿名/化名进行发表后评论，又担任期刊编辑、编委、审稿人、科研诚信顾问或出版社雇员时，应如何设计治理规则以弥补问责空白？
AI.motivation: PubPeer等平台允许匿名评论且不进行科学验证，而期刊同行评审也常向作者和读者隐藏审稿人身份。两套不透明系统可能交叉：某人可能以化名公开批评某论文或作者，随后私下参与相关稿件评审、处理更正或申诉、提供诚信建议或做出编辑决定。虽然这不证明任何人不当行为，但受影响作者可能无法识别先前的对抗性关系，期刊也可能不知情，构成实质性的问责空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于规范性政策分析，整合当前PubPeer规则、出版伦理指南、出版商政策以及同行评审利益冲突的实证研究。核心区分公共匿名（public anonymity）与机构性不披露（institutional non-disclosure）。
AI.method: 规范性政策分析（normative policy analysis），基于对PubPeer现行规则、出版伦理指南、出版商政策及同行评审利益冲突实证研究的系统梳理，提出披露门槛、管理框架、模型声明及实证研究议程。
AI.findings: （1）匿名发表后评论与期刊内部角色重叠构成实质性问责空白；（2）公共匿名与机构性不披露应加以区分；（3）实质性、案件关联的发表后活动应在接受编辑或审稿任务前保密报告；（4）直接作为投诉人、调查者、活动家或信源涉入同一事项时应回避；（5）建议由独立的期刊官员评估先前角色的性质、程度、时间与重叠，而非一刀切。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统地将发表后评论的匿名性问题与期刊治理中的利益冲突问题联系起来，提出公共匿名与机构性不披露的概念区分，并构建了以保密披露为核心的政策框架，补充了同行评审利益冲突研究的理论维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出可操作的披露门槛、管理框架、模型声明及实证研究议程，为期刊编辑、出版伦理委员会和出版商提供具体的政策工具，在保护匿名评论者权利与维护学术问责之间取得平衡。

title: Pax Silica in the Philippines: A Contemporary Documentary Analysis

detail.title: Pax Silica in the Philippines: A Contemporary Documentary Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known personal, financial, or professional relationships with any individuals or organizations that could have influenced, or could reasonably be perceived to have influenced, the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study, as it was based exclusively on publicly available secondary and documentary sources and did not involve human participants, patients, interviews, surveys, or identifiable personal information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted without external financial support or funding from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit organization.

detail.abstract: Pax Silica has emerged as a significant development in the changing architecture of global technology supply chains, linking economic security, semiconductors, artificial intelligence (AI), advanced manufacturing, critical minerals, logistics, and technological cooperation. The Philippines formally joined the United States-led Pax Silica initiative in April 2026 and subsequently advanced plans for an AI-native industrial acceleration and manufacturing hub in New Clark City, Tarlac. This study examines the emergence, strategic significance, opportunities, and potential challenges of Pax Silica in the Philippines using a qualitative historical-documentary research design and secondary data analysis. Documentary sources included official government statements, policy documents, institutional reports, international policy publications, and credible news reports published from 2025 to August 2026. The analysis was guided by Historical Institutionalism, Global Value Chain Theory, and the Economic Security perspective. Findings indicate that Pax Silica represents an emerging opportunity for the Philippines to strengthen its participation in higher-value technology and manufacturing activities. Government projections indicate potential investments of US$40-70 billion and more than 130,000 high-quality jobs, while the proposed development covers approximately 1,620 hectares within New Clark City. However, these figures remain projections rather than realized outcomes. The study also identifies challenges involving technological dependence, skills requirements, environmental sustainability, water demand, governance, local participation, and domestic value capture. The study argues that Pax Silica should not be understood simply as an investment project but as a potential mechanism for Philippine industrial upgrading. Its long-term developmental contribution will depend on the country's ability to convert foreign investment and international partnerships into domestic technological capability, human capital, innovation, local supply-chain participation, and sustainable development.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了菲律宾于2026年4月正式加入美国主导的"Pax Silica"倡议及其在新克拉克城推进AI原生工业加速与制造中心的计划。通过定性历史文献研究和二手数据分析，发现该倡议为菲律宾参与高价值科技与制造活动提供了机遇，预计潜在投资400-700亿美元和13万个高质量就业岗位（但仅为预测），同时面临技术依赖、技能需求、环境可持续性、治理等挑战。研究认为Pax Silica不应被简单视为投资项目，而是菲律宾产业升级的潜在机制，其长期贡献取决于将外国投资转化为国内技术能力、人力资本、创新和本地供应链参与的能力。
AI.research_question: Pax Silica倡议对菲律宾的战略意义、机遇与挑战是什么？该倡议能否成为菲律宾产业升级的机制？
AI.motivation: Pax Silica作为全球科技供应链架构中的重要发展，涉及经济安全、半导体、AI、先进制造、关键矿产等多个领域，菲律宾已正式加入该倡议，但对其战略意义和发展前景缺乏系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史制度主义（Historical Institutionalism）、全球价值链理论（Global Value Chain Theory）、经济安全视角（Economic Security perspective）
AI.method: 定性历史文献研究设计（qualitative historical-documentary research design）和二手数据分析（secondary data analysis），资料涵盖官方政府声明、政策文件、机构报告、国际政策出版物及2025年至2026年8月的可信新闻报道。
AI.findings: 1) Pax Silica为菲律宾参与高价值技术和制造活动提供了新兴机遇；2) 政府预测潜在投资400-700亿美元、创造超13万个高质量就业岗位，拟开发面积约1620公顷（新克拉克城内），但仅为预测而非已实现成果；3) 面临技术依赖、技能要求、环境可持续性、水资源需求、治理、本地参与和国内价值获取等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Pax Silica概念化为菲律宾产业升级的潜在机制而非单纯的投资项目，从全球价值链和经济安全视角提供了对新兴科技供应链倡议的系统性分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为菲律宾政策制定者提供了关于如何将外资和国际伙伴关系转化为国内技术能力、人力资本、创新、本地供应链参与和可持续发展的实践指导，同时警示了技术依赖和环境可持续性等潜在风险。

title: The Importance of Complexity in Hospital Performance: A Data Envelopment Analysis Versus Network Data Envelopment Analysis Comparison
affiliations: Instituto Superior Técnico (IST), University of Lisbon and Instituto Superior Técnico (IST)

detail.title: The Importance of Complexity in Hospital Performance: A Data Envelopment Analysis Versus Network Data Envelopment Analysis Comparison
detail.abstract: Nonparametric methods have been widely used in the last few decades to assess system eciency. Among them, Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) has been among the most widely used. However, the DEA approach does not account for the internal structure of the systems, which pulls the model back from reality. To overcome that, network-DEA has been suggested as a solution. Models based on this approach are also widely present in the literature, although the quantitative dierences between the two have not been totally addressed. This paper addresses this gap by performing a quantitative comparison of the DEA and network-DEA approaches. In addition to highlighting the methodological dierences between the two, it applies both models to a complex healthcare case study. 39 Portuguese local health units served as an illustrative example for the comparison, using 17 variables, including productivity, quality, and access indicators. The analysis concluded that the network-DEA model yields better results, enabling more useful conclusions to be conveyed to decision-makers. The DEA results showed almost no dispersion, making it impossible to distinguish with condence between ecient and inecient units. In contrast, the results obtained with the network-DEA model under the same circumstances are valuable. It also became clear that the practical implications that can be derived from the DEA method are limited, supercial, and do not allow decision-makers to understand the origins of ineciencies. No advantage was found in applying a DEA model over the network-DEA approach when the case study being analyzed has a complex internal structure.

AI.tldr: 本文对DEA和网络DEA两种效率评估方法进行了定量比较，通过葡萄牙39个地方卫生单位的复杂医疗案例研究（17个变量），发现网络DEA在区分有效与无效单元、识别低效率根源方面显著优于DEA，能为决策者提供更有用的结论。
AI.research_question: 在具有复杂内部结构的系统评估中，DEA与网络DEA在定量结果上存在哪些差异？网络DEA是否在实践应用中显著优于传统DEA？
AI.motivation: 传统DEA方法无法考虑系统的内部结构，使其与实际情况脱节。虽然网络DEA被提出作为解决方案，但两种方法之间的定量差异尚未得到充分研究，存在文献空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据包络分析（DEA）与非参数效率评估理论；网络DEA（network-DEA）模型理论。
AI.method: 采用定量比较研究方法，将DEA和网络DEA两种模型同时应用于葡萄牙39个地方卫生单位的复杂医疗案例，使用17个变量（包括生产力、质量和可及性指标）进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 网络DEA模型产生的结果更优：DEA结果几乎没有离散度，无法可靠区分有效与无效单元；而网络DEA在相同条件下能提供有价值的区分结果。DEA的实践意义有限且肤浅，无法帮助决策者理解低效率的根源。在具有复杂内部结构的案例中，DEA相对于网络DEA没有优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了DEA与网络DEA之间定量比较的文献空白，明确了在复杂系统评估中网络DEA相对于传统DEA的方法论优势，为效率评估理论的发展提供了实证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗健康领域的决策者提供了更有效的效率评估工具选择依据，帮助识别低效率的具体来源，从而制定更有针对性的改进策略。

title: When the Executor Changes: An Executor-Contingency Theory of Project Governance
affiliations: and The Mirandola Institute

detail.title: When the Executor Changes: An Executor-Contingency Theory of Project Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: Project-control research treats the task and its characteristics as conditions that shape control effectiveness. This conceptual paper adds a second contingency: the executor’s characteristics. Agentic AI provides the revealing case. The same project work may be performed by an executor that generates consequential interpretations during execution yet cannot become institutionally answerable for them. This paper distinguishes measuring an outcome from the governance diagnosticity of the output. The latter is the extent to which an output reveals whether execution preserved the authorized mandate. The paper argues that realized interpretive autonomy reduces diagnosticity as path-to-artifact multiplicity increases; that diagnosticity matters more for assurance when procedural consequentiality is high; and that trajectory observability supports assurance when execution separates from answerability.

AI.tldr: 本文是概念性论文，在项目控制研究中引入第二个权变因素——执行者的特征。以代理式AI为典型案例，区分了"衡量结果"与"输出治理诊断性"，论证了执行者的解释性自主权会降低输出的诊断性，从而影响项目保证（assurance）效果。
AI.research_question: 执行者的特征如何影响项目控制的有效性？特别是当执行者（如代理式AI）在生成解释性判断但无法为这些判断承担制度性责任时，项目保证如何实现？
AI.motivation: 传统项目控制研究仅将任务及其特征视为塑造控制有效性的条件，忽视了执行者特征这一权变因素。代理式AI的出现提供了一个揭示性案例：同一项目工作可能由能产生重要解释性判断但无法制度性负责的执行者完成，这对现有控制理论构成挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 项目控制理论、权变理论、治理诊断性概念（区分输出衡量与治理诊断性）、解释性自主权、程序重要性与轨迹可观测性。
AI.method: 概念性论文（conceptual paper），通过理论推演和逻辑论证提出命题。
AI.findings: （1）已实现的解释性自主权会随着"路径到人工制品多重性"（path-to-artifact multiplicity）的增加而降低输出诊断性；（2）当程序重要性高时，诊断性对保证更重要；（3）当执行与责任分离时，轨迹可观测性支持保证。
AI.theory_contributions: 将执行者特征作为项目控制的第二个权变维度引入，丰富了项目控制理论；提出"治理诊断性"这一新概念，区分于单纯的输出衡量；建立了解释性自主权、诊断性与保证之间的理论关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理代理式AI项目的组织提供控制设计指导：在解释性自主权高和程序重要性高的场景下需关注输出诊断性，通过轨迹可观测性弥补执行与责任分离带来的保证缺口。

title: How Much Sharpe is Illusory? Quantifying Backtest Overfitting in Crypto Factor Strategies

detail.title: How Much Sharpe is Illusory? Quantifying Backtest Overfitting in Crypto Factor Strategies
detail.abstract: We quantify how much of the reported performance of cryptocurrency factor strategies is an artifact of backtesting methodology rather than genuine premia. Auditing six standard factors-momentum, short-term reversal, volatility, size/liquidity, funding-carry, and beta-on 137 Binance USDT-perpetual contracts over 2020-2024, we compare a naïve protocol (full-sample optimization, frictionless, no multiplicity correction) against a rigorous one (nested walk-forward selection, explicit transaction costs, and the Deflated Sharpe Ratio over a pre-committed grid of 24 configurations). Naïve evaluation inflates the annualized Sharpe ratio by 3.6× on average, and under the baseline protocol none of the six factors survives deflation; four collapse to a negative out-of-sample Sharpe. A decomposition attributes most of the gap to trading frictions rather than to in-sample over-optimization. Funding-carry, the strongest naïve performer, survives only under optimistic cost assumptions-evidence that apparent significance in crypto factor research is contingent on methodological choices that are rarely stated.

AI.tldr: 本文通过审计加密货币因子策略，发现朴素回测方法（全样本优化、无摩擦、无多重检验校正）平均将年化夏普比率夸大了3.6倍。在严格的基线协议下（嵌套滚动前向选择、显式交易成本和预承诺网格上的Deflated Sharpe Ratio），六个标准因子无一通过紧缩检验，其中四个样本外夏普比率为负。绩效差距主要归因于交易摩擦而非样本内过度优化。
AI.research_question: 加密货币因子策略报告的表现中有多少是回测方法学的伪影而非真实溢价？
AI.motivation: 加密货币因子研究领域普遍存在回测方法学不透明的问题，报告的表现可能被方法学选择所夸大，且这些选择很少被明确说明。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多重检验理论、Deflated Sharpe Ratio（紧缩夏普比率）、回测过拟合理论
AI.method: 对137个Binance USDT永续合约（2020-2024年）审计六个因子（动量、短期反转、波动率、规模/流动性、融资利率套利、贝塔），比较朴素协议（全样本优化、无摩擦、无多重性校正）与严格协议（嵌套滚动前向选择、显式交易成本、预承诺24种配置网格上的DSR）。
AI.findings: 1. 朴素评估平均将年化夏普比率夸大3.6倍；2. 基线协议下六个因子无一通过紧缩检验；3. 四个因子样本外夏普比率为负；4. 绩效差距主要源于交易摩擦而非样本内过度优化；5. 最强的朴素表现者（融资利率套利）仅在乐观成本假设下存活。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将Deflated Sharpe Ratio和严格回测协议应用于加密货币因子研究，量化了方法学选择对因子表现报告的实质影响，揭示了加密货币因子溢价的存在性高度依赖方法论假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加密货币因子研究者提供了可复制的严格回测框架（嵌套滚动前向选择、交易成本建模、多重检验校正），提醒投资者和实践者对报告的策略表现保持警惕，并强调了明确报告方法学假设的必要性。

title:
Research-industry Innovation and Commercialization Framework: 
International Practice and an Integrated TRL-based Model
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and

detail.title:
Research-industry Innovation and Commercialization Framework: 
International Practice and an Integrated TRL-based Model
detail.abstract: Commercialization depends on coordinated interaction among public agencies, research organizations, enterprises, intermediaries and infrastructure providers, while the responsibilities of these actors change as technologies mature. This paper develops a Research-Industry Innovation and Commercialization Framework (RIICF) that integrates institutional roles, commercialization mechanisms and Technology Readiness Levels. The framework is based on a conceptual synthesis of relevant literature and a comparative review of selected national innovation and commercialization systems. It distinguishes who participates in the commercialization process, what functions the actors perform, and when and how particular mechanisms should be deployed. RIICF combines an Institutions-Roles Matrix, a TRL-Mechanisms Matrix, a collaboration and coordination zone, and strategic scenarios for research-led, jointly led and industry-led stages of technology development. The paper also examines international practice, including Triple and expanded helix models, cluster-based approaches, public-private partnerships and mission-oriented innovation. The synthesis suggests that effective commercialization systems are typically hybrid and stage-specific rather than based on a single institution or instrument. Research commercialization is more likely to succeed when institutional responsibilities, financing, infrastructure and collaboration mechanisms are aligned with technology maturity and clearly identified industrial and market demand.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个研究-产业创新与商业化框架（RIICF），该框架整合了制度角色、商业化机制与技术就绪水平（TRL），用以解释商业化过程中不同行动者如何随技术成熟度变化而承担不同责任。框架基于文献综合与多国创新系统比较，提出有效的商业化系统通常是混合且分阶段的。
AI.research_question: 商业化过程中各利益相关者（公共机构、研究组织、企业、中介和基础设施提供者）的角色如何随技术成熟度的变化而演变？如何构建一个整合制度角色、商业化机制与技术就绪水平的综合性框架？
AI.motivation: 商业化依赖于多主体协调互动，且各主体责任随技术成熟而变化，但现有文献缺乏一个整合制度角色、商业化机制和技术成熟度的统一框架来指导实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 研究-产业创新与商业化框架（RIICF），包含制度-角色矩阵、TRL-机制矩阵、协作与协调区，以及研究主导、联合主导和产业主导三种战略情景；参考三重螺旋及扩展螺旋模型、集群方法、公私合作伙伴关系和使命导向创新等理论。
AI.method: 概念性文献综合与多国国家创新与商业化系统的比较性回顾。
AI.findings: 有效的商业化系统通常是混合且分阶段的，而非依赖单一机构或工具；当制度责任、融资、基础设施和协作机制与技术成熟度及明确的产业和市场需求对齐时，研究商业化更可能成功。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了RIICF这一整合性框架，将制度角色、商业化机制与TRL三个维度系统性地结合起来，区分了谁参与、发挥什么功能以及何时部署何种机制，弥合了现有文献中制度角色与技术成熟度之间的割裂。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、研究机构和企业提供了分阶段的商业化战略指导，帮助其根据技术成熟度选择适当的协作机制和制度安排，优化创新商业化系统的资源配置。

title: When Does Scientific Discovery Enter a New Regime? An Emergence-adjudication Framework for AI-enabled Science
affiliations: Anglia Ruskin University

detail.title: When Does Scientific Discovery Enter a New Regime? An Emergence-adjudication Framework for AI-enabled Science

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Claims that artificial intelligence is transforming scientific discovery often combine several propositions that should be tested separately. More scientific output is not the same as more validated discovery, and faster validated discovery is not the same as a change in the predictive or causal organisation of science. This paper develops a self-contained emergence-adjudication framework for distinguishing these claims. The framework treats emergence as an escalating burden of proof rather than as a label attached to any observed increase in activity. It begins by separating candidate, validated, and consequential novelty and by allowing AI exposure to alter the relationship between accumulated knowledge and subsequent discovery. It then specifies distinct diagnostic questions motivated by work on novelty and robustness, structure and pseudorandomness, computational mechanics, quantitative coarse-graining, causal emergence, cross-scale derivation, and computational irreducibility. The resulting architecture asks sequentially whether an AI-associated discovery change is novel and robust; whether it is structurally informative rather than merely volumetric; whether lower-dimensional predictive states can be recovered; whether those states support faithful effective dynamics; whether causal contribution increases or redistributes across scales; and whether the macro-regularity can be connected explicitly to the multi directional causal organisation through which it is generated, propagated, constrained, and transformed over time. Computational shortcutability is treated as a further, logically independent diagnostic. The framework deliberately avoids a single scalar “emergence score”. Instead, it reports an adjudication profile whose interpretation becomes stronger only as in dependent burdens of proof are met. Longevity science is used as a high-stakes application because changes in the organisation of discovery could affect the rate at which validated biomedical knowledge is translated into usable interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个"涌现-裁决"框架（emergence-adjudication framework），用于区分关于AI转变科学发现的多种不同命题。框架将涌现视为逐步升级的举证责任，而非简单的活动增加标签，通过七个序贯的诊断问题来评估AI相关的发现变化是否真正构成科学组织的结构性转变。
AI.research_question: 如何区分"AI增加科学产出"、"AI加速已验证发现"和"AI改变科学的预测或因果组织"这三类不同的命题？
AI.motivation: 关于AI转变科学发现的声明往往混合了多个应该分别检验的命题。更多科学产出不等同于更多已验证发现，更快已验证发现也不等同于科学预测或因果组织的改变。需要一套框架来区分这些不同层次的声明。
AI.theoretical_framework: 融合了新颖性与稳健性、结构与伪随机性、计算力学、定量粗粒化、因果涌现、跨尺度推导、计算不可约性等多条理论脉络。
AI.method: 构建序贯裁决框架：首先区分候选、已验证和后果性新颖性；允许AI暴露改变累积知识与后续发现的关系；然后依次回答七个诊断问题——(1)发现变化是否新颖且稳健；(2)是否具有结构信息性而非仅体积性；(3)能否恢复低维预测状态；(4)这些状态是否支持忠实有效动力学；(5)因果贡献是否跨尺度增加或再分配；(6)宏观规律能否与产生、传播、约束和转化它的多方向因果组织显式连接；(7)计算捷径性作为独立诊断。最终输出裁决档案而非单一涌现分数。
AI.findings: 框架避免了单一标量"涌现分数"，而是报告一个裁决档案（adjudication profile），其解释力仅在独立举证责任逐步满足时增强。长寿科学被用作高风险的应景应用场景。
AI.theory_contributions: 将涌现概念从模糊标签转化为可操作的分层举证责任体系；整合多条独立理论脉络构建序贯诊断架构；提出"裁决档案"替代单一量化评分的方式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为长寿科学等高风险领域提供评估AI对发现组织影响的系统化诊断工具，有助于判断AI是否真正加速了已验证生物医学知识向可用干预措施的转化。

title: From Public Investigator to Published Analyst: Why Extensive Post-Publication Scrutiny Should Be Declared as a Non-Financial Competing Interest
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: From Public Investigator to Published Analyst: Why Extensive Post-Publication Scrutiny Should Be Declared as a Non-Financial Competing Interest

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial.

detail.abstract: When researchers publish analyses of literature, authors, journals, publishers, or research-integrity processes that they have already investigated in public, their earlier activity is commonly treated as background expertise rather than as a matter requiring formal disclosure. That assumption is no longer defensible when the prior activity was sustained, adversarial, interventionist, or directly connected to the cases selected for study. An individual who has posted repeated criticisms, assembled allegations, contacted journals or institutions, supplied information to journalists, promoted a particular interpretation, or evaluated the consequences of complaints in which that individual participated enters the subsequent research process with more than general subject knowledge. The author may possess a prior public commitment, a reputational stake in the vindication of earlier judgments, privileged knowledge produced through intervention, or overlapping responsibilities as commentator, complainant, source, investigator, and scholar. This article presents a normative policy analysis of whether such activity should be declared as a non-financial competing interest. It examines current principles expressed by the International Committee of Medical Journal Editors, the Committee on Publication Ethics, the World Association of Medical Editors, the Council of Science Editors, selected journal and publisher policies, and research-governance guidance. These sources do not establish a uniform rule directed specifically at post-publication scrutiny, but they repeatedly require disclosure of relationships and activities that might bias, or reasonably be perceived to bias, scholarly judgment. An instructive World Health Organization guideline annex expressly treats repeated public positions and related research or publication activity as potentially significant intellectual bias. The article concludes that extensive and materially overlapping post-publication review or sleuthing should ordinarily be declared. Disclosure should not be equated with proof of bias, improper motive, or misconduct, and it should not operate as automatic disqualification. Its purpose is to expose relevant role overlap so that editors, reviewers, readers, and affected parties can evaluate case selection, methods, interpretation, and the adequacy of safeguards. A proportionate threshold, model declaration language, and editorial management framework are proposed.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨研究者发表对文献、作者、期刊或研究诚信过程的批判性分析时，若其此前已参与过相关公开活动（如持续批评、举报、联系期刊机构、向记者提供信息等），应否将这些非财务关系披露为利益冲突。文章通过规范性政策分析，审查了ICMJE、COPE、WAME、CSE等机构的现行原则，结论认为广泛且实质重叠的出版后审查或调查活动通常应予以披露，并提出了比例阈值、示范披露语言和编辑管理框架。
AI.research_question: 当研究者发表对文献、作者、期刊、出版商或研究诚信过程的批判性分析时，其此前的公开调查活动（如持续批评、举报、干预等）是否应被声明为非财务性利益冲突？
AI.motivation: 既有学术实践将研究者此前的公开活动视为背景专长而非需要正式披露的事项，但当事先活动具有持续性、对抗性、干预性，或与所研究案例直接相关时，该假设不再合理。研究者可能带有先前的公开承诺、声誉利益、通过干预获得的特权知识，或身兼评论者、投诉者、消息来源、调查者和学者的多重角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 规范性政策分析框架；基于ICMJE、COPE、WAME、CSE等机构的利益冲突披露原则；世界卫生组织关于重复公开立场及研究与出版活动可能导致智力偏见的指南精神。
AI.method: 规范性政策分析：系统检视国际医学期刊编辑委员会（ICMJE）、出版伦理委员会（COPE）、世界医学编辑协会（WAME）、科学编辑委员会（CSE）的现行原则，以及选定的期刊、出版商政策与研究治理指南。
AI.findings: 现有来源未针对出版后审查制定统一规则，但反复要求披露可能使学术判断产生偏倚或合理感知偏倚的关系与活动；世界卫生组织指南附件明确将重复公开立场及相关的科研/出版活动视为潜在的实质性智力偏倚。文章结论认为，广泛且实质重叠的出版后审查或调查活动通常应予以披露。
AI.theory_contributions: 将非财务性利益冲突的概念扩展至出版后审查/揭弊活动领域，提出披露不应等同于偏倚或不当动机的证明，也不应自动取消资格，其目的是暴露角色重叠以便各方评估案例选择、方法、解释及保障措施的充分性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出比例化披露阈值、示范性披露声明语言以及编辑管理框架，为期刊编辑、审稿人、读者及受影响方提供可操作的处理出版后审查利益冲突的实践指导。

title: Attrition as an Overlooked Variable in Insider Risk: Global Evidence and Implications for Ghana's Growing BPO Sector

detail.title: Attrition as an Overlooked Variable in Insider Risk: Global Evidence and Implications for Ghana's Growing BPO Sector
detail.abstract: Insider risk research consistently finds that the costliest incidents stem from negligent, nonmalicious behaviour rather than malicious intent (Ponemon Institute, 2026; CERT National Insider Threat Centre, 2022). Much of this literature frames negligence as an individual behavioural failure: a lapse in judgment, training, or attention. This paper argues that workforce attrition itself is a structural driver of negligence-related insider risk: high turnover compresses training timelines, accelerates system-access provisioning, and erodes the informal knowledge that keeps formal controls functioning in day-today practice, independent of any individual's intent. The argument draws on Ghana's business process outsourcing (BPO) sector, a rapidly growing part of the country's economy operating under the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843) and the Cybersecurity Act, 2020 (Act 1038). The sector's characteristics (rapid workforce expansion, competitive entry-level labour markets, and heavy reliance on newly onboarded staff handling client data) make it a useful setting for examining the attrition-security relationship. The paper also considers, and does not claim to fully resolve, the alternative explanation that management quality drives both attrition and negligence independently, arguing that the practical implication, tracking attrition and tenure data as a security-relevant signal, holds under either reading. The paper concludes that retention and security functions, typically organised as separate reporting lines with separate metrics, should be understood as addressing substantially overlapping risk.

AI.tldr: 本文提出员工流失率（workforce attrition）本身是疏忽型内部风险的结构性驱动因素，而不仅仅是个人行为失败。基于加纳业务流程外包（BPO）行业的研究，论证高流失率压缩培训时间、加速系统访问权限配置、侵蚀非正式知识，从而削弱正式安全控制的有效性。论文主张将留存与安全职能视为应对高度重叠风险的整体。
AI.research_question: 员工流失（workforce attrition）如何作为结构性因素驱动疏忽型内部风险（negligence-related insider risk）？
AI.motivation: 现有内部风险文献将疏忽视为个体行为失败（判断、培训或注意力的失误），但忽略了组织结构因素（如人员流失）作为系统性驱动力的作用。最昂贵的内部安全事件源于非恶意的疏忽行为，因此需要重新审视其结构性根源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内部风险理论（insider risk）；组织流失与知识管理理论；结构性风险框架（区别于个体行为解释）；制度合规理论（围绕加纳《数据保护法》和《网络安全法》）
AI.method: 基于加纳业务流程外包（BPO）行业的论证性/概念性分析，结合行业特征（快速扩张、竞争性初级劳动力市场、新员工处理客户数据）进行情境化推理，并检验替代解释（管理质量同时驱动流失与疏忽）。
AI.findings: 高流失率通过三条路径驱动疏忽型内部风险：（1）压缩培训时间；（2）加速系统访问权限配置；（3）侵蚀维持正式控制日常运作的非正式知识。论文认为即使在不完全解决"管理质量作为混杂因素"的替代解释下，将流失率和任职时间数据作为安全相关信号的实际含义仍然成立。结论是留存职能与安全职能应被视为覆盖高度重叠的风险领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 将内部风险文献中"疏忽=个体行为失败"的主导框架拓展为结构性解释，提出员工流失作为系统性风险驱动因素的理论视角；为风险管理与人力资本管理研究建立新的交叉点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供可操作的建议：将流失率和任职时间指标纳入安全风险监测信号；推动留存职能与安全职能的整合与协作，而非各自独立运作；为新兴市场BPO行业的安全治理提供实践指引。

title: Redesign of Assembly Networks under Regional Supply-Chain Disruptions
affiliations: Durham Business School and Michigan State University

detail.title: Redesign of Assembly Networks under Regional Supply-Chain Disruptions
detail.abstract: Supply-chain turbulence has prompted China-plus-one and China-plus-N strategies. We compare multistage assembly-network redesigns, where alternative sources of one material are substitutes but required materials are complements. Our discounted dynamic model includes inventories, pipelines, stochastic demand, deterministic lead times, and regional disruptions. In a two-region benchmark, placing sources for every required input in each source region weakly improves their joint availability in every regional state relative to material specialization and, under lead-time and cost conditions, weakly reduces optimal operating cost. Holding marginal availabilities fixed, the availability gain decreases with positive regional dependence. An additional source raises the feasible launch bound only when its material is the strict bottleneck and only until another material binds. To compare designs that are difficult to optimize directly, we bracket each design's optimal operating cost between a root-pooled lower bound and the cost of a feasible target-cap-allocate policy. Separated intervals certify rankings and bound the implementation premium a redesign can justify. In the single-root-material, unit-root-lead-time case, the pooled problem separates into two one-dimensional convex echelon problems with an optimal regionalstate-dependent base-stock policy. When intervals overlap, a retained-echelon hierarchy tightens the comparison and reaches the physical optimum. Five notebook-supply-chain configurations show that component-only diversification leaves the original bottleneck unchanged, whereas alternative assembly and complete regional systems reduce cost. Regional resilience therefore depends on complete usable production paths, not supplier or country counts alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了供应链中断背景下多阶段装配网络的重新设计问题，通过一个包含库存、在途库存、随机需求、确定性提前期和区域性中断的折现动态模型，比较了"中国+1"和"中国+N"策略下的不同装配网络设计方案。研究发现，将每种所需投入品的供应源放置在各个源区域（而非按材料专业化分工）能改善供应的联合可用性，并在一定条件下降低最优运营成本。核心结论是区域韧性取决于完整的可用生产路径，而非单纯的供应商或国家数量。论文还开发了区间界定方法来比较难以直接优化的设计方案，并通过五款笔记本电脑供应链配置进行了验证。
AI.research_question: 在供应链动荡背景下，多阶段装配网络的不同重新设计方案（中国+1、中国+N）中，何种资源配置策略能最优地平衡供应可用性与运营成本？如何有效比较难以直接优化的复杂装配网络设计方案？
AI.motivation: 供应链动荡（如地缘政治风险、区域中断）促使企业采取中国+1和中国+N策略来进行供应源多元化。然而，现有研究缺乏对多阶段装配网络中不同源配置策略的系统比较，特别是考虑到材料之间的替代与互补关系（替代资源的可替代性vs必需材料的互补性）。企业需要在供应韧性与运营成本之间做出权衡，但缺乏理论工具的指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 折现动态规划模型；包含库存、在途库存、随机需求、确定性提前期和区域中断的多阶段装配网络模型；材料间的替代（alternative sources）与互补（required materials）关系框架；根汇聚下界（root-pooled lower bound）与目标产能分配政策（target-cap-allocate policy）区间界定方法；保留梯队层级（retained-echelon hierarchy）比较方法。
AI.method: 构建折现动态模型比较多阶段装配网络的重新设计方案。在双区域基准中，分析将每个必需投入的供应商放置在每个源区域（联合配置）相对于材料专业化配置的优劣。开发区间界定方法：用根汇聚下界和可行目标产能分配政策的成本来夹住每个设计的最优运营成本，用分离区间来认证排名。在单根材料、单位根提前期情形下，将汇总问题分解为两个一维凸梯队问题，并推导最优区域状态依赖的基础库存策略。通过五款笔记本电脑供应链配置进行数值验证。
AI.findings: (1) 在双区域基准中，将每个必需投入的供应商放置在每个源区域相比材料专业化配置，能在每个区域状态下弱改善供应的联合可用性，并在提前期和成本条件下弱降低最优运营成本。(2) 在边际可用性固定时，可用性增益随区域正相关性增加而减少。(3) 增加一个供应源只有在材料是严格瓶颈且另一个材料未成为瓶颈时才提高可行启动上限。(4) 仅零部件多元化不会改变原有瓶颈，而替代装配方案和完整区域系统能降低成本。(5) 区域韧性取决于完整的可用生产路径，而非单纯的供应商或国家数量。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 建立了多阶段装配网络中材料替代与互补关系下的动态优化模型，填补了供应链韧性研究中对此类复杂装配结构的理论空白。(2) 提出了区间界定方法（根汇聚下界+目标产能分配政策），为难以直接优化的复杂设计方案提供了可认证的比较框架。(3) 在单根材料、单位根提前期情形下，揭示了问题可分解为两个一维凸梯队问题并存在最优区域状态依赖基础库存策略的结构性质。(4) 提出了保留梯队层级方法，在区间重叠时能收紧比较并达到物理最优。(5) 澄清了"供应商/国家数量≠韧性"的重要理论认知。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为企业进行供应链重新设计（中国+1、中国+N策略）提供了具体的资源配置指导：应将每种必需投入品的供应商分布在各个源区域（联合配置）而非按材料专业化分工。(2) 通过笔记本电脑供应链的五个配置案例，向管理者展示仅增加零部件供应商不足以解决瓶颈问题，需要确保完整的可用生产路径。(3) 提供了区间界定方法作为实践工具，使企业能在复杂场景中比较不同设计方案的运营成本，并界定重新设计可合理化的实施溢价。

title: From Public Investigator to Publisher Consultant and Journal Editor: Should Elisabeth Bik’s Overlapping Roles Require Greater Disclosure and Separation?
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: From Public Investigator to Publisher Consultant and Journal Editor: Should Elisabeth Bik’s Overlapping Roles Require Greater Disclosure and Separation?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or non-financial competing interests relevant to this article.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this policy analysis.

detail.abstract: Elisabeth Bik's public record presents a concentrated combination of roles in post-publication research integrity. Science Integrity Digest identifies itself as a blog by Bik for Harbers-Bik LLC, directs readers to post concerns on PubPeer and contact journal editors, reports income from Patreon, and states that Bik has regularly undertaken paid consultancy for scientific publishers and research institutions since 2019, with almost all cases governed by confidentiality agreements. The same disclosure records a paid position on the eLife Ethics Committee from 2021 to 2024 and an unpaid Stanford METRICS affiliation from 2024, while Stacks Journal currently lists Bik as an Editor. Her website also attributes 1,686 retractions, 269 expressions of concern, and 1,256 corrections to her work as of April 2026. Those totals are her organisation's own accounting and are not presented here as an independently audited measure of causation. This article asks whether the combination of public criticism, journal notification, confidential publisher consultancy, outcome-based professional standing, and editorial authority requires stronger disclosure and role separation. A purposive review of first-party disclosures, journal pages, published notices, publication-ethics standards, and empirical conflict-of-interest research supports a qualified but firm answer: yes. A current or recent paid relationship with a publisher materially connected to a public comment or editorial assignment should be disclosed; prior case-connected investigation should be treated as a potential non-financial competing interest; and direct participation in the same controversy should normally trigger recusal. Confidentiality can justify tiered disclosure, but it should not make the participant the sole judge of whether a hidden relationship matters. No evidence reviewed for this article establishes that Bik has handled a particular conflicted manuscript, influenced a publisher improperly, or concealed a client in a specific case. The argument is therefore prospective and institutional: journals and publishers should adopt confidential interest registers, behaviour-specific assignment questions, independent handling, recorded recusals, and public procedural statements where an overlap is material.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Elisabeth Bik的公开记录，分析其在出版后科研诚信领域同时扮演的多重角色（公开批评者、期刊通知者、保密的出版方顾问、评审编辑等），并提出一个问题：这种角色组合是否需要更强的利益冲突披露和角色分离机制。文章通过目的性审查第一方披露、期刊页面、出版通知、出版伦理标准和实证利益冲突研究，得出"是"的定性但坚定的结论，并提出制度性建议（如保密利益登记册、行为特定分配问题、独立处理、记录回避和公开程序声明）。文章明确说明没有证据证明Bik处理过特定受冲突稿件或不当影响出版商，论证是前瞻性和制度性的。
AI.research_question: 当个人在出版后科研诚信领域同时担任公开批评者、期刊通知者、保密出版商顾问和编辑等多重角色时，现有的利益冲突披露和角色分离机制是否足够？
AI.motivation: Elisabeth Bik的公开记录集中展示了科研诚信领域角色组合的极端案例——她既是公开的论文打假者，又是收取出版商保密咨询费的顾问，同时还担任期刊编辑和伦理委员会成员。这种角色重叠可能导致利益冲突未被充分披露，而现有的出版伦理规范对此缺乏明确指引。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益冲突（Conflict of Interest）理论、出版伦理规范（publication-ethics standards）、角色分离（role separation）原则、财务与非财务利益冲突区分框架。
AI.method: 目的性审查（purposive review）：系统审查第一方披露记录、期刊页面、已发布的通告、出版伦理标准以及实证利益冲突研究。
AI.findings: （1）当前或近期与出版商存在有偿关系且与该出版商相关的公开评论或编辑任务应当披露；（2）过往涉及案件的调查应被视为潜在的非财务性利益冲突；（3）直接参与同一争议时应触发回避机制；（4）保密性可以证明分层披露的合理性，但不应让参与者成为判断隐藏关系是否重要的唯一裁决者；（5）文章未发现Bik处理过特定受冲突稿件、不当影响出版商或隐瞒特定案件客户的具体证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"前瞻性和制度性"的利益冲突治理框架，认为应通过制度设计（而非仅依赖个人自律）来解决科研诚信领域多重角色重叠带来的利益冲突问题；将保密性纳入了分层披露的理论框架，挑战了"参与者自裁"的传统做法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为期刊和出版商提供了具体的制度建议：建立保密利益登记册、采用行为特定（behavior-specific）的分配问题、确保独立处理机制、记录回避决定、在利益重叠具有实质性时发布公开程序声明。

title: Structured Attention as an Organizational Truce
affiliations: University of Wisconsin Law School and Georgetown University - McDonough School of Business

detail.title: Structured Attention as an Organizational Truce
detail.abstract: A cornerstone of the behavioral theory of the firm is that firms keep latent conflict from becoming manifest by attending to goals sequentially rather than jointly. We reconsider structured attention as part of an intra-organizational truce rather than a byproduct of bounded rationality: a collective solution to a coordination problem rooted in divergent stakeholder preferences and the need to aggregate private information. We model rival multidimensional projects of uncertain quality entailing trade-offs over contested goals, where knowledge of which projects satisfy which criteria is privately held by stakeholders who must jointly approve any project. This invites misrepresentation, producing a coordination failure related to the hawk-dove game. We compare joint evaluation with three attention-based alternatives. Sequential generation withholds information about the second project, making misrepresentation riskier and sustaining truth-telling under higher conflict. Sequential evaluation reveals both projects but considers them sequentially, so the agenda acts as a coordination device. Focused evaluation narrows the consideration set ex ante, restoring truth-telling but forgoing the option to select among alternatives. Sequential generation is preferable where high-quality projects are scarce relative to conflict, sequential evaluation where they are abundant and conflict extreme, and focused evaluation where the firm cannot credibly commit to an agenda.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了行为企业理论中的"顺序关注"假设，提出结构化注意力不仅是有限理性的副产品，更是组织内部"休战"（truce）的集体解决方案，用于协调多元利益相关者之间的分歧并聚合私人信息。文章通过理论模型比较了联合评估与三种基于注意力的替代方案（顺序生成、顺序评估、聚焦评估），揭示了不同情境下的最优注意力配置策略。
AI.research_question: 企业的结构性注意力（如顺序关注目标）如何作为一种组织内部协调机制，解决多元化利益相关者之间因偏好分歧和私人信息导致的协调失败问题？
AI.motivation: 行为企业理论传统上将顺序关注归因于有限理性，本文质疑这一解释，提出应将其视为组织内"休战"的产物——即一种集体协调博弈的解。这一重新定位有助于理解组织注意力配置的更深层战略功能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为企业理论（Behavioral Theory of the Firm）、协调博弈理论（以鹰鸽博弈为类比）、组织休战概念（organizational truce）、注意力基础观
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含多元利益相关者、冲突目标和私人信息的博弈模型，比较联合评估与三种注意力配置方案（顺序生成、顺序评估、聚焦评估）的均衡结果。
AI.findings: （1）联合评估下会产生与鹰鸽博弈类似的协调失败，利益相关者可能虚报信息；（2）顺序生成通过隐藏第二项目的信息使虚报风险增大，在冲突较高时仍能维持诚实报告；（3）顺序评估通过议程设置发挥协调作用；（4）聚焦评估预先缩小考虑集，恢复诚实性但放弃了替代选择权；（5）不同方案的最优性取决于高质量项目稀缺度与冲突程度的相对关系及企业能否可信承诺议程。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）重新概念化了行为企业理论中的顺序关注机制，从"有限理性的副产品"转向"组织休战的集体解决方案"；（2）将组织注意力配置与协调博弈理论联系起来，丰富了组织休战理论；（3）为注意力配置的三种形态提供了统一的博弈论解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为企业管理者提供了在不同冲突水平和项目质量情境下选择注意力配置策略的指导；（2）揭示了议程设置作为组织协调工具的战略价值；（3）提醒企业在无法可信承诺议程时应采用聚焦评估策略。

title: Stratified Vulnerability: Probability, Magnitude and the Redistribution of International Student Demand in UK Higher Education

detail.title: Stratified Vulnerability: Probability, Magnitude and the Redistribution of International Student Demand in UK Higher Education

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could be perceived as influencing this work. The author was previously employed in student recruitment at a UK university (2022–2024) and has professional experience in international education; this informed the research questions but conferred no interest in its findings. All sources were independently verified against primary documents, and the author takes full responsibility for the content.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a documentary analysis of publicly available regulatory, governmental and sector sources. It involved no human participants, no personal data and no fieldwork, and therefore required no ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: UK higher education's dependence on international student fees is well documented; how the risk attached to that dependence is distributed across the sector is not. This article develops a framework of stratified vulnerability from a documentary analysis of regulatory, governmental and sector sources covering the 2024-2026 international recruitment shock. It argues that the shock did not reduce demand so much as redistribute it up the reputational hierarchy, and that the mechanism was structural: dependant-visa restrictions bore precisely on the source markets and postgraduate-taught segments on which teaching-intensive institutions had concentrated. The framework resolves an apparent contradiction in current analysis-that elite institutions hold the largest international income yet proved least fragile-by distinguishing the probability of financial distress from the magnitude of exposure. The article closes with implications for institutional strategy, mission-group collaboration and government policy, and identifies machine-mediated student choice as the next channel through which stratification may deepen.

AI.tldr: 本文通过2024-2026年国际招生冲击的文献分析，提出"分层脆弱性"框架，论证国际学生需求冲击并非减少总需求，而是将其沿声誉层级向上重新分配，导致教学密集型院校面临不成比例的财务风险。
AI.research_question: 英国高等教育对国际学生学费的依赖所带来的风险如何在部门内分布？
AI.motivation: 英国高等教育对国际学生学费收入的依赖已有充分记录，但该依赖所附带的风险在部门层面的分布情况尚不清楚，需要系统性框架加以分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层脆弱性（stratified vulnerability）框架，区分财务困境概率与暴露规模两个维度。
AI.method: 对2024-2026年国际招生冲击期间的监管、政府和部门来源文件进行文献分析。
AI.findings: 冲击并未减少总需求，而是将需求沿声誉层级向上重新分配；其机制是结构性的：受抚养人签证限制恰好作用于教学密集型院校所集中的来源市场和授课型研究生细分领域；该框架解决了精英院校国际收入最大却最不脆弱的表面矛盾。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"分层脆弱性"框架，区分财务困境概率与暴露规模，解决了现有分析中"精英院校收入最大但脆弱性最低"的表观矛盾。
AI.practical_contributions: 为院校战略、使命集团合作及政府政策提供启示，并指出机器中介的学生选择（machine-mediated student choice）可能成为分层加深的下一个渠道。

title: Compact Self-Supervised 3D Deep Learning for CT-Based Pancreatic Lesion Detection and Segmentation
affiliations: Northern Technical University, University of Mosul, Northern Technical University, University of Messina and Kastamonu University

detail.title: Compact Self-Supervised 3D Deep Learning for CT-Based Pancreatic Lesion Detection and Segmentation
detail.abstract: Background and Objective: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains difficult to detect on CT, particularly small lesions. We evaluated whether train-only masked-context self-supervised learning (SSL) can improve a compact 3D localization/segmentation pipeline under leakage-controlled development and source-separated testing.,Methods: The audited cohort comprised 2,238 studies from 2,224 patients. PANORAMA-local data were partitioned into 1,376 training, 295 validation, and 293 internal-test studies; 194 Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) studies and 80 NIH negative-only studies were held out by source. SSL used only training CTs. A 471,764-parameter localizer defined a fixed crop, followed by a 1.64-million-parameter dual-head network trained from SSL or random initialization. Model selection and a validation-only threshold were frozen before test inference.,Results: SSL improved the prespecified validation selection score from 0.5351 to 0.5706 (difference 0.0355; 95% CI, 0.0094-0.0582) but not case-level AUC. Internal testing yielded AUC 0.820, lesion Dice 0.476, and lesion-localization sensitivity 80.5%. On MSD, AUC was 0.770, lesion Dice 0.474, and sensitivity 81.6% at 0.722 FP/case. Sensitivity was 62.1% for lesions ≤20 mm versus 91.0% for lesions >20-40 mm; NIH specificity was 38.8% at 0.975 FP/case.,Conclusions: Train-only SSL improved a segmentation-weighted development criterion without evidence of improved case discrimination. Source-separated testing exposed false-positive burden and small-lesion weakness. The main contribution is a compact, leakage-controlled, auditable 3D workflow with a public versioned reproducibility package, warranting prospective validation and matched standard baselines before clinical use.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了仅使用训练集的掩码上下文自监督学习（SSL）能否改善一个紧凑的3D胰导管腺癌（PDAC）定位/分割管线，在严格的泄漏控制开发和来源分离测试下进行。结果表明SSL改善了分割加权的开发选择指标，但未提升病例水平的判别能力；通过来源分离测试暴露了假阳性负担和小病灶检出短板。
AI.research_question: 仅训练集的掩码上下文自监督学习是否能改善紧凑型3D PDAC定位/分割管线在CT影像上的性能？
AI.motivation: PDAC在CT上难以检测，尤其是小病灶。现有深度学习模型在开发与测试之间可能存在数据泄漏风险，且缺乏严格控制的验证流程。需要评估SSL能否在紧凑模型和严格审计条件下提升检测性能，同时提供可复现、可审计的工作流。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自监督学习（SSL）理论，具体采用仅训练集的掩码上下文SSL；深度学习定位/分割理论；数据泄漏控制与来源分离测试方法论。
AI.method: 采用2,238个研究（2,224例患者）的审计队列。数据按来源分区：1,376训练/295验证/293内部测试，194 MSD和80 NIH阴性作为外部保留集。SSL仅使用训练CT。使用471,764参数的定位器定义固定裁剪区域，随后是1.64M参数的双头网络（SSL或随机初始化训练）。模型选择与验证阈值在测试前冻结。
AI.findings: SSL将验证选择得分从0.5351提升至0.5706（差异0.0355，95%CI 0.0094-0.0582），但未改善病例级AUC。内部测试AUC 0.820、病灶Dice 0.476、定位敏感性80.5%；MSD上AUC 0.770、Dice 0.474、敏感性81.6%（0.722 FP/例）；≤20mm病灶敏感性62.1% vs >20-40mm为91.0%；NIH特异性38.8%（0.975 FP/例）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了仅训练集SSL在分割加权指标上有效但未必提升病例判别能力的现象；强调了来源分离测试在暴露模型真实局限（如假阳性负担和小病灶弱点）方面的重要性，丰富了医学影像AI评估方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个紧凑（~2.1M参数）、泄漏控制、可审计的3D PDAC定位/分割工作流及公开的版本化可复现包；明确了当前模型的假阳性负担和小病灶检出缺陷，为临床转化前的验证方向与标准基线对照提供了依据。

title: The Macroeconomic Return to Quality, A General Equilibrium Model of Public Investment Efficiency in Mali

detail.title: The Macroeconomic Return to Quality, A General Equilibrium Model of Public Investment Efficiency in Mali

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: A series of earlier studies established, on World Bank appraisals and on named West African projects, that the rate of return of a public investment suffers from an optimism bias, and derived from it a reference-class correction that de-biases the announced return. The present article places this corrected efficiency at the core of a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model, calibrated on a West African Economic and Monetary Union economy, Mali. Public capital raises the productivity of private factors, is built with a lag, and is acquired only to the extent of its efficiency, a parameter that the reference-class correction precisely allows to estimate. The model is tested over two horizons. In the long run, a permanent infrastructure programme of two points of gross domestic product raises steady-state output by 12.3 percent under announced efficiency but by only 7.8 percent under corrected efficiency, and a low efficiency additionally raises the tax burden required to stabilise the debt. In the medium run, the impact multiplier is near zero, a consequence of the construction lag, the output response peaks around the thirteenth year, and the cumulative multiplier is markedly higher under announced efficiency. The lesson for the practice of infrastructure advisory is that the quality of project appraisal and execution, that is, efficiency, governs the macroeconomic return and the sustainability of a programme more than its volume, and that the lever is structural and quantifiable.

AI.tldr: 本文将以世界银行评估中得出的乐观偏差修正后的效率参数置于动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型核心，以马里这一西非经货联盟经济体为校准对象，分析基础设施项目的宏观经济回报。研究发现：若按公布的效率，永久性基础设施计划（占GDP的2%）可使稳态产出增长12.3%，但按修正后效率仅增长7.8%；且低效率会推高稳定债务所需的税收负担。在中期，由于建设时滞，影响乘数近乎为零，产出响应在第13年达到峰值，累计乘数在公布效率下明显更高。对基础设施咨询实践的启示是：项目评估与执行质量（即效率）比项目规模更能决定宏观回报与可持续性，且该杠杆是结构性的、可量化的。
AI.research_question: 将前期研究推导出的参考类修正（去偏）效率纳入DSGE模型后，公共基础设施投资对宏观经济（长期产出、税收负担及中期乘数效应）的影响如何？效率修正对宏观回报的量化影响有多大？
AI.motivation: 前期研究已证实公共投资回报率存在乐观偏差并推导出参考类修正方法，但尚未将修正后的效率参数系统地应用于宏观经济模型，以评估其对基础设施项目宏观经济回报与财政可持续性的影响。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型；参考类修正（reference-class correction）；公共资本与私人要素生产率关系；建设时滞；财政债务稳定机制。
AI.method: 基于DSGE模型，以马里（西非经货联盟经济体）为校准对象。将参考类修正后的效率参数作为公共资本获取的核心参数纳入模型。在长期（稳态）和中期两个时间维度上进行测试分析，比较公布效率与修正效率下的产出增长、税收负担及乘数效应。
AI.findings: （1）长期：永久性基础设施计划（占GDP的2%）在公布效率下使稳态产出增长12.3%，但修正效率下仅增长7.8%；低效率还会提高稳定债务所需的税收负担。（2）中期：由于建设时滞，影响乘数近乎为零，产出响应约在第13年达到峰值；公布效率下的累计乘数显著高于修正效率。（3）实践启示：项目评估与执行质量（效率）比项目规模更能决定宏观回报和可持续性，且这一杠杆是结构性、可量化的。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文首次将参考类修正的效率参数嵌入DSGE模型框架，实现了微观项目评估中的乐观偏差修正与宏观经济增长模型的系统整合，为理解公共投资效率与宏观回报之间的关系提供了定量理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 对基础设施投资咨询实践提供明确指导：效率（项目评估与执行质量）比规模更关键；为政策制定者提供了可量化的杠杆，即通过提高项目评估和执行质量来改善宏观回报和财政可持续性，而非单纯扩大投资规模。

title: Durable Knowledge Transfer and Equitable Learning: Evidence from Authentic Assessment in a Quasi-Natural Experiment
affiliations: , London School of Economics and King’s College London

detail.title: Durable Knowledge Transfer and Equitable Learning: Evidence from Authentic Assessment in a Quasi-Natural Experiment

keywords: authentic assessment; collaborative learning; durable knowledge transfer; cognitive engagement; equity; online instruction; quasi-natural experiment; heterogeneous treatment effects

detail.abstract: Universities typically evaluate instructional effectiveness through immediate measures such as course grades and examination scores, which reveal little about whether students retain and apply knowledge in subsequent courses. This study evaluates instructional quality using durable knowledge transfer-whether learning from introductory courses persists into and supports achievement in advanced coursework-as a complementary evaluation framework. The COVID-19 pandemic created a quasi-natural experiment comparing two cohorts in Principles of Macroeconomics. The 2019 cohort experienced traditional face-to-face instruction; the 2020 cohort participated in online instruction with a collaborative, research-based Final Report. Using longitudinal data (n = 159), we estimate econometric models examining immediate learning, knowledge persistence, heterogeneous effects by ability, and the importance of specific assessment components. Four key findings emerge. First, the online redesign maintained immediate learning outcomes across ability levels. Second, both cohorts demonstrated significant durable knowledge transfer to Intermediate Macroeconomics with equivalent transfer elasticities across instructional modes. Third, knowledge transfer benefits are equitably distributed-both Merit Scholars and nonscholars earned statistically equivalent Final Report grades, yet demonstrated differential knowledge transfer elasticities. This divergence reveals a critical insight: assessment performance alone incompletely captures the depth and durability of learning, particularly for higher-ability students operating closer to performance ceilings. Non-scholars experienced larger knowledge gains as they developed fundamental conceptual competencies through authentic problem-solving, while scholars exhibited diminishing marginal returns as they applied existing analytical capabilities. Fourth, the collaborative Final Report shows approximately three times stronger associations with subsequent performance than traditional assessment components, suggesting that assessment emphasizing authentic problem-solving engages deeper cognitive processes that produce more durable, transferable knowledge. These findings establish longitudinal analysis of knowledge transfer as an evaluation framework, demonstrate that authentic assessment can reveal differential learning mechanisms masked by grade equivalence, provide evidence that online instruction with thoughtful assessment maintains quality and inclusivity, and identify how assessment design shapes cognitive engagement and knowledge durability across the ability distribution.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用COVID-19疫情创造的准自然实验（2019年面对面教学班 vs 2020年线上教学班），以"持久知识迁移"作为评价教学质量的补充框架，通过纵向追踪数据（n=159）发现：线上教学改革保持了即时学习效果，两种教学模式在知识迁移弹性上无显著差异；但评估成绩相同的不同能力学生在知识迁移上存在差异，非奖学金生通过真实问题解决获得更大的知识增益；协作式期末报告对后续学业表现的关联强度约为传统评估的三倍，表明真实情境评估能促进更深层次的认知加工和更持久的知识迁移。
AI.research_question: 如何用"持久知识迁移"（从入门课程到高级课程的延续与应用）作为评价教学质量的补充框架？线上教学设计与真实情景评估如何影响不同能力学生的即时学习效果和长期知识迁移？
AI.motivation: 传统大学教学评估依赖课程成绩和考试成绩等即时性指标，无法反映学生是否真正保留知识并在后续课程中应用。需要一种更全面的评估框架来衡量教学质量的长期效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识迁移理论（knowledge transfer）、持久学习（durable knowledge）、真实情境评估（authentic assessment）与认知加工深度、边际收益递减理论
AI.method: 利用COVID-19疫情作为准自然实验，比较2019年（面对面教学）和2020年（线上教学+协作研究型期末报告）两个宏观经济学原理课程班，使用纵向数据（n=159）构建计量经济学模型，分析即时学习、知识持久性、能力异质性效应及特定评估成分的重要性。
AI.findings: （1）线上教学改革在所有能力水平上保持了即时学习结果；（2）两个队列均表现出显著的知识迁移到中级宏观经济学课程，且不同教学模式的迁移弹性相当；（3）知识迁移收益公平分配——Merit Scholars和非学者在期末报告成绩上统计等价，但知识迁移弹性存在差异：非学者通过真实问题解决获得更大的知识增益，学者因接近成绩天花板呈现边际收益递减；（4）协作式期末报告与后续成绩的关联强度约为传统评估的三倍，表明真实情境评估促进更持久的可迁移知识。
AI.theory_contributions: 将纵向知识迁移分析确立为教学评估的理论框架；证明真实情境评估能揭示被分数等价掩盖的差异化学习机制；识别评估设计如何塑造认知参与度和不同能力分布上的知识持久性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学教学评估提供"持久知识迁移"这一补充评价框架；为教育管理者提供线上教学与真实情境评估设计有效性的实证证据，支持线上线下融合教学的质量保障和包容性设计决策。

title: Observable AI Capability and Firm Uncertainty: Market Reassurance versus Operating Volatility
affiliations: Prague University of Economics and Business, University of the Azores and Hofstra University

detail.title: Observable AI Capability and Firm Uncertainty: Market Reassurance versus Operating Volatility
detail.abstract: We examine whether observable artificial intelligence (AI) capability reduces firm-level uncertainty. We construct a novel firm-level measure of AI capability by linking patent-level classifications from the USPTO Artificial Intelligence Patent Dataset to patent–firm assignments for U.S. public firms. Using a staggered-adoption difference-in-differences design, we find that with the first observed AI patent grant, the annualized stock-return volatility declines by 3.5 percentage points. By contrast, the first AI patent has no statistically significant average effect on operating cash-flow volatility. however, the operational consequences become clear when we examine individual AI technologies and the depth of firms’ AI capability. Patents in machine learning, natural-language processing and speech, computer vision, and AI hardware reduce stock-return volatility by 2.3 to 5.8 percentage points, whereas machine-learning and NLP patents increase operating cash-flow volatility by 0.9 and 0.8 percentage points, respectively. These findings are robust when analyzing accumulated AI patent stock, and across alternative specifications.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建基于专利的AI能力度量指标，利用交错采用双重差分设计，发现企业首次获得AI专利后股票收益波动率下降3.5个百分点，但不同AI技术（机器学习、NLP、计算机视觉、AI硬件）对股票收益波动率和经营现金流波动率的影响存在显著差异。
AI.research_question: 可观察的人工智能能力是否能够降低企业层面的不确定性？
AI.motivation: 人工智能能力对企业的影响日益重要，但已有研究缺乏对企业层面AI能力的系统度量，且对AI能力如何影响企业不确定性的实证证据不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业能力理论和技术创新经济学的框架，将AI能力视为企业不确定性降低的重要因素。
AI.method: 构建基于USPTO人工智能专利数据集与企业专利分配匹配的新型企业层面AI能力指标，采用交错采用双重差分（staggered-adoption difference-in-differences）设计进行因果识别。
AI.findings: （1）企业首次获得AI专利后，年化股票收益波动率下降3.5个百分点；（2）首次AI专利对经营现金流波动率无显著平均效应；（3）机器学习、NLP和语音、计算机视觉、AI硬件领域的专利使股票收益波动率下降2.3至5.8个百分点；（4）机器学习和NLP专利分别使经营现金流波动率上升0.9和0.8个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将AI能力与企业不确定性联系起来，提出并验证了AI能力异质性对企业不确定性影响的差异化理论机制，丰富了企业能力与不确定性关系的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者评估AI投资价值提供实证依据，为企业根据自身风险偏好选择不同的AI技术方向提供决策参考，同时为投资者和监管部门理解企业AI能力的经济后果提供证据。

title: Cross-dataset transportability of pediatric chest X-raydeep learning across three countries: discrimination,calibration, operating-point failure, and limited-labelrecovery
affiliations: American International University Bangladesh

detail.title: Cross-dataset transportability of pediatric chest X-raydeep learning across three countries: discrimination,calibration, operating-point failure, and limited-labelrecovery
detail.abstract: Background and Objective: External evaluation of medical-imaging AI isoften collapsed into discrimination. We evaluated a computational protocolthat separately tests discrimination, probability calibration, fixed operatingpoint transport, shortcut-associated signal, and limited-label recoverabilityfor pediatric pneumonia classification across datasets from three countries.Methods: After exact-duplicate removal, 5,824 Guangzhou radiographssupported leakage-controlled source development and internal testing. Afrozen three-seed DenseNet121 dual-view ensemble was evaluated zero-shoton BDCXR-3257 from Bangladesh (n = 3,257) and an untouched harmonizedVinDr-PCXR/PediCXR test cohort from Vietnam (n = 1,077). Matchedseed-42 variants tested architectural robustness. Secondary BDCXR analysesused a fixed 651-image adaptation pool and 2,606-image hold-out; 163, 326,and 651 labels represented 5%, 10%, and 20% of complete BDCXR.Results: Internal AUROC was 0.976 with 95.1% sensitivity. BDCXR andVinDr-PCXR AUROC were 0.798 and 0.742, while frozen-threshold sensitivityfell to 6.2% and 0%. Source-to-BDCXR AUROC degradation occurred fora full-image baseline (0.961 to 0.749), ungated dual-view model (0.977 to0.766), and gated MixStyle model (0.966 to 0.789). With 163 BDCXR labels,Platt recalibration preserved AUROC while increasing held-out sensitivityto 88.3%, but specificity was 47.9% and the alert rate was 78.5%. Twohundred repeated 163-label fits confirmed sensitivity recovery but substantialspecificity variability.Conclusions: Cross-dataset shifts across countries affected ranking, probability alignment, and source-defined decision behavior differently. Transportstudies should evaluate these components separately and quantify the operational burden of apparent recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了一种计算协议，用于分别测试医学影像AI在儿科肺炎分类中的判别能力、概率校准、固定操作点迁移、捷径相关信号和有限标签可恢复性，涉及中国、孟加拉国和越南三个国家的数据集。
AI.research_question: 外部评估医学影像AI时，仅用判别指标是否足够？跨数据集迁移如何影响不同性能维度，以及有限标签重校准能否恢复操作点行为？
AI.motivation: 外部评估通常被简化为判别指标（如AUROC），忽略了概率校准、固定操作点迁移等关键维度，导致对模型跨数据集部署性能的理解不完整。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医学影像AI外部验证理论；概率校准理论；分布偏移与迁移学习理论；有限标签学习理论。
AI.method: 使用冻结的DenseNet121双视图集成模型进行零样本跨数据集评估（中国→孟加拉国→越南），通过AUROC、校准、固定阈值灵敏度、Platt重校准等方法分别测试各性能维度，并进行重复拟合验证稳健性。
AI.findings: 内部AUROC达0.976，但在跨国数据集上降至0.798和0.742，固定阈值灵敏度骤降至6.2%和0%。用163个标签进行Platt重校准可恢复灵敏度至88.3%，但特异性仅47.9%、告警率高达78.5%，且重复拟合显示特异性波动显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出应将医学影像AI的外部评估分解为判别、校准、操作点迁移、捷径信号和有限标签可恢复性等多个独立维度，而非仅用单一判别指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医学影像AI的跨国部署提供了多维评估协议，量化了有限标签重校准策略的"表观恢复"与实际操作负担之间的差距，指导临床部署决策。

title: The Long Shadow of Communal Violence: Childhood Exposure and Later-Life Mental Health
affiliations: University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB), Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad and

detail.title: The Long Shadow of Communal Violence: Childhood Exposure and Later-Life Mental Health

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: We study the long-run relationship between childhood exposure to communal violence and women’s mental health in India.
