We make three contributions: (1) a unified evaluative framework enabling systematic comparison across distinct philosophical traditions, (2) an operational nested CES Islamic SWF rooted in Al-Ghazali's tripartite hierarchy, illustrated with empirical data from 34 Indonesian provinces, and (3) a practical policy decision matrix for function selection based on policy objectives. Our analysis reveals that no single SWF satisfies all desirable properties; the choice is inescapably normative. Atkinson's SWF and Sen's income-based SWF exhibit the broadest compatibility, while the Islamic SWF offers a distinctive multidimensional alternative integrating material, spiritual, social, environmental, and intergenerational dimensions. We conclude with comprehensive mapping tables and practical guidance for policymakers.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地将十种主要社会福利函数（SWF）放在统一的十五原则框架（七项技术性、八项规范性）下进行评估。研究发现没有任何单一SWF能满足所有理想属性，选择本质上是规范性的。Atkinson SWF和Sen基于收入的SWF兼容性最广，而以Al-Ghazali三层级结构为基础的伊斯兰SWF提供了融合物质、精神、社会、环境和代际维度的独特多维替代方案。论文还提供了基于34个印尼省份数据的实证说明和面向政策制定者的实用决策矩阵。
AI.research_question: 如何将个体福祉聚合为能够指导政策决策的社会排序？十种主要社会福利函数在统一的评估框架下表现如何？
AI.motivation: 不同哲学传统下存在多种社会福利函数，但缺乏一个统一的框架来系统比较它们的优劣和适用场景，政策制定者难以在不同SWF之间做出有依据的选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会福利函数理论；十五原则统一评估框架（七项技术性+八项规范性原则）；Al-Ghazali三层级需求层级理论；嵌套CES（常替代弹性）社会福利函数
AI.method: 构建统一的十五原则评估框架，对十种主要SWF进行系统性评估；提出嵌套CES伊斯兰SWF，并利用34个印尼省份的实证数据进行说明；构建政策决策矩阵以指导函数选择。
AI.findings: （1）没有任何单一SWF能满足所有理想属性，SWF的选择本质上是规范性的；（2）Atkinson SWF和Sen的收入基础SWF展现出最广泛的兼容性；（3）伊斯兰SWF提供了整合物质、精神、社会、环境和代际五个维度的独特多维替代方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次建立了跨越不同哲学传统的统一SWF评估框架（十五原则），使不同理论传统间的系统比较成为可能；提出了操作化的嵌套CES伊斯兰SWF，将Al-Ghazali的三层级层级结构转化为可应用的福利函数形式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了实用的政策决策矩阵，帮助政策制定者根据政策目标选择适合的社会福利函数；提供了全面的映射表和面向政策制定者的实践指导；通过印尼34个省份的实证数据展示了伊斯兰SWF的实际可操作性。

title: When Workers are Scarce: Labor-shortage Exposure and Corporate Default Risk
affiliations: Queen Mary University of London, Northern Trust Corporation - Northern Trust Asset Management and Griffith University - Griffith Business School

detail.title: When Workers are Scarce: Labor-shortage Exposure and Corporate Default Risk
detail.abstract: We examine whether firm-level labor-shortage exposure predicts corporate default risk. Using an earnings-call-based measure of labor scarcity, we find that firms discussing labor shortages more intensively subsequently move closer to the default boundary. The effect is economically meaningful, with a one-standard-deviation increase in LBSE associated with a roughly 3-4% decline in distance-to-default. Identification tests around the 2017 tightening of U.S. immigration policy show that labor-intensive firms experience both a relative increase in LBSE and a subsequent deterioration in default risk. The result is robust to alternative exposure and default-risk measures, demanding fixed effects, macro-labor controls, Bartik 2SLS, matching, entropy balancing, placebo timing tests, and subsample analyses. Channel tests point to higher debt costs, weaker organizational capital, and lower operating performance. Overall, the evidence recasts labor scarcity as a credit-risk exposure, not merely an operating constraint.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现企业层面的劳动力短缺暴露（LBSE）能显著预测企业违约风险。基于财报电话会议文本构建的劳动力稀缺度量指标显示，劳动力短缺讨论越多的企业，其距离违约边界越近。通过2017年美国移民政策收紧作为外生冲击进行识别，并进行了多种稳健性检验，证实了劳动力短缺是企业信用风险的重要暴露因素。
AI.research_question: 企业层面的劳动力短缺暴露是否能够预测企业违约风险？其内在机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多将劳动力短缺视为企业经营约束，但缺乏证据表明其是否构成信贷风险暴露。劳动力短缺可能通过提高债务成本、削弱组织资本和降低经营绩效等渠道影响企业偿债能力，因此需要系统检验劳动力稀缺与信用风险之间的因果关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信用风险理论（距离违约模型/结构化违约模型），将劳动力短缺视为影响企业资产价值和违约边界的关键风险因素；结合劳动经济学中劳动力市场摩擦理论，以及资源基础观中组织资本对企业竞争力的作用。
AI.method: 利用财报电话会议文本构建企业层面劳动力短缺暴露（LBSE）指标；使用距离违约（distance-to-default）衡量违约风险；以2017年美国移民政策收紧作为外生冲击进行DID识别；采用Bartik 2SLS、倾向得分匹配、熵平衡、安慰剂检验等多种稳健性检验方法。
AI.findings: LBSE每增加一个标准差，距离违约指标下降约3-4%；移民政策收紧后，劳动密集型企业LBSE上升且违约风险恶化；渠道检验表明劳动力短缺通过提高债务成本、削弱组织资本和降低经营绩效三个渠道加剧违约风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将劳动力短缺重新定义为信用风险暴露而非仅仅是运营约束，拓展了企业违约风险的理论驱动因素；丰富了劳动力市场摩擦与企业财务决策交叉领域的理论框架；为结构化违约模型提供了劳动力维度的重要补充。
AI.practical_contributions: 为债权人、投资者和信用评级机构提供了新的风险预警指标（LBSE）；为政策制定者评估移民政策和劳动力市场政策对企业财务稳健性的影响提供实证依据；为企业管理者识别和缓解劳动力短缺带来的财务风险提供参考。

title: The Problem of Copyright Compliance in the Music Industry of Bangladesh: An analysis
affiliations: and Southeast University

detail.title: The Problem of Copyright Compliance in the Music Industry of Bangladesh: An analysis
detail.abstract: According to the 2015 Report of International Property Rights Index, Bangladesh in terms of Intellectual Property (IP) protection stands itself at 128th out of 129 countries. Moreover, it is the Asian country with the highest copyright piracy rate. In this connection, one of the major victimized sectors is music industry where piracy rate is shockingly 96%. Availability of pirated musical works, absence of adequate incentive for musical actors and weaker legal and social structure are mainly responsible for such unhappy situation. This paper examines the reasons for this shocking situation, seeks possible alternatives from international and foreign standards and essentially provides some recommendations to improve copyright enforcement in music industry of Bangladesh.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨孟加拉国音乐产业版权保护严重不足的问题（盗版率高达96%），分析其原因并借鉴国际标准提出改善版权执法的建议。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国音乐产业为何存在高达96%的盗版率？如何借鉴国际和外国标准来改善其版权执法？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国在知识产权保护排名中位列128/129，且是亚洲版权盗版率最高的国家，其中音乐产业盗版率高达96%，严重损害了音乐创作者和相关从业者的利益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识产权保护理论、版权执行理论
AI.method: 定性分析，基于国际知识产权保护指数报告和外国标准进行比较研究
AI.findings: 盗版音乐作品的可得性、音乐从业者缺乏足够激励、以及法律制度和社会结构薄弱是导致孟加拉国音乐产业盗版率惊人的主要原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家版权保护不足的原因分析提供案例参考，揭示法律与社会结构对版权执行的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国政策和立法者提供改善音乐产业版权执法的具体建议，并可借鉴至其他面临类似问题的国家。

title: The Distribution of Observational Capacity in Environmental Governance: Epistemic Position, Establishment, and the Duty to Look

detail.title: The Distribution of Observational Capacity in Environmental Governance: Epistemic Position, Establishment, and the Duty to Look
detail.abstract: The architecture developed in the earlier papers of this series presupposes throughout that parties can observe the field they govern: conditions must be characterised, changes assessed against records, couplings established, and approaching thresholds detected. This paper takes that presupposition as its subject. Observational capacity is unevenly held, its distribution follows the distribution of instruments and of operational tenure, and the international record shows warning and monitoring coverage lowest where exposure is highest. The method is conceptual and the paper's contribution is to state why this distribution is a matter of justice and not of service quality, and what follows procedurally. Four positions are developed. Observational capacity is constituted by duration and cannot be acquired at the moment of need, since establishing that a coupling obtains requires paired records spanning a multiple of the coupling's own timescale, so capacity is a stock accumulated by presence and no expenditure substitutes for the years not observed. This yields an establishment frontier whose adverse property is that the couplings requiring the longest records are those whose alteration is least reversible, so the parties least instrumented are excluded from precisely the claims that matter most. A governing principle keyed to a property that must be established, as this series' principle is, therefore allocates protection along the distribution of instruments unless something is done about it, and four asymmetries compound: over establishment, over the standards defining what counts as unusual, over the credibility accorded to accounts, and over which couplings are examined at all. The paper's constructive proposal is a duty to look, owed by parties holding capacity toward couplings their own conduct bears on, with an adverse inference available where the duty is unmet, drawing on the treatment of evidential control in the law of proof; and a set of presumptions operating where capacity is absent, so that the silence of the unobserved is not read as the safety of the unobserved. The paper surveys environmental justice, procedural rights in environmental law, epistemic injustice, community-based monitoring, indigenous data sovereignty, the sociology of undone science, and the law of evidential control, states what each owns, and identifies the residue. It reports no empirical study.

AI.tldr: 本文是系列论文中的一篇，聚焦于治理中"观测能力"的分配正义问题。论文认为观测能力是一种通过时间积累形成的"存量"，无法在需要时即时获得，其分布与仪器和运营权属的分布相一致，且国际记录显示预警和监测覆盖在暴露度最高的地区反而最低。论文提出四项立场：观测能力由持续时间构成、存在一个"建立前沿"（耦合需要最长的记录往往是最不可逆的），治理原则按仪器分布分配保护，以及四种不对称（建立、异常标准、可信度和检查范围）。建设性提议是"注视义务"（duty to look）和"不利推断"机制，并引入一系列推定以防止"未观测的沉默被解读为未观测的安全"。
AI.research_question: 观测能力的分布不均为何是一个正义问题而非简单的服务质量问题？以及这种分布对治理程序性规则有何影响？
AI.motivation: 系列论文的架构预设了各方能够观测其所治理的领域（条件必须被表征、变化需对照记录评估、耦合需建立、阈值需被检测），但这一预设本身未被审视。现实中观测能力分布极不均匀，国际记录显示监测覆盖在风险暴露最高的地区反而最低。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了环境正义、环境法中的程序性权利、认识论不正义（epistemic injustice）、社区主导监测、原住民数据主权、未完成科学的社会学（sociology of undone science）以及证据控制的法律（law of evidential control）等理论资源。
AI.method: 概念分析方法，无实证研究。
AI.findings: （1）观测能力由持续时间构成，不能即时获得；（2）存在"建立前沿"——需要最长记录的耦合其改变最不可逆，因此仪器最少的当事方被排除在最关键的诉求之外；（3）以需建立的性质为关键的治理原则会沿仪器分布分配保护；（4）四种不对称叠加：建立上的不对称、界定"异常"标准的不对称、账户可信度的不对称、被检视耦合范围的不对称。
AI.theory_contributions: 论证观测能力分布问题属于正义范畴而非服务质量范畴；提出"注视义务"（duty to look）与不利推断机制，借鉴证据法中对证据控制的处理；提出在观测能力缺失时运作的推定体系，防止"未观测的沉默"被误读为"未观测的安全"。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了建设性的程序性救济方案：持有观测能力的当事方对其行为所涉及的耦合负有"注视义务"，未尽义务时适用不利推断；在观测能力缺失处引入推定，改变证据负担的分配。

title: Trade, Power, and Resources in the New Political Economy of Energy Diplomacy and Supply Chain Resilience

detail.title: Trade, Power, and Resources in the New Political Economy of Energy Diplomacy and Supply Chain Resilience

detail.abstract: The global shift from fossil fuels toward renewable energy is not only a technical or envi ronmental project; it is reshaping the very structure of international economic power. This paper examines how the transition away from hydrocarbons is forcing states to rethink trade policy, industrial strategy, and diplomacy around a new class of strategic goods: crit ical minerals, battery components, and clean-technology hardware. Using the analytical lens of International Political Economy (IPE), the study places two rival traditions– neo mercantilism and liberal institutionalism– alongside Global Value Chain (GVC) theory to explain why supply chains that once seemed like purely commercial arrangements have become sites of geopolitical contest. The paper argues that market concentration in mining and, more importantly, in mineral processing has given a small number of states, most no tably China, a form of structural leverage that is increasingly described as the “weaponiza tion of interdependence.” It traces how policy responses in the United States and the European Union– from the Inflation Reduction Act to the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism– are reorganizing trade flows along political rather than purely comparative advantage lines, producing strategies commonly labelled friend-shoring and near-shoring. The paper also investigates the macroeconomic consequences of this fragmentation, par ticularly “greenflation,” and evaluates strategic stockpiling and diversification as resilience tools. A separate section considers how these dynamics are experienced by developing countries, which hold much of the world’s mineral wealth yet often capture the smallest share of its value, and asks what a genuinely “just” energy transition would require. The paper concludes that supply chain resilience cannot be achieved through unilateral protec tionism alone; it requires coordinated, rules-based cooperation that treats critical mineralsas a shared strategic concern rather than a zero-sum prize. Twelve original figures are used throughout to illustrate market concentration, policy timelines, and resilience frameworks, and the paper closes with a set of concrete policy recommendations for both advanced and developing economies.

AI.tldr: 本文从国际政治经济学视角分析全球能源转型如何重塑国际经济权力结构，探讨关键矿产、电池组件和清洁技术硬件如何成为地缘政治争夺的场所，批判性比较了新重商主义与自由制度主义两大传统及全球价值链理论，并以中国在矿产加工环节的结构性杠杆为例，分析了美国与欧盟（如《通胀削减法案》和碳边境调节机制）的政策应对及其对贸易流向的重新组织。
AI.research_question: 能源转型如何重塑国际经济权力结构？关键矿产供应链如何从纯商业安排转变为地缘政治竞争场所？供应链碎片化对宏观经济和发展中国家有何影响？
AI.motivation: 全球从化石燃料向可再生能源的转变不仅是技术或环境工程，更在重塑国际经济权力的基本架构，而现有研究对供应链地缘政治化及其宏观经济后果的深层机制探讨不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际政治经济学（IPE），新重商主义、自由制度主义、全球价值链（GVC）理论，"相互依赖武器化"概念。
AI.method: 理论分析框架与政策比较研究，结合12幅原创图表展示市场集中度、政策时间线和韧性框架，对美国与欧盟的政策案例（IRA与CBAM）进行追踪分析。
AI.findings: 矿业和矿产加工环节的市场集中使少数国家（尤其是中国）获得结构性杠杆，形成"相互依赖武器化"；美欧政策正在按政治而非比较优势逻辑重组贸易流，产生友岸外包和近岸外包策略；供应链碎片化引发"绿色通胀"；发展中国家拥有矿产财富但获取价值份额最小。
AI.theory_contributions: 将新重商主义、自由制度主义与GVC理论并列整合，提出供应链韧性不能通过单边保护主义实现，而需要以关键矿产作为共享战略关切进行协调的、基于规则的合作的结论。
AI.practical_contributions: 评估战略性储备和多元化采购作为韧性工具的效果，分析绿色通胀的宏观经济后果，为发达经济体和发展中经济体分别提出具体的政策建议，并探讨"公正"能源转型的要求。

detail.abstract:
This essay asks why some countries became rich while others stayed poor, and what changes when a technology, for the first time, embeds part of cognitive capacity itself in the infrastructure. It reads the classic explanations of the Great Divergence (geography, institutions, useful knowledge, fossil energy, colonialism) as components of a single mechanism, the multiplier: effective productive capacity is the capacity of the individual multiplied by the quality of the system. Technology transfers; the system that makes it productive does not. The empirical anchor is Comin and Mestieri's finding that adoption lags converge while intensity of use diverges, and that this second divergence explains about 80 per cent of the income gap since 1820. Applied to artificial intelligence, the mechanism produces two simultaneous forces: on the side of access, AI converges (it raises the productivity of less experienced workers most, and the price of inference has fallen by over 99 per cent in two years); on the side of production, it diverges (AI compute hubs exist in 32 countries, over 150 have none, and four US companies will invest 720-745 billion dollars in 2026). Which force prevails in a country depends on its multiplier: institutions, energy, skills, organisation. The final part examines Europe and Italy (productivity, energy prices, skills, adoption gap between large and small firms, Transizione 4.0 and Nuova Transizione 5.0 incentives) and closes with five verifiable conditions, each with an indicator, for a convergence that can be checked against the data of the coming years.

English edition (August 2026) of the Italian first edition, Quando anche l'intelligenza diventa infrastruttura. Dalla Grande divergenza all'età dell'intelligenza artificiale, Lean4digital srl, Brescia, 25 August 2026, ISBN 979-12-82585-00-2, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22095141. English edition: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22109416. 36 pages, 58 footnotes, 3 figures, 1 table. Licence CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨为何一些国家变富而另一些国家仍然贫穷，提出"乘数"机制（有效生产能力=个人能力×系统质量）统一解释大分流中的地理、制度、有用知识、化石能源和殖民主义等经典理论，并将其应用于人工智能时代。作者认为AI在获取端趋于收敛，但在生产端趋于发散，哪个力量占主导取决于国家的乘数（制度、能源、技能、组织）。最后以欧洲和意大利为例，提出五个可验证的收敛条件。
AI.research_question: 为什么一些国家变富而另一些仍然贫穷？当一种技术首次将部分认知能力嵌入基础设施时，会发生什么变化？人工智能是否会导致国家间收入收敛还是发散？
AI.motivation: 传统大分流解释（地理、制度、有用知识、化石能源、殖民主义）往往被视为相互独立的因素，本文试图将它们统一为一个机制。同时，AI作为首次将认知能力嵌入基础设施的技术，其扩散模式对全球收入差距的影响需要新的分析框架。实证锚点是Comin和Mestieri的发现：技术采纳滞后趋于收敛，但使用强度发散，后者解释了1820年以来约80%的收入差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: "乘数"机制（multiplier）：有效生产能力=个体能力×系统质量。技术可以转移，但使技术发挥生产力的系统无法转移。AI时代的双重效应：获取端收敛（AI最高程度提升经验较少工人的生产力，推理价格两年下降超99%）与生产端发散（AI算力中心仅存在于32个国家，150多个国家没有，四家美国公司2026年将投资7200-7450亿美元）。
AI.method: 理论综合与概念框架构建：将经典大分流理论整合为统一机制；基于Comin和Mestieri的实证发现作为经验锚点；对AI领域的实证数据进行分析（算力中心分布、推理价格下降、投资规模）；以欧洲和意大利为案例研究（生产力、能源价格、技能、大小企业采纳差距、Transizione 4.0和Nuova Transizione 5.0激励政策）；提出五个可验证条件并附指示器。
AI.findings: 国家贫富差距的根源在于"乘数"差异而非单纯的技术获取差异；技术采纳滞后收敛而使用强度发散是解释收入差距的关键；AI在获取端趋于收敛（降低低经验工人生产力差距、推理成本急剧下降），但在生产端趋于发散（算力基础设施高度集中）；一个国家的制度、能源、技能和组织质量（乘数）决定哪种力量占主导；提出五个可验证条件及对应指标用于检验未来AI驱动的收敛。
AI.theory_contributions: 将大分流的五种经典解释（地理、制度、有用知识、化石能源、殖民主义）统一为单一的"乘数"机制框架；将Comin和Mestieri的"采纳滞后收敛/使用强度发散"实证发现上升为分析AI时代收入分配的理论基础；提出AI时代"获取端收敛"与"生产端发散"的双重力量分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者（尤其是欧洲和意大利）提供AI时代国家竞争力分析框架；提出五个可验证条件及指标，便于以数据检验政策效果；分析意大利的Transizione 4.0和Nuova Transizione 5.0激励政策，为AI时代的产业政策提供具体指导；指出大小企业间的采纳差距和能源价格、技能供给等具体政策瓶颈。

title: Beyond the Unemployment Rate: A Structural Labor Market Indicator
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland

detail.title: Beyond the Unemployment Rate: A Structural Labor Market Indicator

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 058, 2026[10.17016/FEDS.2026.058]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Labor market variables frequently send conflicting signals about the degree of slack or tightness, often complicating policy assessments at critical junctures. This paper develops a Structural Labor Market Indicator (SLMI) for the U.S. economy that addresses the limitations of existing univariate measures or atheoretical statistical approaches that synthesize multiple labor market indicators but cannot distinguish between supply and demand driving forces. We construct the SLMI using a medium scale New Keynesian DSGE model featuring search and matching frictions, endogenous labor force participation, and variable hours. The model is disciplined by a comprehensive dataset that includes not only labor market variables but also other macroeconomic aggregates. The SLMI synthesizes model-implied gaps across multiple labor market dimensions using principal component analysis. We show that GDP growth and inflation provide substantial information about labor market slack beyond what labor market variables contain, validating our multi-variable structural approach. Relative to alternative measures, the SLMI often provides earlier warnings of deteriorating conditions at recession onset but recovers more gradually during expansions.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个结构劳动力市场指标（SLMI）来度量美国经济的劳动力市场松弛程度。该指标基于一个中等规模的新凯恩斯主义DSGE模型，融合搜索匹配摩擦、内生劳动力参与和可变工作时间，并通过主成分分析综合多个劳动力市场维度的模型隐含缺口。研究发现GDP增长和通胀为劳动力市场松弛提供了重要补充信息，且SLMI在经济衰退初期能更早发出预警，但在扩张期恢复较慢。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够综合多个劳动力市场指标、同时区分供给与需求驱动因素的结构性劳动力市场指标（SLMI）？
AI.motivation: 现有的单一劳动力市场指标或基于（非理论的）统计方法的综合指标存在局限——前者信息不全面，后者无法区分劳动力市场的供给与需求驱动力量，这在关键时刻常使政策评估复杂化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯主义DSGE模型（中等规模），包含搜索与匹配摩擦、内生劳动力参与率、可变工作时间。
AI.method: 使用包含劳动力市场变量及其他宏观经济总量在内的全面数据集对DSGE模型进行校准；利用模型生成多个维度的劳动力市场缺口；通过主成分分析（PCA）将这些缺口综合为单一SLMI指标。
AI.findings: （1）GDP增长和通胀为评估劳动力市场松弛提供了超出劳动力市场变量本身的大量额外信息，验证了多变量结构性方法的有效性；（2）与替代指标相比，SLMI在衰退初期往往能更早发出劳动力市场恶化预警，但在经济扩张阶段的恢复速度较慢。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个基于结构性DSGE模型的多维劳动力市场指标，克服了传统单变量指标和非理论统计合成方法的局限，能够在结构上区分劳动力市场的供给与需求驱动因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了一个更全面、更具结构性基础的劳动力市场松弛度监测工具，能够更早识别衰退信号，有助于在关键时刻做出更及时准确的政策评估。

title: Can Governments Really Change Retirement Saving Habits? A Comparison between Australia and New Zealand
affiliations: Formerly Co-Director, Retirement Policy & Research Centre, University of Auckland

detail.title: Can Governments Really Change Retirement Saving Habits? A Comparison between Australia and New Zealand

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: No-one funded the research.

detail.abstract: Australia's compulsory system has transformed how household wealth is packaged there: superannuation is 49% of Australian household financial assets against 11% in New Zealand. However, it has not made households wealthier, relative to their incomes: net worth is nine to ten times income in both countries, and the median New Zealand adult ranks fourth in the world for wealth, only one place behind Australia. Australian household debt has climbed to 177% of income while New Zealand's has been flat at about 125% for two decades. Once Australia's superannuation tax concessions are counted, the true fiscal gap between the two retirement systems over the long-term is roughly half what the headline superannuation numbers suggest. Poverty rates amongst the old in each country also don't establish a 'winner'. Nothing in the available data shows widespread under-saving in New Zealand. This paper suggests that making KiwiSaver compulsory can wait until the data exist to justify it. However, New Zealand does need a data-and research-led discussion about both public and private provision for retirement. We have never done that.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比澳大利亚强制养老金（superannuation）与新西兰自愿性KiwiSaver制度，发现强制性体系虽然改变了家庭财富的持有形式（澳洲养老金占家庭金融资产49%，新西兰仅11%），但并未使家庭相对收入更富有（两国净资产均为收入的9-10倍）；澳洲家庭债务攀升至收入177%而新西兰维持在125%左右；考虑税收优惠后两国养老金体系的实际财政差距约为表面数字的一半。文章认为在新西兰缺乏充分数据证明养老金储蓄普遍不足之前，不应强制推行KiwiSaver，但新西兰确实需要以数据和研究为导向的退休保障公共讨论。
AI.research_question: 强制性养老金制度是否真正使家庭更富裕？新西兰是否应当效仿澳大利亚推行强制性KiwiSaver制度？
AI.motivation: 新西兰面临是否将自愿性KiwiSaver改为强制性制度的政策讨论，而澳大利亚的强制性superannuation常被作为成功范例引用。本文旨在通过两国数据的系统比较，检验强制性养老金制度是否真的优于自愿性制度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于对强制性储蓄与自愿性储蓄制度下家庭财富积累比较的经济学分析框架，综合考察资产配置结构、债务水平、税收政策及老年贫困率等多个维度的制度绩效。
AI.method: 采用澳大利亚与新西兰两国的宏观比较数据分析方法，从家庭金融资产结构、净资产与收入比、家庭债务水平、养老金税收优惠、老年贫困率等多个指标进行跨国对比研究。
AI.findings: 1）强制性养老金改变了资产包装形式但未提升财富水平：两国净资产相对收入均为9-10倍；2）澳洲家庭债务（177%收入）远高于新西兰（125%）；3）计入税收优惠后，两国养老金体系长期财政差距约为表面数字的一半；4）老年贫困率数据同样不能证明哪国制度更优；5）现有数据未显示新西兰存在普遍的储蓄不足问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"强制性养老金制度必然优于自愿性制度"的主流假设，指出强制性制度可能只是重新组合了家庭资产负债结构（提高养老金资产与债务），而未必提升整体福利水平，为养老金制度比较研究提供了更全面的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新西兰政策制定者提供了暂缓强制推行KiwiSaver的数据支持，同时呼吁建立以数据和研究为导向的退休保障政策讨论机制，对两国退休制度现状提供了全面的实证评估。

title: Autoencoder-based H&E stain deconvolution: a cross-domain approach with histological image segmentation and classification analyses
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Autoencoder-based H&E stain deconvolution: a cross-domain approach with histological image segmentation and classification analyses
detail.abstract: Background and Objective: Cancer diagnosis in hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) histological images relies on visual assessment by specialists, which is complex and subjective. Computational methods have been used to support histopathological analysis, especially in segmentation and classifica- tion tasks. However, color variations caused by tissue preparation, staining, and digitization protocols may affect image appearance and algorithm per- formance. This study aimed to propose and evaluate an autoencoder-based method for H&E stain deconvolution by a cross-domain estimation of con- centration maps.Methods: The proposed method was based on the Beer–Lambert opti- cal model and investigated different loss functions, skip-add connections, and training strategies for stain deconvolution. Public histological image datasets were used for quantitative evaluation, visual analysis, and downstream ex- periments involving nuclei segmentation and image classification. Structural similarity index measure (SSIM) and peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) were used when reference concentration maps were available.Results: In the dataset with reference concentration maps, the best val-ues achieved across the proposed configurations were SSIM and PSNR of 0.8436 and 39.4546 for hematoxylin, and 0.7530 and 35.7264 for eosin, re- spectively. Although literature methods achieved higher quantitative values on global reconstruction metrics, the proposed method generated visually interpretable maps aligned with relevant histological structures. This struc- tural and biological fidelity is critical in clinical computer-aided diagnosis, as it mitigates stain-mixing artifacts and ensures that feature extraction relies on true tissue morphology rather than pixel noise. In downstream tasks, the deconvolved HE channel input alone did not outperform RGB images in nuclei segmentation, whereas the combined RGB+HE representation was more competitive, with gains of up to 0.0130 in sensitivity. In classification, the effect of deconvolution varied according to the dataset and network. For multiclass colorectal images, the best result of the proposed method was an F1-score of 0.4164. In the binary cervical dataset, the proposed method with RGB+HE input achieved an F1-score of 0.9888 and an AUC of 0.9988.Conclusions: Autoencoder-based H&E stain deconvolution is a promis- ing strategy for generating complementary representations to RGB images in histopathological analysis. However, limitations remain regarding the se- lective separation of hematoxylin, eosin, and background, which motivates future works.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了一种基于自编码器的H&E染色反卷积方法，通过跨域估计浓度图来分离苏木精和伊红通道。该方法基于Beer-Lambert光学模型，探索了不同损失函数、跳跃连接和训练策略。实验表明，虽然全局重建指标（SSIM/PSNR）不及文献方法，但生成图在结构生物学保真度上更优，且RGB+HE组合输入在下游任务中表现更具竞争力。
AI.research_question: 如何利用自编码器方法实现H&E组织病理图像的染色反卷积，通过跨域估计浓度图来分离苏木精和伊红通道，并评估其在分割和分类等下游任务中的表现？
AI.motivation: 癌症诊断中H&E组织学图像的视觉评估复杂且主观，而染色制备、组织处理和数字化协议的差异会导致颜色变化，影响图像外观和算法性能。现有计算方法需要一种能够有效处理染色偏差、生成生物学可解释表示的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: Beer-Lambert光学模型（染色浓度与光吸收的线性关系）、自编码器架构（用于跨域估计浓度图）
AI.method: 基于Beer-Lambert光学模型的自编码器方法，探索不同损失函数、跳跃连接（skip-add connections）和训练策略；使用公开组织病理数据集，进行定量评估（SSIM、PSNR）、视觉分析和下游实验（细胞核分割、图像分类）。
AI.findings: 在具有参考浓度图的数据集中，苏木精通道达到SSIM 0.8436和PSNR 39.4546，伊红通道达到SSIM 0.7530和PSNR 35.7264。文献方法在全局重建指标上更高，但本文方法生成视觉可解释的浓度图，与相关组织结构对齐。在下游任务中，单独的HE通道在核分割上不优于RGB，但RGB+HE组合更优（灵敏度最高提升0.0130）；在宫颈二分类数据集中RGB+HE输入取得F1-score 0.9888和AUC 0.9988。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自编码器与Beer-Lambert光学模型相结合实现H&E染色反卷积，证明了基于自编码器的方法能够在保持生物学结构保真度的同时进行染色分离；揭示了不同网络配置（损失函数、跳跃连接、训练策略）对染色反卷积效果的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床计算机辅助诊断提供了互补性表示生成策略，缓解染色混合伪影，确保特征提取依赖真实组织形态而非像素噪声；在下游分割和分类任务中验证了RGB+HE组合输入的实践价值。

title: Length-of-stay prediction using physician latent traits
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Length-of-stay prediction using physician latent traits
detail.abstract: Background and Objective: Variation in length of stay (LoS) across physicians is documented in the multilevel-modelling literature, but that literature is explanatory. In prediction models the physician identifier is routinely dropped because of missingness and high cardinality. In public EHRs the physician exists only as a de-identified identifier with no observed attributes, leaving nothing from which to build a feature.Methods: We used 294,701 admissions from MIMIC-IV v3.1 (148,239 patients, 1,807 physicians), restricted to information available at admission; diagnosis codes, assigned at discharge, were excluded as leakage. Cyclic dual latent discovery (CDLD) found a 64-dimensional latent trait for each physician from interaction records alone, combined with 54 patient features, and assessed by five-fold cross-validation with fold-paired t-tests. As comparators we added the physician's historical mean LoS (raw and empirical-Bayes shrunk) and case volume as single columns.Results: The historical mean alone reached RMSE 4.302 days (R² 0.085), below the 54-feature patient model (4.387 days, R² 0.048). Adding physician latent traits gave 4.270 days (R² 0.098), improving on patient features alone by 0.117 days (p<0.0001). Of that improvement, 0.090 days (77%) was reproduced by the single mean column; latent traits added 0.027 days (23%; p<0.001, all five folds). Shuffle and stratification analyses showed that latent discovery depended primarily on records per entity.Conclusions: Physicians with no observed attributes can be represented from interaction records and contribute to LoS prediction. Patients, whose records are sparse, could not, which supports the asymmetric design. Whether the gain translates into operational benefit was not evaluated.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种循环双隐变量发现（CDLD）方法，仅从医患交互记录中提取医生的64维隐特质，用于住院时长（LoS）预测。在MIMIC-IV的294,701次入院数据上，该方法在54个患者特征基础上额外提升了0.117天的预测精度（RMSE 4.270天，R² 0.098），其中77%的提升可由医生历史均值简单特征复现，隐特质贡献23%的额外增益。研究还发现隐变量发现的效率主要取决于每条实体的记录数量，患者因记录稀疏无法获得相似效果。
AI.research_question: 在公有电子健康记录（EHR）中，医生仅以去标识化的ID存在且缺少可观察属性时，能否仅从交互记录中提取医生表征并用于住院时长预测？
AI.motivation: 现有文献中医生间住院时长差异已被记录，但主要集中在解释性多层级建模；在预测模型中，医生标识符因缺失和高基数问题常被丢弃。由于公有EHR中医生无任何属性特征可构建，需要探索从交互记录中学习医生表征的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多层级建模视角下的医生间住院时长差异理论；隐变量发现（latent discovery）方法；交互记录驱动的实体表征学习；经验贝叶斯收缩估计。
AI.method: 使用MIMIC-IV v3.1的294,701次入院记录（148,239名患者、1,807名医生），采用循环双隐变量发现（CDLD）方法从交互记录中提取每位医生的64维隐特质，结合54个患者特征构建预测模型，通过五折交叉验证和配对t检验评估；以医生历史均值住院时长（原始及经验贝叶斯收缩）和病例量作为基线比较特征。
AI.findings: （1）医生历史均值特征单独即可达到RMSE 4.302天（R² 0.085），优于54特征的纯患者模型（4.387天，R² 0.048）；（2）加入医生隐特质后RMSE降至4.270天（R² 0.098），比纯患者模型提升0.117天（p<0.0001）；（3）该提升中77%（0.090天）可由单一历史均值列复现，隐特质额外贡献23%（0.027天，p<0.001）；（4）洗牌与分层分析表明隐变量发现主要依赖于每条实体的记录数量，患者因记录稀疏而无法获得同等效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次证明在没有可观察属性的公有EHR环境中，仅从交互记录即可学习医生隐表征并用于预测任务；揭示了隐变量发现的效率受实体记录密度制约，支持了不对称设计（医生记录稠密、患者记录稀疏）的合理性；为多层级文献中的医生间LoS差异提供了预测建模视角的补充。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公有EHR数据集中缺乏属性标注的医生提供了可用的表征学习方法；CDLD方法可将医生历史均值特征替换为更丰富的隐特质表征，从而小幅但显著提升住院时长预测精度；但在转化为运营效益前需进一步评估。

title: The Cost of being Different: Name Rarity and Analyst Research
affiliations: , College of Management and Economics and China Center for Social Computing and Analytics and Tianjin University

detail.title: The Cost of being Different: Name Rarity and Analyst Research
detail.abstract: We examine whether the rarity of an analyst's given name, a stable attribute of personal identity, is associated with how analysts produce research and how their research is received by market participants. Using nationwide frequencies covering approximately 1.2 billion Chinese citizens, we measure the rarity of the characters in each analyst's given name. Analysts with rarer names issue forecasts that depart farther from consensus, and these departures are more informative. Their reports draw on scarcer information sources, and their coverage portfolios are more focused. Yet this differentiated research receives weaker recognition: rare-name analysts obtain less management access, are less likely to attain star status, and elicit smaller short-window reactions to favorable recommendations. Those recommendations subsequently earn higher risk-adjusted returns over the following one to three months. Together, the findings reveal a wedge between production and recognition. The identity associated with differentiated information production also shapes the access, professional evaluation, and market attention that determine how quickly that information is incorporated.

AI.tldr: 本文研究分析师名字的罕见程度（一个稳定的个人身份属性）如何影响其研究报告的产出以及市场对其研究的接受程度。基于覆盖约12亿中国公民的全国性姓名频率数据，发现名字更罕见（即名字中的汉字使用频率更低）的分析师发布的预测更偏离共识，且这些偏离更具信息含量。他们的报告引用更稀缺的信息来源，覆盖的投资组合更为聚焦。然而，这种差异化研究获得的市场认可度却更低：罕见名字的分析师获得的管理层接触机会更少，更不可能成为明星分析师，其正面推荐在短期内引发的市场反应也更小。但这些推荐在随后1-3个月内获得了更高的风险调整后收益。研究揭示了信息生产与市场认可之间的"鸿沟"（wedge）。
AI.research_question: 分析师的个人身份属性（名字的罕见程度）如何影响其研究报告的产出质量以及市场对这些研究的接受和认可程度？
AI.motivation: 已有文献多关注分析师的能力、经验、机构激励等因素对研究产出和认可的影响，但忽略了稳定的个人身份属性（如名字）可能对分析师行为和市场反应产生的系统性影响。名字作为个人身份的稳定标识，可能通过影响分析师的自我认知、社会互动和他人对其的刻板印象，进而塑造其信息生产过程与市场认可度之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 身份经济学理论；信息差异化生产理论；市场认可与社会资本理论；刻板印象与偏见理论
AI.method: 基于覆盖约12亿中国公民的全国性姓名频率数据库，度量分析师名字中汉字的罕见程度。通过实证分析检验名字罕见度与分析师预测偏离共识程度、信息含量、信息来源稀缺性、覆盖组合集中度、管理层接触、明星分析师评选、短期市场反应及后续收益之间的关联。
AI.findings: （1）名字更罕见的分析师发布的预测更偏离共识，且这些偏离更具信息含量；（2）他们的报告引用更稀缺的信息来源，覆盖组合更为聚焦；（3）罕见名字分析师获得的管理层接触更少，成为明星分析师的可能性更低；（4）其正面推荐在短期窗口内引发的市场反应更小，但在随后1-3个月获得更高的风险调整后收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了信息生产与市场认可之间的"鸿沟"（wedge），表明与差异化信息生产相关联的个人身份特征同样塑造了分析师获取资源、获得专业评价和市场关注的程度，从而影响信息融入价格的效率。这一发现将个人身份属性纳入分析师行为和资本市场信息效率的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资本市场参与者（投资者、券商管理层）提供了理解分析师研究差异性和市场认可度偏差的视角。提示投资者应关注那些短期内未被市场充分反应但具有更高信息含量的差异化研究，同时也为证券行业的分析师评价与激励机制设计提供了参考依据。

reference: FEDS Working Paper No. 2026-59
title: Characterizing the Conditional Pricing Kernel: A New Approach

detail.title: Characterizing the Conditional Pricing Kernel: A New Approach

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 059, 2026[10.17016/FEDS.2026.059]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: I propose a novel method to reliably estimate the conditional pricing kernel by incorporating conditioning variables. The VIX and the term spread are most informative variables for identifying state prices. The conditional kernel estimate exhibits significant time variation: the more favorable market expectations, the higher state prices in negative return states. During bad times, the equity premium implied by the conditional kernel is fully attributable to compensation for left-tail scenarios, in contrast to findings from the unconditional kernel. Lastly, the conditional kernel estimate yields superior out-of-sample option pricing performance compared to the unconditional kernel estimate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合条件变量的方法来可靠估计条件定价核（conditional pricing kernel）。研究发现VIX和期限利差是识别状态价格最具信息量的变量。条件核估计表现出显著的时间变化：市场预期越乐观，负收益状态下的状态价格越高。在经济低迷时期，条件核隐含的股权溢价完全可归因于左尾情景的补偿，这与无条件核的发现不同。最后，条件核估计在样本外期权定价方面优于无条件核估计。
AI.research_question: 如何通过纳入条件变量来更可靠地估计条件定价核，并考察其时间变化特征及其在期权定价中的表现？
AI.motivation: 传统的无条件定价核估计可能忽略了市场状态信息，导致对状态价格和股权溢价的估计存在偏差。通过纳入条件变量（如VIX和期限利差），可以更准确地刻画定价核的动态特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 定价核理论（pricing kernel）、条件资产定价理论
AI.method: 提出一种结合条件变量的条件定价核估计新方法，使用VIX和期限利差作为条件变量，并通过实证分析检验条件核的时间变化及其期权定价表现。
AI.findings: 1. VIX和期限利差是识别状态价格最具信息量的变量；2. 条件核估计呈现显著时间变化，市场预期越乐观，负收益状态下状态价格越高；3. 经济低迷时期，条件核隐含的股权溢价完全由左尾情景补偿驱动，与无条件核的结论不同；4. 条件核估计在样本外期权定价中优于无条件核估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文为条件定价核的估计提供了新方法，揭示了定价核的时变特征，并修正了无条件核在解释股权溢价来源上的偏差（特别是在经济低迷时期左尾风险的作用）。
AI.practical_contributions: 条件定价核估计在样本外期权定价中表现更优，为期权定价实务提供了更准确的定价工具；同时为投资者理解市场状态与风险补偿之间的关系提供了新的视角。

title: The Role of Stablecoins in Cross-Border Payments: USDT and USDC Under Sanctions
affiliations: Independent; MGIMO (Moscow State University of International Relations)

detail.title: The Role of Stablecoins in Cross-Border Payments: USDT and USDC Under Sanctions
detail.abstract: This paper examines the growing role of dollar-pegged stablecoinsprimarily Tether (USDT) and USD Coin (USDC)-as a quasi-settlement infrastructure for cross-border payments under conditions of financial sanctions. Drawing on recent market data, the Russian regulatory experience, and the case of Iran, the paper argues that stablecoins have become a systemic parallel payment layer that partially substitutes for SWIFT-based correspondent banking while simultaneously introducing a new form of dependency on centralized dollar-denominated issuers. The analysis concludes that stablecoins play a dual role: they enhance payment efficiency and sanctions resilience, but they also reproduce, rather than eliminate, exposure to U.S.-dollar infrastructure and issuerlevel risk.

AI.tldr: 本文考察了与美元挂钩的稳定币（主要是USDT和USDC）在金融制裁条件下作为跨境支付准结算基础设施的日益增长的作用，认为稳定币已形成一种系统性的平行支付层，部分替代了基于SWIFT的代理银行体系，但同时引入了对中心化美元发行方的新型依赖。
AI.research_question: 在金融制裁条件下，美元挂钩稳定币如何作为跨境支付的准结算基础设施发挥作用？它们是否真正替代了传统的SWIFT代理银行体系，还是仅仅转换了依赖形式？
AI.motivation: 随着金融制裁的扩大，传统美元支付通道（如SWIFT代理银行）受到限制，稳定币作为替代支付工具的使用显著增长，但学术界对稳定币在制裁条件下作为系统性支付基础设施的作用缺乏系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融制裁与支付基础设施理论；跨境支付体系依赖理论；准结算基础设施概念
AI.method: 本研究采用多案例分析方法，结合市场数据、俄罗斯监管经验和伊朗案例进行定性分析。
AI.findings: 稳定币已形成系统性平行支付层，部分替代SWIFT代理银行体系；稳定币发挥双重角色：一方面增强支付效率和制裁韧性，另一方面并未消除对美元基础设施和发行方层面风险的暴露，而是将其重新生产。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"稳定币作为准结算基础设施"的概念框架，揭示了稳定币在制裁条件下既提供替代又产生新型依赖的双重性，丰富了关于金融制裁与支付体系演化的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解稳定币在制裁环境下的系统性影响提供参考；提示各国在利用稳定币规避制裁的同时需关注对中心化发行方的依赖风险；为评估稳定币监管和国际支付体系改革提供实证依据。

title: Classification of Cervical Histopathological Images Using the DualScopeNet Model
affiliations: Shenyang Medical College, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Classification of Cervical Histopathological Images Using the DualScopeNet Model
detail.abstract: Background and Objective: Cervical cancer remains one of the most prevalent malignancies among the female population worldwide. Accurate diagnosis and grading are essential for determining optimal treatment strategies and improving patient survival outcomes. This study aims to develop a PyTorch-based deep learning framework, termed DualScopeNet, for the identification, localization, classification, and grading of cervical lesion regions in histological images.,Methods: A total of 1,010 histological images were collected, encompassing eight distinct categories: normal tissue, intraepithelial lesions, squamous cell carcinoma, adenocarcinoma, and others. The proposed DualScopeNet model was designed to automatically identify key regions in cervical images, enabling the localization, classification, and grading of abnormal areas. Model performance was evaluated using multiple metrics and compared against existing approaches, including U-Net, HistoSeg, VMamba, and Vision GNN.,Results: On the test set, DualScopeNet achieved an average IoU of 87.24%, an average Dice coefficient of 93.02%, an average accuracy of 93.95%, and an average precision of 92.14%. Squamous cell carcinoma yielded the best segmentation performance (IoU 94.51%, Dice 97.18%). Adenocarcinoma (IoU 86.74%, Dice 92.90%) and intraepithelial lesions—LSIL and HSIL, with Dice scores of 94.58% and 93.12%, respectively—also demonstrated commendable results. For morphologically complex categories such as metaplasia and atrophy, the model attained Dice scores of 84.45% and 88.41%, respectively. Comparative analysis revealed that DualScopeNet outperformed other approaches across all evaluation metrics.,Conclusions: The proposed DualScopeNet model enhances the accuracy and consistency of cervical lesion identification, reduces subjective human error, and provides an efficient and reliable auxiliary diagnostic tool for clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个基于PyTorch的深度学习框架DualScopeNet，用于宫颈组织病理图像的病变区域识别、定位、分类和分级。模型在1,010张涵盖8种类别的组织学图像上训练和测试，在测试集上取得了87.24%的平均IoU、93.02%的平均Dice系数、93.95%的平均准确率和92.14%的平均精确率，综合性能优于U-Net、HistoSeg、VMamba和Vision GNN等现有方法，为临床提供了一种高效可靠的辅助诊断工具。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个基于深度学习的自动化框架，实现对宫颈组织病理图像中病变区域的准确识别、定位、分类和分级？
AI.motivation: 宫颈癌是全球女性最常见的恶性肿瘤之一，准确的诊断和分级对制定最佳治疗策略和改善患者生存至关重要。传统人工病理诊断存在主观性高、一致性差等问题，亟需开发自动化辅助诊断工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习的分割与分类理论，具体包括编码器-解码器架构、多尺度特征提取、以及图像分割和分类的联合学习框架。
AI.method: 收集1,010张涵盖8种宫颈组织学类别的病理图像，设计DualScopeNet深度学习模型实现病变区域的定位、分类和分级，并使用IoU、Dice系数、准确率和精确率等多种指标进行评估，与U-Net、HistoSeg、VMamba和Vision GNN等方法进行对比。
AI.findings: DualScopeNet在测试集上取得87.24%的平均IoU、93.02%的平均Dice系数、93.95%的平均准确率和92.14%的平均精确率。鳞状细胞癌分割效果最佳（IoU 94.51%，Dice 97.18%）；腺癌和上皮内病变（LSIL和HSIL）也表现良好；对于形态复杂的类别（化生和萎缩）Dice得分分别为84.45%和88.41%。在所有评估指标上均优于对比方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了DualScopeNet这一新型深度学习框架，将病变区域的识别、定位、分类和分级任务整合到统一模型中，并在多种复杂病理类别上验证了方法的有效性，为宫颈组织病理图像的自动化分析提供了新的技术路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 提高了宫颈病变识别的准确性和一致性，减少了主观人为误差，为临床实践提供了高效、可靠的辅助诊断工具，有助于改善宫颈癌患者的诊疗效果。

reference: Peter B. Andersen and Peter Gundelach (eds.), Changing Religiosities in the Nordic Countries. A Complexity Perspective (232-251 [chapter 10]). Brill, 2025.
title: National Identity and Religion in the Nordic Countries: Politicians or Majority Churches Framing Perceptions of Diversity, Religion and belonging
affiliations: VID Specialized University and Helsinki University

detail.title: National Identity and Religion in the Nordic Countries: Politicians or Majority Churches Framing Perceptions of Diversity, Religion and belonging

publicationDetails.detailsText: Peter B. Andersen and Peter Gundelach (eds.), Changing Religiosities in the Nordic Countries. A Complexity Perspective (232-251 [chapter 10]). Brill, 2025.

detail.abstract: The chapter shows that while political positions vary, the official voices in the majority churches have been generally more inclusive than those of the politicians. With some variations, the position of the majority churches in the Nordic countries is positive toward including immigrants in society, based on Christian values of hospitality and mercifulness to strangers. In contrast, right-wing political groups in all countries make references to Christianity in ways that are exclusionary or nationalist. Definitions of what constitutes Christian values may become politicalized and debated, and churches that engage in the debate risk being accused of being too political.

AI.tldr: 本章探讨了北欧国家多数教会官方立场与政治家（尤其是右翼政治团体）在移民议题上的立场差异。研究发现，多数教会的官方声音总体比政治家更具包容性，基于基督教好客与怜悯陌生人的价值观，倾向于支持移民融入社会；而各国右翼政治团体则以排斥性或民族主义的方式引用基督教。教会参与此类辩论可能面临被指责过于政治化的风险。
AI.research_question: 北欧国家多数教会的官方立场与政治家（特别是右翼政治团体）在移民议题上的立场有何差异？教会如何定义和运用基督教价值观？
AI.motivation: 理解在移民议题上，宗教机构（教会）与政治力量（右翼政党）如何在基督教价值观的解释权上产生分歧与交锋。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基督教价值观的诠释与政治化；宗教与政治的边界理论；移民融入与排斥的叙事框架。
AI.method: 比较分析，覆盖多个北欧国家的教会官方声明与政治团体言论。
AI.findings: 多数教会官方立场总体比政治家更具包容性，基于基督教好客与怜悯陌生人的价值观支持移民融入；右翼政治团体以排斥性或民族主义方式引用基督教；基督教价值观的定义可能被政治化并引发争论；参与争论的教会有被指责过于政治化的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了宗教价值观在移民议题上被不同主体（教会与政治团体）策略性引用的差异，以及宗教组织参与公共辩论时面临的政治化困境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解北欧国家宗教与政治在移民议题上的互动提供实证依据，对教会如何在不失宗教正当性的前提下参与公共政策辩论具有启示意义。

reference: FEDS Notes No. 2026-08-19
title: Liquidity Transformation Risks in U.S. Bank Loan and High-Yield Mutual Funds: A 2026 Update
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston, Federal Reserve Bank of Boston, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Federal Reserve Board of Governors and Federal Reserve Board of Governors

detail.title: Liquidity Transformation Risks in U.S. Bank Loan and High-Yield Mutual Funds: A 2026 Update

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Mutual funds (MFs) and other open-ended collective investment funds engage in liquidity transformation—they offer investors daily redemptions while investing in assets that may take longer than a day to sell without significant price impact. This activity is particularly salient for corporate debt funds, where large investor redemptions during stress periods could result in fire sales that adversely affect underlying markets (see, e.g., Goldstein, Jiang, and Ng, 2017; Chernenko and Sunderam, 2020; Falato, Goldstein, and Hortaçsu, 2021; Federal Reserve Board, 2025).

AI.tldr: 本文研究开放式共同基金（尤其是公司债基金）的流动性转换活动——为投资者提供每日赎回，同时投资于可能需要更长时间才能出售的资产。这种流动性错配在压力时期可能引发大规模赎回和抛售（fire sales），对底层市场产生不利影响。
AI.research_question: 开放式共同基金（特别是公司债基金）的流动性转换活动如何运作，以及这种活动在压力时期对底层市场产生何种影响？
AI.motivation: 开放式共同基金向投资者提供每日赎回承诺，但同时投资于流动性较差的资产，这种流动性错配在大规模赎回时可能导致被迫抛售，进而引发底层市场的价格紊乱和系统性风险。已有文献（如Goldstein等2017；Chernenko和Sunderam 2020；Falato等2021；美联储2025）均指出这一问题在公司债基金中尤为突出。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流动性转换理论；开放式基金赎回机制与资产流动性错配理论；金融脆弱性与系统性风险理论。
AI.method: 本文为研究综述/引言性质的论文，通过梳理已有文献（Goldstein, Jiang, and Ng 2017; Chernenko and Sunderam 2020; Falato, Goldstein, and Hortaçsu 2021; Federal Reserve Board 2025）来系统阐述开放式基金流动性转换的机制及其风险。
AI.findings: 开放式共同基金存在显著的流动性转换活动，即"每日赎回+长期资产"的错配模式；在公司债基金中，压力时期的大规模投资者赎回可能导致底层资产被迫抛售，对债券市场产生负面溢出效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了关于开放式基金流动性转换及其金融稳定影响的既有研究，为理解基金流动性错配与底层市场脆弱性之间的关系提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了关于开放式基金流动性风险的实证证据和理论依据，有助于制定缓解基金赎回压力与防止系统性风险的政策措施。

title: MBF-Net: Multi-Scale Fusion for Health-Aware Solenoid Valve Current Prediction
affiliations: Northwestern Polytechnical University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: MBF-Net: Multi-Scale Fusion for Health-Aware Solenoid Valve Current Prediction
detail.abstract: The health state of solenoid valves directly determines the operational reliability of aerospace propulsion systems. To address the scarcity of fault samples and the inability of traditional pointwise time-series prediction to support full-cycle valve monitoring in reusable scenarios, this paper proposes the Multi-Scale Bidirectional Fusion Network (MBF-Net) for sequence-to-sequence prediction and anomaly detection of drive-end current signals. The method employs a hierarchical residual decomposition architecture, constructing multi-scale wavelet convolution branches to extract local high-frequency details and global low-frequency trends from current signals. A bidirectional fusion mechanism is designed to achieve cross-scale feature complementary enhancement, coupled with max pooling for hierarchical multi-resolution processing. Furthermore, a dynamic threshold band is derived from historical statistics, enabling anomaly detection using only normal data. Results on a proprietary liquid rocket engine solenoid valve dataset demonstrate superior performance: for rising-edge prediction, MAE and MSE are 2.2e-3 and 1.5e-5; for falling-edge, 1.9e-3 and 7.5e-6. These exceed LSTM, CNN, and other baselines. Moreover, it accurately identifies three typical faults: coil abnormality, spring failure, and spool sticking, providing technical support for health management and reusability of liquid rocket engine solenoid valves.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多尺度双向融合网络（MBF-Net），用于液体火箭发动机电磁阀驱动端电流信号的序列到序列预测与异常检测，解决了故障样本稀缺和传统逐点预测无法支持全周期监控的问题。该方法采用层次残差分解架构，结合多尺度小波卷积分支和双向融合机制，并利用动态阈值带实现仅基于正常数据的异常检测。在专有数据集上，上升沿和下降沿预测的MAE分别为2.2e-3和1.9e-3，能够准确识别线圈异常、弹簧失效和阀芯卡滞三类典型故障。
AI.research_question: 如何利用驱动端电流信号实现液体火箭发动机电磁阀全周期健康状态的序列到序列预测与异常检测？
AI.motivation: 电磁阀健康状态直接决定航天推进系统运行可靠性，但存在故障样本稀缺、传统逐点时间序列预测无法支持可重复使用场景下全周期阀监测的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多尺度小波变换理论、残差分解架构、双向特征融合机制、动态阈值统计分析
AI.method: 构建多尺度小波卷积分支提取局部高频细节和全局低频趋势，设计双向融合机制实现跨尺度特征互补增强，结合最大池化进行层次多分辨率处理，基于历史统计推导动态阈值带实现仅用正常数据的异常检测。
AI.findings: 在专有液体火箭发动机电磁阀数据集上，上升沿预测MAE为2.2e-3、MSE为1.5e-5，下降沿预测MAE为1.9e-3、MSE为7.5e-6，优于LSTM、CNN等基线方法，并能准确识别线圈异常、弹簧失效和阀芯卡滞三类典型故障。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出MBF-Net多尺度双向融合网络架构，将小波卷积与双向特征融合相结合实现跨尺度特征互补，并设计动态阈值带方法实现仅基于正常数据的异常检测，解决了故障样本稀缺下的监测难题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为液体火箭发动机电磁阀健康管理和可重复使用提供了技术支撑，能够准确识别三类典型故障（线圈异常、弹簧失效、阀芯卡滞），支持可重复使用场景下的全周期阀监控。

title: Taxing Generative AI: Evidence from Chicago

detail.title: Taxing Generative AI: Evidence from Chicago
detail.abstract: I provide the first estimate of consumers' demand elasticity for generative AI subscriptions, using variation from a 9% Chicago tax and transaction data. The tax passed through fully. ChatGPT subscriptions grew more slowly than in untreated ZIP3s, though not significantly. My point estimate is that demand is unit elastic and I rule out elasticities below −3. The cross-sectional income elasticity of subscriptions is positive but below one, so the tax was regressive for ChatGPT Plus plans. Using panel data, I provide a novel estimate of the income elasticity that uses only within-person variation, and find it is positive but only about one-third the cross-sectional magnitude. Finally, I show 22 states appear to tax ChatGPT, at an average rate exceeding 6.6%.

AI.tldr: 本文利用芝加哥9%的税收变动作为自然实验，首次估算了生成式AI订阅（ChatGPT）的需求价格弹性。研究发现税收完全转嫁，需求为单位弹性，且排除了弹性低于-3的可能。同时发现收入弹性为正但小于1，表明该税收具有累退性。基于面板数据的新估计显示，个体内部收入弹性仅为横截面估计的三分之一。最后，作者发现美国22个州对ChatGPT征税，平均税率超过6.6%。
AI.research_question: 消费者对生成式AI订阅（ChatGPT）的需求价格弹性是多少？该税收是否具有累退性？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI订阅服务快速增长，但对其需求弹性和税收影响缺乏实证估计。现有政策讨论中，多个州已在征收数字服务税，但缺乏对AI订阅需求弹性的严格估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求价格弹性理论、税收转嫁理论、收入弹性理论
AI.method: 利用芝加哥9%税收作为准自然实验，结合交易数据，比较征税区（芝加哥）与未征税区（其他ZIP3地区）的ChatGPT订阅增长率差异；使用横截面数据估计收入弹性，并使用面板数据基于个体内部变动估计收入弹性。
AI.findings: （1）税收完全转嫁给消费者；（2）ChatGPT订阅在征税区增长较慢但不显著；（3）需求为单位弹性，排除了弹性低于-3；（4）横截面收入弹性为正但小于1，税收具累退性；（5）面板数据收入弹性仅为横截面三分之一的量级；（6）22个州对ChatGPT征税，平均税率超过6.6%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了生成式AI订阅服务的需求价格弹性估计；提出了利用个体内部变动来估计收入弹性的新方法；为数字服务税的累退性提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估数字服务税对AI订阅的影响提供实证基础；为各州是否应对生成式AI服务征税提供了税收分配效应的参考；对AI企业的定价策略提供需求弹性信息。

title: The Need for Amendment of Section 172 of the Companies Act 2006 Due to Game Changer ESG: Double Enlightened Shareholder Value Approach for Sustainable and Purposeful Companies
affiliations: Queen Mary University of London

detail.title: The Need for Amendment of Section 172 of the Companies Act 2006 Due to Game Changer ESG: Double Enlightened Shareholder Value Approach for Sustainable and Purposeful Companies
detail.abstract:
This paper is cited in the UK Government (GOV.UK) research project on Director Perceptions of Section 172. [https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/director-perceptions-of-section-172-of-the-companies-act]
The spectacular rise of ESG usage in investment decision-making made public companies’ environmental and social attitudes critical more than ever as their shares are sold and bought in stock exchanges. Even though the enlightened shareholder value approach (ESV) by Section 172 (S172) of the Companies Act 2006 requires directors to pay regard to their decisions’ environmental and social impacts, UK public companies continue to commit environmental and social violations. Besides, the UK relied on soft laws instead of a radical reform that is in demand among UK companies and British community. This dissertation argues that it is time to amend S172 with second enlightenment by integrating the Purposeful Company Model (PCM) that aims to create a sustainable future by requiring companies to have a sustainable purpose, which blocks directors from pursuing shareholder wealth maximisation at the expense of non-shareholders. By the end of the research, the double enlightened shareholder value approach (D-ESV) is proposed with inspiration from PCM and its example in French law, which leads to higher ESG scores for better investment opportunities for UK public companies and a sustainable future for all.

AI.tldr: 本文主张修订英国《2006年公司法》第172条，引入"双重开明股东价值方法"（D-ESV），借鉴"有目的公司模式"（PCM）和法国法律经验，要求公司确立可持续目的，以防止董事以牺牲非股东利益为代价追求股东财富最大化，从而提升英国上市公司的ESG表现和投资机会。
AI.research_question: 如何修订英国《2006年公司法》第172条，以解决英国上市公司持续发生的环境与社会违规问题，并提升其ESG表现？
AI.motivation: ESG在投资决策中的重要性急剧上升，尽管S172的开明股东价值方法要求董事考虑环境和社会影响，但英国上市公司仍持续违反环境和社会法规；英国依赖软法而非英国公司和社区所需的激进改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开明股东价值方法（ESV）、有目的公司模式（PCM）
AI.method: 规范性法律分析/比较法学研究，借鉴法国法律中的相关实践作为灵感来源
AI.findings: 提出双重开明股东价值方法（D-ESV），即在S172中融合PCM模式，要求公司确立可持续目的，阻止董事以牺牲非股东利益为代价追求股东财富最大化，从而提升ESG评分。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"双重开明股东价值方法"（D-ESV）这一新概念，将PCM与ESV进行理论融合，拓展了公司治理中股东价值理论的边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为英国上市公司提供更高的ESG评分和更好的投资机会，为英国公共政策和立法修改提供建议，推动可持续未来的实现。

title: The Asymmetric Rise: Supply Dominance Without Import-Side Centrality in China's Integration into Global Production Networks
affiliations: Istanbul Bilgi University and Istanbul Bilgi University

detail.title: The Asymmetric Rise: Supply Dominance Without Import-Side Centrality in China's Integration into Global Production Networks
detail.abstract: We apply the HITS algorithm to a single-edition, balanced OECD ICIO panel of 80 economies, 1995-2022, to locate China in the global goods-production network across two layers, intermediate inputs and final goods. China's L 2-normalised authority centrality-its weight as a supplier to central importers-rises by 764% on the intermediate layer and 806% on the final layer, while its hub centrality, its role as a dependent importer, falls on both (-59%;-76%). An unweighted benchmark agrees: China's share of world cross-border intermediate-goods exports rises from 2.0% to 11.1%, and importers' summed dependence on Chinese intermediates rises 8.1-fold. On the import side, supplier concentration falls sharply, the new entrants being mostly low-authority emerging markets. The surge is broad-based across electronics, machinery, chemicals and metals, survives ending the sample in 2019, and occurs at a stable value-chain position (Antràs-Chor upstreamness 2.47 to 2.52). A counterfactual removing China shows that no single economy absorbs both of its roles, and a PPML gravity specification corroborates a positive post-WTO premium for China-involved pairs. Supply-chain risk therefore runs through supplies from China at both production stages, not through its role as an importer of intermediates. Services lie outside the ICIO goods tables and our scope.

AI.tldr: 本文运用HITS算法分析1995-2022年OECD ICIO面板数据（80个经济体），定位中国在全球商品生产网络中的双重角色：作为中间品和最终品供应商的权威中心度大幅上升（分别增长764%和806%），而作为依赖型进口商的枢纽中心度则大幅下降（分别下降59%和76%）。反事实分析显示没有单一经济体能够同时吸收中国的两个角色，PPML引力模型证实了入世后中国相关贸易对的正向溢价。
AI.research_question: 中国在全球商品生产网络中的供应和进口角色如何演变？其供应链风险主要存在于哪个环节？
AI.motivation: 理解中国在全球生产网络中的结构性地位变化，特别是区分其作为供应商（权威中心度）与作为进口商（枢纽中心度）的双重角色，以准确评估供应链风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: HITS算法（权威-枢纽中心度）、复杂网络分析、Antràs-Chor上游度指标、PPML引力模型
AI.method: 运用HITS算法对OECD ICIO面板数据进行两层（中间投入品和最终品）网络分析；采用未加权基准验证；进行反事实分析（移除中国）；采用PPML引力模型估计入世溢价。
AI.findings: 中国在中间品和最终品层的权威中心度分别上升764%和806%，枢纽中心度分别下降59%和76%；中国占世界跨境中间品出口份额从2.0%升至11.1%；进口商对中国中间品的依赖总和增长8.1倍；供应集中度显著下降且新进入者多为低权威新兴市场；增长在电子产品、机械、化学品和金属领域广泛存在；价值链位置保持稳定（上游度2.47-2.52）。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过区分权威中心度与枢纽中心度，揭示了全球生产网络中国家角色的不对称演变，将HITS算法创新性地应用于国际贸易网络分析，并明确了供应链风险主要源于中国作为供应商而非进口商。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业提供了供应链风险评估的新视角：风险集中在从中国的进口环节（中间品和最终品），而非中国作为进口商的作用；入世（WTO）溢价的存在为贸易政策评估提供实证依据。

title: Adaptive Graph-Temporal Learning for Cardiovascular Risk Prediction and ECGDiagnostic Classification
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Deakin University and Deakin University

detail.title: Adaptive Graph-Temporal Learning for Cardiovascular Risk Prediction and ECGDiagnostic Classification
detail.abstract: Early detection of cardiovascular disease is critical for timely clinical intervention. Leveraging the increasing availability of Electronic Health Records (EHRs) and physiological signals, recent advances in deep learning have shown promise in predictive modeling;however, existing approaches often struggle to jointly capture structural feature interdependencies and long-range temporal trends inherent in heterogeneous clinical data modalities. This study evaluates an adaptive attention-based deep learning architecturethat integrates Graph Attention Networks (GAT) with Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) networks, augmented by a temporal attention mechanism, to optimize predictive performance without early feature fusion. The framework is evaluated across two distinct clinical objectives: binary cardiovascular risk prediction using the cross-sectional Framingham Heart Study dataset, and multi-class diagnostic superclass classification using the high-resolution PTB-XL ECG dataset, with a derived binary NORM vs. Non-NORM screening view for clinical triage evaluation. Class imbalance within the Framingham training folds isaddressed using the Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE), applied strictly within each training fold to prevent data leakage. On the Framingham dataset, 5-fold stratified cross-validation yields an accuracy of 88.73 ± 1.54%, an AUC-ROCof 94.57 ± 0.67%, and an F1-score of 0.90. On the held-out PTB-XL test split, the model achieves a NORM-screening accuracy of 96.20%, a precision of 0.85, a recall of 0.98, and an F1-score of 0.91 with an overall 5-class classification accuracy of 96%. These outcomes outperform competitive machine learning and deep learning baselines, verifying the framework’s adaptability and capability to process heterogeneous clinical modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应注意力深度架构，将图注意力网络（GAT）与双向长短期记忆网络（Bi-LSTM）相结合，并辅以时间注意力机制，用于心血管疾病的早期预测。该框架在Framingham数据集（二元心血管风险预测）和PTB-XL心电图数据集（多类诊断分类）上均取得优异性能，超越了多种机器学习与深度学习基线。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种深度学习架构，能够同时捕捉异构临床数据中的结构化特征间依赖关系与长期时间趋势，从而提升心血管疾病早期预测性能？
AI.motivation: 心血管疾病早期检测对及时临床干预至关重要，但现有深度学习方法难以联合捕捉异构临床数据模态中固有的结构化特征间依赖关系和长期时间趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 图注意力网络（GAT）、双向长短期记忆网络（Bi-LSTM）、时间注意力机制、SMOTE过采样技术。
AI.method: 构建基于自适应注意力的深度学习框架：采用GAT捕捉结构化特征间的空间依赖关系，Bi-LSTM建模时间序列的长期趋势，时间注意力机制进一步优化时序特征权重；不使用早期特征融合；在Framingham训练折内使用SMOTE处理类别不平衡（避免数据泄漏）；采用5折分层交叉验证评估。
AI.findings: Framingham数据集上：准确率88.73±1.54%，AUC-ROC 94.57±0.67%，F1分数0.90；PTB-XL测试集上：NORM筛查准确率96.20%，精确率0.85，召回率0.98，F1分数0.91，5类总体分类准确率96%。均优于竞争性基线和深度学习方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种无需早期特征融合即可联合建模结构化特征依赖与长期时间趋势的通用深度学习架构，验证了GAT+Bi-LSTM+时间注意力组合在异构临床数据上的有效性与适应性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为心血管疾病早期筛查提供了高性能的预测工具，适用于跨截面数据和时序心电数据两种临床应用场景，具备临床分诊评估（NORM vs Non-NORM）的实用价值。

title: Integrated World Tuna Markets
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Integrated World Tuna Markets
detail.abstract: The Law of One Price (LOP) is a little bit like quantum entanglement: despite their functional or geographical distance, different markets with their own separate groups of buyers and sellers, can experience similar price changes, unrelated to local economic conditions, due to their economic integration.We test for LOP in the separate raw and canned tuna product world markets, where raw tuna is an input into canned tuna. The world markets for raw and tinned tuna products are interconnected, and we estimate a cointegrating long-run relationship between their prices that confirms LOP. In the long-run, the two markets are tightly integrated, with prices transmitted bilaterally between each. No evidence was found for transport costs creating price wedges. Short-term price adjustment - for a world market - is extremely quick: the two product markets equilibrated within 2-3 months of a price shock.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了一价定律（LOP）在生金枪鱼和罐装金枪鱼两个世界产品市场中的适用性。研究发现这两个市场之间存在长期协整关系，价格呈双向传导，市场高度整合，且价格冲击后2-3个月内即可完成短期调整，未发现运输成本造成价格楔子的证据。
AI.research_question: 生金枪鱼和罐装金枪鱼两个世界产品市场之间是否存在一价定律？价格传导的方向和调整速度如何？
AI.motivation: 将一价定律类比于量子纠缠，探究经济一体化中即便功能或地理距离遥远的市场，其价格变化如何相互关联并超越本地经济条件。选择生金枪鱼（上游投入品）和罐装金枪鱼（下游制成品）这一投入产出关联的市场组合来检验LOP。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一价定律（Law of One Price, LOP）理论；协整理论（cointegration）；国际市场价格传导理论。
AI.method: 采用协整分析（cointegration analysis），估计生金枪鱼与罐装金枪鱼价格之间的长期均衡关系，并检验短期价格调整动态。
AI.findings: (1) 生金枪鱼与罐装金枪鱼市场间存在长期协整关系，证实了一价定律；(2) 两个市场在长期中高度整合，价格呈双向传导；(3) 未发现运输成本造成价格楔子的证据；(4) 短期价格调整速度极快，价格冲击后2-3个月内即可实现市场均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 将一价定律的检验扩展到投入品-制成品（上游-下游）关联的全球商品市场，验证了协整框架下长期价格趋同的存在性；揭示了跨产品阶段市场的价格传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球金枪鱼产业的定价和风险管理提供依据；表明该市场遵循一价定律，价格调整迅速，有助于市场参与者理解价格联动模式并做出更准确的定价和采购决策。

title: Capital Flows in Risky Times: Risk-on Risk-off and the Amplifying Role of Passive Investment
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill, Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City and

detail.title: Capital Flows in Risky Times: Risk-on Risk-off and the Amplifying Role of Passive Investment
detail.abstract: Risk-on risk-off shocks have pronounced distributional impacts on emerging market capital flows, with passive funds playing an increasingly pivotal role in amplifying these effects. Using panel quantile regressions on weekly EPFR fund flow data, this paper demonstrates that global risk-off shocks reshape the entire probability distribution of capital flows, with the worst outflow realizations reacting far more than the median. Passive funds, given their limited discretion and benchmarking mandates, react nearly three times more forcefully than active funds in the tails. This amplification traces to ETFs, concentrates in risk-off episodes, and stems from credit repricing and liquidity conditions, offering new insights into the mechanisms driving tail risk in emerging markets.

AI.tldr: 本文利用EPFR周度基金流数据与面板分位数回归，研究全球风险偏好冲击对新兴市场资本流动的分布性影响，发现被动基金在尾部（极端资本外流）中的反应强度约为主动基金的三倍，且这一放大效应主要通过ETF在风险规避时期经由信用重新定价和流动性条件机制传导。
AI.research_question: 全球风险偏好（risk-on/risk-off）冲击如何影响新兴市场资本流动的整个概率分布？被动基金在这一过程中扮演何种角色？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场资本流动的极端尾部风险对金融市场稳定具有重大影响，而被动基金在其中的作用日益增强，但现有研究多关注均值效应，缺乏对分布尾部效应的深入理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本流动的分布性影响理论、被动基金管理约束（有限自由裁量权与基准跟踪要求）理论、分位数回归框架
AI.method: 基于EPFR周度基金流数据的面板分位数回归（panel quantile regressions）
AI.findings: (1) 全球风险规避冲击重塑资本流动的整个概率分布，最差流出实现值（尾部）的反应远大于中位数；(2) 被动基金在尾部的反应强度约为主动基金的三倍；(3) 该放大效应主要通过ETF渠道传导；(4) 效应集中在风险规避（risk-off）时期；(5) 机制源于信用重新定价与流动性条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 将资本流动研究从均值效应拓展到整个概率分布，揭示了被动基金在放大新兴市场资本流动尾部风险中的系统性作用及其传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场参与者提供了被动基金扩张背景下新兴市场资本流动尾部风险的监管与风险管理启示。

title: A Trustworthy Expert Decision-Support System for Underwater Acoustic Vessel Classification under Domain Shift
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Trustworthy Expert Decision-Support System for Underwater Acoustic Vessel Classification under Domain Shift

keywords.keywords: Underwater acoustic classificationVessel acoustic monitoringExpert decision supportDomain generalizationUncertainty estimationOut-of-distribution detectionTrustworthy artificial intelligence

detail.abstract: Underwater acoustic vessel classification is an important component of civilian maritime monitoring, autonomous underwater vehicle operation, port safety management, and environmental observation. Although recent deep-learning models achieve strong performance on public acoustic benchmarks, many are evaluated under closed-set and distribution-matched assumptions that are fragile in real deployments. Acoustic signatures vary with vessel speed, engine load, sensor type, recording location, background noise, and propagation conditions. As a result, a classifier can produce a high-confidence prediction even when the input is ambiguous or outside the training distribution. This paper proposes a trustworthy expert decision-support system for underwater acoustic vessel classification under domain shift. The proposed system, named UAMS-DSS, integrates four complementary components: multimodal acoustic representation learning from waveform, time–frequency, and low-frequency modulation views; domain-generalized feature learning to reduce sensitivity to recording-specific nuisance factors; evidential uncertainty and latent out-of-distribution scoring to estimate prediction reliability; and a risk-aware expert decision layer that converts model evidence into operator-oriented actions such as accept, monitor, reacquire, defer, and safety alert. The contribution of the paper is not a forced-label classifier alone, but a complete intelligent decision-support framework that separates recognition evidence, reliability estimation, and operational recommendation. A reproducible evaluation protocol is defined for public underwater acoustic datasets using recording-disjoint, vesseldisjoint, cross-dataset, and low-SNR settings. The framework is designed to be assessed using macro- F1, calibration error, out-of-distribution detection, selective risk, coverage, and action-level decision metrics, thereby aligning acoustic machine learning with the requirements of trustworthy expert systems in civilian maritime applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UAMS-DSS，一个面向领域偏移下水下声学船舶分类的可信专家决策支持系统。该系统整合多模态声学表征学习、域泛化特征学习、证据不确定性估计和风险感知决策层四个互补组件，将识别证据、可靠性估计和操作建议分离，形成一个完整的智能决策支持框架，而非仅是一个强制标签分类器。
AI.research_question: 如何在领域偏移（domain shift）条件下，构建一个可信赖的水下声学船舶分类专家决策支持系统，使其能够可靠地估计预测不确定性并向操作人员提供可执行的风险感知决策建议？
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型在水下声学船舶分类基准上表现良好，但多数在封闭集和分布匹配假设下评估，实际部署中声学信号随船舶速度、发动机负载、传感器类型、记录位置、背景噪声和传播条件变化，导致分类器对模糊或分布外输入产生高置信度错误预测，缺乏可信赖性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多模态表征学习、域泛化学习、证据深度学习（evidential deep learning）、分布外检测、风险感知决策理论
AI.method: UAMS-DSS框架包含四个互补组件：(1)从波形、时频和低频调制三个视角进行多模态声学表征学习；(2)域泛化特征学习以减少记录特定干扰因素的影响；(3)证据不确定性估计和潜在分布外评分以评估预测可靠性；(4)风险感知专家决策层，将模型证据转化为面向操作人员的行动建议（接受、监控、重新获取、延迟、安全警报）。评估采用记录分离、船舶分离、跨数据集和低信噪比的可复现协议。
AI.findings: 该框架通过将识别证据、可靠性估计和操作建议分离，能够在领域偏移下提供可信赖的决策支持。评估涵盖宏F1分数、校准误差、分布外检测、选择性风险、覆盖率和行动级决策指标等多个维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将识别、不确定性和操作建议相分离的完整智能决策支持框架，超越传统强制标签分类器范式；将证据深度学习、分布外检测和风险感知决策理论整合到水下声学分类任务中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为民用海事监测、自主水下航行器操作、港口安全管理和环境观测提供了可信赖的决策支持工具；定义了可复现的评估协议，使声学机器学习与可信专家系统要求对齐，有助于推动该系统在实际海洋场景中的部署。

title: Inflation and Exchange Rate Shocks in the Presence of Parallel Markets
affiliations: Harvard University and NYU Stern School of Business

detail.title: Inflation and Exchange Rate Shocks in the Presence of Parallel Markets
detail.abstract: We study exchange-rate pass-through to consumer prices where an official rate coexists with a parallel-market rate at a substantial premium, using monthly Nigerian data (2014-2023). Prices respond strongly to the parallel rate. In a structural VAR, a one-standard-deviation parallel-rate depreciation raises cumulative CPI by about 0.5% over the following year, implying a twelve-month structural pass-through of 0.29. By contrast, a shock that raises the official rate does not raise prices. The asymmetry holds across major CPI sub-indices, widens with the parallel premium, and is corroborated by a joint OLS local projection. We interpret these findings through a framework of foreign-exchange rationing and repressed goods markets, where the parallel rate is the marginal price of imports and the official rate acts only through fiscal financing and money creation. Central banks that track only the official rate may thus underestimate the sensitivity of inflation to exchange-rate movements in dual-rate regimes.​

AI.tldr: 本文利用尼日利亚2014-2023年的月度数据，研究官方汇率与平行市场汇率并存且溢价显著时，汇率对消费者价格的传导效应。研究发现价格对平行汇率反应强烈：结构性VAR显示，一个标准差的正向平行汇率贬值冲击会使未来一年累计CPI上升约0.5%，对应12个月结构性传导弹性为0.29；而官方汇率冲击不会推高价格。这一不对称性在主要CPI分项中均成立，且随平行溢价扩大而增强。
AI.research_question: 在官方汇率与平行市场汇率并存的双轨汇率制度下，汇率对消费者价格的传导效应如何？官方汇率与平行汇率对通胀的影响是否存在不对称性？
AI.motivation: 传统汇率传导研究大多假设单一汇率制度，忽视了双轨汇率体系中平行市场汇率作为边际进口价格的重要性。在存在外汇配给和商品市场压制的经济体中，仅关注官方汇率可能导致严重低估汇率变动对通胀的敏感性，误导中央银行的政策判断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外汇配给与商品市场压制框架：平行汇率是进口的边际价格，官方汇率仅通过财政融资和货币创造渠道发挥作用。
AI.method: 采用结构性VAR（SVAR）方法评估汇率冲击对CPI的动态影响，并结合联合OLS局部投影（local projection）进行稳健性检验；利用尼日利亚2014-2023年月度数据，涵盖总体CPI及各主要分项指数。
AI.findings: （1）平行汇率贬值冲击显著推高CPI：一个标准差冲击使累计CPI在一年内上升约0.5%，12个月结构性传导弹性为0.29；（2）官方汇率冲击不推高价格；（3）该不对称性在主要CPI分项中均成立；（4）平行溢价扩大时，不对称性更强；（5）局部投影方法结果与SVAR一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地在双轨汇率制度下区分官方汇率与平行汇率对消费者价格的传导效应，提出"平行汇率为边际进口价格、官方汇率仅通过财政货币渠道起作用"的理论框架，揭示传统单一汇率传导模型在双轨制下的适用性局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为双轨汇率制度国家的中央银行提供政策启示：仅盯住官方汇率会低估汇率变动对通胀的敏感性，应同时监测平行市场汇率动态及其溢价水平，以更准确地评估通胀风险和制定货币政策。

title: Is electrification the answer to decarbonising inshore fishing? - lessons learned from the Scottish commercial vessel 'Lorna Jane'
affiliations: Cranfield University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Cranfield University

detail.title: Is electrification the answer to decarbonising inshore fishing? - lessons learned from the Scottish commercial vessel 'Lorna Jane'
detail.abstract: Reducing greenhouse gases (GHG) from fisheries is enshrined in UK, European and global policies but examples of successful approaches are rare. In 2023, the inshore vessel ‘Lorna Jane’ was converted to battery-electric propulsion and has since been working in the Scottish inshore creel fishery. We present performance data supported by a Life Cycle Analysis (LCA) to show that the conversion has delivered reduced carbon emissions, alongside other significant benefits including reductions in noise and risk of hydrocarbon spills. The LCA did however identify some negative impacts, mostly associated with the manufacture of batteries and solar panels, and the electricity required for battery recharging. The case study demonstrates that battery-electric propulsion can undoubtedly contribute to the decarbonisation of inshore fishing but the scope for electrification of larger fishing vessels remains unproven. However, around 28% of UK, 19% of European Union, and 80% of global motorised fishing vessels are of similar length and engine power to the ‘Lorna Jane’, so such vessels might be suitable for electrification, although the type of fishing being undertaken can also be a constraint. Despite the success of the ‘Lorna Jane’ conversion, progress with decarbonisation through electrification is presently limited by access to renewable power in ports, as well as wider fishing industry scepticism and lack of experience in building, converting and operating electrically propelled vessels. Decarbonisation policies will need to recognise and address these issues in a more holistic manner if electrification is to play a major role in decarbonising inshore fisheries.

AI.tldr: 本文通过苏格兰近岸捕鱼船"Lorna Jane"从柴油动力改装为电池电动的案例研究，结合生命周期分析（LCA），证明电池电动推进能够显著减少碳排放，并带来降低噪音和减少碳氢化合物泄漏风险等额外效益。但LCA也识别出电池和太阳能板制造及充电用电带来的负面影响。研究指出，全球约28%的英国、19%的欧盟和80%的全球机动渔船与"Lorna Jane"规模和功率相似，具备电动化潜力，但港口可再生电力获取、行业怀疑态度和经验不足是当前主要制约因素。
AI.research_question: 电池电动推进能否有效实现近岸渔业的脱碳？其环境效益与制约因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 渔业温室气体减排已列入英国、欧盟和全球政策目标，但成功案例罕见。本研究通过实际改装案例填补这一空白，评估电池电动推进在近岸渔业脱碳中的可行性和潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期分析（LCA）框架，结合渔业脱碳政策背景与船舶电动化技术评估。
AI.method: 案例研究法：对"Lorna Jane"渔船改装为电池电动推进后的性能数据进行分析，并辅以生命周期分析（LCA）评估全生命周期的碳排放和环境影响。
AI.findings: 1. 电池电动改装显著降低了碳排放，并带来降噪和降低碳氢化合物泄漏风险等额外效益；2. LCA发现电池和太阳能板制造及充电用电存在负面环境影响；3. 约28%英国、19%欧盟和80%全球机动渔船规模与改装船只相似，具备电动化潜力，但作业类型可能构成约束；4. 港口可再生电力获取不足、行业怀疑态度和经验缺乏是当前主要制约因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 为渔业脱碳领域提供了首个成功的电池电动改装实证案例，将LCA方法应用于渔船的电动化转型评估，揭示了电动化在近岸渔业脱碳中的潜力边界和条件约束。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，指出脱碳政策需更整体性地解决港口可再生电力基础设施、行业认知和技能建设等问题，才能推动电动化在近岸渔业中的规模化应用。

title: Re-embedding the Market Economy: Adjustment-bearing Dependence and the Governance of Platform Work
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Groningen, Faculty of Law

detail.title: Re-embedding the Market Economy: Adjustment-bearing Dependence and the Governance of Platform Work

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

detail.abstract: Karl Polanyi called labour, land and money fictitious commodities because none was produced for sale in the manner of ordinary goods. Later scholarship has stretched the term across other forms of social harm, often without identifying how market organisation produces the injury alleged. This article holds Polanyi's textual category steady and develops a distinct diagnostic, adjustment-bearing dependence. The inquiry focuses on a marketed capacity that remains attached to its bearer, an adjustment the bearer cannot escape within the period in which harm matures, and a material contribution to impairment before recovery becomes reasonably possible. Exposure, switching conditions, seriousness of impairment, reversibility and displaced repair costs bear on severity. The platform-work application distinguishes fluctuations in demand from platform choices over price, allocation, ratings and account access. It then reads Directive (EU) 2024/2831 against that mechanism. The Directive redistributes some authority through employment-status procedures, governance of automated systems, collective rights and Article 9(6)'s portability right. Its Union floor leaves unpaid waiting, remuneration volatility and the receiving platform's recognition of imported reputation largely to other law and national implementation. Adjustment-bearing dependence can therefore explain why intervention is warranted; institutional and normative analysis must still decide its form.

AI.tldr: 本文基于波兰尼的"虚拟商品"概念，发展出"调整型依赖"这一诊断性概念，用以识别平台劳动市场中市场组织造成社会损害的具体机制，并据此评估欧盟《第2024/2831号指令》的干预效果。
AI.research_question: 如何精确识别市场组织方式（而非一般市场波动）所造成的劳动者损害？欧盟《第2024/2831号指令》能否针对这种损害机制提供有效干预？
AI.motivation: 波兰尼"虚拟商品"概念在后续学术中被过度泛化使用，往往未能说明市场组织如何具体产生其所指控的社会伤害。作者希望收敛概念范畴，建立更精确的诊断工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 波兰尼的虚拟商品理论（劳动、土地、货币）；"调整型依赖"（adjustment-bearing dependence）概念框架。
AI.method: 概念分析（概念发展与界定）+ 制度分析（对欧盟指令的法律文本解读）+ 应用于平台劳动的具体情境分析。
AI.findings: （1）调整型依赖包含三个核心要素：市场化能力附着于其承载者、承载者在损害成熟期内无法逃避的调整、在合理恢复之前对能力造成实质性损害；（2）严重性取决于暴露程度、转换条件、损害严重度、可逆性及替代性修复成本；（3）欧盟指令通过雇佣地位程序、自动化系统治理、集体权利及第9(6)条可携带权重新分配了部分权力，但在未付等待时间、报酬波动及接收平台对导入声誉的认可方面，仍主要依赖其他法律和国家实施。
AI.theory_contributions: 收紧了"虚拟商品"概念的学术适用范围，提出了一个更具诊断精确性的"调整型依赖"框架，能够区分市场波动与市场组织选择所导致的不同损害来源。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟平台劳动立法的效果评估提供了分析工具，指出欧盟指令在哪些方面有效干预了平台权力，哪些方面仍存在制度缺口。

title: Risk Management in Monetary Policy: A Review with Asset Pricing Implications
affiliations: Duke University - Fuqua School of Business, University College London and University of Texas at Dallas - Naveen Jindal School of Management

detail.title: Risk Management in Monetary Policy: A Review with Asset Pricing Implications
detail.abstract: We review recent research on how the Fed's risk-management approach shapes the overall policy stance and how it affects financial market conditions. The evidence shows that the policy stance contains a forward-looking, conditional component that has long been an integral part of the Fed's policymaking toolkit. Asymmetric forward-looking policy tilts - motivated by risk-management considerations and revealed via the Fed's communication - complement and extend beyond the effects of direct policy actions. Drawing on the transcripts of FOMC meetings between 1976 and 2019, we provide an institutional history of the tilt and its connection to how the Committee's thinking about risk evolved over decades. Going back at least to the early 1990s, the Fed has relied on tilts not only to steer market expectations but, equally importantly, to stabilize risk premia and maintain easy financial conditions. We discuss successes and challenges associated with communication via tilts and draw lessons for the renewed debate over the form and extent of central bank forward-looking guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了美联储风险管理办法如何塑造整体政策立场并影响金融市场条件的研究。证据表明，政策立场包含前瞻性、条件性成分，一直是美联储政策工具包的重要组成部分。基于风险管理的非对称前瞻性政策倾斜——通过美联储沟通揭示——补充并扩展了直接政策行动的效果。基于1976-2019年FOMC会议记录，作者提供了政策倾斜的制度史及其与委员会风险思维演变的联系。至少自1990年代初以来，美联储不仅依靠政策倾斜引导市场预期，更重要的是稳定风险溢价和维持宽松金融条件。文章讨论了通过倾斜进行沟通的成功与挑战，并为关于央行前瞻性指导形式和程度的重新辩论提供了借鉴。
AI.research_question: 美联储的风险管理办法如何塑造整体政策立场，以及前瞻性政策倾斜如何影响金融市场条件和预期？
AI.motivation: 理解美联储政策制定中前瞻性风险管理成分的作用机制和历史演变，为当前关于央行前瞻性指导形式的争论提供经验教训。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险管理框架、前瞻性指导理论、政策倾斜（policy tilt）理论、预期管理理论、风险溢价理论
AI.method: 文献综述与制度史分析；基于1976-2019年FOMC会议记录的定性历史研究方法
AI.findings: 1) 政策倾斜是美联储政策工具包中长期存在的组成部分；2) 非对称前瞻性政策倾斜能够补充直接政策行动的效果；3) 至少自1990年代初以来，美联储利用政策倾斜来稳定风险溢价和维持宽松金融条件；4) 政策倾斜的沟通既有成功经验也面临挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了政策倾斜作为风险管理工具的理论地位，阐明了前瞻性政策倾斜与直接政策行动之间的互补关系，为理解美联储风险管理办法提供了制度史视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中央银行前瞻性指导的形式和程度提供了历史经验和政策启示，有助于政策制定者评估风险管理沟通策略的有效性。

reference: Boston College Law Review, Vol. 68, No. 4 (Forthcoming 2027)
title: The Misaligned Market of Health Influencing
affiliations: Wake Forest University - School of Law

detail.title: The Misaligned Market of Health Influencing
detail.abstract:
Healthcare has numerous challenges. First, it is costly, with the United States having the highest healthcare expenses in the Western world. It is also time-consuming; an emergency room visit can take hours, and scheduling an appointment with a doctor may take months. Healthcare is socially and emotionally demanding. The system has historically marginalized groups such as women, racial minorities, and LGBTQ+ populations, causing fear and distrust. Additionally, doctors are often seen as detached or reserved, which can be off-putting during crises. These issues create major legal and policy obstacles-primarily, healthcare access. Consumers have never enjoyed the expensive, impersonal healthcare market, and mainstream alternatives have been virtually nonexistent. Recently, health influencersindividuals who share medical information through social media-have emerged as a nominal substitute. They are affordable, accessible, personable, and entertaining. In many ways, they are the easiest entry point for health information. This development has some positives; however, health influencers lack strong incentives to provide accurate information. This has resulted in an unregulated market for critical health details.
The law has left the burgeoning health influencing and content creation industry untouched, leaving consumers without redress for poor information. Legal scholars have begun to propose solutions to these challenges, citing the role of the tort system in protecting consumers. However, there is an additional concern that previous scholarship does not fully address: how exclusion pushes individuals into unregulated markets. This Article posits that examining perceived exclusion illuminates why health influencing has developed into a market for medical information, rather than a mere form of speech. It argues that health influencers should be regulated, but within this context. It contributes to the growing discourse in health law on misinformation. It also provides novel insights into the health influencer market and its impact on public health infrastructure. First, I will provide an overview of the health influencer industry: who is in it, which platforms they use, and the incentives within it. Then I will address the conditions that allow for the health influencer market to thrive. Lastly, I will propose that states should regulate health influencers through negligent misrepresentation claims and address why duty is the best avenue for change.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了健康影响者（health influencers）作为替代性健康信息来源的市场兴起，认为消费者被传统医疗体系排斥推动了这一市场的发展，并主张应通过过失性虚假陈述（negligent misrepresentation）索赔来监管健康影响者。
AI.research_question: 为什么健康影响者市场会发展为一个提供医疗信息的市场，而非仅仅是一种言论形式？以及应如何在这一背景下对健康影响者进行监管？
AI.motivation: 传统医疗体系存在成本高昂、耗时、排斥边缘群体等固有缺陷，而健康影响者已成为消费者获取健康信息的主要替代渠道，但该市场缺乏监管，消费者对错误信息缺乏救济途径。现有法律学术虽提出了侵权法解决方案，但未充分回应"排斥如何将个体推向不受监管的市场"这一核心关切。
AI.theoretical_framework: 排斥感知理论（perceived exclusion）、侵权法中的过失性虚假陈述理论、市场形成与公共健康基础设施理论
AI.method: 法律分析/规范性论文方法，结合对健康影响者行业的概述（参与者、平台、激励机制）以及法律理论推演
AI.findings: 感知到的排斥是推动健康影响者市场形成的核心动力；健康影响者应被视为提供医疗信息的市场主体而非单纯言论；各州应通过过失性虚假陈述索赔对健康影响者进行监管，其中"义务"（duty）是法律变革的最佳途径。
AI.theory_contributions: 论文首次将"排斥感知"概念引入健康法律中的错误信息讨论，为理解健康影响者市场的形成提供了新的理论视角，并丰富了对公共健康基础设施影响的学术探讨。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各州立法者提供了具体的监管路径——通过过失性虚假陈述索赔约束健康影响者，从而为消费者提供错误信息的救济机制，填补健康信息市场的监管空白。

title: The Impact of China's Demand on Agriculture in the United States
affiliations: University of International Business and Economics, The University of Hong Kong - University of Hong Kong, Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Impact of China's Demand on Agriculture in the United States
detail.abstract: We investigate the effect of rising Chinese demand for agricultural goods between 1997 and 2012 on U.S. local agricultural sectors, exploiting cross-county variation in exposure to Chinese demand due to differences in crop/product specialization. We find that farmland value rises in counties that are more exposed to the rise in Chinese demand. Meanwhile, rising exports causes an increase in farmland concentration. The benefits are unequally distributed across farmers: the business income of the top earners rises, but the wage income of all farmers stagnates. We provide a simple theoretical model in which farms are heterogeneous in efficiency and land intensities and are selected into exporting to explain the facts.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1997-2012年间中国对美国农产品需求上升这一外生冲击，通过美国各县级农作物专业化程度的差异来识别暴露度，发现中国需求上升导致美国农地价值上升、农地集中度增加，且收益分配不均：最高收入者的经营收入上升，但普通农民工资收入停滞。
AI.research_question: 中国对农产品需求的上升如何影响美国地方农业部门，包括农地价值、农地集中度以及农民收入分配？
AI.motivation: 理解全球化贸易冲击（特别是中国需求的快速增长）对进口国国内农业部门的结构性影响，特别是其收益分配效应，为贸易政策的福利分析提供实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性农场选择出口模型——农场在效率和土地密集度上存在异质性，并据此选择是否进入出口市场。
AI.method: 利用美国县域层面农作物/产品专业化程度的差异构建中国需求暴露度指标，进行计量回归分析；并构建简单理论模型解释实证事实。
AI.findings: （1）中国需求上升导致暴露度更高的县农地价值上升；（2）出口上升导致农地集中度增加；（3）收益分配不均：高收入农场主的经营收入上升，但全部农民工资收入停滞。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了具有农场异质性（效率和土地密集度差异）且选择进入出口市场的理论模型，解释了贸易冲击如何导致农地集中和收益分配不均。
AI.practical_contributions: 为贸易政策制定者提供了中国需求冲击对美国农村地区结构性影响的实证依据，揭示了贸易收益分配不均的问题，提示政策需要关注农业部门内部的公平性。

reference: Accepted for TRIZfest-2026 Conference Proceedings, MATRIZ (forthcoming)
title:
The ERM Contradiction: 
From Qualitative Comfort to Quantitative Intelligence – A TRIZ-Based Approach

detail.title:
The ERM Contradiction: 
From Qualitative Comfort to Quantitative Intelligence – A TRIZ-Based Approach

publicationDetails.detailsText: Accepted for TRIZfest-2026 Conference Proceedings, MATRIZ (forthcoming)

detail.abstract: Enterprise risk management (ERM) governs decisions whose underlying reality is probabilistic, yet its dominant tools remain qualitative-a contradiction internal to the discipline itself, not merely a gap in practice. The contradiction is decades old, and TRIZ (Theory of Inventive Problem Solving), a methodology built to resolve contradictions, has been available throughout. Why, then, was it never resolved sooner?
