detail.abstract: Accurate estimation of soil organic carbon (SOC) is vital for soil monitoring and carbon accounting, yet conventional laboratory analyses are destructive and labour-intensive. Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) offers a rapid, non-destructive alternative by simultaneously capturing spectral profiles and surface spatial heterogeneity. In this study, we investigated SOC estimation from fused visible-near-infrared (VNIR) and shortwave-infrared (SWIR) hyperspectral imagery using 555 tropical soil samples represented by 1,656 image cubes spanning 268 contiguous spectral bands. Four predictive modelling paradigms were benchmarked: partial least squares regression (PLSR), a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN), a dual-branch Fusion-ResNet (FResNet), and the proposed Spatial-Spectral Transformer Regression (SSTR) model. Under a strict sample-code grouped evaluation across 10 independent splits, SSTR yielded the highest mean predictive performance among the evaluated models. In the 8:2 split, SSTR reached R² = 0.8198 ± 0.0361, Pearson r = 0.9258 ± 0.0079, RMSE = 0.7396 ± 0.1043%, and RPD = 2.4040 ± 0.2493, compared with PLSR (R² = 0.5568 ± 0.0566). Furthermore, SSTR used 2.57 M parameters compared with 43.30 M for FResNet (a 94.1% reduction), and maintained higher mean performance under constrained training data (20% training ratio: R² = 0.6329 ± 0.0365, RPD = 1.6583 ± 0.0810). These findings support the use of joint spatial-spectral representation learning for proximal SOC sensing and provide a methodological basis for future evaluation with imaging spectroscopy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种空间-光谱Transformer回归（SSTR）模型，用于从融合的VNIR和SWIR高光谱影像中估算热带土壤有机碳（SOC）。在555个热带土壤样本（1656个图像立方体，268个连续光谱波段）上，SSTR在10个独立分组的严格评估中超越了PLSR、1D-CNN和FResNet，达到R²=0.8198，同时参数仅为FResNet的5.9%（2.57M vs 43.30M），并在小样本训练条件下保持更高的预测性能。
AI.research_question: 如何利用融合的可见-近红外（VNIR）和短波红外（SWIR）高光谱成像数据，通过联合空间-光谱表示学习来提高土壤有机碳估算的准确性和效率？
AI.motivation: 传统实验室分析方法测定土壤有机碳是破坏性的且劳动密集；高光谱成像虽提供快速非破坏性替代方案，但现有模型（如PLSR、CNN）在捕捉空间-光谱联合信息方面存在局限，需要更高效的深度学习方法以提升SOC估算精度并降低计算复杂度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于空间-光谱联合表示学习理论，结合Transformer架构的自注意力机制，提出SSTR模型来同时捕捉土壤表面的空间异质性和光谱特征。
AI.method: 使用555个热带土壤样本的1656个图像立方体（268个波段），比较四种建模范式：PLSR、1D-CNN、双分支Fusion-ResNet（FResNet）和提出的SSTR模型。采用严格的样本编码分组评估，在10个独立划分和8:2分割下进行性能比较。
AI.findings: SSTR模型在所有评估中表现最佳：8:2分割下R²=0.8198±0.0361，Pearson r=0.9258±0.0079，RMSE=0.7396±0.1043%，RPD=2.4040±0.2493。SSTR仅用2.57M参数（比FResNet减少94.1%），且在20%训练比例下仍保持较高性能（R²=0.6329±0.0365）。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了联合空间-光谱表示学习框架在近端土壤传感中的有效性，为将Transformer架构应用于高光谱影像的SOC估算提供了方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: SSTR模型以极低的参数量实现高精度SOC估算，且在小样本条件下表现稳健，为未来基于成像光谱学的快速、非破坏性土壤监测和碳核算提供了高效的工具和实证支持。

title: Institutional Investor Attention and Fund Performance
affiliations: Peking University

detail.title: Institutional Investor Attention and Fund Performance
detail.abstract: This article examines the information processing techniques used by large-scale investors by analysing the amount of time and attention that funds devote to online news stories about both the overall economy and individual enterprises. We want to see how it influences their investment choices and the overall performance of the funds. Using a time-series approach and a dataset that records stock ownership and news consumption habits, we can examine how market volatility affects people's focus. Looking at how paying attention to certain stocks alters portfolio weights and value contributed at the business level is also done using cross-sectional regression models. One of the three key takeaways from the data is that funds gravitate toward macro news when aggregate volatility is high and that funds that do so to a greater extent end up with better returns in the long run. The second finding reveals a positive correlation between larger stock portfolios and cross-sectional fund attentiveness. Additionally, when it comes to high-value news, fund attention significantly boosts the value-add of individual holdings. In light of these findings, policymakers and legislators should push for more open information settings and real-time reporting to improve market efficiency and equity in the allocation of resources.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析基金对宏观经济新闻和企业新闻的关注时间与注意力分配，研究大型投资者的信息处理方式如何影响其投资决策和基金绩效。研究发现基金在高波动时期倾向于关注宏观新闻且长期回报更好，基金关注度与投资组合规模正相关，且对高价值新闻的关注显著提升个股价值增益。
AI.research_question: 大型投资者（基金）如何通过处理在线经济新闻和企业新闻信息来影响其投资选择和基金绩效？
AI.motivation: 理解大型投资者（基金）的信息处理行为如何影响投资决策和绩效，以揭示市场信息利用效率与资源配置的公平性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息处理理论、注意力经济学、行为金融学中的有限注意力理论
AI.method: 采用时间序列方法分析市场波动对投资者关注度的影响；采用横截面回归模型分析个股关注度对投资组合权重和商业层面价值增益的影响。
AI.findings: 三大主要发现：（1）当市场总体波动率高时，基金倾向于关注宏观经济新闻，且对此类新闻关注程度更高的基金长期回报更好；（2）股票投资组合规模与基金横截面关注度之间存在正相关关系；（3）对于高价值新闻，基金关注显著提升了个股持仓的价值增益。
AI.theory_contributions: 将注意力经济理论与大型机构投资者的信息处理行为相结合，拓展了对基金信息处理策略与投资绩效关系的理论理解，揭示了市场波动环境下投资者注意力配置的规律。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和立法者提出建议，推动更开放的信息环境和实时报告机制，以提高市场效率和资源配置的公平性。

title: A New Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge
affiliations: VID Specialized University

detail.title: A New Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge

keywords: India's Plant Variety and Farmers' Rights Act
TRIPS Agreement (Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights)
Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge

detail.abstract: Among the most contentious practices within a globalized and corporatized economy is allegations of so-called 'biopiracy'. This refers to the taking of genetic resources and associated traditional knowledge without either free, prior and informed consent or any mechanisms for benefit-sharing with the community that provided the resource. Attempts to revise the TRIPS Agreement (Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights) to bring it more in compliance with the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) have not led to concrete results. The article analyzes CBD provisions, binding protocols and non-binding guiding documents, and two less known treaties of the United Nations. The World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO), that joined the United Nations in 1974, has-after negotiating for almost 15 yearsadopted the WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge. The article demonstrates how this WIPO Treaty is embedded in the 'defensive strategy' of traditional knowledge protection, enabling patent examiners to reject a patent as the alleged invention does not represent new and applicable knowledge. The alternative, termed 'positive strategy', is witnessed primarily in India's Plant Variety and Farmers' Rights Act, which has resulted in more grants of certificates for so-called 'farmers' varieties' compared to all other varieties together. Other United Nations treaties include elements of such protection, but not on the level of specify and subsequent implementation as found in India. The negotiations of what became the WIPO Treaty has generated increased awareness of indigenous peoples' traditional knowledge and should be easy to ratify as it aligns with existing legislation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了生物剽窃（biopiracy）背景下传统知识保护的国际法律框架，重点审视了WIPO于2024年通过的《知识产权、遗传资源和相关传统知识条约》如何嵌入"防御性策略"，并与印度《植物品种和农民权利法》所代表的"积极策略"进行对比，论证了WIPO条约与现有立法的一致性及易于批准的特点。
AI.research_question: 国际法律框架如何通过防御性与积极性策略来应对生物剽窃问题？特别是WIPO新条约与印度立法在传统知识保护中的差异与互补何在？
AI.motivation: 生物剽窃已成为全球化经济中争议最激烈的实践之一，涉及在不获得自由事先知情同意或利益共享机制的情况下窃取遗传资源和相关传统知识。TRIPS协定与CBD公约之间的协调修订长期未取得实质性成果，迫切需要分析新兴的国际法律工具（尤其是WIPO条约）如何应对这一挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统知识保护的"防御性策略"（defensive strategy）与"积极性策略"（positive strategy）理论框架；CBD公约、TRIPS协定、WIPO条约等国际知识产权法框架；传统知识与遗传资源的利益共享理论。
AI.method: 规范性法律文本分析，系统梳理了CBD条款、具有约束力的议定书、非约束性指导文件、联合国两个较少为人知的条约，以及WIPO条约和印度《植物品种和农民权利法》的法律条款与实施情况。
AI.findings: 1) WIPO条约体现了防御性策略，使专利审查员能以发明不具备新颖性和适用性为由拒绝授予专利；2) 印度《植物品种和农民权利法》展现了积极性策略，其授予的"农民品种"证书数量超过了所有其他品种的总和；3) 其他联合国条约虽包含相关保护要素，但在具体性和实施层面不及印度立法；4) WIPO条约的谈判提高了对土著人民传统知识的认识，且因其与现行立法一致而易于批准。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文深化了传统知识保护中"防御性策略"与"积极性策略"的理论区分，阐明了WIPO条约在全球知识产权体系中作为防御性策略的制度定位，并揭示了不同国际条约在传统知识保护具体化和实施程度上的理论差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和国际立法者提供了WIPO条约与CBD、TRIPS及其他联合国条约关系的系统分析，展示了印度立法作为积极性策略的实践范本，并指出WIPO条约因与各国现行立法兼容而具有较高的批准可行性。

title: Heterogeneous Knowledge in Distributed Environmental Governance: Emergence, Integration, and the Preservation of Disagreement

detail.title: Heterogeneous Knowledge in Distributed Environmental Governance: Emergence, Integration, and the Preservation of Disagreement
detail.abstract: Governance of an interdependent environmental field requires knowledge that no party holds. Knowledge of such a field stands distributed among hydrological services, ecological programmes, health authorities, industrial operators, and populations resident in the systems concerned, and their holdings differ in variable, in resolution, in evidential standard, and in the kind of claim they issue. The prevailing response is integration understood as reconciliation: harmonise the categories, resolve the disagreements, and produce a single account on which decisions may rest. This paper argues that reconciliation so understood is unavailable and that its pursuit is harmful, and proposes an alternative conception of what integration can be. The method is conceptual, developed through an examination of what aggregation procedures preserve and what they discard. Three insights are advanced. Knowledge of a distributed field is not the union of what its parties hold, since the relations among their holdings, including their disagreements, carry information that no party's holding contains. Aggregation over claims that stand in logical relations to one another cannot in general be conducted claim by claim without producing conclusions no party accepts, which is a known impossibility whose bearing on environmental assessment has not been drawn. And the claims held by parties in such a field are of kinds that cannot be averaged, since a probability, a rate ratio, a monetary estimate, a qualitative account, and a legal duty are not five measurements of one quantity. From these the paper develops a conception of integration as temporary, question-relative assembly that preserves disagreement, uncertainty, and acknowledged ignorance as first-class content, together with the provenance required to prevent a single source counted twice from appearing as two confirmations. The paper surveys social epistemology, judgment aggregation, expert elicitation, post-normal science, co-production, epistemic injustice, and the traditional-knowledge literatures, states what each owns, and identifies the residue. It reports no empirical study and establishes no formal result.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了在相互依存的環境領域中，將分散知識「整合為一致共識」的傳統做法既不可行也有害，並提出了一種替代性整合概念：即暫時性、問題相對性的組裝，保留分歧、不確定性與承認的無知作為一級內容，同時保留來源信息以防止重複計數被誤認為多次確認。
AI.research_question: 在相互依存的環境治理領域中，當知識分散於不同主體且無法達成傳統意義上的「調和式整合」時，整合應該如何被重新概念化？
AI.motivation: 環境治理需要整合多方知識（水文、生態、健康、工業、居民等），但這些知識在變量、分辨率、證據標準和主張類型上各不相同。傳統的「整合=調和」模式試圖通過統一範疇、解決分歧來產出單一決策依據，但本文認為這種做法不可行且有害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社會認識論、判斷聚合（judgment aggregation）、專家啟發（expert elicitation）、後常規科學（post-normal science）、共同生產（co-production）、認識論不義（epistemic injustice）與傳統知識文獻。
AI.method: 概念性研究方法，通過檢視聚合程序保留什麼、丟棄什麼來展開論證。
AI.findings: 1）分散領域的知識並非各方持有知識的簡單並集，因為各方持有知識之間的關係（包括分歧）攜帶了任何單方都不含有的信息。2）對處於邏輯關係中的主張進行聚合，不能逐條聚合而不產生各方都不接受的結論（已知的不可能性，但尚未應用於環境評估）。3）各方持有的主張類型無法被平均化，因為概率、比率比、貨幣估算、定性敘述和法律義務並非同一量的五次測量。
AI.theory_contributions: 將判斷聚合的不可能性定理應用於環境評估領域；提出「整合作為暫時性、問題相對性組裝」的新概念框架，將分歧、不確定性和承認的無知視為一級內容而非需要消除的雜訊；明確區分了各文獻傳統的貢獻與殘餘。
AI.practical_contributions: 為環境治理中的跨領域知識整合提供新的操作理念，強調保留來源信息（provenance）以防止單一來源被重複計數而誤判為獨立確認，並為決策者提供一個不強迫消除分歧的整合模式。

title: A Diaconal Approach Guiding Strategic Alliance-Building
affiliations: VID Specialized University

detail.title: A Diaconal Approach Guiding Strategic Alliance-Building
detail.abstract: Two terms that are included in separate preambular paragraphs to the 2015 Paris Agreement, just transition and eco-justice, are analysed, to understand how they emerged and how they have implications for strategic alliance building and policymaking. Churches and church-related organisations have to prioritize with whom to cooperate, which relates to which notion of sustainability that is chosen. The article explains two Norwegian decades long cooperations, also identifying the main content of the massive investment programmes in green technology that are underway in the USA and the EU, that shift considerably the modes of cooperation. The article builds on the practice of diakonia as identified in Called to Transformation. Ecumenical Diakonia by the World Council of Churhes and ACT Alliance, and theological perspectives, asking how they can be tools for alliance building. Specifically, the article identifies two opposing views on nature: instrumental and intrinsic; two opposing understandings of environmental compensation; and two rationales for cooperation in relation to nature: "technology fix" and "nature first".

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2015年《巴黎协定》序言中"公正转型"和"生态正义"两个术语的起源及其对战略联盟建设和政策制定的影响。文章基于世界教会理事会和ACT联盟提出的"召命转化：普世性服侍"实践及神学视角，探讨了教会及教会相关组织如何选择合作对象。通过挪威两个长达数十年的合作案例，文章识别了关于自然的两种对立观点（工具性与内在性）、环境补偿的两种对立理解，以及两种合作逻辑（"技术修复"与"自然优先"），并指出美国和欧盟正在进行的大规模绿色技术投资计划正在显著改变合作模式。
AI.research_question: 《巴黎协定》中的"公正转型"和"生态正义"这两个术语如何产生，它们对战略联盟建设和政策制定有何影响？教会及教会相关组织应如何在不同的可持续性观念和合作模式之间做出选择？
AI.motivation: 面对全球气候危机和绿色转型，教会及相关组织需要明确其合作优先对象，而不同的可持续性观念（工具性vs.内在性的自然观）和合作逻辑（技术修复vs.自然优先）将深刻影响联盟建设的路径选择。随着美国和欧盟大规模绿色技术投资计划的推进，既有合作模式正在发生根本性转变，亟需从神学和实践层面提供分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文的理论框架建立在两个支柱上：一是世界教会理事会和ACT联盟提出的"召命转化：普世性服侍"（Called to Transformation: Ecumenical Diakonia）中的服侍（diakonia）实践；二是神学视角，特别是关于自然的工具性与内在性观点、环境补偿的两种理解，以及"技术修复"与"自然优先"两种合作理性。
AI.method: 基于文本分析和案例研究的质性方法。通过分析《巴黎协定》序言中两个术语的历史脉络，并结合挪威两个长达数十年的合作案例，以及对美国和欧盟绿色技术投资计划的内容分析，来阐释不同可持续性观念如何影响联盟建设。
AI.findings: 文章识别出三组关键对立：其一，关于自然存在工具性与内在性两种对立观点；其二，对环境补偿存在两种对立理解；其三，在自然相关合作中存在"技术修复"和"自然优先"两种理性。这些对立深刻影响了教会组织在联盟建设和政策参与中的路径选择。此外，美国和欧盟的大规模绿色技术投资正在显著改变传统合作模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 将神学的服侍（diakonia）实践与气候政治中的公正转型和生态正义概念相结合，为理解宗教组织在全球气候治理中的角色提供了新的神学-政治分析框架。通过区分工具性/内在性自然观、不同环境补偿理解和两种合作理性，丰富了可持续性理论中关于宗教行动者联盟建设的理论维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教会及教会相关组织在绿色转型时代如何选择合作对象、如何参与政策制定提供了实践指导。通过分析挪威案例和美欧绿色技术投资计划，帮助宗教组织理解当前全球绿色转型的政治经济格局，从而更有效地进行战略联盟建设。

title:
Furnisher, not Excluded: 
Mapping the Scope Gap Between CEMAC’s Credit Information-sharing Mandate and Mobile Money Data

detail.title:
Furnisher, not Excluded: 
Mapping the Scope Gap Between CEMAC’s Credit Information-sharing Mandate and Mobile Money Data
detail.abstract: The Economic and Monetary Community of Central Africa (CEMAC) launched its first regional credit bureau, BIC-CEMAC, in January 2026 with a founding cohort of 41 commercial banks and 20 microfinance institutions — and no mobile money operators. This is notable because both dominant Cameroonian mobile money issuers, Orange Money Cameroun and MTN’s Mobile Money Corporation, have held Établissement de Paiement (EP) licenses since 2022 and 2023 respectively, and are, under the primary text of BEAC Instruction N°014/2020 (Article 3), mandatorily bound to furnish credit information to the bureau on the same terms as banks. This paper undertakes a close textual analysis of the two governing instructions — 014/2020 (furnisher obligations) and 010/2020 (client-consent architecture) — and finds that the absence of EPs from the founding cohort does not reflect legal exclusion but a narrower, more consequential problem: the mandated data-content categories in Article 3 were drafted around a bank-shaped template of formal credit exposures and payment incidents, and do not contemplate the transactional and behavioral data (cash-in/cash-out volume, merchant payment frequency, airtime top-up patterns) that has underpinned alternative-data credit scoring in comparable African markets. We situate this within the information-economics literature on credit registries (Pagano & Jappelli, 1993; Djankov, McLiesh, & Shleifer, 2007) and argue that CEMAC’s 2018–2020 regulatory architecture predates a demonstrable regional and continental shift — visible in UEMOA’s 2016-era grands facturiers furnisher category and Morocco’s 2024 reform — toward explicitly naming telecom and mobile data as bureau-eligible inputs. We propose a targeted amendment to Instruction 014/2020 rather than new primary legislation, and identify testable near-term indicators — including whether MTN’s Momocash micro-credit product is already generating Article 3-reportable exposures — for assessing whether the gap is closing.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了CEMAC地区首个征信机构BIC-CEMAC（2026年1月成立）创始成员中缺少移动支付运营商的现象，通过对两项BEAC监管指令（014/2020和010/2020）的文本分析，发现这一缺失并非法律排斥，而是由于指令中的数据内容类别是以银行信贷暴露为模板设计的，未涵盖移动支付交易和行为数据。论文建议对014/2020指令进行有针对性的修订，并提出可检验的近期指标来评估这一差距是否正在缩小。
AI.research_question: 为什么CEMAC地区征信机构的创始成员中没有移动支付运营商？这是法律排斥还是监管架构设计问题？如何使监管架构适应移动数据作为征信输入的转变？
AI.motivation: CEMAC地区两大移动支付发行方（Orange Money和MTN）持有支付机构牌照且依法负有向征信机构提供信用信息的义务，但其未出现在创始成员中。这反映出监管架构的潜在缺陷，且与非洲其他市场利用替代数据信用评分的趋势形成对比。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息经济学中关于信用登记机构的理论（Pagano & Jappelli, 1993; Djankov, McLiesh, & Shleifer, 2007），用以分析信用信息共享的经济效应和监管设计。
AI.method: 对BEAC Instruction N°014/2020（信息提供方义务）和010/2020（客户同意架构）进行文本分析，并结合区域比较（UEMOA 2016年改革、摩洛哥2024年改革）进行制度比较分析。
AI.findings: 移动支付运营商缺席创始成员并非法律排斥，而是014/2020号指令第3条中强制要求的数据内容类别是以银行形态的正式信贷暴露和支付违约事件为模板设计的，未考虑现金存取交易量、商户支付频率、话费充值模式等移动支付交易和行为数据，这些数据在其他非洲市场支撑了替代数据信用评分。
AI.theory_contributions: 为信用登记机构的信息经济学文献提供了制度性案例，展示了监管架构的"银行形态模板"如何阻碍移动支付数据纳入征信体系，扩展了对征信数据范围与金融普惠之间关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出对014/2020号指令进行有针对性的修订而非制定新立法；提出可检验的近期指标（如MTN Momocash微型信贷产品是否已产生第3条可报告暴露），为政策制定者和监管机构提供了具体的评估工具和改革路径建议。

title: Natural Resources, Institutions, and Green Economic Diversification in Azerbaijan: An Integrated Analytical Framework
affiliations: Fukuoka University - Faculty of Economics, Independent and Azerbaijan Technical University

detail.title: Natural Resources, Institutions, and Green Economic Diversification in Azerbaijan: An Integrated Analytical Framework
detail.abstract: Azerbaijan's hydrocarbon resources have financed economic growth, public investment, and infrastructure development, but have also reinforced dependence on commodity exports. This article examines how natural resource endowments, institutional quality, productive capabilities, and green-transition policies interact in shaping economic diversification. The study adopts a qualitative analytical design combining a narrative review of academic literature, document analysis of international and national policy and development documents, and contextual synthesis of Azerbaijanspecific empirical evidence. On this basis, it develops an integrated framework in which resource revenues provide financial capacity, institutions govern resource allocation and policy implementation, productive capabilities enable structural transformation, and green policies orient diversification toward sustainable activities. The framework suggests that resource wealth contributes to long-term diversification when revenues are converted into human capital, innovation, infrastructure, and competitive non-oil activities. For Azerbaijan, renewable energy, digital transformation, green industry, and private-sector development are identified as mutually reinforcing priorities. The paper recommends strengthening institutional coordination, investment governance, research and innovation capacity, private-sector capabilities, and international technology partnerships. Its principal contribution is an Azerbaijan-specific conceptual framework integrating resource-based financial capacity, institutional quality, productive capabilities, and green transition, providing a basis for policy design and future empirical testing in resource-rich economies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨自然资源禀赋、制度质量、生产能力和绿色转型政策如何相互作用塑造经济多元化，并以阿塞拜疆为案例，构建了一个整合资源收入财政能力、制度质量、生产能力与绿色转型的综合概念框架。
AI.research_question: 自然资源禀赋、制度质量、生产能力和绿色转型政策如何相互作用，共同塑造资源型经济体的经济多元化？
AI.motivation: 阿塞拜疆的碳氢化合物资源虽推动了经济增长和基础设施建设，但也加剧了对大宗商品出口的依赖，亟需理解资源财富如何转化为长期多元化发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合资源诅咒理论、制度经济学、生产能力理论（结构转型）与绿色转型政策理论，构建资源型经济多元化分析框架。
AI.method: 定性分析方法，包括：学术文献叙事综述、国际与国家政策及发展文件的文档分析、阿塞拜疆特定实证证据的情境综合。
AI.findings: 资源财富只有将收入转化为人力资本、创新、基础设施和具有竞争力的非石油活动时，才能促进长期多元化。对阿塞拜疆而言，可再生能源、数字化转型、绿色产业和私营部门发展是相互强化优先事项。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个阿塞拜疆特定的概念框架，整合资源型财政能力、制度质量、生产能力与绿色转型，为资源丰富经济体的政策设计与未来实证检验提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议加强制度协调、投资治理、研究与创新能力、私营部门能力建设以及国际技术合作伙伴关系，为阿塞拜疆及类似资源型经济体的多元化政策提供实践指引。

title: From Formal Equality to Reserved Representation: Omani Women's Political Rights and Institutional Embedding; A Literature Review
affiliations: Independent Public Policy Analyst

detail.title: From Formal Equality to Reserved Representation: Omani Women's Political Rights and Institutional Embedding; A Literature Review
detail.abstract: This review examines why decades of formal political equality for Omani women did not produce sustained elected representation and what the move toward reserved representation reveals about political institutional embedding. It argues that Oman’s problem was not absent recognition, but the weak conversion of eligibility into durable representation. Women’s access to voting and candidacy, reported from 1994, was not matched by party recruitment, list placement, territorial guarantees, or mechanisms counteracting gendered networks. The Shura Council consequently produced intermittent representation: one woman was elected in 2015, two in 2019, and none in 2023. The 2026 announcement of eleven additional seats for women, one per governorate, marks a shift from non-discrimination toward guaranteed descriptive presence. Yet it remains an announced allocation rather than an operational quota until its legal basis, selection, accountability, and continuity are published. Oman shows that political rights become embedded when organisational rules make inclusion reproducible across electoral cycles.

AI.tldr: 本文审视了阿曼女性在数十年正式政治平等后仍未能获得持续民选代表权的现象，并探讨向保留代表制转变所揭示的政治制度嵌入问题。研究认为阿曼的问题不在于承认缺失，而在于资格向持久代表性转化的薄弱。2026年宣布为女性增设每省一席共11个席位的决定，标志着从非歧视向保障性描述性代表的转变，但该分配仍是宣布性而非操作性配额，需待法律基础、遴选机制、问责和连续性公开后才能真正实现制度嵌入。
AI.research_question: 阿曼女性数十年正式政治平等为何未能产生持续的民选代表？向保留代表制的转变揭示了政治制度嵌入的何种机制？
AI.motivation: 阿曼存在明显的悖论：女性自1994年起拥有投票和候选资格，但协商会议的代表性呈现间歇性——2015年1名女性当选、2019年2名、2023年为零。这一现象挑战了以"承认缺失"为解释视角的传统分析，需要新的理论框架来理解政治权利如何真正嵌入制度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治制度嵌入理论（political institutional embedding）；描述性代表制（descriptive representation）与非歧视原则的区分；资格转换（eligibility conversion）框架。
AI.method: 综述性研究（review），基于阿曼协商会议选举结果数据（2015、2019、2023年）及2026年政策公告的制度分析。
AI.findings: 阿曼女性代表的间歇性源于制度层面缺乏将资格转化为持续代表性的机制：政党招募、名单位置、地域保障及对抗性别化网络的机制均告缺失。2026年的十一席女性席位（每省一席）标志着从非歧视向保障性存在转变，但仍是宣布性分配而非操作性配额。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"政治权利嵌入"须以组织规则使纳入在选举周期中可再生产为条件，挑战了将政治平等等同于法律承认的传统观点，为理解正式权利与实际代表性之间的落差提供了新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿曼及其他海湾国家政策制定者提供启示：保障女性代表性的有效路径不在于单纯承认投票权和候选权，而在于建立可持续的制度化机制（如操作性配额、地域保障等），确保纳入不随选举周期波动。

title:
Beyond the Memorandum: Deconstructing the Strategic Miscalculations of the Sudanese "Russian Partnership" Proposal
A Comprehensive Analysis of the Flamingo Naval Base Agreement and Its Multidimensional Impacts on Sudan's Civil War, Regional Stability, and Geopolitical Alignment
affiliations: Al-Neelain University - Department of Economics

detail.title:
Beyond the Memorandum: Deconstructing the Strategic Miscalculations of the Sudanese "Russian Partnership" Proposal
A Comprehensive Analysis of the Flamingo Naval Base Agreement and Its Multidimensional Impacts on Sudan's Civil War, Regional Stability, and Geopolitical Alignment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The subject is very important for Sudan's future.
declarations.ethicsApproval: There is no conflict of interest
declarations.funderStatement: No Funding

detail.abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive academic analysis of the proposed Russian naval base at Flamingo (Port Sudan) and its multifaceted implications for Sudan's ongoing civil war, regional geopolitical dynamics, and the viability of Sudanese statehood. Through critical examination of primary documents, official statements, and strategic analyses, this study argues that the Russian naval base agreement represents both a strategic opportunity and a profound miscalculation for Sudan's ruling military council. The deal, offering a 25-year lease for a naval logistics facility in exchange for advanced Russian weaponry embodies the desperate calculus of a besieged regime seeking survival through great-power patronage (Larsen & Wivel, 2025). However, this paper contends that the agreement fundamentally misreads Russia's pragmatic realpolitik, overestimates the strategic value of a fixed naval installation in an era of technological warfare, and risks transforming Sudan into a frontline state in renewed great-power competition. Drawing on international relations theory, regional security studies, and critical analysis of the memorandum that surfaced from an unnamed Sudanese faction, this study demonstrates that the naval base deal is symptomatic of deeper institutional dysfunction within Sudan's military establishment. The paper concludes that sustainable peace in Sudan requires not external military patronage but genuine institutional reconstruction, national reconciliation, and a coherent strategic vision that transcends the transactional logic of weapons-for-bases diplomacy (de Waal, 2026).

AI.tldr: 本文对俄罗斯在苏丹弗拉明戈（苏丹港）拟建海军基地的协议进行了全面学术分析，认为该协议对苏丹执政军事委员会而言既是战略机遇也是重大误判，可能使苏丹沦为大国竞争的前线国家，并指出苏丹可持续和平需要制度重建而非外部军事庇护。
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯在苏丹港建立海军基地的协议对苏丹内战、地区地缘政治动态以及苏丹国家生存能力具有哪些多方面影响？
AI.motivation: 理解被围困政权通过大国庇护寻求生存的决策逻辑，同时揭示该协议在大国竞争语境下的战略风险与误判，以及其对苏丹国家建设与和平进程的深层影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系理论、区域安全研究，以及对某未具名苏丹派系公布备忘录的批判性分析。
AI.method: 对一手文献、官方声明和战略分析进行批判性审查，结合国际关系理论和区域安全研究的定性分析方法。
AI.findings: 该海军基地协议误读了俄罗斯务实的现实政治逻辑，高估了固定海军设施在技术战争时代中的战略价值，且可能使苏丹成为大国竞争重新展开的前线国家；该协议反映苏丹军事机构更深层的制度功能障碍；以武器换基地的交易型外交无法实现苏丹的可持续和平。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解弱国政权在面临生存危机时寻求大国庇护的决策困境提供了批判性视角，揭示了大国庇护交易在技术战争时代可能面临的战略局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为苏丹及国际社会提供了政策建议：苏丹可持续和平需要真正的制度重建、民族和解和超越武器换基地交易逻辑的连贯战略愿景，而非依赖外部军事庇护。

reference: 125 Michigan Law Review (forthcoming 2027)
title: Supreme Court Lawmaking and Clear Error as Characterological Discipline

detail.title: Supreme Court Lawmaking and Clear Error as Characterological Discipline
detail.abstract:
This Article proposes a characterological interpretation of clear error deference as it operates in Supreme Court constitutional lawmaking. It adds a fifth justification to the four on which scholars and judges have rested Rule 52(a)(6)—epistemic competence, structural allocation, systemic efficiency, and public legitimacy—attuned to the domain of an apex court making prospective, binding constitutional rules. Drawing on George Herbert Mead’s concept of the generalized other and Erving Goffman’s rules of deference and demeanor, the Article argues that the Rule functions as a role-orienting idiom in an interrelated system: an institutional practice through which a justice signals regard to others, settles expectations of behavior, and pluralizes inputs to lawmaking. This interpretation is characterological because a justice’s internal commitment to her role within a system built on role relationships triggers the idiom and mediates its content; positive law does neither.

Guarding against unitary enunciation of legal rules and unitary management of Article III, the Rule as institutional practice steadies and broadens constitutional lawmaking that must carry authority in a fractious and heterogeneous polity. The act of confronting a record one did not build and displacing the findings of another in a shared system yields three benefits. For the individual justice, the practice enlarges deliberative reasoning by interjecting the presence of other minds at the juncture where the temptation to overreach is greatest. For Article III, it sustains a schema of pluralized, diffuse, and accountable lawmaking power and gives the Court’s pronouncements the social form of authority exercised through role rather than asserted through will. For constitutional law, it sustains the capacity to arbitrate political disagreement by registering and speaking to it.

The Article then demonstrates that the Roberts Court has repeatedly violated the Rule so understood. It isolates five injuries, in roughly escalating order: the disruption of the mutualistic teamwork on which functional differentiation within a unified, hierarchical judiciary depends; the loss of doctrinal and public transparency over Court action; the invitation to view the Court as politicizing justice; the undermining of the Court’s own lawmaking authority at the endpoint of totalizing supremacy; and the disintegration of the deference practices that turn a system into a system of law. It concludes by positioning the Rule alongside other deference practices to argue that Article III lawmaking acquires its authority through a complex system of role-mediated judgments that positive law can capture only in part.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对最高法院宪法立法中"明显错误遵从"（clear error deference）的一种性格学（characterological）解释，认为该规则不仅是认识论、结构、效率或合法性工具，更是一种角色导向的制度实践，通过米德的"概化他人"和戈夫曼的"遵从与仪态规则"理论加以阐释。作者进一步论证罗伯茨法院多次违反该规则，造成五种逐级加重的制度伤害。
AI.research_question: 如何从性格学（characterological）视角重新解释最高法院在宪法制定中适用Rule 52(a)(6)的明显错误遵从原则？罗伯茨法院是否违反了这一原则，其后果为何？
AI.motivation: 现有学者和法官对Rule 52(a)(6)的正当性论证仅停留在四种理由——认知能力、结构分配、系统效率和公共合法性，但这些理由未能解释在最高法院制定前瞻性、有约束力的宪法规则的情境下该规则的特殊功能。作者认为需要一种新的解释框架，以理解该规则在制度系统中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 乔治·赫伯特·米德的"概化他人"（generalized other）概念；欧文·戈夫曼的遵从与仪态规则（rules of deference and demeanor）；角色理论（role theory）；制度实践理论。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念分析：结合社会学理论提出"性格学解释"，并通过对罗伯茨法院司法实践的历史与案例分析，识别五种违反应遵从原则的伤害类型。
AI.findings: 该规则作为制度实践，能为个体大法官扩展审慎推理、为Article III维持多元分散且负责任的立法权力格局、为宪法法保持仲裁政治分歧的能力。但罗伯茨法院反复违反该规则，造成五种逐级加重的伤害：（1）破坏统一、层级化司法系统内功能分化的协作；（2）丧失教义与公共透明度；（3）引发法院政治化司法的观感；（4）削弱法院自身的立法权威（趋于极权至上）；（5）导致将系统转化为法律系统的遵从实践的瓦解。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出第五种正当化理由——性格学正当性，弥补了现有四种理由（认知能力、结构分配、系统效率、公共合法性）的不足；将社会学角色理论引入宪法/司法制度研究，为该领域提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估最高法院的行为提供新的规范性标准；揭示罗伯茨法院遵从实践的失败及其对宪法立法权威、司法合法性和法治系统的具体伤害，对法院改革和司法行为评估具有实践警示意义。

title: Differential Environmental Governance: Coordination through Change among Systems Sharing No Common Ontology

detail.title: Differential Environmental Governance: Coordination through Change among Systems Sharing No Common Ontology
detail.abstract: Coordinated action on an interdependent environmental field requires that parties describing the field in different terms act together on the same processes. The usual route to such coordination is agreement about states: a shared account of what a quantity is, and a shared target for it. This paper argues that agreement of that kind is expensive in representational commitment and frequently unavailable, and proposes a primitive that is cheaper. The method is conceptual and definitional, developed through a graded account of what agreement of successive kinds requires. The paper's central observation is that agreement about the direction and unusualness of a change demands far less shared representation than agreement about the identity of the quantity that changed, so that parties who cannot describe a system in common terms may nonetheless recognise, report, and act on correspondences among changes. Three consequences are developed. Differentials are proposed as an ontology-light coordination primitive, with the conditions under which correspondences among changes are identifiable and the conditions under which they mislead. The argument is grounded in a dynamical result and not in convenience alone: transitions induced by the rate at which a system is forced are not detectable from its state, so a governance arrangement addressed only to states is blind to a class of transition in principle. And the limits of the primitive are stated at length, including its blindness to a system already in an unacceptable state whose rate of change is zero, from which follows a division of labour between constraints stated over states and governance conducted over changes. The paper concedes the philosophical treatment of difference and repetition, the structural analysis of relational value, existing rate-based regulatory instruments, and derivative action in control engineering, and identifies what remains unclaimed. It reports no empirical study and establishes no formal result.

AI.tldr: 本文论证在相互依存的环境领域中，各方无需对系统状态达成一致，仅需对变化的"方向"和"异常性"达成共识，即可实现协调行动。论文提出"微分"（differentials）作为一种"本体论轻量级"的协调原语，并论证了仅针对状态的治理安排在原则上对一类由强制速率引发的转变是盲目的，从而需要在状态约束与基于变化的治理之间进行分工。
AI.research_question: 在相互依存的环境领域中，当各方以不同术语描述同一领域时，如何在不付出高昂表征承诺的前提下实现协调行动？即：是否有一种比"状态一致"更便宜、更基础性的协调原语？
AI.motivation: 通常的协调路径要求各方对"数量是什么"和"目标值是什么"达成一致，但这种基于状态的协议在表征承诺上代价高昂，且经常不可得。本文试图寻找一种更便宜的协调原语。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于概念的、定义的递进分析：对"一致性"进行分级刻画，区分"状态认同的一致性"与"变化方向及异常性的一致性"；动力系统论证（强制速率诱发的转变无法从状态中检测）作为理论支撑。
AI.method: 概念性和定义性方法，通过递进式的一致性分级分析展开论证；辅以动力学结果作为理论基础（非实证研究、非形式化结果）。
AI.findings: （1）对变化的"方向"与"异常性"的一致同意远比"变化数量的同一性"的一致同意要求更少的共享表征；（2）提出"微分"作为本体论轻量级的协调原语，并给出其可识别性与误导条件；（3）由系统被强制速率所诱发的转变无法从系统状态中检测，因此仅针对状态的治理在原则上对一类转变是盲目的；（4）该原语存在局限：对"已处于不可接受状态但变化率为零"的系统是盲目的，由此推出状态约束与基于变化的治理之间的分工。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"微分"作为新的协调原语，挑战了以状态一致为核心的治理理论；通过动力学论证表明状态导向治理存在原则性盲区，为治理理论贡献了一个新的概念框架和分工原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 为环境治理实践提供了一种降低协调成本的路径——各方无需就状态达成一致即可基于变化的对应性进行报告与行动；同时也界定了该路径的适用边界，指导实践者在状态约束与变化治理之间合理分工。

title: Expressly Authorised, Procedurally Underdetermined: Judicial AI and Reviewable Justice in Abu Dhabi

detail.title: Expressly Authorised, Procedurally Underdetermined: Judicial AI and Reviewable Justice in Abu Dhabi

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author serves as a Judge of the Egyptian Court of Appeal within the Egyptian Ministry of Justice. This professional affiliation is disclosed for transparency. The author has no financial, advisory or institutional relationship with the Abu Dhabi Judicial Department, the Abu Dhabi Department of Government Enablement, or any technology provider discussed in this article. The research was conducted independently, and the views expressed are solely those of the author and do not represent the Egyptian Ministry of Justice or any court or public authority.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this study constitutes doctrinal legal research based exclusively on publicly available legislation, official documents, policy instruments and academic literature. It involved no human participants, interviews, surveys, experiments, confidential information or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial or not-for-profit sectors and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Abu Dhabi has announced an AI Judicial Platform intended to support judicial and legal decisionmaking under 'full human supervision and validation', with phased implementation expected from September 2026. This article asks whether the UAE-Abu Dhabi legal framework translates impartiality, reasoned adjudication, equality of arms and judicial independence into enforceable and reviewable safeguards when AI materially assists civil or commercial adjudication in the onshore Abu Dhabi courts. Through doctrinal and institutional analysis, it shows that judicial AI enters neither a legal vacuum nor a merely soft-law environment. Articles 52-54 of Abu Dhabi Law No 6 of 2024 expressly authorise such systems and bind their use to fundamental rights, nondiscrimination, privacy, security, audit, transparency and responsible decision-maker control. The difficulty is procedural: published law and official information do not yet demonstrate a system-use challenge, an AI-inclusive judicial record, case-specific contestability of materially relied-upon output, or a publicly verifiable allocation of control over functions, updates, logs, audit and suspension. Four stress tests expose the resulting mismatch between person-shaped impartiality rules and infrastructure-shaped bias; facially sufficient reasons and unrecorded machine influence; judicial technological advantage and adversarial contestability; and formal judicial authority and external infrastructural control. The article proposes meaningful and reviewable human control as the governing standard and recommends risk-based assessment, proportionate logging, disclosure, party response, independent audit and judicial control of updates and suspension. As an ex-ante publicsource assessment, it does not infer that undisclosed safeguards are absent; it identifies the conditions necessary to make material AI influence visible, answerable and reviewable.

AI.tldr: 本文考察阿布扎比2026年将实施的AI司法平台，分析阿联酋-阿布扎比法律框架能否将公正性、理性裁判、武器平等等原则转化为可执行、可审查的保障措施。通过法理与制度分析，指出法律虽明确授权AI辅助司法并设定约束，但程序层面仍缺乏可竞争性、可记录性和可审查性的具体机制，并提出"有意义且可审查的人类控制"作为核心标准。
AI.research_question: 阿联酋-阿布扎比法律框架是否能在AI实质性辅助民事或商事裁判时，将公正性、理性裁判、武器平等和司法独立转化为可执行且可审查的保障措施？
AI.motivation: 阿布扎比宣布将于2026年9月起分阶段实施AI司法平台，在"完全人类监督和验证"下支持司法与法律决策，这引发了对现有法律框架能否提供充分保障的追问。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法理与制度分析框架，以公正性、理性裁判、武器平等和司法独立四项基本原则为分析基准。
AI.method: 法理分析（doctrinal analysis）与制度分析（institutional analysis），辅以四项压力测试（stress tests）。
AI.findings: 阿布扎比2024年第6号法律第52-54条明确授权AI系统使用并将其绑定于基本权利、非歧视、隐私、安全、审计、透明和决策者责任等要求；但程序层面仍不足：缺乏系统使用质疑机制、AI参与的司法记录、针对实质性依赖产出的个案可竞争性，以及功能、更新、日志、审计和暂停的公开可验证控制分配。四项压力测试揭示了人格化公正规则与基础设施化偏见之间的错配。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"有意义且可审查的人类控制"作为AI辅助司法的治理标准，揭示正式法律授权与程序保障之间的差距，并识别人格化规则与基础设施化系统之间的结构性张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出风险分级评估、比例化日志记录、信息披露、当事方回应权、独立审计以及法官对更新和暂停的司法控制等六项具体建议，为阿布扎比AI司法平台的实施提供操作性指引。

title: The Political Economic Analysis of the Ideology of the Predominant Islamic Fundamentalist Groups in Sudan
affiliations: Al-Neelain University - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Political Economic Analysis of the Ideology of the Predominant Islamic Fundamentalist Groups in Sudan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: It is very important in Sudanese future
declarations.ethicsApproval: There is no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: No Funding

detail.abstract: This paper offers an in-depth analysis of the political ideology of Sudan's predominant Islamic fundamentalist group, tracing its historical roots, evolution, and practical application in governance. The research employs a dialogic model of interpretation, integrating rationalist frameworks and structural analyses of political, cultural, and socioeconomic conditions. The paper examines the historical trajectory of Sudan, the rise of Islamic fundamentalism, and the impact of the National Islamic Front (NIF), later the National Congress Party, on state policy and society. The analysis includes a review of Sudan's constitutional and legal transformations, policies influencing economic development, and the ideological schism driving civil conflict, culminating in events such as the Darfur crisis. Tables illustrating demographic, economic, and conflict data support the discussion. Conclusions address the discrepancy between theoretical ideals and practical realities, shedding light on the challenges of implementing religious ideology within a heterogeneous society.

AI.tldr: 本文深入分析了苏丹主要伊斯兰原教旨主义团体的政治意识形态，追溯其历史根源、演变过程及在治理中的实际应用。研究采用对话式解释模型，整合理性主义框架与政治、文化和社会经济条件的结构分析，考察了苏丹的历史轨迹、伊斯兰原教旨主义的兴起，以及国家伊斯兰阵线（NIF，后为全国大会党）对国家政策和社会的影响，最终审视了理论与现实之间的差距。
AI.research_question: 苏丹伊斯兰原教旨主义团体的政治意识形态如何形成、演变，并在国家治理中得以实践应用？其理论理想与现实治理之间存在怎样的差距？
AI.motivation: 苏丹长期遭受内部冲突（如达尔富尔危机）的困扰，伊斯兰原教旨主义在其中的作用值得深入探讨。研究旨在理解宗教意识形态在多元社会中实施所面临的挑战，揭示理论理想与现实实践之间的不一致。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对话式解释模型（dialogic model of interpretation），整合理性主义分析框架与政治、文化及社会经济条件的结构分析。
AI.method: 定性历史分析方法，综合运用文献分析、宪法与法律变革回顾、政策分析，并结合人口统计、经济和冲突数据的表格化呈现。
AI.findings: 苏丹伊斯兰原教旨主义团体的意识形态在理论上追求宗教理想，但实际治理中面临诸多挑战。意识形态分歧驱动了国内冲突，最终导致达尔富尔危机等事件。理论理想与现实之间存在显著差距，宗教意识形态在异质性社会中的实施面临根本性困难。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了对话式解释模型，将理性主义与结构分析方法相结合，为理解伊斯兰原教旨主义政治意识形态提供了跨学科的理论框架，深化了对宗教意识形态与政治治理关系的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解苏丹政治冲突的意识形态根源提供了系统分析，揭示了宗教意识形态在多元社会治理中的实践困境，对相关政策制定和冲突解决具有参考价值。

title: Family-Controlled Media and News Reporting: Evidence from Korea
affiliations: Institute of Financial Studies, Southwestern University of Finance and Economics and Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey - Rutgers Business School at Newark & New Brunswick

detail.title: Family-Controlled Media and News Reporting: Evidence from Korea
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how family-controlled media shapes news reporting. Exploiting marital ties between the controlling families of Korea's three largest nationwide newspapers and those of major conglomerates (chaebols), we find that firms directly connected to a newspaper through such ties receive systematically more favorable news tone and greater coverage relative to unconnected firms. In a prosecution-related subsample, where conglomerate controlling families face significant reputational and legal exposure, favorable coverage becomes more pronounced and spills over to indirectly connected firms. Consistent with capital market participants recognizing this editorial bias, stock price responses to favorable coverage by connected newspapers are significantly attenuated. These findings suggest that family-controlled media can compromise editorial independence when controlling families have a conflict of interest with the firms they cover, with broad implications given the global prevalence of such ownership structures.

AI.tldr: 本文利用韩国三大全国性报纸的控制家族与主要财阀（chaebols）之间的婚姻关系，发现通过此类关系与企业直接关联的报纸会给予这些企业更有利的新闻报道语气和更多的报道覆盖。在涉及检察机关起诉的子样本中，有利报道变得更加明显，并溢出到间接关联的企业。资本市场参与者认识到这种编辑偏见，因此对关联报纸有利报道的股价反应显著减弱。
AI.research_question: 家族控制的媒体如何影响新闻报道？具体而言，报纸控制家族与财阀企业之间的婚姻关系是否会系统性地影响媒体对企业的报道偏向？
AI.motivation: 家族控制的媒体在全球范围内普遍存在，但编辑独立性可能因控制家族的利益冲突而受到损害。现有研究对媒体所有权的偏见关注不足，尤其是通过人际关系（如婚姻）形成的隐性利益纽带对报道内容的影响尚未得到充分实证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 媒体所有权与控制权理论、利益冲突与编辑独立性理论、信息传播与资本市场定价理论。
AI.method: 利用韩国三大全国性报纸控制家族与主要财阀之间的婚姻关系作为识别策略，构建自然实验。比较关联企业与非关联企业在新闻报道语气和覆盖量上的差异，并利用检察机关起诉子样本考察偏见加剧及溢出效应，同时通过事件研究法检验股票价格反应。
AI.findings: （1）通过婚姻关系与报纸直接关联的企业获得显著更有利的新闻语气和更多报道覆盖；（2）在检察机关起诉相关的子样本中，有利报道更加明显，并溢出到间接关联的企业；（3）资本市场参与者识别到这种编辑偏见，关联报纸的有利报道引发的股价反应显著被削弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 为媒体所有权结构与编辑独立性之间的关系提供了新的实证证据，揭示了家族控制媒体中隐性利益冲突（婚姻纽带）对报道内容的系统性影响，拓展了媒体偏见理论的分析维度；同时阐释了资本市场如何对媒体偏见进行定价调整。
AI.practical_contributions: 对全球范围内普遍存在的家族控制媒体格局具有现实警示意义，提示投资者、监管者和公众关注媒体所有权结构可能带来的信息失真风险；对媒体报道的客观性与资本市场信息效率均具有实践启示。

title: Networked Dollarization: Stablecoin Adoption and Cross-Border Reallocation
affiliations: Tsinghua University - Tsinghua University School of Economics and Management, Tsinghua University - Institute of Economics and Tsinghua University - Tsinghua University School of Economics and Management

detail.title: Networked Dollarization: Stablecoin Adoption and Cross-Border Reallocation
detail.abstract: Dollar stablecoins combine a dollar claim with liquidity from a payment network. User adoption and merchant acceptance reinforce each other, creating a threshold for widespread use and an offshore dollar balance sheet. Crossing this threshold reallocates developing-country saving from domestic capital and local money toward Treasury-backed dollar claims, reducing local monetary revenue while increasing U.S. monetary rents when the peg remains intact. Greater peg risk can eliminate the high-adoption equilibrium, whereas local inflation makes it easier to sustain. Better domestic payment infrastructure raises the coordination hurdle for stablecoin adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美元稳定币将美元债权与支付网络流动性结合后，用户采纳与商户接受度相互强化形成采用门槛，跨越门槛会重新分配发展中国家储蓄，减少当地货币收入并增加美国货币租金。
AI.research_question: 美元稳定币的采用如何形成网络效应门槛，以及跨越这一门槛对发展中国家和美国的宏观经济影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解稳定币在全球支付体系中日益重要的作用，特别是其对发展中国家资本流动、货币政策主权和美国货币地位的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络效应/临界点理论、货币竞争理论、货币租金（seigniorage）理论
AI.method: 理论建模分析，构建用户采纳与商户接受度的协同强化模型，分析均衡条件与稳定性。
AI.findings: （1）稳定币采用存在阈值效应，跨越后形成高采用均衡；（2）跨越门槛会将发展中国家储蓄从国内资本和本币重新配置到美国国债支持的美元债权；（3）这减少当地货币铸币税收入，同时增加美国的货币租金；（4）更高的挂钩（peg）风险会消除高采用均衡；（5）当地通胀反而使高采用均衡更易维持；（6）更好的国内支付基础设施会提高稳定币采用的协调门槛。
AI.theory_contributions: 将网络效应理论引入稳定币采用分析，揭示了稳定币采用的多重均衡特征，并连接了货币竞争理论与国际金融中的货币租金分配问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了稳定币采用的门槛条件认知，提示发展中国家改善支付基础设施可提高稳定币采用的协调难度，同时警示当地通胀可能加速稳定币替代本币的风险。

title: Two Growth Rates, Two Probabilities: New Perspectives on Black-Scholes and the Erosion of Uncertainty

detail.title: Two Growth Rates, Two Probabilities: New Perspectives on Black-Scholes and the Erosion of Uncertainty
detail.abstract: The Black-Scholes option pricing formula contains two probability terms, N(d₁) and N(d₂), that most students can compute but few can explain. Standard treatments leave many questions unanswered, including why there are two different probabilities, what they mean, and why the formula both adds and subtracts σ²/2. This paper provides an intuitive treatment built on the idea that a call option is two contingent claims, and one difference between them cascades into everything else. The first, a short cash-or-nothing, requires the payment of a fixed X if the stock reaches the strike. The key question is whether the stock reached X -a return-based question, viewed retrospectively from expiration. The second, an asset-or-nothing, pays the variable stock price at expiration if exercise occurs. The relevant amount here is the expected future stock value, averaged across only the in-the-money paths-a future-value-based question, viewed prospectively across the fan of paths. The two contingent claims involve σ²/2 in opposite roles: variance drag from compounding returns along a single path; convexity boost from averaging prices across paths. These cancel in the cash-or-nothing case but not in the asset-or-nothing case, so that d₁ and d₂ differ by σ²T. The paper also offers an original connection between option time decay and the common-knowledge "monks puzzle" in epistemic logic. The entire framework relies only on algebra and the normal distribution, without requiring Itô's lemma or other tools of stochastic calculus.

AI.tldr: 本文为Black-Scholes期权定价公式提供了直觉化解释，将看涨期权拆分为现金或无价值（cash-or-nothing）和资产或无价值（asset-or-nothing）两种或有索取权，通过方差拖累（variance drag）与凸性增益（convexity boost）的消长关系解释了d₁与d₂为何相差σ²T，并建立了期权时间衰减与认识逻辑中"僧人谜题"之间的新颖联系。
AI.research_question: 如何为Black-Scholes期权定价公式中的两个概率项N(d₁)和N(d₂)提供直觉化的解释，阐明它们为何存在、含义是什么，以及公式中为何涉及σ²/2的加减？
AI.motivation: 大多数学生能计算Black-Scholes公式中的两个概率项，但很少有人能解释其含义。标准教材的讲解留下了许多未解之谜：为什么有两个不同的概率？它们分别意味着什么？为什么公式中同时加上和减去σ²/2？
AI.theoretical_framework: Black-Scholes期权定价模型；或有索取权分解理论（现金或无价值与资产或无价值）；方差拖累与凸性增益；认识逻辑（epistemic logic）中的僧人谜题。
AI.method: 本文采用概念分析与代数推导的方法，不需使用Itô引理或随机微积分工具，仅依赖代数与正态分布，通过将看涨期权拆分为两种或有索取权，从回溯视角（return-based）和前瞻视角（future-value-based）分别解释两个概率项的含义。
AI.findings: 1）看涨期权可分解为现金或无价值（支付固定X）和资产或无价值（支付到期股价）两种或有索取权；2）现金或无价值涉及回溯的回报问题，资产或无价值涉及前瞻的未来价值期望问题；3）σ²/2在两种索取权中扮演相反角色——沿单一路径复利回报的方差拖累与跨路径价格平均的凸性增益，前者在现金或无价值中抵消，后者在资产或无价值中保留，导致d₁与d₂相差σ²T；4）建立了期权时间衰减与认识逻辑中僧人谜题之间的原创联系。
AI.theory_contributions: 为Black-Scholes公式中的两个概率项提供了直觉化、教学化的理论解释，澄清了N(d₁)与N(d₂)的本质区别，并原创性地将期权时间衰减与认识逻辑中的僧人谜题联系起来，拓展了金融衍生品定价理论的解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融教学提供了更易于理解的Black-Scholes公式讲解框架，帮助学生学习者和从业者更直观地把期权定价的内在逻辑，提升金融教育的可理解性。

title: Institutional Decay and Elite Predation: The Structural Drivers of Ethiopia's Ongoing Political and Administrative Crisis
affiliations: Bule Hora University

detail.title: Institutional Decay and Elite Predation: The Structural Drivers of Ethiopia's Ongoing Political and Administrative Crisis

declarations.funderStatement: Didn't recieved a fund from anyone.

detail.abstract: This manuscript investigates the compounding mechanisms of institutional decay and elite predation driving contemporary Ethiopia's political turmoil and administrative crisis. Moving beyond reductionist narratives of primordial ethnic hatred, this study contends that the current crisis is the structural outcome of historical pathdependencies, flawed ethno-federal designs, and rent-seeking networks that survived successive regime transitions. By examining the post-2018 political transition, the paper explores how the centralization maneuvers of the Prosperity Party, coupled with sub-national elite mobilization, have hollowed out formal bureaucratic accountability. Drawing upon qualitative political economy analysis and foundational literature references, the paper demonstrates that systemic corruption is not merely an administrative failure, but a core governance crisis rooted in state capture.

AI.tldr: 本文研究埃塞俄比亚当代政治动荡与行政危机的制度退化与精英掠夺的复合机制，认为当前危机并非简单的族群仇恨，而是历史路径依赖、缺陷的民族联邦设计和跨越政权更迭存续的寻租网络的系统性产物。
AI.research_question: 当代埃塞俄比亚政治动荡和行政危机的根本驱动机制是什么？后2018年政治转型中，制度退化与精英掠夺如何相互作用并掏空官僚问责制？
AI.motivation: 超越将埃塞俄比亚危机简单归结为"原生族群仇恨"的化约论叙事，揭示危机的结构性根源及其与历史制度遗产的深层关联。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史路径依赖理论、国家俘获理论、民族联邦主义设计理论、寻租网络分析
AI.method: 质性政治经济学分析，结合基础文献综述与后2018年政治转型案例研究
AI.findings: 系统性的腐败不仅是行政失灵，更是植根于国家俘获的核心治理危机；繁荣党的中央集权操作与次国家精英动员共同掏空了正式官僚问责制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将埃塞俄比亚危机重新概念化为制度退化与精英掠夺的复合机制，而非单纯的族群冲突；丰富了国家俘获理论在非洲政治经济语境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解埃塞俄比亚治理危机提供结构性分析框架，对政策制定者识别制度退化与问责制瓦解的关键节点具有参考价值。

title: Network Incidence and VAT Rate Design with Incomplete Crediting

detail.title: Network Incidence and VAT Rate Design with Incomplete Crediting

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants and did not require ethics approval.

detail.abstract: Should upstream sectors face higher or lower VAT rates? The cascading doctrine favors lower upstream rates; captive-base incidence favors higher. We derive both within one welfare objective in a production network with seller-buyer-specific crediting. At a common crediting rate, the incidence and production blocks imply opposing patterns and nearly cancel. Wherever crediting mostly works, model-implied spreads never exceed about two points, against fourteen in statute, across 76 input-output tables and 211-sector Chinese calibrations. China's 2018-2019 cuts realized a third of the attainable compression; the announced merger delivers most of the rest. Where informality removes the downstream base, the prescription reverses.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了上游部门应适用更高还是更低的增值税率问题。在一个包含买卖双方特定抵扣的生产网络模型中，推导出累进关税学说（支持上游低税率）与俘虏税基理论（支持上游高税率）在统一福利目标下的平衡。研究发现，在常见抵扣率下，税负归宿与生产模块的效应几乎相互抵消，模型隐含的税率差绝不超过2个百分点，而中国法定税率差高达14个百分点。中国2018-2019年的降税实现了可压缩空间的三分之一，而宣布的合并将实现其余大部分。当非正规经济侵蚀下游税基时，政策建议则反转。
AI.research_question: 在生产网络中，上游部门应当适用更高还是更低的增值税率？如何统一累进关税学说（上游低税率）与俘虏税基理论（上游高税率）这对看似矛盾的政策主张？
AI.motivation: 增值税税率结构设计是重要的公共财政问题。传统的累进关税学说主张上游低税率以避免税负累积，而俘虏税基理论认为上游企业难以转移税负应适用高税率。这两种理论给出对立政策建议，缺乏统一的理论框架来分析最优税率结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产网络模型，结合买卖双方特定抵扣机制（seller-buyer-specific crediting）的一般均衡框架，整合税负归宿分析（incidence）与生产结构分析（production blocks）。
AI.method: 理论建模（将两种对立理论纳入统一福利目标函数），并使用76个投入产出表和211个部门的中国校准数据进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 在常见抵扣率下，税负归宿与生产模块对税率结构的要求几乎相互抵消，模型隐含的税率差上限约为2个百分点，远低于中国法定的14个百分点差距。中国2018-2019年的增值税改革只实现了可压缩空间的三分之一，而宣布的税率合并能实现剩余的大部分。当非正规经济导致下游税基缺失时，政策建议反转（上游应适用更高税率）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将累进关税学说与俘虏税基理论整合到统一的福利最优化框架中，揭示了两种理论效应在生产网络中近乎抵消的关系，为理解增值税最优税率结构提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为增值税税率结构设计提供了定量分析工具，揭示了现行税率差（14个百分点）远高于最优水平（约2个百分点），并评估了2018-2019年改革及税率合并政策的实际效果，对税务改革具有直接的政策参考价值。

title: Same Return, Same Variance, Different Future Breaking Endpoint-variance Equivalence through Financial Path Geometry
affiliations: Independent Quantitative Researcher

detail.title: Same Return, Same Variance, Different Future Breaking Endpoint-variance Equivalence through Financial Path Geometry

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses publicly available financial market data and does not involve human participants, patients, personal data, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper asks whether a recent financial path can be compressed to its terminal return and close-to-close realized variance without losing predictive information about the future return distribution. For each past window, the cumulative log-price path is detrended by its endpoint and normalized by endpoint-adjusted variation. The resulting path is summarized by interpretable price-shape features, a temporal distribution of variance ("volatility mass"), and price-variance coupling features. Using adjusted daily prices for 50 exchange-traded funds from 2005 through August 2026, three lookback windows (20, 60, and 120 sessions), two forecast horizons (5 and 20 sessions), expanding-window out-of-sample evaluation with an L+h purge, nested training-only model selection, and HAC inference with Holm multiplicity correction, I test whether geometry adds information beyond (R, log RV). The strongest result is a robust rejection of endpoint-variance predictive sufficiency for future risk and return scale. Future realized risk and upside semivariance improve in all six configurations after within-endpoint Holm correction; future absolute return improves in three of six, while all six point estimates are positive. A matched design that holds past return and variance nearly fixed yields even stronger equivalence breaking: future risk and upside semivariance differ in all six configurations even under a global Holm sensitivity correction; downside semivariance and absolute return diverge in all six under endpoint-wise correction. Direct out-of-sample prediction of the conditional mean return does not improve, yet matched paths with similar past return and variance exhibit future-mean divergence in four of six configurations, with two surviving global correction; an all-neighbor residual-dose test also survives global correction at L=120, h=20. The evidence therefore points to an anisotropic information loss: path geometry primarily carries information about future scale and risk rather than a stable directional mean. The study is fully reproducible in the linked repository and explicitly distinguishes final evidence from the iterative development process that produced the specification.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了金融价格路径是否可以压缩为终点收益和收盘到收盘的已实现方差（R, log RV）而不丢失关于未来收益分布的预测信息。通过对50只ETF（2005年至2026年8月）的日度数据，采用路径形状特征、波动率时间分布（波动率质量）和价格-方差耦合特征，在三种回看窗口（20、60、120个交易日）和两种预测期（5、20个交易日）下进行样本外评估，发现路径几何信息对未来的风险和收益尺度具有增量预测能力，但对条件均值收益没有稳定改进，表现为各向异性的信息损失。
AI.research_question: 金融价格路径能否被压缩为终点收益和收盘到收盘的已实现方差而不丢失关于未来收益分布的预测信息？
AI.motivation: 传统金融计量中通常用收益和方差等标量统计量概括价格路径，但路径内部形状（几何信息）可能包含未被捕捉的关于未来收益分布的信息。检验这种信息压缩是否充分，有助于理解价格路径信息的本质价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 路径几何与未来收益分布预测的信息充分性理论；端点-方差预测充分性假设（endpoint-variance predictive sufficiency）
AI.method: 对每个过去窗口的累积对数价格路径去趋势（减去终点）并以端点调整的变化量归一化；提取可解释的价格形状特征、波动率时间分布（波动率质量）和价格-方差耦合特征；采用扩展窗口样本外评估（含L+h purge）、嵌套训练模式选择、HAC推断和Holm多重校正；并进行匹配设计（控制过去收益和方差近似固定）检验等价性。
AI.findings: （1）未来已实现风险和上行半方差在所有六种配置中均显著改善（经Holm校正）；（2）未来绝对收益在六种配置中三种改善，但所有点估计为正；（3）匹配设计中，未来风险和上行半方差在所有六种配置中均显著不同，下行半方差和绝对收益在端点校正下也在所有六种配置中发散；（4）条件均值收益的直接样本外预测无改善，但匹配路径在四种配置中表现出未来均值发散，两种通过全局校正；（5）整体证据表明路径几何主要携带未来尺度和风险信息，而非稳定的方向性均值信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明(R, log RV)统计量在预测未来风险和收益尺度方面不具备充分性，路径几何包含额外的预测信息；揭示了信息损失的各向异性特征——几何信息主要影响未来规模/风险而非方向性均值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和风险管理者提供了超越传统收益-方差框架的路径特征信息，可用于改进未来风险和波动率预测；完整的可复现代码库便于实践应用和进一步研究。

title: Temperature Anomalies and the Term Structure of Credit Risk
affiliations: ESADE Business School, Ramon Llull University and EADA Business School

detail.title: Temperature Anomalies and the Term Structure of Credit Risk
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the connection between local heat shocks and the long-versus short term credit risk prospects of firms located in affected regions. On average, temperature anomalies are associated with an increase in the relative slope of the term structure of forward credit default swap (CDS) spreads, defined as the proportional difference of forward spreads at different horizons relative to the 1-year benchmark. The effect initially increases with the time horizon, becomes statistically significant for maturities of four to five years, and then stabilizes. We interpret these findings as evidence that heat anomalies are perceived as anticipating a long-run steady state characterized by higher default risk, whose effects go beyond any potential short-term impact on productivity. Beyond these findings, the study provides important insights into the potential limitations of using the absolute slope of the term structure of spot CDS spreads to investigate the relation between long-and short-term credit risk. Indeed, we show that the well-established positive effects of leverage and volatility actually reverse when the relative slope of the forward curve is used instead.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了局部热冲击与受影响地区企业长期与短期信用风险前景之间的关系。研究发现，温度异常与远期信用违约互换（CDS）利差期限结构相对斜率（相对于1年期基准的远期利差在不同期限上的比例差异）的增大有关。该效应随期限延长而增大，在4至5年期变得统计显著，随后趋于稳定。作者将此解释为热异常被视为预示着高违约风险的长期稳态，其影响超出对生产力的任何短期冲击。
AI.research_question: 局部热冲击如何影响企业长期与短期的信用风险前景？具体而言，温度异常与企业远期CDS利差期限结构的相对斜率之间存在何种关联？
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多关注极端天气对生产力的短期影响，而对其长期信用风险效应的研究不足。此外，传统使用现货CDS利差期限结构绝对斜率的方法可能存在局限，需要探索更有效的度量方式来理解长短期信用风险之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信用风险定价理论和期限结构理论，利用远期CDS利差期限结构的相对斜率作为度量长短期信用风险相对变化的指标，考察市场参与者对热异常的长期风险预期。
AI.method: 实证研究方法：利用局部温度异常数据与企业远期CDS利差数据，构建期限结构的相对斜率指标，通过回归分析检验温度异常对长期信用风险的影响，并对比绝对斜率与相对斜率的分析结果差异。
AI.findings: （1）温度异常与远期CDS利差期限结构相对斜率的增大显著相关，表明热异常预示着更高的长期违约风险；（2）该效应随期限延长而增强，在4-5年期限变得统计显著后趋于稳定；（3）当使用相对斜率替代绝对斜率时，杠杆率和波动率对信用风险的既有正向效应发生逆转，表明测量方法的选择对研究结论有重大影响。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次将局部热冲击与企业长期信用风险预期联系起来，拓展了气候变化经济学的理论视角；（2）揭示了现货CDS期限结构绝对斜率作为度量工具的局限性，提出并验证了远期曲线相对斜率的优越性，为信用风险实证研究的方法论提供了重要贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为投资者、金融机构和监管者在评估气候变化相关的长期信用风险时提供了新的分析工具和参考指标；（2）提醒市场参与者在使用信用风险期限结构指标时需注意度量方式的选择，避免因方法误用而得出错误的信贷风险评估结论。

title: Whom Do You Sue? - Bonded Penalties for AI Agents Beyond the Reach of Civil Liability

detail.title: Whom Do You Sue? - Bonded Penalties for AI Agents Beyond the Reach of Civil Liability
detail.abstract: When an AI agent creates harm, the law will reach for a defendant. Sometimes it can find one in the deployer who ignored warnings or the developer who shipped a defect. But a growing class of AI agents will cause harms that cannot be attached to a specific defendant: some because the harm emerges from the interaction of many autonomous agents, each individually innocuous, operating at machine speed; others because the principal who deployed the agent is pseudonymous, judgment-proof, or beyond jurisdictional reach. Yet compensatory civil liability, however reformed, collects through a money judgment against a solvent, identifiable defendant. For a definable core of AI agents, ones whose harms emerge from interaction and whose principals cannot be reached, ex ante automated penalty institutions can most effectively collect. For a wider band of identified but thinly capitalized, judgment-proof, or covertly agentic actors, the same bonding institutions are preferable to ordinary liability on deterrence grounds. This is because a posted bond reaches an optimizing agent's decision calculus with a directness ex post liability cannot match: immediate rather than delayed, mechanically specified rather than doctrinally contingent, and levied on resources the agent itself controls. Convergent institutional evolution in two distinct contexts, staked blockchain networks and high-volume commercial venues running reserve-and-threshold regimes, has already field-tested these bonding institutions under adversarial, pseudonymous, machine-speed conditions. No existing proposal for governance of AI agents combines coverage mandatory at the credential level, capital held in venue custody with priority, forfeiture automatic on defined triggers, exclusion attached to the same credential, and scope extending to diffuse, interaction-generated third-party harm. While each of these bonding institutions has prior precedent, their complete combination is my contribution here. Yet I deliberately avoid proposing an "optimal" bond: any penalty rule becomes a term in the objective an optimizing agent or its deployment loop pursues, and agentic behavior adapts to rule choice more completely and rapidly than in most human regulatory contexts. What I instead provide is an overview of the design space: which trigger designs resist manipulation, which resource architectures retain enforcement reach, where human discretion remains necessary, and why persistent variation across deployment contexts is a beneficial equilibrium rather than a defect awaiting standardization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对AI代理造成的损害，特别是那些无法归责于具体被告的损害（如多智能体交互产生的损害、或部署者匿名/无偿付能力/超出司法管辖的情况），应当采用事前自动化的"保证金制度"（bonding institutions）来替代传统的过错侵权责任。作者整合了区块链质押网络和大型商业平台的准备金-阈值制度这两类已实践检验的制度，提出了一个完整的保证金制度组合方案，但刻意避免提出"最优"罚则设计。
AI.research_question: 当AI代理造成损害时，如何对那些无法通过传统民事侵权责任体系追责的损害（如多智能体交互产生的弥散性损害、或部署者匿名/无清偿能力/超出司法管辖）进行有效的事前惩罚与威慑？
AI.motivation: 传统侵权责任依赖对有偿付能力且可识别的被告进行金钱判决，但一类日益增长的AI代理损害无法归责于具体被告：要么损害源于众多本身无害的自主代理在机器速度下的交互涌现，要么部署者是匿名的、无清偿能力的或超出司法管辖的。因此需要一种新的制度方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 威慑理论（deterrence theory）：保证金制度相比事后责任能以更直接的方式进入优化代理的决策计算——即时而非延迟、机械性明确而非教义性偶然、施加于代理自身控制的资源而非依赖第三方执行。
AI.method: 概念性/制度设计分析：通过梳理两个已经过实战检验的制度领域（质押区块链网络、高流量商业平台的准备金-阈值制度），论证制度趋同演化，并在此基础上提出五种制度要素的完整组合方案，同时系统分析设计空间中的触发机制设计、资源架构和执行边界。
AI.findings: （1）存在一类可界定的AI代理损害（交互涌现型损害且主理人无法触及）最适合事前自动化惩罚机构来征收；（2）对于更广泛的已识别但资本薄弱、无清偿能力或隐性代理的行动者，保证金制度在威慑理由上也优于普通责任；（3）区块链质押网络和商业平台准备金-阈值制度已证明此类制度在对抗性、匿名、机器速度条件下可行；（4）五要素完整组合（凭证级强制覆盖、场所托管优先资本、触发即自动没收、同一凭证的排斥、范围覆盖弥散性第三方损害）此前无任何治理提案提出过；（5）不应追求"最优"保证金设计，跨部署情境的持续变异是良性均衡而非需要标准化的缺陷。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文在理论上论证了事前保证金制度在威慑优化代理方面相对于事后侵权责任的直接性优势（即时性、机械确定性、资源控制性），并挑战了"标准化处罚规则"在AI治理中的隐含假设——指出由于代理行为对规则选择的适应更完全更快速，持久的情境变异反而是良性均衡。将威慑理论与AI代理治理结合，提供了新的制度设计框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和平台设计者提供了一个完整的AI代理保证金制度组合方案（凭证级强制+场所托管+自动没收+凭证排斥+覆盖弥散损害），并给出了设计空间的具体指引：哪些触发设计能抵抗操纵、哪些资源架构能保持执行触及、哪些地方仍需人类裁量。整合了区块链和商业平台两个领域的成熟实践经验。

reference: Economics, Culture and Social Theory, W.A. Jackson, Cheltenham: Edward Elgar, 2009, pp. 3-14
title: Cultural Thought and its Origins
affiliations: University of York - Department of Economics and Related Studies

detail.title: Cultural Thought and its Origins

publicationDetails.detailsText: Economics, Culture and Social Theory, W.A. Jackson, Cheltenham: Edward Elgar, 2009, pp. 3-14

detail.abstract: The modern academic concept of culture arose in response to the Enlightenment and its universalist claims about knowledge and scientific method. Cultural thought denied the universal relevance of rationalism and empiricism, asserting the importance of customs, tradition, local knowledge, historical specificity, pluralism and interpretative understanding, especially for the study of society. This chapter examines the origins of cultural thought in the critique of the Enlightenment and considers the main ideas and implications. It then discusses the neglect of culture in the economics discipline, propelled by the long-standing desire to imitate natural science and keep a distance from the humanities. The resulting economics/culture divide has narrowed the perspective of economics and obscured the cultural context of economic activity.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了现代文化概念的起源，它源于对启蒙运动及其普遍主义主张的批判，并分析了经济学学科中文化被忽视的原因及其后果（经济学/文化分立的负面影响）。
AI.research_question: 文化概念如何在批判启蒙运动中产生？经济学为何忽视文化，以及这种忽视带来了怎样的后果？
AI.motivation: 文化对理解社会至关重要，但经济学长期模仿自然科学而排斥文化视角，导致经济学视野狭窄，掩盖了经济活动的文化背景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化理论（强调习俗、传统、地方性知识、历史特殊性、多元主义和诠释性理解）；启蒙运动批判理论
AI.method: 概念史与思想史分析（理论性/文献性研究，非实证方法）
AI.findings: 文化思想源于对启蒙运动普遍主义（理性主义和经验主义）的反拨；经济学因长期模仿自然科学而忽视文化，导致经济学/文化之间的分立，使经济学视野被窄化，经济活动中的文化语境被遮蔽。
AI.theory_contributions: 从思想史角度厘清文化概念在批判启蒙运动中的思想根源及其核心主张（习俗、传统、地方知识、多元主义等），并揭示经济学忽视文化的历史动因与理论后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示经济学研究者应重视经济活动的文化语境，弥合经济学与人文科学之间的鸿沟，以拓宽经济学的研究视野。

title: Trading Signals and Stock Price Formation: A Conceptual Framework of Trading-Signal Reliability in U.S. Equity Markets

detail.title: Trading Signals and Stock Price Formation: A Conceptual Framework of Trading-Signal Reliability in U.S. Equity Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, animals, or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper develops a conceptual framework for evaluating when observable trading activity can support a defensible informational inference in U.S. equity markets. Trading-signal reliability is defined as a task-, observer-, and environment-specific property of the inference drawn from an observed or constructed trading signal, rather than as an intrinsic property of the signal or its information content. Drawing on literature on information revelation, social learning, heterogeneous trading motives, market structure, and empirical measurement, the framework identifies four diagnostic dimensions: dependence-aware interpretation, source identifiability, structural conditioning, and measurement validity. Their relevance varies with the inferential claim; source identification is especially important for mechanism-oriented interpretations but need not be required for purely predictive uses. The framework also distinguishes market from researcher inference under overlapping but non-identical information sets and separates trading-signal reliability from informativeness, price impact, and price informativeness. For empirical research, it shifts attention from whether a trading measure predicts an outcome to what inference that measure can defensibly support under relevant economic, institutional, and observational conditions. The framework is conceptual rather than structural and provides a basis for task-specific evaluation of trading signals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个概念性框架，用于评估美国股票市场中可观察交易活动能否支撑合理的信息推断。该框架将交易信号可靠性定义为任务、观察者和环境特定属性，而非信号本身的内在属性，并识别了四个诊断维度：依赖感知解读、来源可识别性、结构条件化和测量有效性。
AI.research_question: 在美国股票市场中，何时可观察的交易活动能够支撑合理的（可辩护的）信息推断？如何系统地评估交易信号的可靠性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究中，交易信号（如交易量、订单流等）常被直接用作信息推断的依据，但对"何种推断在何种条件下成立"缺乏系统性评估框架，导致研究结论可能过度解读或误用交易指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息揭示、社会学习、异质交易动机、市场结构及实证测量等文献，构建了交易信号可靠性的概念性框架。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性方法，整合多领域文献构建诊断框架，非结构性经验实证。
AI.findings: 提出四个诊断维度（依赖感知解读、来源可识别性、结构条件化、测量有效性）；其相关性因推断主张而异；区分了市场推断与研究者推断；将交易信号可靠性区别于信息含量、价格影响和价格信息含量。
AI.theory_contributions: 为交易信号评估提供了系统性概念框架，澄清了信号可靠性、信息含量、价格影响等概念间的区别与联系，将可靠性重新定义为情境依赖属性而非信号固有属性。
AI.practical_contributions: 对实证研究者提供了评估交易指标可支持推断的指导准则，强调从"交易指标能否预测结果"转向"该指标在何种条件下能支撑何种推断"。

title: Does Sub-national Complexity Matter for Income? Panel Evidence from New Zealand's Territorial Authorities
affiliations: Victoria University of Wellington and Victoria University of Wellington - Te Herenga Waka

detail.title: Does Sub-national Complexity Matter for Income? Panel Evidence from New Zealand's Territorial Authorities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None Declared
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: None Declared

detail.abstract: Economic complexity methods are increasingly applied at the sub-national scale, but most applications characterize a single cross-section rather than the evolution of the complexity-income relationship over time. We construct the first annual, territorial-authority-level economic complexity panel for New Zealand, spanning 2000-2025, using employment-based industry co-location from Business Demography Statistics and computing economic and product complexity indices from 4-digit ANZSIC06 patterns across 67 territorial authorities. Linking these indices to Linked Employer-Employee Data earnings and Census income, we report three findings. First, New Zealand's complexity geography is strongly polarized and highly persistent, the rank-order correlation between the 2000 and 2025 distributions is 0.82, indicating structural inertia rather than convergence. Second, in a two-way fixed effects model that removes all time-invariant territorial-authority characteristics and aggregate national trends, within-place increases in complexity are associated with higher local earnings, a one standard deviation rise in the index corresponds to 7.2% higher mean earnings, evidence that speaks directly to the common critique that complexity metrics describe rather than inform policy. Third, the cross-sectional complexity-income association strengthens markedly across the 2013, 2018 and 2023 Censuses, with both the coefficient and its explanatory power roughly tripling. Together, these results establish economic complexity as an increasingly consequential structural feature of sub-national income divergence.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了新西兰首个年度领土管理局级别的经济复杂度面板数据（2000-2025），发现经济复杂度的地理分布高度极化且持续性强，且在本地区内部复杂度提升与更高的本地收入显著相关（一个标准差对应7.2%的更高平均收入），同时截面上的复杂度-收入关联在三次人口普查间显著增强。
AI.research_question: 在新西兰领土管理局层面，经济复杂度的演变如何影响本地收入？复杂度与收入的关系随时间如何变化？
AI.motivation: 经济复杂度方法越来越多地被应用于次国家级尺度，但大多数应用只描述单一截面，而非追踪复杂度-收入关系随时间的演变。作者旨在回应"复杂度指标只描述而非指导政策"的批评，并通过面板数据提供因果性更强的证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济复杂度理论（基于行业共聚模式计算经济复杂度和产品复杂度指数），以及结构惯性理论（区域经济结构持续性）。
AI.method: 利用商业人口统计数据的就业行业共聚模式，基于ANZSIC06四位行业代码在67个领土管理局上计算经济复杂度和产品复杂度指数；将指数与LEED（关联雇主-雇员数据）的收入数据和人口普查收入数据相链接；采用双向固定效应模型消除时间不变的领土管理局特征和全国性宏观趋势。
AI.findings: （1）新西兰经济复杂度的地理分布强烈极化且高度持续，2000年与2025年分布的秩相关为0.82，表明结构性惯性而非趋同。（2）双向固定效应模型中，本地复杂度每增加一个标准差，平均收入提高7.2%。（3）跨2013、2018和2023年三次人口普查，截面上的复杂度-收入关联显著增强，系数和解释力约翻三倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经济复杂度分析从静态截面拓展至动态面板，证明了复杂度是次国家级收入分化的日益重要的结构性特征，回应了"复杂度指标仅描述不指导政策"的批评。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新西兰地方经济政策制定提供了基于经济复杂度的实证依据，表明提升区域经济复杂度的政策干预可能带来可量化的收入提升。

title: From Renewable Deployment to Energy Security: The Institutional Foundations of the Renewable Security Dividend
affiliations: University of Bath

detail.title: From Renewable Deployment to Energy Security: The Institutional Foundations of the Renewable Security Dividend

declarations.funderStatement: This paper received support from the UK Economic and Social Research Council through a New Investigator Grant [grant number UKRI2815].

detail.abstract: Renewables are increasingly framed as energy security technologies as well as instruments of decarbonisation, yet evidence on their realised security effects remains fragmented. This paper develops the concepts of the ‘renewable security dividend’ and ‘security conversion capacity’ to explain how renewable deployment changes energy security across different institutional settings. The argument draws on a structured narrative synthesis of empirical studies published between 2015 and 2025 that connect implemented wind or solar to observed energy security outcomes. The evidence identifies a clear but uneven renewable security dividend. The strongest effects arise where deployment changes energy security relatively directly: wind and solar reduce exposure to recurrent fuels, can lower electricity costs, improve access to energy services, and make a useful contribution to electricity system adequacy. The picture becomes less decisive where security depends on wider economic and strategic relationships, particularly national import dependence and technological autonomy. These differences reflect the capacity of grids, productive and maintenance systems, and governing arrangements to turn renewable generation into dependable and accessible energy. Renewable deployment can therefore generate a security dividend, but whether that dividend endures depends on the conversion capacity of the systems in which it is embedded.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可再生能源安全红利"和"安全转化能力"两个概念，通过对2015-2025年间实证研究的结构化叙事综合，解释了可再生能源部署如何在不同制度背景下改变能源安全。研究发现可再生能源部署确实带来安全红利，但效果不均衡：在直接改变能源安全结构的领域（如降低对经常性燃料的暴露、降低电力成本、改善能源服务获取和电力系统充足性）效果最强，而在依赖更广泛经济和战略关系的领域（如国家进口依赖和技术自主）效果较为模糊。红利的持续性取决于系统（电网、生产维护系统、治理安排）的转化能力。
AI.research_question: 可再生能源部署在不同制度背景下如何改变能源安全？其实现的"安全红利"在哪些维度上显著、在哪些维度上不显著？
AI.motivation: 可再生能源日益被框定为能源安全技术，但关于其已实现的安全效应的证据仍然零散、缺乏系统性整合，需要理论框架来解释不同制度环境中可再生能源安全效应的差异性。
AI.theoretical_framework: "可再生能源安全红利"（renewable security dividend）概念——衡量可再生能源部署带来的实际能源安全收益；"安全转化能力"（security conversion capacity）概念——指电网、生产维护系统和治理安排将可再生能源发电转化为可靠、可获取能源的能力。
AI.method: 结构化叙事综合（structured narrative synthesis），对2015-2025年间发表的、将已实施的风能或太阳能与观测到的能源安全结果联系起来的实证研究进行系统性综合分析。
AI.findings: 可再生能源部署确实带来了安全红利，但效果不均衡：在直接效应维度上（降低燃料暴露、降低电力成本、改善能源服务获取、贡献电力系统充足性）效果最强；在依赖更广泛经济和战略关系的维度上（国家进口依赖、技术自主）效果较不明确。红利的持续性取决于嵌入系统的转化能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"可再生能源安全红利"和"安全转化能力"两个原创性概念，为理解可再生能源部署与能源安全之间的因果关系提供了新的理论框架，解释了为何不同制度背景下可再生能源的安全效应存在显著差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估可再生能源能源安全价值的分析工具，提示决策者需关注系统转化能力建设（电网、维护系统和治理安排）以确保可再生能源安全红利的可持续性。

title: LLMs Do Not Emulate Populations
affiliations: and

detail.title: LLMs Do Not Emulate Populations
detail.abstract: Increasingly, researchers are using large language models (LLMs) to generate synthetic survey responses and behavioral data as a substitute for human samples. The justification for this approach is that appropriate prompt conditioning can recover latent patterns that LLMs learn about humans from training data. Existing evaluations of this technique typically compare LLM output to direct measurements of human behavior. However, these evaluations do not reflect the goal of this approach, which is often to make inferences about unobserved scenarios and populations. By contrast, we devise tests that can be run on LLM output alone and are based solely on structural properties implied by the assumptions underlying the technique. We show that LLMs produce data that is incoherent with respect to the statistical structure of real populations, which requires that the mean of any population lies within the range of the means of its constituent subpopulations. LLMs violate this condition at rates similar to purely random predictions. Further, we show that model outputs are subjective responses rather than objective predictions about a common (even biased) human benchmark population. In our tests the chosen model explains far more of the variation in output than can be explained by the choice of emulated demographic group. We conclude that LLM output is unreliable for inference about human populations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过设计仅基于LLM输出本身即可运行的统计一致性检验，发现LLM生成的合成调查数据在统计结构上与真实人类人口数据不一致，其违反子群体均值约束条件的概率与随机预测相当，表明LLM输出不适合用于推断人类群体。
AI.research_question: LLM生成的合成调查数据和行为数据是否能可靠地替代人类样本，用于对未观测情景和群体的推理？
AI.motivation: 现有对LLM合成数据技术的评估通常将其输出与人类行为的直接测量进行比较，但这些评估并未反映该技术的实际目标——即对未观测情景和群体进行推断。因此需要设计能够在LLM输出上独立运行的检验方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于统计推断的基本结构性质：任何总体的均值必须位于其组成子群体均值的范围内（均值包容性约束）。
AI.method: 设计了仅基于LLM输出即可运行的检验，检验其对统计结构性质的满足程度；同时通过方差分解分析模型输出与模拟人口群体选择之间的关系。
AI.findings: （1）LLM生成的数据在统计结构上与真实人口不一致，违反均值包容性约束的概率与随机预测相当；（2）模型输出是主观反应而非对共同（即便是偏倚的）人类基准人口的客观预测；（3）所选模型对输出的变异解释力远高于所模拟的人口群体选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种不依赖外部人类基准数据、仅基于统计结构性质的LLM合成数据有效性的检验框架，推进了对LLM合成数据推断有效性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 警告研究人员不应使用LLM生成的合成数据替代人类样本进行人口推断，为使用LLM合成数据的研究实践提供了重要的方法论警示。

title: Harnessing Digitalization Advantage for Economic Transformation:,Evidence from Nigeria
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Independent and Nigerian Institute of Social and Economic Research

detail.title: Harnessing Digitalization Advantage for Economic Transformation:,Evidence from Nigeria
detail.abstract: This paper is premised on the proposition that economic transformation occurs when macroeconomic reform is accompanied by innovation policy. Nigeria’s digital economy has expanded rapidly due to digitalization advantage created by innovation policy involving several initiatives that enabled a transition from ICT policy to digital economy policy. This paper applies the Growth with DEPTH analytical framework to diagnose Nigeria’s economic transformation trajectory and examine how digitalization advantage can foster economic transformation powered by technology upgrading and signified by diversification of production and exports, export competitiveness, increases in productivity of labour, and human economic wellbeing. The analysis identifies a persistent paradox: Nigeria leads Africa in fintech, technology startups, and AI readiness, yet ranks at or near the bottom of 32 sub-Saharan African countries in export competitiveness and economic diversification. The paper highlights concrete digitalization effects at the firm and sector level, in agro-processing, solid minerals, petrochemicals, ICT services, environmental technology, and financial inclusion, and derives evidence-grounded policy imperatives for converting digitalization advantage into sustained economic transformation. The lessons from the Nigerian case analysis are instructive for digital economy governance across sub-Saharan Africa.

AI.tldr: 本文基于"宏观经济改革须伴随创新政策才能实现经济转型"的前提，运用Growth with DEPTH分析框架诊断尼日利亚的经济转型轨迹，揭示其"数字创新领先但出口竞争力与经济多元化垫底"的悖论，并从企业与部门层面提出将数字化优势转化为持续经济转型的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚的数字化优势如何通过技术升级促进经济转型（表现为生产与出口多元化、出口竞争力提升、劳动生产率提高和人类经济福祉改善）？其中存在何种悖论及政策启示？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚数字经济因创新政策（从ICT政策向数字经济政策过渡）而快速扩张，但其经济转型成果与数字化领先地位严重不匹配，这一悖论值得系统诊断。
AI.theoretical_framework: Growth with DEPTH分析框架
AI.method: 运用Growth with DEPTH分析框架对尼日利亚经济转型轨迹进行诊断，结合企业与部门层面的数字化效应案例分析，并与32个撒哈拉以南非洲国家进行排名比较。
AI.findings: 尼日利亚在金融科技、科技初创企业和AI准备度方面领先非洲，但在32个撒哈拉以南非洲国家中，其出口竞争力和经济多元化排名几乎垫底，构成一个持续的悖论。数字化在农业加工、固体矿产、石化、ICT服务、环境技术和金融普惠等领域产生具体效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Growth with DEPTH框架应用并验证于尼日利亚情境，揭示了数字化领先与经济转型滞后之间的结构性问题，为理解创新政策与宏观经济改革协同作用提供了实证案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚及撒哈拉以南非洲国家提供了基于证据的数字化经济治理政策建议，有助于将数字化优势转化为持续的经济转型。

title: International Legal Frameworks for Ensuring Cross-Border Transportation of Energy -Israel as a Case Study
affiliations: Bar-Ilan University - Faculty of Law and

detail.title: International Legal Frameworks for Ensuring Cross-Border Transportation of Energy -Israel as a Case Study
detail.abstract:
Recent events have highlighted the geopolitical and economic importance of unobstructed international transportation of petroleum and other energy resources. This article examines the legal regulation of cross-border energy transportation through the lens of the Energy Law and Policy Triangle, which highlights the interaction between political security, economic efficiency, and environmental sustainability. Using Israel's existing and prospective transit routes for natural gas, oil, coal, and electricity as its principal case study, it considers the domestic, contractual, intergovernmental, and multilateral legal frameworks applicable to them. It is the first research combining this integrative perspective, based on the understanding that international energy transportation is governed by a multilayered legal regime, made up of public international law, domestic law and project-specific agreements. Drawing on comparable international practice in pipeline and interconnection projects, the article identifies useful regulatory approaches and evaluates their significance for the design of stable and predictable cross-border energy transportation arrangements across different national and regional contexts.

The analysis shows that existing legal frameworks are lacking in their ability to guarantee stable energy flows, in particular for future cross-border energy projects. This is because existing arrangements rely largely on domestic regulation and commercial agreements, but only on limited intergovernmental arrangements, which do not necessarily guarantee full continuity of flows, especially under conditions of geopolitical tension or military conflicts. The article further examines relevant international treaty regimes for energy transit, including the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade, the law of the sea as reflected in the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, and the Energy Charter Treaty, in order to evaluate both their limitations and their potential to mitigate transit-related risks. On this basis, it identifies a set of core legal principles for stable energy transportation arrangements, including non-discrimination, continuity of flows, transparency, effective dispute settlement, respect for the legal regime governing maritime zones and submarine infrastructure, and the incorporation of environmental safeguards.
