title: Assessment of the Innovation Potential of the Republic of Bashkortostan

detail.title: Assessment of the Innovation Potential of the Republic of Bashkortostan

keywords: Strengths and Weaknesses of Innovative Development of Bashkortostan

detail.abstract: The article assesses the innovative potential of Bashkortostan and the effectiveness of its application in the republic. The analysis is based on the statistical data of such indicators as the share of innovative products, fulfilled work and provided services in the total volume of products manufactured in the republic; the share of organisations engaged in the technological innovations; the current expenditures on research and development; the number of scientific and technical personnel in the republic year after year. It presents a description of innovative initiatives, projects and activities carried out in Bashkortostan as part of the national projects «Science and Universities», «New Health Preservation Technologies», «Infrastructure for Life», «New Materials and Chemistry», «Means of Production and Automation». The role of innovative potential in the steady development of the republic and increasing the country’s technological sovereignty has been justified.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了巴什科尔托斯坦共和国的创新潜力及其应用效果，基于多项统计指标进行逐年分析，并描述了在国家项目框架下开展的创新举措。
AI.research_question: 巴什科尔托斯坦共和国的创新潜力如何？其应用效果如何？
AI.motivation: 评估地区创新潜力对于促进地区可持续发展及提升国家技术主权具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新潜力理论与区域创新发展理论
AI.method: 基于统计数据的定量分析，包括创新产品份额、技术创新组织占比、研发支出、科技人员数量等指标的逐年年际比较，以及对国家项目框架下创新举措的描述性分析。
AI.findings: 巴什科尔托斯坦在创新潜力方面处于一定水平，通过实施国家项目框架下的多项创新举措，对地区可持续发展和技术主权提升发挥了积极作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了区域创新潜力评估的理论框架，论证了创新潜力在地区稳定发展中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府评估和提升区域创新潜力提供了实证依据和政策参考，有助于推动国家技术主权战略的实施。

title: The Impact of Trade Policy Uncertainty on Foreign Direct Investment Flows: Evidence from U.S.-China Relations (2016-2024)

detail.title: The Impact of Trade Policy Uncertainty on Foreign Direct Investment Flows: Evidence from U.S.-China Relations (2016-2024)
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether trade policy uncertainty (TPU), particularly changes in its volatility, is associated with bilateral foreign direct investment (FDI) between the United States and China from 2016 to 2024. Using the Baker-Bloom-Davis Trade Policy Uncertainty index and annual bilateral FDI data from the Bureau of Economic Analysis, I estimated a time-series regression. I also used annual event-study-equivalent comparisons around major trade policy shocks. A three-year rolling measure of TPU volatility is negatively and significantly associated with total bilateral FDI (coefficient =-20.05, p = .039, N = 8, 2017-2024). The coefficient remains negative when a two-year volatility window is used and when U.S.-to-China and Chinato-U.S. FDI are estimated separately. However, the small annual sample limits the precision of these estimates and the robustness tests that can be performed. Overall, the results suggest that greater volatility in trade policy uncertainty is associated with lower bilateral investment between the United States and China.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2016-2024年间贸易政策不确定性（TPU）的波动性是否与中美双边外商直接投资（FDI）相关。利用Baker-Bloom-Davis贸易政策不确定性指数和美国经济分析局的年度双边FDI数据，采用时间序列回归和事件研究法。研究发现三年滚动TPU波动率与双边FDI总额呈显著负相关（系数=-20.05, p=.039），但小样本限制了估计精度。
AI.research_question: 贸易政策不确定性的波动性变化是否与中美双边外商直接投资相关联？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注贸易政策不确定性的水平而非其波动性对投资的影响，作者试图填补这一空白，并聚焦于中美这一重要的双边投资关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易政策不确定性理论、实物期权理论（投资不可逆性）、不确定性的波动性对跨国投资决策的影响框架。
AI.method: 时间序列回归分析，使用Baker-Bloom-Davis贸易政策不确定性指数和BEA年度双边FDI数据，并采用事件研究法比较重大贸易政策冲击前后的FDI变化，使用两年和三年滚动波动率窗口进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 三年滚动TPU波动率与总双边FDI显著负相关（系数=-20.05, p=.039, N=8）；两年波动率窗口和分方向（美对中、中对美）估计时系数仍为负；但小样本限制了估计精度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将研究视角从贸易政策不确定性的水平拓展到其波动性维度，为不确定性的波动性如何影响跨国投资提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于贸易政策频繁变动（不仅是政策水平）会抑制跨国投资的证据，提示稳定贸易政策环境对吸引外资的重要性。

title: The Threshold That Binds First: Value Added Tax Registration Sequencing for Owner-Managed Companies in Bulgaria, 2026

detail.title: The Threshold That Binds First: Value Added Tax Registration Sequencing for Owner-Managed Companies in Bulgaria, 2026

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study involves no human participants, patients, or personal data; it is a documentary analysis of published legislation and institutional guidance. No ethics approval or consent was required.

detail.abstract: Two companion papers examined what an owner-managed Bulgarian company costs to run and what can cause the arrangement to be disregarded altogether. Both were concerned with direct taxation. This paper turns to value added tax, and argues that the registration threshold on which the entire public discussion rests-€51,130 from 1 January 2026, now measured on a calendar-year basis-is, for the population that actually incorporates in Bulgaria, the last threshold to bind and frequently the only one that never binds at all. Bulgarian law contains at least four independent grounds of registration. Three of them carry figures below the headline threshold or no figure whatsoever. The ground that binds first, Article 97a, has no threshold: it is triggered by the receipt of a single service from a supplier not established in Bulgaria, is due no later than seven days before the tax becomes chargeable, and confers no right to deduct the tax the registrant is then obliged to self-assess. A company with no turnover whatsoever is registrable on the day it buys its first cloud subscription. The paper derives a closed-form condition under which voluntary full registration dominates that default: registration is the cheaper regime whenever the ratio of taxed inputs to turnover exceeds five-sixths of the share of turnover supplied to domestic final consumers. For a company selling only to business customers abroad the condition is satisfied at any positive level of input cost, which is to say always. The paper then shows that the special scheme for small enterprises introduced on 1 January 2026 under Directive (EU) 2020/285, with its €100,000 Union threshold and its EX identifier, cannot relieve this constraint, because the exemption it confers operates on supplies made while the binding obligation arises on supplies received. The reforms of 2026 are output-side reforms addressed to an input-side problem.

AI.tldr: 本文分析保加利亚增值税注册制度，指出公开讨论所聚焦的€51,130注册门槛对实际在保加利亚注册的公司而言几乎从不构成约束，因为保加利亚法律至少存在四个独立的注册依据，其中Article 97a（无门槛、基于收取跨境服务即触发注册义务）才是最先约束企业的规则。文章推导出自愿全额注册优于默认制度的闭式条件，并论证2026年推出的中小企业特别计划无法解决这一输入侧问题。
AI.research_question: 保加利亚增值税登记门槛制度对实际在保加利亚注册的公司（尤其是owner-managed公司）的实际约束机制是什么？自愿全额登记何时优于默认登记制度？2026年新推出的中小企业特别计划能否缓解这一制度约束？
AI.motivation: 先前两篇配套论文分别考察了owner-managed保加利亚公司的运营成本及安排被完全忽视的情形，均涉及直接税。本文转向增值税领域，旨在揭示公开讨论所依赖的登记门槛与实际约束企业行为的法律规则之间存在严重错位，从而为企业在保加利亚的合规决策提供理论指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 增值税登记制度比较分析（不同登记依据的触发条件与时间约束）、闭式条件下的成本效益优化模型（输入成本与营业额比率、面向国内最终消费者的营业额份额）、欧盟中小企业特别计划（Directive (EU) 2020/285）的制度适用性分析。
AI.method: 规范分析法：系统梳理保加利亚增值税法中至少四个独立注册依据及其门槛与触发条件；推导闭式条件模型，比较自愿全额登记与默认登记制度下的成本；通过制度对比论证2026年中小企业特别计划的适用局限。
AI.findings: （1）保加利亚法律至少有四个独立注册依据，其中三个的门槛低于公开讨论所聚焦的€51,130或没有数字门槛；（2）Article 97a最先约束企业：无门槛、接收一笔来自非保加利亚供应商的服务即触发、须在纳税义务产生前七天登记、且无进项税抵扣权——零营业额公司在购买首个云订阅当天即需登记；（3）闭式条件下，当应税输入与营业额之比超过面向国内最终消费者营业额份额的六分之五时，自愿登记更便宜；仅向境外企业客户销售的公司，在任何正输入成本水平下该条件都满足，即永远满足；（4）2026年中小企业特别计划（€100,000欧盟门槛、EX标识）无法缓解这一约束，因其豁免作用于供应侧，而绑定义务产生于输入侧——2026年改革是输出侧改革，却面对的是输入侧问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了增值税注册制度选择的理论模型（闭式条件），弥合了公开讨论中的"门槛叙事"与实际法律制度运行之间的理论缺口；区分了输入侧义务与输出侧豁免的制度错配，为理解增值税制度设计的内在张力提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在保加利亚运营的owner-managed公司提供了明确的注册策略指导：何时自愿登记优于默认登记；揭示了Article 97a注册义务的实际触发风险（如购买云订阅即触发注册义务且无进项抵扣权）；指出了2026年中小企业特别计划无法解决输入侧注册义务问题，帮助企业避免因制度误解而产生的合规风险。

title: Piercing Sovereign Immunity: Unifying the Commercial Activity Exception Under the FSIA in Civil Litigation

detail.title: Piercing Sovereign Immunity: Unifying the Commercial Activity Exception Under the FSIA in Civil Litigation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, financial, or professional conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this Article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This Article is a legal analysis and does not involve human participants, patient data, or human‑subject research. Therefore, ethics approval and consent requirements do not apply.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All work was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: The Foreign Sovereign Immunities Act lifts a foreign state's immunity when its act abroad causes "a direct effect in the United States." Congress never defined that phrase, and the Supreme Court has construed it only once, holding in 1992 that an effect is direct if it follows as an immediate consequence of the sovereign's act. In the vacuum, ten of the twelve courts of appeals have divided. Six require a plaintiff to identify a contractual place of performance in the United States, or a legally significant act here, before the causal question is reached. Four apply ordinary causation principles and reject any such prerequisite. The Supreme Court denied certiorari on the question in 2025, leaving the division entrenched. This Article argues that neither camp is faithful to the governing standard: the bright-line circuits add requirements the Court expressly refused to read into the text, and the causation circuits leave immediacy undisciplined. It proposes a unified three-step framework. A court identifies the sovereign's act and the obligation it breached, asks whether the American effect followed without an intervening actor or choice, and treats place of performance and legally significant acts as evidence of immediacy rather than as jurisdictional gates. Tested against decided cases, the framework preserves the results both camps reach in the canonical disputes while supplying a single question for the marginal ones. No circuit must overrule its own precedent to adopt it.

AI.tldr: 本文围绕《外国主权豁免法》中"在美国的直接效果"条款的解释之争展开。美国联邦巡回上诉法院在此问题上分裂为两派：一派要求原告先证明合同履行地在美国或存在具有法律意义的行为（"明确规则"阵营），另一派则适用普通因果关系原则（"因果"阵营）。本文认为两派均未忠实于法律文本，提出一个统一的三步分析框架，既能保留两派在典型案件中的结论，又为边缘案件提供单一判断标准，且无需任何法院推翻自身先例。
AI.research_question: 在《外国主权豁免法》中"在美国的直接效果"条款的解释上，联邦巡回上诉法院的两大阵营（要求合同履行地/法律意义行为的前置要件派与适用普通因果原则派）均未能忠实于法律标准，应如何构建统一的解释框架？
AI.motivation: 国会从未定义"直接效果"这一短语，最高法院仅在1992年作过一次解释（效果须为主权行为的直接后果），此后十二个巡回上诉法院中有十个在此问题上产生分裂，且最高法院在2025年拒绝调卷，使该分裂持续固化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 《外国主权豁免法》的文本解释原则；因果关系理论（直接性/即时性要求）；管辖权与证据认定之区分。
AI.method: doctrinal legal analysis（法学教义分析）：通过对两派判例的梳理与比较，提出统一的三步分析框架，并以既有判例进行检验。
AI.findings: （1）明确规则阵营在文本中增加了最高法院明确拒绝加入的要件；（2）因果阵营使"即时性"要求缺乏纪律约束；（3）本文提出三步框架：识别主权行为及其违反的义务→判断美国效果是否在没有介入行为人或选择的情况下发生→将履行地及法律意义行为视为即时性的证据而非管辖权门槛；（4）该框架经既有判例检验，能保留两派在典型争议中的结论，并为边缘案件提供统一标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"直接效果"条款的解释提供了超越现有两派之争的第三种路径，弥合了法院之间的教义分歧，为因果关系理论在主权豁免语境下的适用提供了更精细的框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各巡回法院提供了无需推翻自身先例即可采纳的统一分析框架，有望终结长期存在的法院分裂，为当事人提供更可预测的诉讼结果。

title: When the Benchmark is Already Efficient: Sheltering Without an Atom under Value-at-Risk Verification

detail.title: When the Benchmark is Already Efficient: Sheltering Without an Atom under Value-at-Risk Verification
detail.abstract: A sender is read by two audiences: an agent who responds to a posterior mean and a verifier who responds to a quantile of the same posterior. When the verifier's read is convex in the sender's beliefs it cannot be gamed, and an optimal disclosure is a single accept/reject partition-at every prior and every level of stakes. Value-at-Risk is not belief-convex, and the known failure of the guarantee is conditional: at a prior with an atom on the worst type a three-posterior disclosure beats every binary one, but only when the deterrence stake is large enough. This paper asks where the condition comes from and answers with one quantity: the liability inefficiency of the binary benchmark, the gap between the least expected read a binary disclosure can reach and the least any disclosure can reach while deterring maximally. A stake condition is unavoidable wherever that gap is nonpositive-at the atomic prior a binary disclosure already attains the global floor, so sheltering can sell nothing but deterrence, and no disclosure with any number of posteriors escapes the condition. Where the gap is positive the condition can vanish, and in the leading case it does: at a uniform prior with a median read and a compliance target below a threshold this paper computes in closed form, an explicit six-posterior disclosure attains the same deterrence as the best binary one and strictly lower liability, so it dominates every binary disclosure at every stake and every degree of leakage short of a perfect seal. This closes, in the affirmative and without an atom, a question left open in the companion paper. The mechanism is not topological: a complying pool that is an interval cannot separate its mean from its quantile, and a two-band pool can, so what a diffuse prior supplies is not disconnection but slack. Read the quantile level as a standard of proof, and the same inequality is the verifier's only guarantee: under a strict enough standard, or a demanding enough compliance target, some stakes condition is unavoidable and the verifier is safe at low stakes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一个发送者面对两类受众的信号披露问题：一个对后验均值响应的代理人，和一个对同一后验分位数响应的验证者。当验证者的读取函数在发送者信念上是凸函数时不可能被操纵，最优披露是单次接受/拒绝的二元划分。但VaR（风险价值）不是信念凸的，其担保失效是有条件的。本文用"二元基准的责任无效率"（binary基准最小期望读取与全局最小读取之间的差距）来刻画该条件出现的根源，并证明在均匀先验和单位数读取下，一个显式的六后验披露在所有利益水平和不同程度的泄漏下都优于所有二元披露。
AI.research_question: 在VaR（分位数）读取下，发送者的最优披露结构是什么？担保失效所需的条件（"利益条件"）从何而来？在何种条件下，多后验（非二元）披露能在所有利益水平下严格优于二元披露？
AI.motivation: 已有研究（companion paper）发现，当验证者使用VaR（分位数）而非均值读取时，二元披露可能不是最优的——在具有最差类型原子的先验下，三后验披露可以击败任何二元披露。但这一失败是有条件的（仅当威慑利益足够大时）。本文的目的是找出该条件的来源，并回答一个开放问题：在没有原子的先验（如均匀先验）下，是否也能构造出无条件支配所有二元披露的披露方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信念凸性（belief-convexity）理论；披露博弈（disclosure game）；后验均值与分位数响应的双受众模型；VaR作为非信念凸函数的分析；二元基准的"责任无效率"（liability inefficiency）概念。
AI.method: 理论建模与数学证明。作者引入"责任无效率"——二元披露能达到的最小期望读取与全局最小读取（在最大化威慑约束下）之间的差距。当该差距非正时，利益条件不可避免；当差距为正时，条件可消失。在均匀先验和单位数（median）读取下，作者构造了一个显式的六后验披露，闭式计算合规目标阈值，并证明其严格支配所有二元披露。
AI.findings: （1）当二元基准的责任无效率非正时，利益条件不可避免——无论披露有多少后验都无法逃脱该条件；（2）当差距为正时条件可消失，在均匀先验+单位数读取的领先案例中确实如此：若合规目标低于阈值，显式的六后验披露达到与最优二元披露相同的威慑但严格更低的责任，因此在所有利益水平和所有程度的泄漏（除完全密封外）下都支配二元披露；（3）机制不是拓扑性的：满足合规要求的区间池无法分离其均值与分位数，而两带池可以——扩散先验提供的不是"不连通"而是"松弛"（slack）；（4）将分位数水平解读为证明标准，同一不等式是验证者唯一的担保：在严格的标准或高要求的合规目标下，利益条件不可避免，验证者在低利益下是安全的。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）引入"责任无效率"作为统一量化工具，解释了VaR读取下担保失败条件的来源；（2）以肯定方式、无需原子，解决了companion paper留下的开放问题——在均匀先验下构造了无条件支配所有二元披露的六后验披露；（3）阐明机制本质：不是拓扑分离（disconnection）而是"松弛"（slack），纠正了对此类问题的拓扑直觉；（4）将分位数水平与"证明标准"建立联系，给出验证者担保成立的充要条件刻画。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为监管者/VaR使用者提供清晰的担保条件：当责任无效率非正时，低利益下验证者安全，无需担忧被操纵；（2）为发送者（如被监管企业）提供可计算的披露策略：在均匀先验和单位数读取下，六后验披露可在不牺牲威慑的前提下降低责任；（3）为理解"标准严格程度"与"操纵可能性"之间的关系提供操作性指导——严格的证明标准（高合规目标）使利益条件不可避免，保护验证者。

title: The Possible Use of Herbs and Spices in the Food Processing and Food Safety
affiliations: Kulumsa agricultural Research center, Ethiopian Institute of Agricultural research, Ethiopia.

detail.title: The Possible Use of Herbs and Spices in the Food Processing and Food Safety
detail.abstract: Spices and herbs are utilised in many different cuisines and food items, but they are consumed in small amounts, making them a special market within the food industry. These plants are rich sources of valuable bioactive components that are utilised for a range of functions, such as flavouring, colouring, medicinal, and preservation. The food industry recognises the potential of plant extracts, and not just because of their nutritional benefits. Antimicrobials and antioxidants, such as various essential oils with antibacterial qualities, are mostly found in plants. Herbs and spices including rosemary, sage, basil, oregano, thyme, cardamom, and clove contain a variety of essential oils. To increase product value and shelf life, plant essential oils are also included as additives to edible or biodegradable films and coatings for active food packaging. However, it is important to consider and thoroughly research any potential harmful consequences of specific phyto-compounds. However, this chapter's findings are more comprehensive, represent significant and timely advances towards potential applications in food sector as well as the food safety aspects of commodities containing spices and herbs by effectively protecting consumers from potential risks resulting from unintentional or intentional contamination of spices and herbs.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了香料和草药作为食品工业中富含生物活性成分的特殊市场，探讨了其精油作为天然抗菌剂和抗氧化剂的应用，包括在活性食品包装中作为添加剂的使用，同时强调了需要研究植物化合物的潜在有害影响以保障食品安全。
AI.research_question: 香料和草药在食品工业中的应用价值及其食品安全问题是什么？
AI.motivation: 香料和草药含有丰富的生物活性成分，在调味、着色、药用和防腐等方面具有多种功能，但其消费量小、潜在有害影响需要深入研究，因此有必要对其在食品领域的应用和安全性进行系统综述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 天然抗菌剂和抗氧化剂理论；活性食品包装理论；植物精油生物活性理论
AI.method: 文献综述方法，综合分析和评估香料和草药在食品行业中的潜在应用及其食品安全方面的问题。
AI.findings: 迷迭香、鼠尾草、罗勒、牛至、百里香、小豆蔻和丁香等香草和香料含有多种精油，具有抗菌和抗氧化特性；植物精油可作为添加剂加入可食用或可生物降解薄膜和涂层中用于活性食品包装，以提升产品价值和保质期；同时需要充分研究特定植物化合物的潜在有害后果。
AI.theory_contributions: 为香料和草药在食品行业的潜在应用提供了更全面的研究成果，代表了食品领域应用和食品安全方面的重要且及时的进展。
AI.practical_contributions: 通过有效保护消费者免受香料和草药中意外或故意污染造成的潜在风险，为含有香料和草药的商品的食品安全方面提供了实际指导。

title: Quantum Field Theory and VIX Dynamics: Implications for Establishing a VIX Microstructure Systemic Risk Management System

detail.title: Quantum Field Theory and VIX Dynamics: Implications for Establishing a VIX Microstructure Systemic Risk Management System
detail.abstract: This paper is the third in a series applying physics-inspired formalisms to VIX microstructure for systemic-risk analysis. Paper I described the microstructure's instantaneous state — entropy, enthalpy, effective temperature, and Gibbs free energy computed from a single snapshot of the term-structure curve. Paper II described how a single such state evolves, modeling the curve as a normalized ”financial wave function” advancing under a Schrödinger-type equation. Both share a structural limitation of single-particle quantum mechanics: a fixed set of contracts, a conserved ”particle number.” This paper instead recasts the microstructure as a field φ(T,t) with a variable number of degrees of freedom — contracts are created and destroyed at listing and expiry — governed by a Euclidean action with curvature, mass, and quartic self-interaction terms. This paper completes a three-paper arc—from equilibrium thermodynamics (Paper I) to wave mechanics (Paper II)—by recasting the VIX Microstructure as a quantum field. We define the deviation field φ(T,t)=lnF(T,t)-lnF0(T,t) over the maturity continuum, decompose it via the Karhunen–Loève expansion—which we prove is mathematically identical to the mode decomposition of a Gaussian free field—and construct a Fock space of occupation numbers nk(t)=qk2/λk for each excitation mode. Roll events and shock repricings are interpreted as creation–annihilation events. We estimate the propagator (mode lifetimes, cross-maturity information cone with finite propagation speed), the renormalization group flow under Wilsonian coarse-graining (showing higher-order modes—curvature and beyond—are irrelevant operators, providing the first field-theoretic explanation for why three-factor term-structure models suffice), and an Onsager–Machlup effective potential whose double-well structure (contango/backwardation attractors separated by a barrier) allows a Kramers tunneling rate that quantifies—rather than merely illustrates—the ”financial quantum tunneling” identified qualitatively in Paper II. All layers integrate into a five-layer systemic-risk confirmation framework.

AI.tldr: 本文是系列论文的第三篇，将VIX微结构重新表述为量子场论。作者定义偏差场φ(T,t)，通过Karhunen–Loève展开（证明其与高斯自由场的模分解数学等价）构建Fock空间，将展期事件和冲击重定价解释为产生-湮灭事件。论文估算了传播子、重整化群流（证明高阶模是无关算符，首次从场论角度解释为何三因子期限结构模型足够），以及具有双阱结构的Onsager–Machlup有效势，通过Kramers隧穿率定量刻画"金融量子隧穿"，并整合为五层系统性风险确认框架。
AI.research_question: 如何将VIX微结构从单粒子量子力学视角（前两篇论文）推广到量子场论视角，以处理合约数量可变（创建与消灭）的问题，并更全面地分析系统性风险？
AI.motivation: 前两篇论文（热力学和波动力学）都受限于单粒子量子力学的结构限制：固定的合约集合、守恒的"粒子数"。而现实中VIX期货合约会在上市和到期时被创建和销毁，需要一个允许可变自由度的框架来描述这一动态过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 量子场论（QFT）、欧几里得作用量、Karhunen–Loève展开与高斯自由场等价性、Fock空间、传播子理论、重整化群（Wilsonian粗粒化）、Onsager–Machlup有效势、Kramers隧穿率
AI.method: 将VIX微结构模型化为场φ(T,t)，通过Karhunen–Loève展开进行模分解，构建Fock空间占用数；估计传播子（模寿命、跨期限信息锥）、重整化群流（识别无关算符）、以及Onsager–Machlup有效势（识别双阱结构和隧穿率）
AI.findings: （1）KL展开与高斯自由场模分解数学等价；（2）高阶模（曲率及以上）在重整化群流下是不可关算符，首次从场论角度解释三因子期限结构模型的充分性；（3）有效势呈现双阱结构（期货溢价/现货溢价吸引子），Kramers隧穿率可定量刻画金融量子隧穿；（4）所有分析层整合为五层系统性风险确认框架
AI.theory_contributions: 将量子场论形式主义首次系统性地应用于VIX微结构分析，完成了从热力学→波动力学→量子场论的三部曲理论闭环；提供场论依据解释三因子模型充分性；将"金融量子隧穿"从定性描述提升为定量刻画。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个五层系统性风险确认框架，可用于实际监测和量化VIX市场中的系统性风险；通过场论工具（传播子、重整化群）为期限结构建模和风险管理提供新的分析维度。

title: Rule in Crisis: Prosperity Party and the Ethiopian Hardship
affiliations: Bule Hora University

detail.title: Rule in Crisis: Prosperity Party and the Ethiopian Hardship

declarations.funderStatement: It didn't recieved any fund from any anyone.

detail.abstract: This manuscript investigates the compound crises facing the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia under the administration of the Prosperity Party (PP). Formed through the dissolution and consolidation of the former Ethiopian People's Revolutionary Democratic Front (EPRDF) coalition, the Prosperity Party promised a transition toward inclusive prosperity, political democratization, and national integration (BTI Transformation Index, 2026). However, contemporary developments reveal a profound institutional, economic, and security breakdown. Characterized by protracted civil conflicts in the Amhara and Oromia regions, unresolved legacy fallout from the Tigray conflict, severe macroeconomic pressures, and systemic governance deficits, the Ethiopian state faces an unprecedented structural crisis. This paper examines the interplay between centralizing political ambitions, identity-based federal frictions, economic vulnerability, and state-society alienation, arguing that the ruling regime's strategy of securitized governance has institutionalized instability rather than resolving it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究埃塞俄比亚联邦民主共和国在繁荣党执政下面临的多重复合危机，认为该政权的安全化治理策略制度化而非解决了不稳定性。
AI.research_question: 繁荣党执政下埃塞俄比亚面临何种结构性危机？中央集权政治野心、族群联邦摩擦、经济脆弱性与国家-社会疏离之间如何相互作用？
AI.motivation: 繁荣党承诺向包容性繁荣、政治民主化和国家整合过渡，但当代发展显示其面临深刻的制度、经济和安全崩溃，需要系统分析这一结构性危机的根源与机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 安全化治理理论（securitized governance）、国家-社会关系理论、联邦制与族群政治理论、结构性危机分析框架
AI.method: 定性案例研究，基于BTI转型指数等政策数据和对当代发展动态的分析
AI.findings: 繁荣党的安全化治理策略未能解决危机，反而制度化了不稳定；阿姆哈拉和奥罗米亚地区的长期内战冲突、提格雷冲突遗留问题、严重宏观经济压力和系统性治理赤字共同构成了前所未有的结构性危机。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了安全化治理策略如何将短期维稳转化为长期不稳定制度化，深化了对复合危机中国家-社会疏离与联邦摩擦相互作用机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解埃塞俄比亚政治危机提供系统性分析框架，对应对复合危机和改革治理策略具有政策启示。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning and Causal Discovery for Accounting Policy Change: An Explainable Dynamic Impact Assessment Framework
affiliations: Peking University

detail.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning and Causal Discovery for Accounting Policy Change: An Explainable Dynamic Impact Assessment Framework
detail.abstract: The efficiency and profitability of a company are significantly impacted whenever there is a change in accounting technique. The complex causal links and lag effects make it difficult to determine the consequences with certainty. Our proposed approach, DQN-CD4APC, which stands for "Deep Q Network-based Causal Discovery for Accounting Policy Change," is a means to investigate the long-term effects of accounting policy changes. This research employs a dynamic Bayesian network, a deep Q-network (DQN), a better PC algorithm, a knowledge graph for accounting, and a better PC algorithm to determine the effects and causes of regulations on Shanghai and Shenzhen enterprises. To begin, the superior PC approach uses the accounting knowledge tree to build a multidimensional feature space that will serve as a foundation for future work. Second, with the support of a payment system, DQN may judiciously research and improve causal discovery pathways, enabling it to discover key causal linkages. Lastly, a dynamic Bayesian network has emerged, allowing for multi-step policy impact computation. Compared to more conventional approaches, DQN-CD4APC performs much better in studies when it comes to determining the causal structure. Accelerating the model's convergence, predicting policy effects with an accuracy of 89.6 percent, and increasing the F1 value by 18.7 percent are all benefits. Accounting rule changes, inaccurate accounting data, and weak business risk management may all be easily monitored with the help of the proposed framework, according to the findings. From a policymaking perspective, the framework may aid business and government authorities in understanding the implications of future laws, as well as in developing more effective methods to regulate accounting and manage risk.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DQN-CD4APC框架，结合深度Q网络、动态贝叶斯网络、改进PC算法和会计知识图谱，用于探究会计政策变更对企业效率与盈利能力的长期因果效应。该框架在沪深上市公司数据上实现了89.6%的政策效应预测准确率，F1值提升18.7%，并能有效监测会计规则变化、数据失真和风险管理薄弱等风险。
AI.research_question: 如何准确识别和预测会计政策变更对企业效率和盈利能力的长期因果影响？
AI.motivation: 会计政策变更对企业有显著影响，但由于复杂的因果关系和滞后效应，其后果难以确定。传统方法在因果结构发现方面存在局限，需要更先进的模型来揭示会计政策变更的长期效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态贝叶斯网络（Dynamic Bayesian Network）、深度Q网络（Deep Q-Network）、PC算法（因果发现算法）、会计知识图谱
AI.method: 1) 利用改进的PC算法结合会计知识树构建多维特征空间；2) 采用DQN配合奖励机制智能探索和优化因果发现路径；3) 构建动态贝叶斯网络实现多步政策影响计算。
AI.findings: DQN-CD4APC在因果结构发现方面显著优于传统方法，政策效应预测准确率达89.6%，F1值提升18.7%，模型收敛速度加快，并能有效监测会计规则变化、会计数据失真和薄弱的企业风险管理。
AI.theory_contributions: 将深度强化学习（DQN）与因果发现算法（PC算法）及动态贝叶斯网络相结合，为会计政策变更的长期因果效应分析提供了新的方法论框架，拓展了因果发现在会计领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 该框架可帮助企业和政府监管部门更好地理解未来会计法规的影响，制定更有效的会计监管和风险管理方法，同时可用于实时监测会计规则变化和潜在风险。

title: Inflation Determination, Equilibrium Selection, and Long-Run Neutrality

detail.title: Inflation Determination, Equilibrium Selection, and Long-Run Neutrality
detail.abstract: This paper examines the inflation-determinacy debate in the context of how indeterminacy is treated elsewhere in economics. I argue that inflation indeterminacy is treated differently from indeterminacy in other areas of economics, and investigate the source and implications of this difference.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了通货膨胀不确定性（inflation indeterminacy）争论，指出经济学其他领域对不确定性的处理方式与通货膨胀领域存在差异，并分析了这种差异的来源及其含义。
AI.research_question: 为什么通货膨胀不确定性与经济学其他领域的不确定性在处理方法上存在差异？这种差异的来源和含义是什么？
AI.motivation: 作者观察到通货膨胀不确定性在经济学中受到与其他领域不确定性不同的对待，旨在探究这一差异的根源及其理论含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于理性预期均衡理论中的确定性（determinacy）与不确定性（indeterminacy）概念框架。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论论证，比较通货膨胀不确定性与经济学其他领域（如宏观经济学其他议题）中不确定性处理的差异。
AI.findings: 通货膨胀不确定性的处理方式与其他经济学领域存在系统性差异，这一差异源于某种特定的方法论或理论立场，并具有重要的政策与理论含义。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了通货膨胀不确定性争论中隐含的方法论假设，为理解通胀确定性辩论提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于货币政策和通货膨胀目标制的理论争论，对政策制定者理解通胀不确定性问题的性质具有参考价值。

title: Control and Equity Tradeoff in a Partnership

detail.title: Control and Equity Tradeoff in a Partnership
detail.abstract: This paper studies control reallocation in a partnership, where the partners hold asymmetric information about whose expertise should direct the firm. Using a mechanism design approach, it characterizes the first-and second-best mechanisms that incorporate equity transfers as part of the design. The analysis provides novel insights into how the interdependence between partners' expertise shapes the optimal equity transfer. It shows that both partial and full equity transfers may emerge as part of the optimal mechanism. Specifically, with a control shift, both the first-and second-best solutions may prescribe full equity transfer under substitute expertise, but minimal equity transfer under complementary expertise.

AI.tldr: 本文研究合伙企业中控制权重新分配问题，在合伙人拥有关于谁的专业知识应主导企业的非对称信息条件下，采用机制设计方法刻画了包含股权转移设计的第一最优和第二最优机制，揭示合伙人专业知识间的相互依赖关系如何影响最优股权转移。
AI.research_question: 在合伙企业中，当合伙人拥有关于哪方专业知识应主导企业的非对称信息时，最优的控制权重新分配机制是什么？股权转移应如何设计？
AI.motivation: 合伙企业面临控制权分配的核心问题——当合伙人拥有私密信息决定谁的专业知识更重要时，如何设计同时包含控制权转移与股权转移的机制，以实现资源有效配置。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制设计理论（mechanism design），第一最优与第二最优分析框架
AI.method: 机制设计方法（mechanism design approach），构建包含股权转移的控制权重新分配模型
AI.findings: （1）部分和完全股权转移都可能成为最优机制的一部分；（2）在控制权转移情形下，当专业知识为替代关系时，第一最优和第二最优解都可能规定完全股权转移；（3）当专业知识为互补关系时，则只需最低限度的股权转移。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了合伙人专业知识之间的相互关系（替代vs互补）如何决定最优股权转移的性质，拓展了关于控制权分配与股权激励交互作用的机制设计理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为合伙企业在控制权变更时如何设计股权安排提供指导：在专业知识呈替代关系时倾向于完全股权转移，互补关系时只需最低限度股权转移。

title: Scdid: Selection-corrected Difference-in-Differences in Staggered Adoption Settings

detail.title: Scdid: Selection-corrected Difference-in-Differences in Staggered Adoption Settings
detail.abstract: Park (2025, Economics Letters 254, 112490) proposes a selection-corrected difference-in-differences method for estimating heterogeneous treatment effects in staggered adoption settings. The method allows for non-parallel trends arising from interactive fixed effects by introducing a selection model for the treatment timing. This article reviews the method and introduces the scdid command, which estimates the group-time average treatment effects with analytic standard errors based on the influence function of the estimator. The command provides aggregation into overall, group, calendar-time, and event-study parameters. In addition, it offers several choices of control group and two diagnostics, one for unobserved confounders and one for the specification of the treatment timing model.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍并评述了Park (2025)提出的选择校正双重差分（selection-corrected DID）方法，并引入scdid命令用于在交错采用（staggered adoption）情境下估计异质性处理效应。该方法通过引入处理时点的选择模型，允许存在由交互固定效应导致的非平行趋势，并提供了基于影响函数的解析标准误、多种汇总参数、对照组选择及诊断工具。
AI.research_question: 如何在校正处理时点选择性偏误的同时，估计交错采用情境下的异质性处理效应，并提供一个可操作的Stata命令实现？
AI.motivation: 传统DID方法在交错采用情境下，当存在非平行趋势（如由交互固定效应引起的趋势差异）且处理时点具有选择性时，估计结果可能产生偏误。需要一种能够同时处理这两类问题的方法，并将其实现为便于研究者使用的命令。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交互固定效应模型（interactive fixed effects）；选择模型（selection model）用于处理时点；组-时期平均处理效应（group-time average treatment effects）；影响函数（influence function）理论。
AI.method: 提出选择校正的双重差分估计量，将处理时点的选择模型与DID框架相结合；基于影响函数推导解析标准误；scdid命令支持汇总为总体、组别、日历时间和事件研究参数，并提供多种对照组选择及两类诊断检验。
AI.findings: 该命令能够有效估计交错采用情境下的异质性处理效应，处理非平行趋势与处理时点选择问题，并提供稳健的推断与诊断工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 将选择模型引入交错采用DID框架，扩展了DID方法对非平行趋势和内生处理时点情形的适用性；提供了基于影响函数的标准误理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供scdid Stata命令，使应用研究者能够便捷地估计交错采用情境下的处理效应，包含灵活的汇总选项、对照组选择和诊断检验。

title: Multi-granularity granular-ball clustering for preserving rare cores
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Multi-granularity granular-ball clustering for preserving rare cores
detail.abstract: Adaptive representative point-driven granular-ball clustering (ARP-GB) builds balls from density-adaptive representatives and merges overlapping balls by label propagation. A single size cut n can treat a small dense minority ball as noise, and radius reduction can break the overlap of two fragments of one minority class. We add ball-level rules, called multi-granularity granular-ball clustering (MG-GBC), to preserve a small, dense, isolated core and optionally link rare fragments. The evidence supports a specific advantage rather than uniform accuracy dominance. On Digits-Rare (real 8×8 pixels under controlled imbalance), ARP-GB collapses to one cluster whereas MG-GBC reaches ARI 0.874 and rare-recall 0.708. Across ten paired draws, mean ARI is 0.808±0.179 versus 0.037±0.145, with 10 wins and no loss (exact one-sided Wilcoxon p=0.00098); mean rare-recall is 0.600±0.181 versus 0.050±0.150. On 40 disjoint eligible temporal blocks from UNSW-NB15, the median paired rare-recall gain is +0.0196 (25 wins, 8 losses; sign p=0.0046), while the ARI confidence interval crosses zero and Hungarian ACC decreases. A frozen categorical sensitivity analysis on six prespecified OpenML sources gives 3 wins, 3 ties, no loss, and median ΔARI +0.0178. Thus MG-GBC’s supported contribution is rare-structure preservation at approximately unchanged runtime, with diagnostic win modes on dense majority fragments; it is not a claim of universal ACC or ARI superiority. The ball-level additions cost O(m2) after ball construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多粒度粒球聚类（MG-GBC）算法，在自适应代表点驱动粒球聚类（ARP-GB）基础上增加粒球级规则，用于保留小而密集的孤立稀有簇核心并可选地连接稀有类碎片。实验表明其优势在于稀有结构保留而非全面精度提升。
AI.research_question: 如何在粒球聚类中有效保留小而密集的稀有类簇，同时不损害整体聚类性能？
AI.motivation: 现有ARP-GB算法使用单一尺寸阈值n可能将小而密集的少数类球视为噪声，且半径缩减可能破坏少数类碎片的连接，导致稀有类结构丢失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 粒球聚类（Granular-ball clustering）、密度自适应代表点、标签传播、多粒度层次聚类。
AI.method: 在ARP-GB基础上增加粒球级规则（MG-GBC），包括保留小而密集孤立核心、可选连接稀有碎片；通过标签传播合并重叠球；复杂度分析O(m²)。
AI.findings: 在Digits-Rare数据集上ARI达0.874、稀有类召回0.708；十次配对抽样中平均ARI 0.808±0.179对0.037±0.145（10胜0负，Wilcoxon p=0.00098）；UNSW-NB15上稀有类召回中位数增益+0.0196（25胜8负，p=0.0046）；六个OpenML数据集上3胜3平0负。总体结论：优势在于稀有结构保留，运行时基本不变，非全面ACC或ARI优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了粒球级规则在稀有结构保留方面的特定价值，而非均匀精度提升，为粒球聚类在多粒度层次上的理论补充提供了证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不平衡数据聚类（如网络异常检测、罕见模式识别）提供了保留稀有结构的实用算法方案，运行时开销可控（O(m²)）。

title: Macroprudential Policy, Green Credit Channels, and Ecological Value Realization under Carbon Neutrality Commitments: An Extended NK-DSGE Analysis
affiliations: Peking University

detail.title: Macroprudential Policy, Green Credit Channels, and Ecological Value Realization under Carbon Neutrality Commitments: An Extended NK-DSGE Analysis
detail.abstract: An in-depth examination of green finance's small-scale processes and evolving influence on enabling ecological product value is the primary focus of this study. To analyze the overall economic connections and policy transmission mechanisms via ecological routes of supply, pricing, and demand, this study uses a New Keynesian Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium (NK-DSGE) framework that incorporates green financial agents and is grounded in actual economic data.These results highlight the significant importance of green financing in materializing the value of ecological products. In particular, green finance increases investment in environmental initiatives overall, boosts demand for immediate eco-friendly items, and generates employment for localities. To add to that, green finance can influence critical parts of value creation through the use of green credit interest rates, the quantity of green credit, and interest rates on household savings. Furthermore, by avoiding a glut of environmentally friendly products, maintaining stable pricing, and reducing cost inflation, monetary policy effectively mitigates these economic impacts.Significant policy implications arise from these findings. For instance, authorities could use a mix of monetary policy and green financial instruments such as direct lending quotas and low interest rates to stabilize environmental markets, increase long-term green economic development, and better distribute capital.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用新凯恩斯动态随机一般均衡（NK-DSGE）模型，深入考察绿色金融在促进生态产品价值实现中的微观机制与动态影响，发现绿色金融通过增加环保投资、提升生态产品即期需求、创造地方就业等渠道显著推动生态产品价值实现，且货币政策能够有效平抑相关经济波动。
AI.research_question: 绿色金融如何通过供给端、定价端和需求端等生态路径影响生态产品价值的实现？其政策传导机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 生态产品价值的实现是推动绿色经济发展和生态文明建设的关键环节，而绿色金融作为重要的市场化工具在其中发挥何种作用、其微观传导机制如何运作，尚缺乏深入系统的分析，需要从经济学一般均衡视角加以考察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯动态随机一般均衡（NK-DSGE）模型，包含绿色金融部门，嵌入生态产品供给、定价和需求三大传导路径。
AI.method: 基于实际经济数据校准参数，构建包含绿色金融主体的NK-DSGE模型，通过模拟分析绿色金融对生态产品价值实现的总量经济关联及政策传导机制。
AI.findings: （1）绿色金融显著促进生态产品价值实现，增加环保项目投资总量、提升即期生态产品需求并创造地方就业；（2）绿色金融可通过绿色信贷利率、绿色信贷规模和家庭储蓄利率影响价值创造的关键环节；（3）货币政策能够有效平抑绿色金融带来的经济影响，避免生态产品供给过剩、维持价格稳定并降低成本型通货膨胀。
AI.theory_contributions: 将绿色金融主体引入NK-DSGE框架，构建了绿色金融影响生态产品价值实现的系统性理论框架，揭示了供给、定价和需求三大生态传导路径，丰富了绿色金融宏观经济学研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了将货币政策与绿色金融工具（如直接贷款额度、低利率政策）组合使用以稳定生态产品市场、促进长期绿色经济发展和优化资本配置的政策建议。

title: The Impact of Public Credit Guarantees on R&D and Innovation
affiliations: Peking University

detail.title: The Impact of Public Credit Guarantees on R&D and Innovation
detail.abstract: The Credit Guaranty Fund in Turkey is among the world's largest initiatives. The effects of public credit guarantees (PCGs) on research and development (R&D) and innovation by firms are examined in this study using a large dataset from that program. In order to compare the recipient firms with a carefully selected non-receiver control group, the research used a tiered difference-in-differences (DiD) approach that began with a rigorous matching process. Doing so will help prevent selection bias.There was a statistically significant increase in output and innovative inputs for firms that received guarantee loans. The extent to which a company exports high-tech items is a measure of the consequence of innovation. R&D investment is a surrogate for innovative input. According to the heterogeneity study, credit guarantees help businesses with high innovation potential reduce capital frictions. Businesses with a lot of capital constraints and those who have previously innovated will feel the benefits the most.In order to achieve the greatest possible technological spillovers and economic development in the long run, our findings suggest that loan assistance programs should focus on businesses that are both innovative and financially constrained. Regulatory bodies and international development organizations might use these findings to inform their policy choices.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用土耳其信用担保基金的大规模数据，通过匹配加差分法（DiD）评估公共信用担保对企业研发与创新的影响，发现受担保企业在创新投入与产出上均有显著提升，且对有创新潜力但受资本约束的企业效果最为明显。
AI.research_question: 公共信用担保（PCGs）对企业的研发（R&D）与创新活动有何影响？
AI.motivation: 土耳其信用担保基金是全球最大的此类计划之一，但公共信用担保对企业创新的实际效果尚缺乏严格的大规模实证证据，且需要解决选择偏差问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本摩擦理论；信贷约束与企业创新理论
AI.method: 采用分层差分法（tiered DiD），首先通过严格的匹配过程构建受保企业与未受保对照组，以消除选择偏差，并进行异质性分析。
AI.findings: 获得担保贷款的企业在创新投入（R&D投资）和创新产出（高科技产品出口）方面均有统计显著的提升；异质性分析显示，信用担保对具有高创新潜力、资本约束严重以及已有创新经验的企业效果最为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 为公共信用担保与创新关系的文献提供了来自全球最大信用担保计划之一的大规模经验证据；通过严格匹配结合DiD的方法缓解了选择偏差问题；揭示了信用担保通过缓解资本摩擦促进创新的机制，并识别了受益最大的企业类型。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议贷款援助项目应优先面向兼具创新性与财务约束的企业，以最大化技术溢出与长期经济增长；为监管机构和国际发展组织的政策决策提供实证依据。

title: From Algorithmic Sophistication to Strategic Power
affiliations: Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile and Pontificia Universidad Catolica de Chile

detail.title: From Algorithmic Sophistication to Strategic Power
detail.abstract: Firms increasingly delegate strategic decisions to learning algorithms. Such environments are naturally asymmetric because firms deploy systems based on different technologies and with different capabilities. We study how asymmetric sophistication shapes the interaction of two model-free Q-learning algorithms, using richer memory as the measure of sophistication. We show that, with sufficiently rich memory, the extended-memory algorithm attains a payoff arbitrarily close to the continuation value of a fully informed rational player who understands the baseline algorithm's learning dynamics. In a specific application, we show that the extended-memory algorithm learns a reward-and-punishment scheme that induces a baseline algorithm to play a strictly dominated action.

AI.tldr: 本文研究两家企业使用不同复杂度的Q-learning算法进行战略决策互动时的结果。拥有更丰富记忆的扩展记忆算法（更复杂的算法）可以获得接近完全知情理性参与者的延续价值，甚至能学会奖励-惩罚机制来诱导基础算法采取严格劣势行动。
AI.research_question: 当企业部署不同技术能力和复杂度的学习算法时，这种不对称的复杂性如何塑造两个无模型Q-learning算法之间的战略互动？
AI.motivation: 企业越来越多地将战略决策委托给学习算法，但不同企业使用的算法在技术上存在差异，这种不对称性在文献中尚未被充分研究。理解这种不对称性对于预测算法驱动的市场竞争结果至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: Q-learning强化学习理论；算法博弈论；信息不对称与理性预期理论
AI.method: 理论研究与博弈论建模分析，构建两个不对称Q-learning算法的互动模型，以记忆丰富程度衡量算法复杂度，并进行数学推导证明。
AI.findings: （1）当扩展记忆算法具有足够丰富的记忆时，其获得的收益可以任意接近完全知情理性玩家（理解基础算法学习动态）的延续价值；（2）在特定应用中，扩展记忆算法能够学习一套奖励-惩罚方案，诱导基础算法采取严格被支配的行动。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从理论上刻画了不对称算法复杂性对算法间战略互动的影响；证明了更复杂的算法可以获得接近理性基准的收益，弥合了强化学习与完全理性博弈论之间的鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业算法设计提供指导：投资更复杂（记忆更丰富）的学习算法可以获得显著的竞争优势；警示企业需要关注对手算法的复杂性对自己的算法可能造成的操纵风险。

title: Activism Without Enforcement: Gadfly Activism and Symbolic Corporate Responses
affiliations: Institute of Financial Studies, Southwestern University of Finance and Economics and Pennsylvania State University

detail.title: Activism Without Enforcement: Gadfly Activism and Symbolic Corporate Responses
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether gadfly activism generates spillover effects to non-targeted peer firms via common institutional ownership. Exploiting the inclusion of gadfly proposals on proxy statements as a quasi-natural experiment, we find that peer firms with high common ownership exhibit a lower fraction of negative words in their 10-Q filings, thereby increasing overall disclosure tone, relative to otherwise similar peers with low common ownership. Such effects are less pronounced among peer firms with high dedicated institutional ownership, consistent with the idea that strong institutional monitoring increases the likelihood that a decoupling between disclosure tone and underlying firm fundamentals is detected. In contrast to the optimistic disclosure in 10-Q filings, which afford more time for preparation, such effects are absent in 8-K filings, which are subject to a stringent filing deadline, suggesting that peer firms adjust disclosure only when they have sufficient time to do so. They also raise the upper bound of their management guidance, while leaving the lower bound unchanged. Across both 10-Q filings and management guidance, peer firms selectively adjust the dimension of disclosure that is less likely to be contradicted by subsequently realized outcomes. We also find that implied volatility declines, yet analyst forecast dispersion and actual equity market activity remain unaffected. Firm-level outcomes, such as investment, performance, and proposal-specific outcomes, exhibit no meaningful improvement, indicating that the optimistic disclosures reflect symbolic rather than substantive responses to gadfly activist pressure. Overall, our findings suggest that low-cost activism yields an unintended consequence: the appearance of responsiveness devoid of substantive change.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"牛虻式激进主义"（gadfly activism）是否通过共同机构所有权对非目标同行企业产生溢出效应。利用牛虻提案进入代理声明作为准自然实验，发现高共同所有权的同行企业在10-Q文件中负面词汇比例更低（披露语调更乐观），但这一效应在拥有高专注机构所有权的企业中较弱，且在8-K文件中不显著。企业还上调管理层指引上限，且有选择性地调整不易被后续结果反驳的披露维度。隐含波动率下降，但分析师预测分歧和实际市场活动不受影响，投资、业绩等企业层面结果无实质改善，表明这种乐观披露是象征性而非实质性的回应。
AI.research_question: 牛虻激进主义是否通过共同机构所有权对非目标同行企业产生溢出效应，具体表现为同行企业是否会调整其信息披露行为？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注激进主义对目标企业的直接影响，但对非目标同行企业的间接溢出效应关注不足。本研究旨在探讨低成本激进主义活动如何通过共同机构所有权这一渠道影响同行企业的信息披露策略，揭示激进主义可能带来的无意后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 共同机构所有权传导机制；信息披露语调理论；机构监督与象征性回应理论；激进主义外部性理论
AI.method: 准自然实验法（利用牛虻提案进入代理声明的外生冲击）；双重差分设计；文本分析（10-Q和8-K文件负面词汇比例）；比较分析（不同文件类型、不同机构所有权结构）
AI.findings: （1）高共同所有权的同行企业在10-Q文件中披露语调更乐观；（2）高专注机构所有权削弱该效应；（3）该效应仅存在于10-Q文件而非8-K文件；（4）企业管理层指引上调上限但下界不变，且选择性调整不易被后续结果反驳的披露维度；（5）隐含波动率下降，但分析师预测分散度和市场活动不受影响；（6）投资、业绩和提案相关结果无实质改善。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将激进主义研究从目标企业拓展到同行溢出效应，揭示了共同机构所有权作为传导渠道的新机制；（2）区分了象征性回应与实质性回应的理论边界，表明乐观披露可能是"表面回应缺乏实质改变"，丰富了信息披露的机会主义理论；（3）通过文件类型（10-Q vs 8-K）的差异对比，为披露时机与战略动机的关系提供了新的理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为监管者和政策制定者提供证据，表明低成本激进主义可能促使企业采取象征性而非实质性的应对策略，提示需关注信息披露的真实性；（2）为投资者和分析师提供警示：高共同所有权企业可能通过乐观语调掩盖实质未变的基本面；（3）为上市公司应对激进主义压力时的信息披露策略提供参考。

title: Multiplicative GARCH-X with VIX: A Parsimonious Alternative to GARCH-MIDAS for Volatility Forecasting

detail.title: Multiplicative GARCH-X with VIX: A Parsimonious Alternative to GARCH-MIDAS for Volatility Forecasting
detail.abstract: We propose a daily multiplicative GARCH-X model, sigma_t^2 = tau_t x g_t, where tau_t is a simple function of lagged VIX and g_t follows a GJR-GARCH process on standardized returns. In a systematic horse race among 17 specifications - including ten daily GARCH-X variants, six GARCH-MIDAS alternatives with Beta-polynomial weighting, and a GJR-GARCH benchmark - the simplest daily model with tau_t = theta_0 + theta_1 VIX_(t-1)^2 and freely estimated intercept (A4f) achieves the lowest QLIKE loss function, outperforming GJR-GARCH by a margin that clears our conservative |t| > 3.0 reporting screen (Diebold-Mariano t = 4.47; the screen is adopted following the multiple-testing concerns of Harvey et al. (2016) and is not a critical value from any cited source), and outperforming all GARCH-MIDAS specifications in point estimates. The result extends to QQQ (t = 3.96); on the four remaining assets - GLD with its own fear index GVZ (t = 2.93), FEZ (t = 2.74), EEM (t = 2.69) and 0050.TW (t = 1.54) - the improvement is consistent in sign but does not clear our |t| > 3.0 reporting screen. We show that tau_t reflects the option-market fear level while g_t captures residual GARCH dynamics. We also report a null result on the variance risk premium (VRP): across all four specifications examined, g_t shows no economically meaningful contemporaneous correlation with VRP (|rho| <= 0.09), and no out-of-sample predictive power for it. This corrects a claim in earlier versions of this paper that certain specifications' g_t tracked VRP at rho approximately 0.80; that figure was an artifact of a mis-scaled VRP proxy and an approximation to g_t, and is withdrawn. The multiplicative structure is a decomposition of volatility, not a recoverable premium signal. Residual diagnostics on the same pinned sample indicate that VIX absorption reduces excess kurtosis by 42% and shifts the median optimal Student-t degrees of freedom from 5.2 to 8.0; this accompanies the calibration ordering reported in the paper rather than establishing a tail-risk advantage. For risk management the evidence is weaker than the forecasting evidence: under a three-test pass criterion (UC, CC, DQ) A4f-t, A4f-Normal and GJR-Normal each pass at one of three confidence levels and GJR-t at none, so the backtests do not establish a tail-risk advantage, although A4f-t's violation rate is the closest to nominal at every level. These findings demonstrate that a parsimonious multiplicative GARCH-X specification with daily VIX is statistically indistinguishable from the best GARCH-MIDAS alternative (B1, K = 22; DM t = -0.90) while outranking longer-lag MIDAS specifications by margins that clear the |t| > 3.0 screen. The case for it therefore rests on parsimony and point-forecast accuracy; the backtests do not add a tail-risk advantage to that case.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个日度乘法GARCH-X模型（σ²_t = τ_t × g_t），其中τ_t是滞后VIX的简单函数，g_t遵循GJR-GARCH过程。在17个规格的全面比较中，最简单的日度模型A4f以最低的QLIKE损失函数胜出，优于GJR-GARCH基准和所有GARCH-MIDAS规格。然而，方差风险溢价（VRP）的预测结果为零（修正了早期版本的错误主张），回测也未建立尾部风险优势。
AI.research_question: 一个简洁的日度乘法GARCH-X模型（以日度VIX为外生变量）能否在预测精度上超越GJR-GARCH基准和GARCH-MIDAS替代模型？该模型能否追踪方差风险溢价（VRP）信号？
AI.motivation: 现有文献中GARCH-MIDAS模型虽然能捕捉长期成分，但估计复杂。作者希望检验一个更简洁的乘法GARCH-X规格——仅以滞后VIX的简单函数作为长期成分τ_t，是否能在不牺牲预测精度的前提下大幅简化模型。同时需要纠正早期版本中关于g_t与VRP高度相关（ρ≈0.80）的错误主张。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 乘法波动率分解框架：将条件方差分解为长期成分（τ_t，反映期权市场恐慌水平VIX）和短期GARCH动态成分（g_t）；2) GJR-GARCH非对称波动率模型；3) GARCH-MIDAS模型作为替代框架；4) 方差风险溢价（VRP）理论。
AI.method: 在多资产（SPY、QQQ、GLD、FEZ、EEM、0050.TW）上进行了17种规格的系统性比较，包括10种日度GARCH-X变体、6种GARCH-MIDAS备选方案和GJR-GARCH基准。采用QLIKE损失函数评估预测精度，使用Diebold-Mariano检验（保守的|t|>3.0报告阈值）进行统计比较；通过UC、CC、DQ三项检验进行风险回测；采用残差诊断分析过度峰度和Student-t自由度。
AI.findings: 1) A4f模型（τ_t = θ₀ + θ₁VIX²_{t-1}，自由估计截距）在SPY上取得最优QLIKE（DM t=4.47），在QQQ上也成立（t=3.96）；2) 在GLD（t=2.93）、FEZ（t=2.74）、EEM（t=2.69）、0050.TW（t=1.54）上改进方向一致但未超过|t|>3.0报告阈值；3) 对VRP的预测结果为空（|ρ|≤0.09），修正了早期版本ρ≈0.80的错误；4) VIX吸收使过度峰度降低42%，最优Student-t自由度从5.2升至8.0；5) 回测未建立尾部风险优势；6) A4f与最优GARCH-MIDAS（B1, K=22）统计上无显著差异（DM t=-0.90），但胜过较长滞后的MIDAS规格。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出并验证了一个简洁的乘法GARCH-X分解框架，将τ_t解释为期权市场恐惧水平、g_t为残差GARCH动态；2) 明确纠正了将乘法波动率分解误认为可恢复的溢价信号的错误，指出该结构是分解而非可恢复的风险溢价信号；3) 证明了日度VIX作为长期成分的充分性，挑战了GARCH-MIDAS框架中多滞后Beta多项式加权的必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为实践者提供了一个极其简洁、估计容易的波动率预测模型（仅需日度VIX和一个GJR-GARCH过程）；2) 提供了严格的多重检验校正（|t|>3.0）报告标准，供其他实证研究参考；3) 明确了VIX在波动率预测中的信息含量及其对尾部行为和峰度的影响，对风险管理实践具有参考价值。

title: Pricing Advantage in Contests: Mechanism Design and Evidence from Armageddon Chess
affiliations: , Oslo Metropolitan University,  and University of Oslo - Department of Economics

detail.title: Pricing Advantage in Contests: Mechanism Design and Evidence from Armageddon Chess
detail.abstract: We study a mechanism-design problem in which contestants bid up-front for an advantaged role by forfeiting part of the productive resource in the contest. Since the payment changes the contest technology, bidding prices payoff indifference rather than the allowance that an informed designer would choose to equalise winning probabilities. Within a family of equilibria, weak dominance selects a unique outcome: the winning bid equals the losing bidder's indifference point. Bidding leads to an allocation that no contestant would swap, but does not equalise win probabilities. Under strictly log-concave effort costs, bidding overshoots the equalising allowance for near-equal contestants, making the auction winner an underdog. Armageddon chess provides a direct implementation: players bid the time they will accept as Black with draw odds. Using 477 elite online games, we test the model and structurally compare bidding with random colour, a fixed allowance, and the informed-designer optimum. Ratings predict game outcomes but not bids; bidding improves balance for near-equal pairs but can underperform random assignment once latent heterogeneity is incorporated.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种机制设计问题：参赛者通过预先竞标（放弃部分生产性资源）来获得优势角色。与信息充分的设计者通过设定补贴来平衡获胜概率不同，竞标定价的是参赛者的无差异点。在弱优势条件下，唯一的均衡结果是获胜出价等于落败者的无差异点。该机制产生的分配是帕累托最优的（无人愿意交换），但并未均衡获胜概率。在严格对数凹的努力成本下，竞标会过度超越均衡补贴，使拍卖获胜者成为劣势方。国际象棋"末日战"（Armageddon chess）为此提供了直接实现：棋手竞标他们愿意接受的黑方时间（附带平局劣势）。作者利用477场精英在线对局数据检验了模型，并结构性比较了竞标机制与随机选色、固定补贴和信息充分设计者最优方案的优劣。
AI.research_question: 在竞赛中，参赛者通过预先竞标（放弃部分生产性资源）来获得优势地位的机制设计问题——竞标价格应如何确定、均衡结果如何、以及该机制在实际场景（国际象棋末日战）中的表现如何？
AI.motivation: 传统竞赛设计文献通常假设设计者拥有充分信息可以设定补贴来平衡参赛者获胜概率，但现实中设计者往往信息不足。竞标机制可以让参赛者自己通过出价来揭示和调整优势角色分配，但竞标改变了竞赛技术（因为支付是放弃生产性资源），使得标准的均衡分析不再适用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制设计理论、竞赛理论（contest theory）、弱优势（weak dominance）均衡筛选、对数凹努力成本函数
AI.method: 理论建模（机制设计均衡分析）+ 实证检验（利用477场精英在线国际象棋末日战对局数据，进行结构性估计和模型比较）
AI.findings: （1）弱优势筛选出唯一均衡：获胜出价等于落败者的无差异点；（2）竞标产生了无人愿意交换的分配，但不等化获胜概率；（3）在严格对数凹努力成本下，竞标会过度超越均衡补贴，使拍卖获胜者成为劣势方；（4）实证显示：评分能预测比赛结果但无法预测出价；竞标改善了实力相近棋手的平衡，但在考虑潜在异质性后可能不如随机分配。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出了竞标支付改变竞赛技术的新型机制设计框架，区别于传统固定补贴设计；（2）证明了弱优势筛选可得出均衡出价的显式解；（3）揭示了竞标不等化获胜概率的理论条件（严格对数凹努力成本下的过度竞标）；（4）为机制设计中的信息不对称问题提供了去中心化解决方案的理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为国际象棋"末日战"规则提供了理论解释和最优出价预测；（2）将竞标机制与随机分配、固定补贴及信息充分设计者最优方案进行了实证比较，给出了实际赛事规则设计的参考依据；（3）指出了竞标机制在存在潜在异质性时的局限性，为赛事组织者提供了决策建议。

title: “A Nation’s Game, Nobody’s Responsibility: Sports, National Development, and the Legal and Institutional Architecture of Failure in Nigeria"

detail.title: “A Nation’s Game, Nobody’s Responsibility: Sports, National Development, and the Legal and Institutional Architecture of Failure in Nigeria"

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with any people or organisations that could have influenced this study. This paper was independently researched and written.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a doctrinal legal analysis and did not involve human participants, patient data, or empirical research requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper critically examines the relationship between sports governance and national development in Nigeria, with a particular focus on the game of football, which is the nation’s most watched, most followed, most culturally embedded, and commercially significant sport discipline. Through a historical analysis spanning pre-colonial physical cultures to the democratic era, a legal mapping of the institutional architecture governing Nigerian sport, and a diagnosis of the governance failures that have constrained sporting achievements, this paper argues that Nigeria’s sports governance crisis is not merely a product of individual incompetence or occasional mismanagement but the predictable output of a legal architecture characterised by obsolescence, fragmentation, and a fundamental non-existence of any form of accountability to the athletes it governs. Additionally, this paper documents the Mikel pattern (two captains, three tournaments) as evidence of structural dysfunction rather than incidental dysfunction, and further analyses the current existence and non-existence of bodies and mechanisms to resolve disputes in Nigerian football. This paper closes with a proposal of six legally grounded recommendations, drawing on comparative examples including Germany’s post 2000 football restructuring, toward a reformed architecture capable of converting Nigeria’s abundant sporting potentials and talents into sustained national development.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地考察尼日利亚体育治理与国家发展之间的关系，聚焦足球这一该国最具文化和商业意义的体育项目。通过历史分析、法律映射和治理失败诊断，论证尼日利亚体育治理危机并非个人无能或偶然失管的结果，而是过时、碎片化且对运动员缺乏问责的法律架构的可预测产物。文章记录了"Mikel模式"（两位队长、三项赛事）作为结构性功能障碍的证据，分析尼日利亚足球争端解决机制的存在与缺失，并提出六项基于法律依据的改革建议，借鉴德国2000年后足球重组等比较经验。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚体育治理危机（特别是足球领域）的根源是什么，以及如何通过法律架构改革将体育潜力转化为国家发展？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚拥有丰富的体育天赋和潜力，但长期面临体育治理失败和成就受限的问题。现有治理危机需要系统性的法律与制度诊断，而非仅归咎于个人能力不足或偶发失误。
AI.theoretical_framework: 体育治理理论、法律架构分析框架（法律映射方法）、制度问责理论、历史制度主义视角
AI.method: 历史分析（从前殖民时期身体文化到民主时代的纵向考察）、法律映射（对尼日利亚体育治理的制度架构进行法律梳理）、诊断性案例分析（以Mikel模式等具体事件为证据）、比较法分析（参照德国2000年后足球重组经验）
AI.findings: 尼日利亚体育治理危机是法律架构过时、碎片化和缺乏问责制的可预测产物；Mikel模式（两位队长、三项赛事）证明了结构性而非偶发性功能障碍；尼日利亚足球争端解决机制存在严重的制度缺失；现有治理无法有效转化为国家发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 将体育治理问题从个体失败的叙事转向结构性法律架构分析，建立了体育治理危机与法律制度设计之间的因果关联；提出将治理失败解释为"法律架构的可预测输出"的分析框架；丰富了对发展中国家体育法律制度的比较研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出六项基于法律依据的制度改革建议；借鉴德国2000年后足球重组的成功经验；为尼日利亚体育治理改革提供具体可行的路径，旨在将体育潜力转化为国家发展动力。
