title: Ancient Indian Economic Thought and Contemporary Indian Macroeconomic Policy: An Indian Knowledge System Perspective
affiliations: BBK College

detail.title: Ancient Indian Economic Thought and Contemporary Indian Macroeconomic Policy: An Indian Knowledge System Perspective
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the importance of ancient Indian economic thoughts for modern Indian macroeconomic policy from the perspective of the Indian Knowledge System (IKS). Based on documentary evidence from the Rig Veda, Arthashastra and Dharmashastra, the study develops an integrated conceptual framework synthesising classical economic ideas in five interrelated dimensions: productive economy, fiscal prudence, institutional governance, welfare orientation and sustainable development. This study uses a qualitative conceptual research design with documentary and thematic analysis to find lasting normative and institutional concepts contained within these classical writings. The findings imply that ancient Indian economic thinking provides a comprehensive view of economic administration in which affluence, ethical conduct, institutional efficiency, public welfare, and environmental stewardship are interconnected goals. The study does not argue that ancient Indian texts anticipated modern macroeconomic theory, but that these offer complementary ethical and institutional perspectives that can enrich contemporary policy discourse. The suggested paradigm contributes to the burgeoning literature on the Indian Knowledge System by providing a systematic analytical lens to analyse indigenous economic theory in connection to modern macroeconomic policy. The study finds that the inclusion of these lasting principles in current policy debates will help foster more inclusive, institutionally strong and sustainable ways of achieving economic development in India.

AI.tldr: 本文从印度知识体系（IKS）的视角，探讨古代印度经济思想对现代印度宏观经济政策的重要性。研究基于《梨俱吠陀》《政事论》和《法论》等经典文献，构建了一个涵盖生产性经济、财政审慎、制度治理、福利导向和可持续发展五个相互关联维度的综合概念框架，认为古代印度经济思想能为当代政策讨论提供互补性的伦理和制度视角。
AI.research_question: 古代印度经济思想对现代印度宏观经济政策有何重要性？古代经典著作中包含哪些持久的规范性和制度性概念，以及这些概念如何与当代宏观经济政策相关联？
AI.motivation: 在印度知识体系（IKS）日益受到重视的背景下，系统性地挖掘和整理古代印度经典文献中的经济思想，并将其与现代宏观经济政策建立联系，以丰富当代政策讨论的伦理和制度视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 印度知识体系（IKS）视角；综合概念框架包含五个维度：生产性经济、财政审慎、制度治理、福利导向和可持续发展。
AI.method: 定性概念研究设计，采用文献分析和主题分析方法，基于《梨俱吠陀》《政事论》和《法论》等文献证据。
AI.findings: 古代印度经济思想提供了经济管理的全面视角，其中富裕、伦理行为、制度效率、公共福利和环境管理是相互关联的目标；古代文献并未预见现代宏观经济理论，但提供了可补充当代政策讨论的伦理和制度视角。
AI.theory_contributions: 为印度知识体系的快速发展文献做出贡献，提供了一个系统性的分析视角，用以分析本土经济理论与现代宏观经济政策的关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 将古代持久性原则纳入当前政策辩论，有助于促进印度实现更具包容性、制度更强健和更可持续的经济发展方式。

title: The Demand Regeneration Framework: An Integrated Architecture for Purchasing-Power Regeneration, Participation Dynamics, and Capital Recovery Under Structural Change

detail.title: The Demand Regeneration Framework: An Integrated Architecture for Purchasing-Power Regeneration, Participation Dynamics, and Capital Recovery Under Structural Change
detail.abstract: Traditional macroeconomic models of structural change and automation primarily examine task substitution and productive capacity on the supply side, frequently treating the displaced worker solely as an input of production. Consequently, standard frameworks fail to account for the systemic macroeconomic consequences of displacing high-velocity, discretionary purchasing power. This paper develops the Demand Regeneration Framework (DRF), a technology-neutral, directional diagnostic architecture designed to model the transmission of structural economic shocks from localized household budgets to corporate capital structures. The framework formalizes a four-stage transmission sequence: (1) The Household Shock Engine shifts focus from employment headcounts to the continuous Discretionary Demand Capacity (DDCi,t) of exposed cohorts, introducing the Demand Regeneration Coefficient (A∗ ) to evaluate whether exposed purchasing power is successfully replaced across multiple income channels, and formalizing Demand Node Compression (DNCt) via dynamic Engel constraints; (2) The Network Transmission Layer models how localized budget compression translates into an evaporation of participation (πt) and transaction volume (νt), enforcing the Terminal Final Demand Constraint; (3) The Digital Capital Crisis pits compressed transaction volume against the physical hyper-obsolescence of fixed capital (Tobs), formalizing the conditions under which platform arms races and contractual revenue lags culminate in a Capital Recovery Index (CRIt) default; and (4) Macroeconomic Contagion, tracing recursive secondary wage and demand cascades across interconnected trade sectors. Intended as a theory-building and hypothesis-generating foundation rather than a deterministic forecasting model, the framework establishes an empirical roadmap and ten testable hypotheses to evaluate whether a structural transition trends toward sustainable market equilibrium or systemic capital realization failure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"需求再生框架"(DRF)，这是一个技术中性的诊断架构，用于建模结构性经济冲击如何从家庭预算传导至企业资本结构。框架通过四阶段传导序列(家庭冲击引擎、网络传导层、数字资本危机、宏观经济传染)来评估结构性转型是趋向可持续市场均衡还是系统性资本实现失败。
AI.research_question: 传统的宏观结构变化与自动化模型将受替代的工人仅视为生产投入，忽略了其作为高流动性、可自由支配购买力被替代后产生的系统性宏观经济后果。本文旨在回答：结构性经济冲击如何通过家庭预算传导至企业资本结构，以及如何评估这种传导是否导致可持续市场均衡或系统性资本实现失败。
AI.motivation: 标准宏观经济框架未能充分捕捉被替代工人作为需求方(而非仅供给方)被驱逐所产生的系统性后果。传统模型侧重供给侧的任务替代与生产能力，忽视了高流动性的自由支配购买力消失带来的需求端连锁效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求再生框架(DRF)：四阶段传导序列——(1)家庭冲击引擎：引入自由支配需求能力(DDCi,t)与需求再生系数(A*)；需求节点压缩(DNCt)与动态恩格尔约束；(2)网络传导层：参与度(πt)与交易量(νt)蒸发，终端最终需求约束；(3)数字资本危机：资本恢复指数(CRIt)违约条件；(4)宏观经济传染：递归次级工资与需求级联。
AI.method: 理论构建与假设生成方法：提出四阶段传导架构，建立实证路线图，提出十个可检验假设。非确定性预测模型，而是诊断性理论框架。
AI.findings: 框架识别了结构性冲击的完整传导路径：从家庭预算压缩→需求节点压缩→交易量蒸发→数字资本过时→资本恢复指数违约→宏观经济级联传染。提出了需求再生系数(A*)作为评估购买力替代成功与否的关键指标。
AI.theory_contributions: (1)从供给侧任务替代范式转向需求侧购买力再生范式，弥补了传统模型的盲区；(2)形式化了四阶段传导机制，将微观家庭预算与宏观资本结构联系起来；(3)引入需求再生系数(A*)和资本恢复指数(CRIt)等新概念工具；(4)为结构性转型评估提供了理论生成与假设检验的基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者与产业分析者提供诊断结构性转型方向的实证路线图与十个可检验假设，帮助判断经济转型是否趋向可持续均衡或面临系统性资本实现失败风险。

title: Within the Law, Beyond Exploitation: The Evolution of Immigrant Within the Law, Beyond Exploitation: The Evolution of Immigrant Worker Cooperatives Worker Cooperatives
affiliations: University of California, Irvine School of Law and Fordham University School of Law

detail.title: Within the Law, Beyond Exploitation: The Evolution of Immigrant Within the Law, Beyond Exploitation: The Evolution of Immigrant Worker Cooperatives Worker Cooperatives
detail.abstract:
This Article explores worker cooperatives as a viable and legally permissible pathway for immigrants without work authorization to participate in the United States economy. Due to federal immigration laws that penalize employers for hiring workers without authorization, these immigrants face systemic exclusion from formal employment. Yet, unauthorized workers remain an integral part of the labor force, contributing billions to the economy while often enduring exploitation and limited legal protections. Worker cooperatives offer an alternative, allowing undocumented individuals to earn income as business owners rather than employees, avoiding legal violations.

This Article traces the historical and legal roots of undocumented workers’ precarity and how grassroots-driven worker cooperatives have emerged in response. It highlights limited liability companies (LLCs) as the preferred structure for cooperatives with undocumented members while addressing financial, structural, and legal risks. Though worker cooperatives offer opportunities for economic empowerment and collective action, their members lack employment protections and remain vulnerable to immigration enforcement. Ultimately, this Article argues that while imperfect, worker cooperatives are a crucial strategy for advancing economic justice and dignity for undocumented workers.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了工人合作社作为无工作授权的移民参与美国经济的可行且合法的途径。由于联邦移民法惩罚雇用无授权工人的雇主，这些移民被系统性地排除在正式就业之外。工人合作社允许无证移民以企业主而非雇员的身份赚取收入，从而规避法律违规。文章追溯了无证工人不稳定的历史与法律根源，指出有限责任公司是包含无证成员的合作社的首选结构，同时承认合作社成员缺乏就业保护并易受移民执法影响，但认为工人合作社是推进无证工人经济正义和尊严的关键策略。
AI.research_question: 工人合作社是否以及如何能够作为无工作授权移民参与美国经济的可行且合法途径？
AI.motivation: 无证移民因联邦移民法而遭受系统性就业排斥，但又构成劳动力的重要组成部分，为经济贡献数十亿美元的同时常遭受剥削和有限的法律保护，亟需寻找合法的经济参与路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文采用法律分析框架，结合移民法、劳动法与企业法（特别是有限责任公司结构）的理论视角，并借鉴历史制度分析和基层社会运动（grassroots-driven）的相关理论。
AI.method: 定性法律分析：追溯历史和法理根源，分析判例与立法，并考察基层工人合作社的实践案例，评估不同合作社法律结构（特别是LLC）的优劣与风险。
AI.findings: 工人合作社为无证移民提供了以企业主身份而非雇员身份赚取收入的合法途径，可以规避雇主雇用无授权工人的法律处罚；有限责任公司是包含无证成员的合作社的首选法律结构；但合作社成员缺乏就业保护，仍面临移民执法和财务、结构、法律风险的脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文将合作社法律形式与移民法问题联系起来，为"无证移民经济权利"提供新的法律分析框架，阐明企业所有权结构如何成为移民排外法律体系下的制度性逃生通道，拓展了经济正义与移民劳工权利交叉领域的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、法律从业者和移民社区组织提供了关于如何通过工人合作社（尤其以LLC为结构）帮助无证移民实现经济参与的实务指引，同时警示了相关法律风险和局限。

title:
The Economic Costs of Partisanship: 
Evidence from Workplace Regulators
affiliations: The University of Texas at El Paso, University of Washington and

detail.title:
The Economic Costs of Partisanship: 
Evidence from Workplace Regulators
detail.abstract: We measure the partisanship of workplace regulators who lead the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) using a language-based machine learning approach applied to meeting transcripts from 2001 to 2023. EEOC partisanship has risen sharply since 2009, driven by the appointment of more polarized Commissioners rather than a within-person change. Higher partisanship increases enforcement frequency but diminishes fine severity on average; the exception is for Republican-leaning firms facing a Democratic-majority Commission, where partisanship significantly raises monetary penalties. Equity markets price this enforcement risk, as Republican-leaning firms experience negative abnormal returns around Democratic Commissioner nominations, while all other pairings show no detectable reaction.

AI.tldr: 本文利用基于语言的自然语言处理技术，对2001年至2023年间美国平等就业机会委员会（EEOC）监管者的党派倾向进行测量，发现自2009年以来EEOC的党派性显著上升，主要由更两极分化的委员任命驱动而非个人立场变化。更高的党派性增加了执法频率，但平均降低了罚款严重程度；唯一的例外是民主党占多数的委员会面对共和党倾向企业时，党派性会显著提高罚款金额。股票市场对这一执法风险有定价反应：共和党倾向企业在民主党委员提名时遭遇负的异常收益，而其他配对组合无明显反应。
AI.research_question: 工作场所监管机构（EEOC）的党派性如何随时间和人员构成变化，以及党派性如何影响执法行为（执法频率和罚款严重程度）和资本市场定价？
AI.motivation: 监管机构的党派性可能影响其执法行为，但现有研究难以直接测量监管者的党派倾向。EEOC作为重要的职场监管机构，其党派性对劳动力市场和企业的执行风险具有重大影响，理解其党派性来源及后果对监管政策和企业决策均具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政治两极化理论、监管执法理论以及资本市场信息定价理论，探讨监管机构党派性对执法行为的影响及其市场定价效应。
AI.method: 采用基于语言的机器学习方法，对2001-2023年EEOC会议记录进行文本分析以测量委员的党派倾向；结合EEOC执法数据考察党派性对执法频率和罚款严重程度的影响；利用事件研究法分析资本市场对委员提名事件的异常收益反应。
AI.findings: （1）EEOC党派性自2009年以来显著上升，主要由更两极分化的委员任命驱动；（2）更高党派性增加执法频率但平均降低罚款严重程度；（3）唯一例外是民主党多数委员会面对共和党倾向企业时，党派性显著提高罚款金额；（4）股票市场对执法风险有定价反应：共和党倾向企业在民主党委员提名时遭遇负异常收益，其他配对无显著反应。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次系统测量监管机构党派性的动态变化，区分了委员任命效应与个人内变化效应；（2）揭示了党派性对执法行为影响的异质性，表明党派性并非简单提高或降低处罚，而是具有方向性和选择性；（3）将监管执法政治化与资本市场定价联系起来，扩展了政治与金融交叉领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为企业评估监管执法风险提供了新视角，特别是政治倾向与企业执法风险的匹配问题；（2）为政策制定者理解监管机构党派构成对执法行为的影响提供了实证依据；（3）为投资者在监管机构人事变动时进行风险管理提供了参考信号。

title: A Critical Review of Early Childhood Digital Media Guidelines: Evaluating Risks and Adequacy for Children Aged 0-5
affiliations: , New York University (NYU), New York University (NYU) - New York University and New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: A Critical Review of Early Childhood Digital Media Guidelines: Evaluating Risks and Adequacy for Children Aged 0-5

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Jonathan Haidt reports receiving royalties from books and honoraria for speaking engagements. His nonprofit activities are supported by philanthropic funding, including Bancel Philanthropies, the Walton Family Foundation, the Courage and Civility Award, and other charitable donors. He has served as an expert witness on social media and adolescent mental health (pro bono). Zach Rausch reports receiving honoraria for speaking engagements. The other authors report no conflicts.
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: The television era has been replaced by an ecosystem of mobile, interactive, and algorithmic digital technologies. Despite these radical shifts, current digital media guidelines for young children appear to be more lenient and abstract than they were in the late-1990s. The World Health Organization and multiple governmental organizations generally recommend avoiding screens under age two and limiting exposure to one hour daily for those aged two to five, although some guidelines permit the introduction of digital media before age two. However, research assessing the developmental appropriateness of these guidelines remains scarce, leaving a critical gap in our understanding of whether current guidelines are safe. Therefore, the aim of this paper is to provide a critical review of the current digital media landscape and the adequacy of existing clinical guidelines for children aged 0-5. We first establish the current prevalence and patterns of digital media exposure, highlighting the shift toward mobile devices and streaming platforms (section 2). Next, we synthesize the existing literature on mobile media use across four developmental domains: cognition, language, socio-emotional behavior, and physical health (section 3). We then provide a comparative analysis of national and international digital media guidelines (section 4), and offer a critical evaluation of these guidelines (section 5).

AI.tldr: 本文对0-5岁儿童数字媒体使用现状及现有临床指南的适宜性进行了批判性综述，发现现行的数字媒体指南（如WHO建议）可能比1990年代末更为宽松和模糊，而关于这些指南是否对儿童发展安全的研究证据仍然匮乏。
AI.research_question: 当前针对0-5岁儿童的数字媒体指南是否充分且适宜？现有指南是否基于充分的发展适宜性研究证据？
AI.motivation: 电视时代已被移动、交互和算法驱动的数字技术生态系统取代，但幼儿数字媒体指南却比1990年代末更为宽松和抽象。WHO及多个政府机构建议2岁以下避免屏幕、2-5岁每天限制1小时，但评估这些指南发展适宜性的研究甚少，留下关键的知识空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 儿童发展心理学框架，涵盖认知、语言、社会情绪行为及身体健康四个发展领域。
AI.method: 批判性综述（Critical Review），包括：（1）梳理数字媒体暴露的流行率与模式；（2）综合移动媒体使用对四个发展领域影响的现有文献；（3）对国内和国际数字媒体指南进行比较分析；（4）对这些指南进行批判性评估。
AI.findings: 数字媒体使用已从电视转向移动设备和流媒体平台；现有指南的适宜性缺乏充分的发展研究证据支持，可能不足以应对新数字媒体生态下的儿童发展风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了现有数字媒体指南与发展适宜性研究之间的知识空白，为评估指南安全性提供了综述性理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和临床从业者重新审视和修订幼儿数字媒体使用指南提供证据基础，帮助确定现有指南是否安全及其改进方向。

title: Large-Scale Travel Demand Model Validation Using Mobile-Derived Origin-Destination Demand: A Case Study in Alberta, Canada
affiliations: Government of Alberta, Government of Alberta, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Government of Alberta

detail.title: Large-Scale Travel Demand Model Validation Using Mobile-Derived Origin-Destination Demand: A Case Study in Alberta, Canada
detail.abstract: Travel demand models are traditionally validated against observed traffic counts; however, the increasing availability of mobile device data offers an opportunity to complement conventional validation approaches. This study presents a multi-source statistical framework for validating the Alberta Spatial Economic Transport (ASET) model using three complementary data sources: household survey-based model forecasts, mobile device-derived demand, and observed traffic counts. AM peak-period and daily link volumes were evaluated at 150 roadway locations distributed across six screenlines and three cordons in Alberta, Canada. Model performance was assessed using the GEH statistic, root mean square error (RMSE), mean absolute error (MAE), coefficient of determination (R2), volume-group RMSE, and screenline and cordon volume ratios. Nonparametric bootstrap resampling was used to estimate 95% confidence intervals for R2, RMSE, and MAE, while paired bootstrap differences and statistical tests were used to compare the predictive performance of the household survey-based and mobile-derived demand estimates. Results showed that both demand sources produced comparable agreement with observed traffic counts, with similar error measures, overlapping confidence intervals, and no statistically significant difference in predictive accuracy. Because both demand datasets were assigned to the same network, the comparison primarily reflects differences in OD demand rather than differences arising from network coding or route-choice representation. The findings indicate that mobile-derived demand can serve as a complementary source for regional model validation and provide additional information for locations, corridors, and travel markets where conventional data are limited. The proposed framework offers a practical and transferable approach for multi-source validation of regional travel demand models.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个多源统计验证框架，利用手机设备数据、家庭调查数据模型预测和观测交通量三种数据源，对加拿大阿尔伯塔省ASET区域出行需求模型进行验证。结果表明手机数据与家庭调查数据在预测精度上无显著差异，可作为区域模型验证的补充数据源。
AI.research_question: 手机设备数据能否作为传统家庭调查数据的补充，用于区域出行需求模型的多源验证？
AI.motivation: 传统出行需求模型仅依赖观测交通量进行验证，但手机设备数据的日益普及提供了补充传统验证方法的机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多源统计验证框架，基于GEH统计量、RMSE、MAE、R²等统计指标，结合非参数bootstrap重采样方法进行不确定性估计和模型比较。
AI.method: 在加拿大阿尔伯塔省6条切线和3条环线的150个道路位置评估AM高峰时段和日交通量；使用GEH、RMSE、MAE、R²、分体积组RMSE及切线/环线体积比评估模型性能；采用非参数bootstrap重采样估计95%置信区间，并通过配对bootstrap差异和统计检验比较两种需求数据的预测性能。
AI.findings: 两种需求数据源（家庭调查和手机派生）与观测交通量的一致性相当，误差指标相似，置信区间重叠，预测精度无统计显著差异。由于两种需求数据集分配在同一网络，比较主要反映OD需求差异而非网络编码或路径选择差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个可转移的多源验证框架，证明手机派生需求数据可作为区域出行需求模型验证的补充数据源，尤其适用于传统数据有限的地点、走廊和出行市场。
AI.practical_contributions: 为区域交通规划机构提供了一种实用且可迁移的多源验证方法，帮助在传统数据不足的场景下补充模型验证信息。

title: Short-Term Gains, Long-Term Losses: The Microeconomic Consequences of Child Labor

detail.title: Short-Term Gains, Long-Term Losses: The Microeconomic Consequences of Child Labor
detail.abstract: This paper develops a two-period microeconomic model of the household allocation of a child's time between labor and schooling when occupational harm is imperfectly perceived. The model distinguishes the objective occupational risk that determines realized adult health capital from the perceived risk that guides the parental decision. Actual and perceived health are derived state variables, while child labor is the sole choice variable. Under the stated conditions, strict concavity ensures the existence of a unique optimum, with an asymptotically stable interior solution. The comparative statics show that income transfers, schooling-contingent support, enforcement, and the correction of risk underestimation reduce child labor. By contrast, improved workplace safety may increase child labor by lowering its perceived marginal health cost, while educational productivity is neutral in the baseline specification. Underestimating occupational harm leads to excessive child labor and a welfare loss relative to the fullinformation allocation. Rather than estimating causal effects, the study derives analytical propositions and empirically testable predictions. Conditional on the model's assumptions, information, enforcement, and income or schooling support may be complementary, whereas safety improvements, despite protecting health per unit of labor, need not reduce child labor or unambiguously improve total health.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个两期微观经济模型，分析家庭在儿童劳动与教育之间分配时间时，对职业危害的认知不完美所产生的影响。模型区分了决定实际成人健康资本的客观职业风险与指导父母决策的感知风险。研究发现，收入转移、教育挂钩支持、执法以及纠正风险低估均能减少童工；但改善工作场所安全反而可能因降低感知边际健康成本而增加童工。风险低估会导致过度童工和福利损失。
AI.research_question: 当职业危害被不完美感知时，家庭如何在儿童劳动与教育之间分配时间？客观风险与感知风险的差异如何影响童工决策和福利结果？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常假设家庭能够完美感知童工的职业健康风险，但现实中父母往往低估或误判这些风险。作者旨在建立一个理论模型，揭示感知风险与实际风险的偏离如何导致偏离最优的童工配置，并评估各类政策干预的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两期微观经济模型；人力资本理论；风险感知理论（感知风险与客观风险分离）；家庭效用最大化框架
AI.method: 构建两期微观经济模型，以童工劳动为唯一选择变量，实际健康与感知健康为衍生状态变量。通过严格凹性确保唯一最优解的存在，采用比较静态分析推导各政策参数对童工的影响方向，并推导可检验的实证命题。
AI.findings: （1）收入转移、教育挂钩支持、执法和纠正风险低估均能减少童工；（2）改善工作场所安全可能通过降低感知边际健康成本而增加童工；（3）教育生产率在基准设定中对童工影响中性；（4）低估职业危害导致过度童工和相对于完全信息配置的福利损失；（5）信息、执法和收入/教育支持可能具有互补性，而安全改善虽保护单位劳动健康，但未必减少童工或无条件改善总体健康。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在童工与教育分配模型中正式区分客观职业风险与感知风险，揭示感知偏差如何导致偏离最优配置；对“改善工作场所安全必然有利”的传统直觉提出理论挑战，为政策分析提供了更精细的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供可检验的预测：矫正风险认知误判、提供信息干预、强化执法和收入/教育支持可有效减少童工；提醒安全改善政策需谨慎设计，因可能产生意外的增加童工效应。

title: Inferring Probabilistic Route Choice without Observed Trajectories: A Network-Constrained Latent Route Framework
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University and Pennsylvania State University

detail.title: Inferring Probabilistic Route Choice without Observed Trajectories: A Network-Constrained Latent Route Framework
detail.abstract: Large mobility systems often record origins, destinations, and trip durations without observing the paths traveled between them, limiting route-level analysis of network environments and infrastructure. This study develops a network-constrained latent route-choice framework that estimates posterior probabilities over plausible bicycle routes from repeated origin-destination and elapsed-time records. Candidate choice sets are generated from multiple network cost functions representing distance, bicycle infrastructure, and lower-stress street conditions, then evaluated through a route-utility model and route-specific LogNormal travel-time likelihoods. The framework is applied to 107,218 Citi Bike trips across 82 directional origin-destination pairs in New York City. Probabilistic multi-route models outperform a deterministic shortest-path benchmark, while individual-trip posteriors retain considerable uncertainty. Controlled recovery experiments show strong recovery of origin-destination route shares and model parameters under the fitted data-generating process; aggregate route-share recovery remains high under added unobserved delay, although utility-parameter recovery weakens under severe misspecification. A bicycle-counter comparison provides an independent temporal plausibility check for posterior-weighted route activity. Empirically, bicycle-infrastructure share has a stronger positive association with inferred route probability under darkness, and the distance penalty weakens during peak periods. Casual trips receive greater posterior probability on a residual/un-enumerated component even after systematic duration differences are incorporated. Bicycle-type interactions are comparatively weak. These results show how transaction-based mobility records can support uncertainty-preserving analysis of route-level geographic behavior and infrastructure exposure while defining clear limits on individual trajectory inference.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个网络约束的潜在路径选择框架，从重复的起点-终点和行程时长记录中估计可行自行车路线上的后验概率，应用于纽约市Citi Bike的107,218次出行，发现概率多路线模型优于确定性最短路径基准，但个人出行后验仍存在相当的不确定性。
AI.research_question: 如何在仅拥有起点、终点和行程时长记录（缺乏实际路径观测）的大规模出行系统中，估计出行者在可行自行车路线上的后验概率，以支持路线层面的网络环境和基础设施分析？
AI.motivation: 大型出行系统通常记录起点、终点和行程时长，但不观测实际出行路径，这限制了路线层面的网络环境和基础设施分析。需要一种方法从有限的交易记录中推断可能的路线选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络约束的潜在路线选择框架：结合候选路径集生成（基于多种网络成本函数即距离、自行车基础设施、低压力街道条件）、路线效用模型、路线特定的LogNormal行程时长似然函数，以及贝叶斯后验推断。
AI.method: 从多种网络成本函数生成候选路径选择集，通过路线效用模型和路线特定LogNormal行程时长似然进行评价；应用蒙特卡洛/贝叶斯推断估计后验概率；通过对照恢复实验和自行车计数器验证进行模型验证。
AI.findings: (1) 概率多路线模型优于确定性最短路径基准；(2) 个人行程后验仍存在较大不确定性；(3) 在拟合数据生成过程下，OD路线份额和模型参数恢复良好；(4) 在新增未观测延误下，路线份额恢复仍较高，但严重设定错误下参数恢复减弱；(5) 黑暗中自行车基础设施份额与推断路线概率的正向关联更强，高峰期距离惩罚减弱；(6) 休闲出行在后验概率上获得更大的残余/未枚举路线成分；(7) 自行车类型交互效应较弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个在缺乏实际路径观测条件下进行路线推断的框架，明确界定了个人轨迹推断的局限性，支持不确定性保留的路线层面地理行为和基础设施暴露分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交通系统运营商和城市规划者提供了一种利用现有交易记录（如共享单车出行数据）进行路线级基础设施分析和网络环境评估的方法，并通过自行车计数器验证了其时间层面的可信度。

title: Climate-security early Warning Systems: Integrating Environmental Risk Data into National Governance Frameworks
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Climate-security early Warning Systems: Integrating Environmental Risk Data into National Governance Frameworks
detail.abstract: In vulnerable developing regions, environmental deterioration brought on by climate change poses a systemic danger to institutional capability and socioeconomic stability. The crucial gap between the gathering of predictive climate data and practical, state-level policy solutions is examined in this policy brief. The early warning systems in place today often function in technical silos and put short-term emergency catastrophe response ahead of long-term risk mitigation for climate security. This short illustrates how fragmented data-sharing systems and underfunded municipal institutions worsen resource rivalry, regional displacement, and state fragility by examining current environmental governance frameworks and international climate finance streams. Three strategic policy interventions are suggested to close this implementation gap: mandating institutional climate-security risk evaluations across standard public expenditure frameworks; decentralizing adaptation funding systems directly to municipal governance units; and creating centralized, inter-ministerial climate data clearinghouses. To promote sustained state resilience against climatic shocks, climate intelligence must be realigned with proactive governance frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文是一份政策简报，探讨气候变化引发的环境恶化对脆弱发展中国家制度能力和社会经济稳定性的系统性威胁。文章指出预测性气候数据收集与实际州级政策解决方案之间存在关键落差，当前早期预警系统常陷入技术孤岛，侧重短期紧急救灾而非长期气候安全风险缓解。作者提出三项战略政策干预：将气候安全风险评估纳入公共支出框架、将适应资金直接下放至市政治理单位、建立跨部门的中央气候数据交换中心，从而将气候情报与前瞻性治理框架重新对齐，促进国家韧性。
AI.research_question: 如何弥合预测性气候数据与州级政策解决方案之间的实施差距，以增强脆弱发展中国家应对气候冲击的制度韧性？
AI.motivation: 在脆弱的发展中地区，气候变化引发的环境恶化对制度能力和社会经济稳定构成系统性威胁；现有早期预警系统在技术孤岛中运作，优先短期应急响应而忽视长期气候安全风险减缓，导致资源竞争、区域流离失所和国家脆弱性加剧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候安全治理理论、环境治理框架、国际气候金融流动分析、制度能力与国家韧性理论
AI.method: 政策简报方法，基于对现有环境治理框架和国际气候金融流量的审查分析，识别气候数据与政策执行之间的实施差距。
AI.findings: 碎片化的数据共享系统和资金不足的市政机构加剧了资源竞争、区域流离失所和国家脆弱性；现有早期预警系统在技术孤岛上运作，优先短期紧急救灾而非长期风险减缓。
AI.theory_contributions: 将气候情报重新定位为前瞻性治理框架的核心要素，强调气候安全风险评估应嵌入标准公共支出流程，拓展了气候治理与制度韧性关系的理论认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出三项可操作的政策干预方案：将气候安全风险评估纳入公共支出框架、将适应资金下放至市政治理单位、建立跨部门中央气候数据交换中心，为发展中国家气候政策制定提供具体路径。

title: Book Review: The Human-Machine Team: How to Create Synergy Between Human and Artificial Intelligence that will Revolutionize our World

detail.title: Book Review: The Human-Machine Team: How to Create Synergy Between Human and Artificial Intelligence that will Revolutionize our World
detail.abstract: In May 2021 a short ebook on artificial intelligence (AI) and national security appeared under the pen name "Brigadier General Y.S.", and attracted little attention. By April 2024 The Guardian had identified the author as Yossi Sariel, then commander of Israel's signals intelligence Unit 8200, while Israeli reporting had connected the book's central proposition-a machine generating military targets at industrial scale-to systems reportedly used in Gaza. 1 The book is not good scholarship, nor does it need to be. It is doctrine in all but name: written by a serving collection chief, published without formal review, and now readable against the operational record of the organization he led. Intelligence studies seldom gets to read a commander's stated epistemology before observing his service perform against it.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了一本由以色列信号情报部队8200部队指挥官Yossi Sariel以笔名撰写的关于AI与国家安全的小册子，该书提出了AI大规模生成军事目标的核心命题，其实际应用已与加沙行动中使用的系统相关联。本文将其视为一种事实上的军事条令，通过与部队实际作战记录对照来检验其认识论主张。
AI.research_question: 如何通过一本由情报部队指挥官撰写的非正式出版物，理解AI在军事目标生成中的实际应用及其认识论基础？
AI.motivation: 情报研究很少有机会在观察到指挥官所领导部队的实际表现之前，就能读到其公开阐述的认识论立场。该书提供了这一独特窗口，使其可以与8200部队在加沙的实际作战记录进行对照分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该文以情报研究（Intelligence Studies）为学科基础，关注军事条令的认识论维度，即指挥官如何理解知识生产与目标生成的逻辑。
AI.method: 文本分析：对Sariel的电子书进行细读，并结合以色列媒体报道及8200部队在加沙的作战记录进行对照验证。
AI.findings: 该书虽非严谨学术作品，但作为事实上的军事条令具有重要分析价值；其核心命题——AI以工业规模生成军事目标——与加沙实际使用的系统存在关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 为情报研究提供了一个罕见的案例：在可观察的作战实践之前获得指挥官的认识论声明，从而拓展了情报研究中关于军事条令与认识论分析的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了AI在军事目标生成中的实际应用逻辑，对理解现代战争中的自动化决策和情报作战实践具有重要参考价值。

title: Impact of the 2023 Nuclear Phase-Out in Germany on Renewable Energy Integration
affiliations: , University of Munich (LMU) and University of Bayreuth

detail.title: Impact of the 2023 Nuclear Phase-Out in Germany on Renewable Energy Integration
detail.abstract: Does nuclear energy facilitate the decarbonization of the electricity system or is it incompatible with renewable energy? In this study, we analyze the impact of the 2023 nuclear phase-out in Germany on the integration of renewable energies. We first build a comprehensive dataset of geolocalized redispatch measures on the transmission level by technology. We then use regression analysis to identify the causal effect of the nuclear phase-out on redispatch measures. Specifically, we analyze the 'load-flow effect', holding supply of zero marginal cost constant, as well as the 'market-adjusted effect', controlling for similar market situations characterized by renewable energy infeed and load. We find that, in our main specification, the nuclear phaseout increased redispatch by 1,200 MW and 800 MW, respectively. These were primarily caused by current-related measures. We further find that offshore wind and lignite were particularly affected by curtailments while hard coal and gas were ramped up to compensate for production decreases, leading to an additional 103 t of CO2 per 15min market interval. Geographically, we find that curtailments particularly increased in the North and East of Germany, while rampups were concentrated in the West. Finally, we analyze the impact of the nuclear phase-out by market situation and find that increases were particularly notable in hours with high wind infeed while redispatch decreased in market intervals with high solar infeed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了德国2023年核能逐步淘汰对可再生能源整合的影响，通过构建地理定位的再调度数据集和回归分析，发现核淘汰增加了约1,200 MW和800 MW的再调度量，主要由电流相关措施造成，同时导致额外二氧化碳排放和特定地区的削减增加。
AI.research_question: 核能淘汰是否促进还是阻碍了电力系统的脱碳？德国2023年核淘汰对可再生能源整合产生了怎样的因果影响？
AI.motivation: 核能与可再生能源在电力系统脱碳中的兼容性存在争议，而德国2023年核淘汰为评估核能退出对可再生能源整合的实际影响提供了独特自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于电力系统调度理论，区分了"负荷潮流效应"（保持零边际成本供给不变）和"市场调整效应"（控制可再生能源馈入和负荷等类似市场条件）两种分析框架。
AI.method: 构建了按技术分类的地理定位输电级再调度综合数据集，采用回归分析识别核淘汰的因果效应。
AI.findings: 核淘汰使再调度增加1,200 MW（主规格）和800 MW，主要由电流相关措施导致；海上风电和褐煤受削减影响最大，硬煤和天然气被启动以补偿产量下降，每个15分钟市场间隔额外排放103吨CO2；削减主要集中在德国北部和东部，西部则集中启动；高风电时段再调度增加显著，而高太阳能时段再调度减少。
AI.theory_contributions: 为核能与可再生能源兼容性辩论提供了实证证据，揭示了核淘汰对电网再调度和可再生能源整合的因果影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了核淘汰对电网运行、碳排放和可再生能源整合影响的量化评估，有助于其他国家在能源转型决策中参考。

title: Pakistan-Russia Trade: A Policy Roadmap for Eurasian Connectivity under Geopolitical Shocks: A Structural Gravity Assessment of Tariff Structure, Settlement Frictions, and Unrealised Trade Potential

detail.title: Pakistan-Russia Trade: A Policy Roadmap for Eurasian Connectivity under Geopolitical Shocks: A Structural Gravity Assessment of Tariff Structure, Settlement Frictions, and Unrealised Trade Potential
detail.abstract: Pakistan and Russia sustain a commercial relationship whose realised value sits far below what economic fundamentals predict, and the gap has become a question of first order importance as Eurasian trade architecture reorganises. This study assembles a balanced panel of Pakistan's trade with 44 partners over 2010 to 2024, full HS4 tariff schedules in both directions covering 2019 to 2023, sectoral composition with product complexity, and world commodity price series, and estimates a structural gravity system by Poisson pseudo maximum likelihood across five specifications. Bilateral trade attains only 18.2 percent of its gravity predicted level over 2018 to 2021, rising to 20.6 percent over 2022 to 2024, an improvement of 13.2 percent that stands against contraction along the Belarusian and Ukrainian corridors. Decomposition against the world wheat price shows that 62 percent of the apparent 60 percent surge in Pakistani imports reflects price rather than volume. Tariffs prove a weak constraint: the product level tariff to trade association is statistically insignificant, while shared colonial network membership carries a coefficient of-4.334 and European preference access registers no measurable effect. Settlement infrastructure, not protection, binds. Regional trade agreement membership is associated with trade expansion of 108 to 283 percent, which frames Pakistani accession to BRICS as a quantifiable opportunity.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过结构引力模型分析了2010-2024年巴基斯坦与44个贸易伙伴的双边贸易，发现巴俄双边贸易仅达到引力模型预测水平的18-21%，远低于经济基本面所预示的水平。研究反驳了关税是主要障碍的假设，指出结算基础设施而非贸易保护是制约双边贸易的关键因素，并量化了巴基斯坦加入金砖国家的潜在贸易收益。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦与俄罗斯的双边贸易为何远低于经济基本面所预测的水平？制约双边贸易的关键因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 巴俄商业关系的实际价值远低于经济基本面预测，这一差距在欧亚贸易架构重组背景下成为首要问题；同时需要区分价格效应与数量效应、识别真正的贸易制约因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构引力模型（Structural Gravity Model），泊松伪最大似然估计（PPML）
AI.method: 构建2010-2024年巴基斯坦与44个贸易伙伴的平衡面板数据，整合HS4关税计划（2019-2023）、产品复杂度部门构成和世界大宗商品价格序列，通过PPML估计结构引力系统，采用五种规格设定。
AI.findings: （1）巴俄双边贸易仅达引力预测水平的18.2%（2018-2021），2022-2024年升至20.6%（改善13.2%）；（2）巴基斯坦进口60%的名义增长中62%源于价格效应而非数量效应；（3）关税与贸易关联在统计上不显著，殖民网络系数为-4.334，欧洲优惠准入无显著效应；（4）区域贸易协定成员身份与贸易扩张108-283%相关。（5）结算基础设施而非贸易保护是主要制约因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了关税保护是国际贸易主要障碍的传统假设，提出并验证了结算基础设施作为贸易制约因素的重要性；通过引力模型分解价格效应与数量效应，深化了对名义贸易增长的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦与俄罗斯贸易政策提供实证依据，量化了巴基斯坦加入金砖国家的潜在贸易收益（108-283%），指出改善结算基础设施而非降低关税是促进双边贸易的关键政策方向。

title: Did Five Consecutive Small Annual Tobacco-Tax Increases In Japan Promote Cessation Or Shift Smokers To Heated Tobacco Products? A Longitudinal Cohort Study , 2017–2025
affiliations: Tohoku University, Tohoku University and Osaka International Cancer Institute

detail.title: Did Five Consecutive Small Annual Tobacco-Tax Increases In Japan Promote Cessation Or Shift Smokers To Heated Tobacco Products? A Longitudinal Cohort Study , 2017–2025

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study protocol was reviewed and approved by the Research Ethics Committee of the Osaka International Cancer Institute (most recent approval number 1611079163-3, granted on 13 March 2023) and the National Institute of Public Health (NIPH-IBRA#12112). All participants provided web-based informed consent before responding to the online questionnaire.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was supported by the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS) KAKENHI Grants (grant numbers 17H03589, 18H03062, 18H03107, 19H01073, 19H01074, 19H03860, 19K10446, 19K10671, 19K13704, 19K19439, 20H00040, 20K10467, 20K19633, 21H03203, 21H04856, 23K21579, 24H00663, 25K20591), the JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowships for Research Abroad, Health Labour Sciences Research Grants (grant numbers 19FA1005, 19FA1012, 19FG2001, 20F1005, 20EA1017, 20FA2001, 21HA2016, 22FA1001, 22FA1002, 22FA1010, 22FA2001, 22JA1005, 23EA1009, 23FA1004, 23JA1003), the Japan Agency for Medical Research and Development (AMED; grant number 2033648), JST Grant (JPMJPF2017), the Research Support Program to Apply the Wisdom of the University to tackle COVID-19 Related Emergency Problems, University of Tsukuba, the intramural fund of the National Institute for Environmental Studies, and the research programme on “Using Health Metrics to Monitor and Evaluate the Impact of Health Policies” conducted at the Tokyo Foundation for Policy Research.

detail.abstract:
Background: Evidence that tobacco taxation promotes cessation comes mainly from large single increases. Japan raised tobacco taxes in five small annual steps between October 2018 and October 2022, equalising excise tax on heated tobacco products (HTPs) with cigarettes in 2022. We examined whether they promoted cessation or product switching. 

Methods: We paired consecutive annual waves (2017-2025) of the Japan “Society and New Tobacco” Internet Survey and assigned each to one of seven tax-period categories, with 2022-23 as reference. Among baseline current smokers we estimated adjusted odds ratios (aORs) for cessation and product transitions with generalised estimating equations and inverse-probability-of-censoring weights. 

Findings:  Among 22 062 wave-pairs from 8160 current smokers, cessation occurred in 5·1% in the reference period and was higher in the three periods when cigarette prices rose, at 8·2% in 2018 (aOR 1·72, 95% CI 1·33-2·22), 10·8% in 2019 (2·27, 1·80-2·85), and 8·4% in 2020-21 (1·74, 1·40-2·16), but not during the 2022 HTP equalisation (6·3%, 1·10, 0·87-1·39). The 2018 and 2019 periods shifted cigarette-only smokers toward dual use (aOR 3·83 and 4·97), whereas the 2022 equalisation reduced transitions to HTP-only (0·59, 0·38-0·91) and dual use (0·64, 0·47-0·87). 

Interpretation: Small staged increases that raised cigarette prices were associated with increased cessation, but part of the response was switching to dual use. Equalising HTP and cigarette taxes curbed switching without increasing cessation. Tax design across products shapes where smokers move, not only whether they quit.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用日本2017-2025年连续年度网络调查数据，分析了2018-2022年间五次小规模年度烟草税上调对戒烟和产品转换的影响。研究发现，提高卷烟价格的几次增税显著促进了戒烟（OR值1.72-2.27），但也促使部分吸烟者转向双用（卷烟+加热烟草）。而2022年加热烟草与卷烟税率拉平的政策虽抑制了产品转换，但并未进一步增加戒烟率。
AI.research_question: 日本2018-2022年间五次小规模年度烟草税上调是否促进了戒烟或产品转换？特别是2022年加热烟草产品与卷烟税率拉平政策的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 现有证据表明烟草税收促进戒烟主要来自大规模一次性增税，但日本采取了独特的五次小规模年度阶梯式增税方式，且包含了加热烟草与卷烟税率拉平的政策调整，这为检验小规模增税和跨产品税制设计对吸烟行为的影响提供了独特自然实验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于烟草税经济学理论，税收通过提高烟草产品价格影响消费者行为，包括戒烟决策和产品替代选择。研究将税收政策设计区分为卷烟提价与跨产品税率拉平两种机制，分别考察其对戒烟和产品转换的影响。
AI.method: 使用日本"社会与新烟草"互联网调查2017-2025年连续年度数据，配对相邻年度调查波次，将观察分配到七个税期类别（以2022-23年为参照）。采用广义估计方程和逆概率加权处理失访偏倚，估计基线当前吸烟者的戒烟与产品转换的调整后优势比。
AI.findings: 在22062个波次配对（来自8160名当前吸烟者）中，参照期戒烟率为5.1%。卷烟价格上调的三个时期戒烟率显著升高：2018年8.2%（aOR 1.72）、2019年10.8%（aOR 2.27）、2020-21年8.4%（aOR 1.74）；但2022年HTP税率拉平时期戒烟率无显著变化（6.3%，aOR 1.10）。2018和2019年增税促使纯卷烟吸烟者转向双用（aOR 3.83和4.97），而2022年拉平政策显著减少了向HTP-only和双用的转换（aOR 0.59和0.64）。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究拓展了烟草税理论中关于税制设计影响的理论框架，证明跨产品税率结构（而非仅绝对税负水平）对吸烟者行为具有独立影响。小规模阶梯式增税也能有效促进戒烟，且税率拉平可以抑制产品替代但不会额外促进戒烟，揭示了税收政策设计中"促成戒烟"与"引导产品选择"两个维度可分离的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了小规模阶梯式增税有效性的实证证据，支持发展中国家可在政治可行性约束下采用渐进税率调整。同时提示跨产品税率拉平虽可防止吸烟者转向低税替代品，但需要配套戒烟支持措施以真正提升戒烟率。为烟草税制设计中卷烟与其他烟草制品（如加热烟草）的税率差异化策略提供了关键实证依据。

title: Research on Han Nationalism in China in the 2020s (I): Examining the Narrative Contest between Han Nationalism and State Nationalism through the Withdrawal of the Film The Battle of Penghu

detail.title: Research on Han Nationalism in China in the 2020s (I): Examining the Narrative Contest between Han Nationalism and State Nationalism through the Withdrawal of the Film The Battle of Penghu
detail.abstract: Taking the withdrawal of the 2026 film The Battle of Penghu as a point of entry, this article explores the rise of Han nationalist ideology within Chinese society in the 2020s, and the increasingly prominent divergences in orientation between it and the officially led "Chinese nationalism (state nationalism)." The article analyzes the institutional roots of Han nationalism during a period of economic zero-sum competition, its contestation of historical narratives in the sphere of popular culture, and its comprehensive deconstruction of the official discursive system on core issues such as the definition of the nation, historical orthodoxy, and territorial legality.

AI.tldr: 本文以2026年电影《澎湖战役》撤档为切入点，探讨2020年代中国社会中汉族民族主义意识形态的兴起，以及其与官方主导的"中国民族主义（国家民族主义）"之间日益显著的方向性分歧，分析了经济零和竞争时期汉族民族主义的制度根源、在流行文化领域对历史叙事的争夺，以及对国家定义、历史正统、领土合法性等核心问题上官方话语体系的全面解构。
AI.research_question: 2020年代中国社会汉族民族主义的兴起有何制度根源？它与官方主导的国家民族主义之间存在怎样的分歧与张力？
AI.motivation: 以2026年电影《澎湖战役》撤档这一具体文化事件为切入点，揭示汉族民族主义与官方国家民族主义之间的深层分歧，填补对当代中国民族主义内部多元性与异质性研究的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民族主义理论（汉族民族主义 vs 国家民族主义/官方民族主义）、制度分析理论、历史叙事与话语权理论、领土合法性理论
AI.method: 以电影撤档事件为案例切入点，结合制度分析、文化领域话语分析以及对官方话语体系的解构性文本分析。
AI.findings: 经济零和竞争时期催生了汉族民族主义的制度性土壤；汉族民族主义在流行文化领域积极争夺历史叙事话语权；汉族民族主义对国家定义、历史正统和领土合法性等核心议题上全面解构官方话语体系，与官方国家民族主义产生显著分歧。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了汉族民族主义与国家民族主义之间的内在张力与分歧，丰富了对当代中国民族主义多元面向的理论理解，深化了对经济竞争格局下民族主义产生与演变的制度分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于理解当代中国文化-政治领域民族主义话语的复杂生态，为观察官方话语与民间/族群民族主义之间的互动关系提供分析框架。

This paper was written independently, in the author's personal capacity and on the author's own time, and does not represent the views of any employer or client. All organisations referenced are named for identification and commentary purposes only.

detail.abstract:
Corporate actions and proxy voting are conventionally treated as separate operational domains — staffed separately, systematized separately, and governed separately. This paper argues they are the same distribution problem solved twice: a single entitlement chain of five stages, running from issuer to beneficial owner, in which origination, canonicalization, position truth, instruction integrity and evidence must each hold for the outcome to be correct.

That argument acquires urgency in 2026, when both halves of the chain lost their stabilizing anchor at once. On the corporate actions side, the ISO 20022 migration became a dated decommissioning schedule rather than a strategic choice, arriving alongside settlement compression that removed the buffer in which entitlement discrepancies were previously resolved. On the proxy side, the proxy-advisor benchmark policy is being unbundled, the largest index managers split their stewardship functions, and the SEC withdrew from substantive Rule 14a-8 no-action review — removing the neutral referee that made proposal exclusion predictable. Forecastability, not cost, became the scarce commodity.

The paper introduces four original analytical frameworks: a five-layer Entitlement Chain Integrity model, an associated maturity model, a seven-class corporate actions failure taxonomy, and a five-component cost stack. It examines tokenized recordkeeping, pass-through voting, dual stewardship teams and agentic automation, and sets out playbooks by institution type. Written from two decades of practitioner experience in capital markets operations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出公司行为和代理投票本质上是同一分配问题被解决了两次——即从发行人到受益所有人之间的一条五阶段权益链。文章在2026年特殊背景下（ISO 20022迁移、结算压缩、代理顾问基准政策拆分、SEC退出14a-8无异议审查等）引入四个原创分析框架（五层权益链完整性模型、成熟度模型、七类公司行为失败分类法、五组件成本栈），并探讨了代币化记账、穿透投票、双治理团队及代理自动化等实践方案。
AI.research_question: 公司行为和代理投票为何本质上是同一分配问题的两个侧面？在2026年双重去稳定化环境下，如何系统性地理解和修复这条权益链的完整性？
AI.motivation: 公司行为和代理投票在运营上被分而治之，但事实上共享同一条五阶段权益链。2026年，两个领域同时失去了各自的稳定锚点（公司行为侧的ISO 20022迁移和结算压缩，代理侧的顾问基准政策拆分、管理人分拆和SEC退出审查），使可预测性取代成本成为稀缺资源，亟需统一的理论框架加以应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 五层权益链完整性模型（Entitlement Chain Integrity model）：涵盖发起、规范化、持仓真实性、指令完整性和证据五个阶段；配套的成熟度模型。
AI.method: 基于二十年资本市场运营从业经验的定性分析，提出四个原创分析框架（五层权益链完整性模型、成熟度模型、七类公司行为失败分类法、五组件成本栈），并考察代币化记账、穿透投票、双治理团队和代理自动化等具体方案，按机构类型制定行动手册。
AI.findings: 公司行为和代理投票共享单一权益链的五个必备环节，任一环节失效都导致结果错误；2026年双重去稳定化使可预测性成为最稀缺资源；传统分离式治理在结构性压力下不可持续，需要统一框架下的系统性应对。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将公司行为和代理投票统一纳入单一权益链理论框架，提出四套原创分析工具（权益链完整性模型、成熟度模型、失败分类法、成本栈），为两者在概念和实践上的整合提供了新的理论语言。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同机构类型（发行人、托管行、资产管理人、代理顾问等）提供具体的行动手册；考察代币化记账、穿透投票、双治理团队和代理自动化等前沿实践方案，帮助从业者在预测性稀缺的2026年环境中做出战略决策。

title: Voter Backlash against Climate Policies? The Case of European Elections in the Netherlands Period 1989-2024
affiliations: Wageningen University

detail.title: Voter Backlash against Climate Policies? The Case of European Elections in the Netherlands Period 1989-2024
detail.abstract: The EU Climate Law stipulates that the EU's economy will emit net zero greenhouse gases (GHG) by 2050. This goal necessitates a transformation of the production side of the economy and is conditional on steadfast electoral (and thus political) support for decarbonization policies for several decades to come. Especially areas that harbor large GHG producing firms will have to burden a disproportionally large share of this transition. It might imply significant changes to their local economies and communities and evoke, e.g., unemployment or the fear thereof. We investigate if support for parties that either want to slowdown or accelerate decarbonization is stronger in areas that harbor large greenhouse gas emitting firms. We test our hypotheses using data on European Parliamentary elections in the period 1989-2024 in the Netherlands on the municipal level. The preliminary empirical results indicate a marginally lower voter turnout in high GHG-emitting municipalities. However, this effect is already present before the rise of decarbonization policies. Furthermore, political parties favoring slower decarbonization gained more votes in medium GHG-emitting municipalities than in the control group from 2009 onwards. However, this is again before the politization of decarbonization and the confidence intervals are too large to draw conclusions. On the other hand, parties supporting faster decarbonization grew slightly faster in municipalities that do not emit any industrial GHGs. This finding is counter to our hypotheses although the confidence intervals are again too big to draw definite conclusions. Overall, we find no evidence for voter backlash against decarbonization stemming from the production side of the economy in the Netherlands in European Parliamentary elections.

AI.tldr: 本文利用荷兰1989-2024年欧洲议会选举的市级数据，检验高温室气体排放企业所在地区是否更支持减缓或加速脱碳政策的政党。初步实证结果显示高排放城市的投票率略低（但早于脱碳政策兴起），中等排放城市对缓脱碳政党的支持自2009年起略增（置信区间过宽），而零工业排放城市对加速脱碳政党的支持增长略快。总体而言，未发现荷兰生产侧脱碳引发的选民反弹证据。
AI.research_question: 高温室气体排放企业集中的地区，选民是否更倾向于支持希望减缓或加速脱碳政策的政党？
AI.motivation: 欧盟2050年净零排放目标需要生产侧深刻转型，而高排放企业所在地区将承担不成比例的转型负担，可能引发失业等社会问题。研究这些地区的选民是否产生对脱碳政策的政治反弹，对于评估脱碳政策的长期政治可持续性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于气候政策的政治可行性理论，探讨生产侧脱碳转型对地方经济与社区的影响如何塑造选民偏好与政治支持。
AI.method: 利用荷兰1989-2024年欧洲议会选举的市级面板数据，将城市按工业温室气体排放水平分组，比较不同排放水平城市中支持减缓/加速脱碳政党的得票率及投票率差异。
AI.findings: （1）高排放城市投票率略低，但该效应早于脱碳政策兴起；（2）中等排放城市对缓脱碳政党的支持自2009年起略增，但置信区间过宽；（3）零工业排放城市对加速脱碳政党的支持增长略快，与假设相反但置信区间过宽；（4）总体未发现荷兰生产侧脱碳引发选民反弹的证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 对气候政策政治可行性与选民反弹假设提供了实证检验，发现生产侧排放集中的地区并未系统性反弹脱碳政策，丰富了关于脱碳转型政治成本的学术讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟及成员国制定脱碳政策提供了政治可行性方面的实证依据，表明荷兰生产侧转型可能不会引发强烈选民反弹，有助于缓解政策制定者对于脱碳引发政治阻力的担忧。

title: Back-run Effects in Private Routing for Cryptocurrency Trading on the Blockchain
affiliations: Hitotsubashi University - Graduate School of Economics, University of Tokyo - Faculty of Economics and

detail.title: Back-run Effects in Private Routing for Cryptocurrency Trading on the Blockchain
detail.abstract: This study formulates, for the first time, the back-running mechanism in private routing for on-chain cryptocurrency trading as a leader-follower stochastic differential game between a user and a trusted searcher, providing practical implications for the mechanism design of on-chain market infrastructure. We propose a model to investigate the effect of back-running by a trusted searcher in private routing for a user in on-chain cryptocurrency transactions. The continuous-time linear-quadratic (LQ) leader-follower stochastic differential game is solved via a forward-backward stochastic differential equation (FBSDE) approach using the stochastic maximum principle. Numerical examples illustrate how allowing back-running affects the market impact of the cryptocurrency and the user's total purchasing cost under different liquidity conditions in the on-chain market. This helps infrastructure companies design healthier markets by allowing users to choose whether to provide trade information to trusted searchers.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次将链上加密货币交易私有路由中的背影追踪（back-running）机制建模为用户与可信搜索者之间的领导者-追随者随机微分博弈，通过FBSDE方法求解连续时间LQ博弈，并探讨了背影追踪对市场冲击和用户购买成本的影响，为链上市场基础设施的机制设计提供实践启示。
AI.research_question: 在链上加密货币交易的私有路由中，可信搜索者实施的背影追踪机制如何影响用户的总购买成本和加密货币的市场冲击？
AI.motivation: 链上加密货币交易中，私有路由的引入旨在保护用户免受抢先交易（front-running）的侵害，但同时可能引发背影追踪（back-running）问题。然而，现有研究尚未从博弈论视角系统地建模和分析这一机制，缺乏对其经济影响的定量理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 领导者-追随者随机微分博弈理论；连续时间线性二次（LQ）最优控制理论；随机最大值原理；正倒向随机微分方程（FBSDE）方法。
AI.method: 构建用户（领导者）与可信搜索者（追随者）之间的连续时间LQ领导者-追随者随机微分博弈模型，利用随机最大值原理将博弈转化为FBSDE系统进行求解，并通过数值算例分析不同流动性条件下背影追踪对市场冲击和用户总购买成本的影响。
AI.findings: 数值结果表明，允许背影追踪在不同流动性条件下会对加密货币的市场冲击和用户的总购买成本产生显著影响，具体效果取决于市场流动性状况。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将背影追踪机制形式化为领导者-追随者随机微分博弈模型，拓展了随机微分博弈理论在区块链微观结构领域的应用，为理解链上交易中的策略性互动提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为链上市场基础设施公司设计更健康的交易市场提供了指导，特别是通过允许用户自主选择是否向可信搜索者提供交易信息，从而在保护用户利益与维持市场效率之间取得平衡。

title: Measuring housing affordability: a case study for young starters in the financial sector
affiliations: University of Antwerp and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Measuring housing affordability: a case study for young starters in the financial sector
detail.abstract: The precise measurement and operationalization of housing affordability remain subjects of considerable debate in the academic literature. Most governmental bodies employ macroeconomic indicators, such as total housing costs as a percentage of disposable income. Residual income methodologies, by contrast, assess whether income remaining after housing costs is sufficient to sustain a decent standard of living, and are particularly useful when applied to specific income groups. Regarding the first approach, we contend that evaluating housing costs in isolation is insufficient; transportation expenses must also be considered, particularly for properties located in the periphery of city centers. We propose a location affordability index. Concerning the residual income method, we operationalize this approach specifically for young professionals beginning their careers in four major financial hubs. We utilize descriptive statistics to assess macro economic affordability as well as for our challenges among the target group. Data are sourced from the OECD and salary data provided by HR consultants, supplemented by web scraping of real estate intermediary websites to identify rental apartment listings. Our findings suggest that although macroeconomic measures may indicate that housing and location affordability have remained stable over the past decade, our financial-sector case study shows that these measures should be complemented by more microeconomic insights as the latter clearly show unaffordability. This study constitutes a distinct initiative to combine macroeconomic indicators with housing affordability evaluations, focusing on low-income populations, particularly young individuals entering the housing market in four principal financial centers. This research is innovative, as no prior studies have specifically examined young entrants in financial centers.

AI.tldr: 本文同时采用宏观经济指标（住房成本占可支配收入比例及位置负担能力指数）与剩余收入法，评估四大金融中心年轻金融从业者的住房负担能力。研究发现，宏观经济指标显示过去十年住房及位置负担能力保持稳定，但针对金融行业年轻从业者的微观案例分析却清晰显示其无法负担住房，表明宏观指标需由微观经济洞察补充。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结合宏观经济指标与剩余收入法，更准确地评估四大金融中心年轻金融从业者的住房负担能力？
AI.motivation: 住房负担能力的精确测量与操作化在学术界仍存在较大争议。政府多采用宏观经济指标，但忽视了交通成本等维度；剩余收入法则在特定收入群体中更为适用。且尚无研究专门关注金融中心年轻入市者的住房负担问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 住房负担能力的宏观经济指标法（住房成本占可支配收入比例）；剩余收入法（扣除住房成本后的剩余收入是否足以维持体面生活水平）；位置负担能力指数（将交通成本纳入住房负担评估）。
AI.method: 采用描述性统计方法。数据来源于OECD宏观经济数据、HR咨询公司提供的薪酬数据，并通过网络爬虫抓取房地产中介网站上的租赁公寓信息，针对四大金融中心初入职场的年轻专业人士进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 宏观经济指标显示过去十年住房及位置负担能力保持稳定，但金融行业年轻从业者的微观案例分析清晰显示其住房不可负担，表明宏观指标需要微观经济洞察加以补充。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究首次将宏观经济指标与住房负担能力评估相结合，专门聚焦低收入群体（尤其是四大金融中心年轻入市者），填补了以往研究未关注金融中心年轻从业者住房负担的研究空白，并创新性地提出了位置负担能力指数。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供更全面的住房负担评估框架，提示仅依赖宏观经济指标可能低估住房不可负担的严重性，为针对年轻金融从业者的住房政策制定提供微观层面的实证依据。

title: A physics-driven numerical framework for directed energy deposition: Integrating temperature-dependent boundary conditions and stochastic particle statistics
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Jilin University (JLU)

detail.title: A physics-driven numerical framework for directed energy deposition: Integrating temperature-dependent boundary conditions and stochastic particle statistics
detail.abstract: High-Fidelity Simulation of the Directed Energy Deposition (DED) Process is needed to move from trial-and-error manufacturing to predictability. In this paper, a physics-based numerical framework is developed to connect the macro-scale powder transport and the mesoscale melt pool evolution through integrating temperature-dependent boundary conditions and stochastic particle statistics. An Eulerian–Lagrangian formulation is utilized to simulate turbulent carrier gas and discrete powder stream. To accurately characterize particle and substrate interactions near the moving laser heat source, a temperature-sensitive capture and rebound criterion is incorporated as an interfacial boundary condition governed by the local phase state and surface tension variations. In addition, a Monte Carlo–based stochastic distribution converts discrete particle trajectories into a continuous volumetric mass source, coupled with the Volume of Fluid method to resolve transient thermocapillary convection and free-surface evolution. The framework is validated for various laser powers for single track depositions and for various overlapping ratios for multi-track depositions. The predicted clad track morphologies demonstrate excellent agreement with experimental cross-sections, with geometric deviations strictly restricted within 7%. This physics-driven framework provides a reliable basis for generating high-fidelity dataset assets to promote machine learning modeling and model order reduction in DED processes.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于物理的数值框架，通过集成温度相关边界条件和随机粒子统计，将宏观尺度粉末输运与介观尺度熔池演化相连接。采用欧拉-拉格朗日公式模拟湍流载气和离散粉末流，并结合温度敏感的捕获/反弹判据、蒙特卡洛随机分布和VOF方法，实现对定向能量沉积（DED）过程的高保真模拟。该框架在不同激光功率和搭接率下均展现出与实验良好的吻合（几何偏差<7%），为机器学习建模和模型降阶提供了可靠的数据生成基础。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个高保真的物理数值框架，将宏观尺度粉末输运与介观尺度熔池演化耦合，以预测DED过程的几何形貌？
AI.motivation: 传统DED制造依赖试错方法，缺乏可预测性，需要建立高保真物理模拟框架以替代经验性工艺优化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧拉-拉格朗日多相流理论、温度敏感的粒子捕获-反弹判据、蒙特卡洛随机分布理论、体积分数法（VOF）自由表面追踪理论。
AI.method: 采用欧拉-拉格朗日公式模拟湍流载气与离散粉末流；通过温度敏感的捕获/反弹判据描述粒子-基板相互作用；利用蒙特卡洛随机分布将离散粒子轨迹转化为连续体积质量源；耦合VOF方法求解瞬态热毛细对流和自由表面演化。
AI.findings: 框架在单道沉积（不同激光功率）和多道沉积（不同搭接率）下均得到验证，预测的熔覆道形貌与实验截面高度一致，几何偏差严格控制在7%以内。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将宏观粉末输运与介观熔池演化统一集成的多尺度物理框架，创新性地将温度敏感捕获/反弹判据作为界面边界条件，并结合蒙特卡洛随机分布与VOF方法的耦合策略。
AI.practical_contributions: 为DED工艺提供了可靠的高保真数据生成工具，可支持机器学习建模和模型降阶技术的发展，推动DED从试错制造向可预测制造转变。

reference: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade Research Paper No. 26/MER/07/04; KIET Monthly Industrial Economics, No. 334
title: Feeding an Aging Korea: The Care Food Industry and the Case for Policy Support

detail.title: Feeding an Aging Korea: The Care Food Industry and the Case for Policy Support

publicationDetails.detailsText: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade Research Paper No. 26/MER/07/04
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics & Trade Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Rapid population aging has increased social demand for a stronger care food industry. Beyond the immediate purpose of putting healthy food in front of older people who can no longer eat normally, whether because digestive function has declined or because a spouse has died, some argue that spreading care food to healthy older adults as a preventive measure would also benefit the long-term soundness of National Health Insurance and Long-Term Care Insurance finances. Social demand is rising, yet for several reasons Korea’s care food industry cannot be expected to achieve meaningful qualitative growth if it is left to the market alone.

The core problems are a fragile revenue base and structural constraints. On the surface, mid-sized and larger firms account for a substantial share of the companies selling care food, but market uncertainty has delayed their active participation. The firms that actually depend on care food for most of their revenue are overwhelmingly small and medium-sized enterprises, and the number posting operating losses has been trending upward. Two structural causes stand out: a persistent gap between manufacturing costs and the unit prices public institutions pay, and awareness so low that 66.4 percent of consumers surveyed in 2020 had never heard of care food. Both erode profitability across the industry, and neither is likely to resolve itself through market forces, which makes appropriate government intervention necessary.

The policy agenda divides into short-term and longer-term tasks. In the short term, consumer awareness must be raised through expert endorsement, media exposure, and wider opportunities to try the products, and the picture of the market itself, which currently rests on assumption-based estimates, must be sharpened. Over the medium to long term, infrastructure needs to be put in place so that frozen and partially prepared care food can be used inside care facilities, the Long-Term Care Insurance fee schedule needs adjustment, and upgrading the industry through AI and age tech will be important.

This article was translated from the original Korean using the Claude Opus 5 large language model. It was reviewed by an editor and the author prior to publication.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨韩国照护食品（care food）产业面临的结构性困境与政策对策。由于人口快速老龄化，照护食品社会需求上升，但产业面临收入基础薄弱（中小型企业主导、亏损企业增多）和结构约束（制造成本与公共机构采购单价倒挂、消费者认知度仅33.6%）两大核心问题。文章提出短期提升消费者认知、完善市场数据，中长期建设冷冻/半成品照护食品基础设施、调整长期护理保险费用表、利用AI与年龄科技推动产业升级等政策议程。
AI.research_question: 韩国照护食品产业面临哪些结构性发展障碍？政府应如何通过政策干预促进该产业实现有意义的质的增长？
AI.motivation: 人口快速老龄化导致照护食品社会需求上升，该产业不仅服务于无法正常进食的老年人，还能作为预防措施推广至健康老年人，有利于国民健康保险和长期护理保险财务的长期稳健。然而韩国照护食品产业若仅靠市场力量无法实现有意义的质的增长，亟需政府干预。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场失灵理论、产业结构分析（产业组织理论）、公共政策干预理论。
AI.method: 基于市场调查数据（2020年消费者认知度调查显示66.4%从未听说过照护食品）、产业经营数据分析（企业规模与盈亏状况）以及政策分析方法的规范性研究。
AI.findings: 1）照护食品产业的收入基础脆弱，实际依赖该产业的主要收入来源的企业以中小型企业为主，且经营亏损企业数量呈上升趋势；2）两大结构性原因：公共机构采购单价与制造成本之间存在持续缺口，以及消费者认知度极低（仅33.6%知晓）；3）短期应提升消费者认知、完善市场数据；中长期需建设照护设施内冷冻/半成品食品使用基础设施、调整长期护理保险费用表，并通过AI和年龄科技推动产业升级。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过对照护食品产业的案例分析，展示了在医疗与老龄化相关的新兴产业中，即使大型企业表面参与度高，但市场不确定性如何阻碍其积极进入，从而深化了对"市场失灵"在老年健康产业中具体表现形式的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国政策制定者提供了照护食品产业短期与中长期的具体政策议程：包括通过专家背书和媒体曝光提升消费者认知、建立更精确的市场统计体系、完善照护设施内冷冻/半成品食品的基础设施、调整长期护理保险缴费标准，以及利用AI和年龄科技推动产业升级等可操作建议。

title: Deep Learning of 12-lead ECG for Cardiogenic Shock in the Cardiovascular ICU: Temporal Anchoring, Leakage-Aware Evaluation, and 48-Hour Early Warning
affiliations: Nanjing Medical University - Nanjing First Hospital, Nanjing Medical University - Nanjing First Hospital, Nanjing Medical University - Nanjing First Hospital, Nanjing Medical University - Nanjing First Hospital, Nanjing Medical University - Nanjing First Hospital, Nanjing Medical University - Nanjing First Hospital and Nanjing Medical University - Nanjing First Hospital

detail.title: Deep Learning of 12-lead ECG for Cardiogenic Shock in the Cardiovascular ICU: Temporal Anchoring, Leakage-Aware Evaluation, and 48-Hour Early Warning
detail.abstract: Background and Objective: Cardiogenic shock is a leading cause of mortality in cardiovascular intensive care unit (CICU) patients. We developed a 12-lead ECG deep learning model to stratify cardiogenic shock risk.,Methods: In a retrospective MIMIC-IV-ECG cohort (N=11,543; shock prevalence 4.7%), a 64-layer ResNet with PTB-XL pretraining was trained for shock (primary), in-hospital death, and an arrhythmia composite. Vasopressor/inotrope initiation anchored the ECG-to-shock temporal analysis. Temporal validation used reconstructed ECG years (train ≤2016, test ≥2017); lead reduction used fair initialization.,Results: The 3-seed ensemble achieved shock AUC 0.783 (per-seed 0.761-0.786) for the hospitalization-wide endpoint, which mixes events before and after ECG acquisition. Near-term (48-h) warning achieved AUC 0.893 (0.811-0.962; exploratory, 14 events), replicating at AUC 0.79 in a temporally independent era (94 events), and flagged cases a median 7.1 h before initiation. Discrimination was preserved on the later era (0.771; non-inferior within 0.05, not 0.02) and partially transported across ICU types (0.741). The AUC increment over the clinical baseline could not be uniquely determined: +0.010 (p=0.11) against the full-hospitalization baseline, rising to +0.020 to +0.096 with progressive leakage restriction. Probabilities required Platt recalibration (Brier 0.057 to 0.044). QRS-slurring and repolarization phenotypes replicated for mortality in independent SaMi-Trop data (aVR FVD AUC 0.729). Lead reduction showed no stable advantage under fair initialization.,Conclusions: ECG deep learning is associated with cardiogenic shock, is temporally transportable within-institution, and is strongest for near-term events. Incremental value is limited against full-hospitalization covariates but larger against leakage-restricted baselines; the model should complement, not replace, multimodal risk assessment.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个基于12导联心电图的深度学习模型，用于心血管重症监护病房（CICU）患者的心源性休克风险分层。模型在MIMIC-IV-ECG队列中训练，实现了休克预测AUC 0.783，48小时短期预警达到AUC 0.893，并在独立时间窗口验证中表现出良好的时间可迁移性（AUC 0.79）。模型在事件发生前中位7.1小时发出预警，但对全住院期基线的增量价值有限，应作为多模态风险评估的补充工具而非替代。
AI.research_question: 12导联心电图深度学习模型能否有效对CICU患者进行心源性休克风险分层，其时间可迁移性、短期预警能力及增量价值如何？
AI.motivation: 心源性休克是心血管重症监护病房（CICU）患者死亡的主要原因，现有风险评估方法存在局限，迫切需要开发基于心电图的深度学习工具来早期识别高风险患者。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于64层ResNet的深度学习框架，利用PTB-XL预训练迁移学习；心电图表型（QRS顿挫和复极化异常）与临床预后的关联病理生理学框架。
AI.method: 回顾性MIMIC-IV-ECG队列（N=11,543），64层ResNet模型预测心源性休克、院内死亡及心律失常复合终点；使用血管加压药/正性肌力药启动时间锚定ECG到休克的时间分析；时间验证采用重建ECG年份（训练≤2016，测试≥2017）；导联缩减使用公平初始化；3种子集成；独立SaMi-Trop数据外部验证。
AI.findings: 休克预测AUC 0.783；48小时短期预警AUC 0.893（探索性分析），在独立时间时代复制AUC 0.79；事件前中位7.1小时发出预警；时间可迁移性良好（0.771，非劣效于0.05界值）；跨ICU类型部分迁移（0.741）；对全住院期基线的增量值有限（+0.010，p=0.11），但对防泄漏基线的增量值更大（+0.020至+0.096）；需要Platt校准；QRS顿挫和复极化表型在独立SaMi-Trop数据中复制了死亡预测（aVR FVD AUC 0.729）。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了ECG深度学习模型在院内具有时间可迁移性；识别了与心源性休克相关的可复制的ECG表型（QRS顿挫和复极化异常）；揭示了不同基线设计下增量价值评估的敏感性差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了ECG深度学习的短期预警能力（事件前7.1小时），支持临床预警系统设计；明确了模型应作为多模态风险评估的补充而非替代工具；提供了概率校准的实操指导。

title: Redefining the Game: GST Reforms and Their Implications for India’s Gaming Industry

detail.title: Redefining the Game: GST Reforms and Their Implications for India’s Gaming Industry

publicationDetails.detailsText: GCBPP, Contemporary Discourses in Business, Law and Public Policy, 1st Edition, Pp 17-38

detail.abstract: India’s rapidly expanding online gaming industry has faced significant regulatory scrutiny following the 2023 GST amendments imposing a uniform 28% tax on the total contest entry value for skill- and chance-based games. This paper examines the legal and economic implications of the amended regime, particularly its departure from the judicially recognised distinction between games of skill and gambling. It evaluates the resulting compliance burdens and effects on industry sustainability, employment, and investment. Drawing on taxation models in the United Kingdom and Malta, the paper argues for a Gross Gaming Revenue (GGR)-based framework that better balances revenue generation with industry growth. It further employs a theoretical Laffer Curve to identify an optimal tax rate and proposes a nuanced taxation framework aligned with constitutional principles, regulatory certainty, and sustainable growth in India’s online gaming sector.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了印度2023年GST修订案对在线游戏行业征收统一28%税的影响，分析了该制度偏离司法认可的技巧与赌博区分原则的法律与经济后果，并基于英国和马耳他的税收模型及拉弗曲线理论，提出以GGR为基础、兼顾收入增长与行业可持续发展的税收框架建议。
AI.research_question: 印度2023年GST修订案对在线游戏行业征收统一28%税后，其法律与经济影响是什么？应如何设计更优的税收框架？
AI.motivation: 印度快速扩张的在线游戏行业在2023年GST修订后面临重大监管不确定性。统一28%税率将技巧类游戏与博彩等同对待，背离了司法上长期认可的区分原则，可能对行业可持续性、就业和投资产生不利影响，因此需要研究替代性税收方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拉弗曲线理论（Laffer Curve）、GGR（博彩总收入）税收模型、印度宪法原则、技巧与博彩的司法区分理论
AI.method: 法律与经济学分析，比较法研究（参照英国和马耳他税收模式），理论模型（拉弗曲线）
AI.findings: 统一28% GST税率背离了技巧游戏与博彩的司法区分，增加了合规负担，对行业可持续性、就业和投资产生负面影响；基于拉弗曲线识别出最优税率，GGR框架能更好地平衡政府收入与行业增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 将拉弗曲线理论应用于在线游戏税收政策分析，论证了GGR税收模式相对于统一从价税率的理论优势，并将宪法原则与税收设计相结合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度政策制定者提供了具体可操作的税收改革建议，包括基于GGR的征税框架和最优税率建议，有助于实现监管确定性与行业可持续发展的平衡。

title: Manufactured Belonging: Cognitive Warfare, Algorithmic Identity, and the Ancient Art of Epistemic Self-Defence

detail.title: Manufactured Belonging: Cognitive Warfare, Algorithmic Identity, and the Ancient Art of Epistemic Self-Defence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests, financial or otherwise, in relation to the research presented in this paper. No part of this work was commissioned, funded, sponsored, or influenced by any platform company, political organisation, government body, or commercial entity.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper involves no collection, processing, or analysis of primary human subjects data and requires no ethics committee approval. All sources are publicly available secondary materials, fully cited herein. The case study analyses draw on published academic literature, congressional records, and documented journalistic and institutional reports.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted on an independent, self-funded basis.

detail.abstract:
Cognitive warfare has emerged as one of the defining strategic challenges of the twenty-first century, shifting conflict from territorial domination toward the systematic manipulation of human perception, identity, and collective behaviour. While existing scholarship has examined information operations, algorithmic amplification, and affective polarisation, comparatively little attention has been directed toward civilisational knowledge systems as frameworks for cognitive resilience. This paper proposes to close that gap. It introduces the Indic Cognitive Resilience Model (ICRM) — an original interdisciplinary framework integrating Social Identity Theory, cognitive-warfare doctrine, the attention-economy literature, and Indic epistemology — as a theoretically robust and practically generative account of how human cognition can be defended against identity-based manipulation.

The paper proceeds in seven stages. 

First, it situates cognitive warfare within its contemporary strategic context, drawing on NATO doctrine and emerging academic literature to establish the specific vulnerability this paper addresses: not information flows as such, but the deliberate engineering of identity-based belonging as the primary mechanism through which cognitive capture is achieved. 

Second, it reviews four bodies of scholarship — Social Identity Theory (Tajfel & Turner, 1979; Brown, 2020), cognitive-warfare doctrine (NATO ACT, 2021–2023; Adlakha-Hutcheon et al., 2023), the algorithmic attention economy (Pariser, 2011; Bail, 2021; Vosoughi et al., 2018), and Indic epistemological scholarship (Ganeri, 2001; Bryant, 2009) — and identifies the gap that their non-integration has produced. 

Third, it develops the theoretical mechanism of manufactured belonging: the process by which emotionally resonant identity narratives are constructed, distributed, and amplified through digital infrastructure to produce cognitive outcomes that serve the interests of specific actors rather than the epistemic wellbeing of the individuals captured by them. 

Fourth, it applies this mechanism to two comparative case studies — India and the United States — analysed against six identical variables: emotional trigger, historical reference deployed, enemy construction, moral legitimacy claim, platform amplification mechanism, and documented behavioural outcome. 

Fifth, it introduces the ICRM’s five stages — Perception, Viveka (discernment), Sakshi Bhava (witnessing awareness), Expanded Identity, and Ethical Action — as a functioning counter-architecture calibrated to precisely the vulnerability the manufactured-belonging mechanism exploits. 

Sixth, it derives specific implications for platform design, civic education, and governance. 

Seventh, it states explicit falsification conditions and opens the research agenda that the ICRM’s two testable propositions invite.

The paper’s contribution is not to propose that ancient texts contain all answers to modern problems. It is to demonstrate that a specific Indic epistemological tradition — concerning the mind’s vulnerability to constructed belonging and the disciplined cultivation of meta-awareness as its antidote — is both conceptually precise and practically generative for the most urgent cognitive-security challenge of the digital age.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"印度认知韧性模型"（ICRM），整合社会认同理论、认知战理论、注意力经济与印度认识论，针对数字时代以身份认同操作为核心的认知战威胁，构建了从"制造归属感"机制识别到五阶段防御架构的系统性理论框架，并通过美印双案例比较验证其适用性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用文明知识体系（特别是印度认识论传统）构建认知韧性框架，以防御基于身份认同操纵的认知战威胁？
AI.motivation: 现有认知战研究主要集中在信息操作、算法放大和情感极化等方面，但极少关注文明知识体系作为认知韧性框架的潜力。本研究旨在填补这一空白，回应数字时代最紧迫的认知安全挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合四个理论体系：社会认同理论（Tajfel & Turner）、认知战理论（NATO ACT）、算法注意力经济（Pariser, Bail, Vosoughi）、印度认识论（Ganeri, Bryant），并以此为基础提出"制造归属感"（manufactured belonging）核心机制。
AI.method: 采用七阶段研究设计：战略情境分析→文献综述→理论机制构建→双案例比较（印度与美国，六个变量：情感触发、历史叙事、敌人建构、道德合法性主张、平台放大机制、行为结果）→五阶段ICRM模型开发→实践启示推导→可证伪条件设定。
AI.findings: 提出"制造归属感"作为认知捕获的核心机制；构建ICRM五阶段防御架构（感知、辨智、见证觉知、扩展身份、伦理行动）；识别出既有研究缺乏理论整合的关键缺口；为平台设计、公民教育和治理提供具体启示；提出两个可检验命题及明确证伪条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将印度认识论传统引入认知战研究，提出跨学科整合的ICRM框架；发展"制造归属感"这一原创理论机制；将文明知识体系与现代认知科学、政治学、传播学进行系统性对话。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台设计提供认知韧性导向的改进方向；为公民教育提出元认知与辨智能力培养路径；为治理层面提供认知安全政策建议；为认知战防御提供可操作的五阶段实践架构。

title: Exact Shared-completion Certificates for Comparing Action-preserving Adaptive Acquisition Policies from Incomplete Logs

detail.title: Exact Shared-completion Certificates for Comparing Action-preserving Adaptive Acquisition Policies from Incomplete Logs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study uses public industrial data and publicly released deidentified benchmark tables, including the open MIMIC-IV Demo prepared under the source project's ethics and deidentification process. No participant was recruited or contacted, no intervention was conducted, and no clinical recommendation is made.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Incomplete logs omit measurements requested by a replacement acquisition policy. Point imputation invents one counterfactual trajectory, while subtracting marginal cost intervals can combine incompatible hidden states. We study the shared-completion set: every acquisition-cost difference attainable when two action-preserving policies act on the same admissible completion. We cover finite deterministic policies with affine next-acquisition and stopping predicates. Each terminal path defines a polyhedral cell with designated strict facets. Feasible same-action leaf pairs recover the exact finite cost-difference set, its sharp interval hull, and completions that replay endpoint paths. At most Lp Lb leaf-pair feasibility/projection problems are required; fixed orders require at most 2(m+1)^2 candidates. The finite set can omit cost levels inside its hull. An independent rational Fourier--Motzkin oracle agrees on 44 adaptive configurations, 309 feasible joint-leaf witnesses, and 5,500 boundary replays. A Scania APS experiment selects adaptive depth two using development data only. On 15,637 held-out rows, it preserves carrier actions and reduces mean acquisition cost by 0.0363 groups relative to the fixed order (paired bootstrap 95% interval [-0.0398,-0.0333]); it is cheaper on 495 rows and more expensive on one. With two-group controlled masking, shared completion reduces mean marginal-interval width by 96.65% and changes 13,524 comparison statuses. All 94,516 Scania endpoints replay, and an independent audit reconstructs policy selection and held-out results. The theorem is exact for the declared contract; large floating-point experiments are numerically certified under stated tolerances and do not establish causal or deployment utility.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了不完整日志中的"共享补全集"问题，即在两个保持动作的策略作用于同一可接受补全时所有可能的采集成本差异。论文覆盖了具有仿射下一采集和停止谓词的有限确定性策略，证明了终端路径定义多面体单元，并通过可行叶对精确恢复有限成本差异集和区间包络。在Scania APS实验中，自适应深度2策略在15,637行保留数据上相比固定顺序降低了平均采集成本0.0363组。
AI.research_question: 当不完整的日志缺失替换采集策略所请求的测量时，如何精确刻画两个保持动作的策略在同一可接受补全上的所有采集成本差异集合？
AI.motivation: 不完整日志中，单点插补只能发明一个反事实轨迹，而减去边际成本区间可能组合不兼容的隐藏状态，现有方法无法精确刻画成本差异集合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 共享补全集理论、有限确定性策略、仿射下一采集和停止谓词、多面体单元与严格刻面、Fourier-Motzkin消元。
AI.method: 将每个终端路径定义为具有指定严格刻面的多面体单元；通过可行的同动作叶对恢复精确有限成本差异集及其区间包络；提出至多Lp Lb个叶对可行/投影问题的算法，固定顺序需至多2(m+1)^2个候选；结合独立理性Fourier-Motzkin预言机验证和Scania APS实验。
AI.findings: 定理对声明契约是精确的；该有限集可遗漏其包络内的成本水平。独立预言机在44个自适应配置、309个可行联合叶见证和5,500个边界重放上一致。Scania APS实验中自适应深度2策略在15,637行保留数据上减少平均采集成本0.0363组（95%置信区间[-0.0398,-0.0333]），在495行上更便宜、1行上更贵。两组建控掩蔽下共享补全将边际区间宽度平均减少96.65%，改变13,524个比较状态。全部94,516个Scania端点均可重放。
AI.theory_contributions: 精确刻画了共享补全集合下的成本差异集合结构，证明了有限集可以遗漏其区间包络内的成本水平，建立叶对可行性与成本差异恢复之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 该方法可用于不完整日志场景下策略评估与比较，在Scania APS数据上展示了自适应策略相比固定顺序的采集成本优势，且所有端点均可重放，支持独立审计。

title: Coordinated Multi-Time-Scale Dispatch of Hydrogen-Electric Coupled System Considering Multi-Modal Ultra-Short-Term PV Forecasting

detail.title: Coordinated Multi-Time-Scale Dispatch of Hydrogen-Electric Coupled System Considering Multi-Modal Ultra-Short-Term PV Forecasting
detail.abstract: The increasing integration of distributed photovoltaic (PV) generation introduces rapid source-side fluctuations into hydrogen-electric coupled systems (HECS), especially during cloud-induced ramping events. Existing studies often separate meteorological forecasting from scheduling decisions, leaving the operational value of improved PV forecasting insufficiently quantified. This paper proposes a closed-loop predict-then-optimize framework for PV-dominated HECS. At the perception stage, a dual-stream multimodal ultra-short-term PV forecasting model separately extracts static spatial features from sky images and dynamic optical-flow features from consecutive images. A two-stage spatiotemporal gating mechanism and xLSTM network are then used to fuse multimodal information and infer PV trajectories. At the decision-making stage, the predicted PV trajectories are embedded into an intraday model predictive control (MPC) model built on a day-ahead economic schedule. Case studies based on the SKIPP'D dataset and representative microgrid parameters show that the proposed forecasting model achieves an RMSE of 1.615 kW at the 15-min horizon under cloudy and ramping scenarios, outperforming selected multimodal baselines by 6.6%. Under the same MPC setting, the proposed forecasts reduce the tie-line power error rate from 8.36% to 6.04% and lower the actual operating cost by 4.82% in the cloudy scenario. These results provide simulation-based evidence that multimodal PV forecasting can improve HECS dispatch economy when explicitly coupled with rolling optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向光伏主导的氢电耦合系统（HECS）的闭环"预测-优化"框架。在感知阶段，采用双流多模态超短期光伏预测模型，结合天空图像静态空间特征与连续图像的光流动态特征，通过两阶段时空门控机制和xLSTM网络融合多模态信息；在决策阶段，将预测的光伏轨迹嵌入日内模型预测控制（MPC）模型中。基于SKIPP'D数据集和微电网参数的案例研究表明，该框架在阴天爬坡场景下15分钟预测的RMSE为1.615 kW，比其他多模态基线方法提升6.6%，并将联络线功率误差率从8.36%降至6.04%，实际运行成本降低4.82%。
AI.research_question: 如何将超短期光伏预测与调度决策显式耦合，以量化改进的光伏预测对氢电耦合系统运行经济的价值？
AI.motivation: 分布式光伏的快速源侧波动（尤其云致爬坡事件）给氢电耦合系统带来挑战，但现有研究往往将气象预测与调度决策分离，导致改进光伏预测的运行价值未被充分量化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预测-优化闭环框架；双流多模态学习；两阶段时空门控机制；xLSTM网络；模型预测控制（MPC）；日前经济调度
AI.method: 提出闭环predict-then-optimize框架：1）感知阶段采用双流多模态超短期光伏预测模型（天空图像静态空间特征提取+连续图像光流动态特征提取，融合两阶段时空门控机制和xLSTM）；2）决策阶段将预测结果嵌入日内MPC模型，基于日前经济调度构建滚动优化。使用SKIPP'D数据集和代表性微电网参数进行仿真验证。
AI.findings: 1）所提预测模型在阴天爬坡场景下15分钟预测RMSE为1.615 kW，优于多模态基线方法6.6%；2）在相同MPC设置下，所提预测将联络线功率误差率从8.36%降至6.04%；3）阴天场景下实际运行成本降低4.82%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）构建了预测与优化显式耦合的闭环框架，弥补了预测与调度分离的研究空白；2）提出双流多模态融合（静态空间+动态光流）的预测方法，结合两阶段时空门控和xLSTM，提升了复杂天气场景下的光伏预测精度；3）通过仿真验证了多模态预测改进对HECS调度经济性的传导效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为光伏主导的氢电耦合系统提供了可落地的预测-调度一体化方案；2）为运营者提供了量化评估预测改进价值的方法，支持在预测技术投入与运行经济性之间进行合理的资源配置决策。

title: FROM CONTROL TO COMMITMENT: HOW MANAGEMENT CONTROL SYSTEMS SHAPE FOOD SAFETY PERFORMANCE THROUGH CULTURE AND COMPLIANCE
affiliations: Universitas Ciputra Surabaya, affiliation not provided to SSRN, INTI International University, University of Sunderland, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: FROM CONTROL TO COMMITMENT: HOW MANAGEMENT CONTROL SYSTEMS SHAPE FOOD SAFETY PERFORMANCE THROUGH CULTURE AND COMPLIANCE
detail.abstract: Food safety incidents remain frequent even after organizations adopt formal food safety management systems, showing that technical compliance alone does not ensure consistent performance. Grounded in Simons' Levers of Control framework, this study tests a sequential mediation model linking management control systems (MCS), food safety culture, compliance, and performance among employees of two Indonesian food processing companies, using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling complemented by tetrad analysis, importance-performance mapping, necessary condition analysis, and a cross-validated predictive ability test. All six hypothesized paths were positive and significant: MCS strongly shaped culture and, to a lesser extent, compliance and performance directly, while culture shaped both compliance and performance, and compliance had a smaller but significant direct effect on performance. The full sequential chain from MCS through culture and compliance to performance was also significant, and MCS influenced performance mainly through the culture and behaviors it shapes rather than directly. Necessary condition analysis confirmed that MCS, culture, and compliance are each necessary, though not sufficient, for high performance, while importance-performance mapping identified MCS as the highest-priority lever for managerial intervention. These findings extend management control theory into the food safety domain and offer an evidence-based architecture for strengthening food safety performance.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Simons的控制杠杆框架，通过两家印尼食品加工企业的员工数据，检验了管理控制系统（MCS）→食品安全文化→合规→绩效的序列中介模型。所有六条假设路径均显著为正，MCS主要通过塑造文化和行为来影响绩效，而非直接作用。必要条件分析表明MCS、文化和合规都是高绩效的必要但非充分条件，重要性-绩效映射显示MCS是管理干预的最高优先级杠杆。
AI.research_question: 即使企业采用了正式的食品安全管理体系，食品安全事故仍然频发，那么管理控制系统（MCS）如何通过食品安全文化和合规行为来影响食品安全绩效？
AI.motivation: 技术合规本身并不能保证持续的食品安全表现，现有研究缺乏对管理控制系统如何通过组织文化影响食品安全绩效的机制性理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: Simons的控制杠杆（Levers of Control）框架
AI.method: 采用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM），辅以四元分析、重要性-绩效映射（IPMA）、必要条件分析（NCA）和交叉验证预测能力检验。样本为两家印尼食品加工企业的员工。
AI.findings: 所有六条假设路径均为正且显著：MCS强烈塑造文化，并在较小程度上直接影响合规和绩效；文化塑造合规和绩效；合规对绩效有较小但显著的直接影响。从MCS经文化到合规再到绩效的完整序列链显著；MCS主要通过其塑造的文化和行为影响绩效而非直接作用。必要条件分析确认MCS、文化和合规均为高绩效的必要但不充分条件；重要性-绩效映射将MCS识别为管理干预的最高优先级杠杆。
AI.theory_contributions: 将管理控制理论扩展到食品安全领域，为理解MCS如何通过组织文化与行为机制间接影响食品安全绩效提供了实证证据，丰富了控制杠杆框架在特定行业情境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了基于证据的食品安全绩效提升架构，明确指出MCS是最优先的管理干预杠杆，帮助企业更有效地配置管理资源以增强食品安全表现。

title: The DEI Reversal Penalty
affiliations: NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Accounting, Auditing and Law, NHH Norwegian School of Economics and

detail.title: The DEI Reversal Penalty
detail.abstract: After a number of years in which corporations have increased their use of social initiatives and internal diversity policies, corporations are now facing pressure to discontinue such policies, in particular in the United States. How this affects corporate incentives to introduce, maintain or reverse such policies depends on stakeholder reactions. We present results from a well-powered, pre-registered, online vignette experiment where we test the effect of reversing diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) policies on respondent willingness to work for a company. A politically representative sample of 1600 US respondents were randomized into four treatment arms. In the first treatment they were presented with a hypothetical company that introduces and maintains a DEI programme, in the second treatment a company that introduces but then discontinues a DEI programme for non-political reasons, in the third treatment the DEI programme is introduced but discontinued due to political pressure, and in the fourth control condition the company never introduces a DEI programme. The results show that respondents exhibit a stronger willingness to work for a company that introduces and maintains a DEI programme compared to the control. However, reversing a DEI programme for non-political reasons leads to worse employee perceptions than never having a programme in the first place. Moreover, this negative effect is significantly greater if the programme is discontinued due to political pressure. While reversing a DEI programme is adversely related to perceptions of professionalism of a company, we find that the main mechanism explaining the drop in stakeholder perceptions is a perceived lack of authenticity.
