Results are also highly heterogeneous by political preference, liberal respondents favour DEI and disfavour DEI reversal, while conservative respondents oppose DEI programmes and are not mollified by their reversal.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个预注册的在线情景实验（1600名美国政治代表性样本，四种处理组），考察企业逆转多样性、公平与包容（DEI）政策对员工（潜在员工）求职意愿的影响。研究发现：引入并维持DEI政策能提升求职意愿；而非政治原因撤销DEI政策比从未实施更糟糕；若因政治压力撤销则负面效应更大。主要机制是感知到的缺乏真诚（authenticity），而非专业性问题。结果在政治倾向上高度异质：自由派支持DEI并反感逆转，保守派反对DEI且对逆转无动于衷。
AI.research_question: 企业逆转DEI政策（尤其是因政治压力而逆转）会如何影响潜在员工的求职意愿？其背后的心理机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 美国企业近年来面临撤销DEI政策的政治压力，但此类决策如何影响利益相关者（尤其是潜在员工）的反应尚不清楚。理解这一影响对企业是否引入、维持或逆转DEI政策的激励至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益相关者反应理论、组织真诚性（authenticity）感知、信号理论
AI.method: 预注册在线情景实验（vignette experiment），1600名美国政治代表性受访者随机分为四组：①引入并维持DEI；②引入后因非政治原因撤销；③引入后因政治压力撤销；④从未引入（对照组）。测量求职意愿及感知机制。
AI.findings: ①引入并维持DEI显著提升求职意愿；②非政治原因逆转DEI比从未实施更差；③因政治压力逆转的负面效应显著更大；④主要机制是感知缺乏真诚性，而非专业性下降；⑤结果按政治偏好高度异质：自由派支持DEI且强烈反感逆转，保守派反对DEI且不受逆转影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了DEI逆转对利益相关者感知的非对称效应——"做过再撤销"比"从未做过"更糟，并将真诚性感知识别为核心中介机制，丰富了组织信号与利益相关者反应理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供政策启示：DEI政策的引入具有承诺效应，逆转（尤其是因政治压力逆转）会显著损害雇主品牌与人才吸引力；企业应谨慎评估撤销DEI的政治成本与人才市场代价。同时提示企业注意不同政治群体间的差异化反应。

title: The Mechanics of the Hunt: Hawkes-Driven Liquidity Siphoning and the Execution of Institutional Pinning Traps in Gold Futures
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Mechanics of the Hunt: Hawkes-Driven Liquidity Siphoning and the Execution of Institutional Pinning Traps in Gold Futures
detail.abstract: While classical continuous-time market-making frameworks, such as the Avellaneda-Stoikov model, assume symmetric liquidity provision, modern limit order books (LOBs) frequently exhibit structural fragility under clustered volatility. Building upon previous research demonstrating the empirical failure of continuous-time quoting in Hawkes-driven environments and the identification of the Asymmetric Absorption Threshold (KAT), this paper synthesizes quantitative market mechanics with behavioral microstructural manipulation. Utilizing a high-fidelity, 13.7-million-tick Market-by-Order (MBO) dataset of CME Gold Futures (GC) across major macroeconomic releases, we mathematically reconstruct the timeline of institutional liquidity siphoning. We demonstrate that algorithmic cancellation cascades—quantified via discretized Hawkes intensity (λ(t))—are not merely defensive reactions to toxic flow, but serve as proactive mechanisms that force Order Book Imbalance (OBI) into extreme skews (OBI ≤ −0.85). This deliberate withdrawal of liquidity creates microstructural vacuums that satisfy KAT conditions, weaponizing the failure of continuous-time models to execute pinning traps against aggressive retail flow. The findings provide empirical proof that retail delta decoupling in commodities is a deterministic, mechanically executed event rather than a byproduct of passive capital asymmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文利用CME黄金期货1300万笔MBO高频数据，证明算法取消级联（以离散Hawkes强度量化）不是对有毒订单流的防御性反应，而是主动操纵工具：通过制造极端订单簿失衡（OBI≤-0.85）形成微观结构真空，满足非对称吸收阈值（KAT）条件，触发钉扎陷阱，从而对散户交易者执行确定性、机械化的流动性虹吸。
AI.research_question: 算法取消级联是否不仅是防御性机制，而是主动制造微观结构真空、触发KAT条件以对散户执行钉扎陷阱的操纵手段？零售Delta脱钩在商品市场是否是确定性的事件？
AI.motivation: 经典连续时间做市模型（如Avellaneda-Stoikov）假设对称流动性供给，但现代LOB在波动聚集下存在结构性脆弱；前期研究已证明连续时间报价在Hawkes驱动环境中的经验失效并识别出KAT，本文进一步整合定量市场机制与行为微观结构操纵。
AI.theoretical_framework: Avellaneda-Stoikov做市框架（连续时间）、Hawkes过程强度建模、非对称吸收阈值（KAT）、订单簿失衡（OBI）理论、连续时间模型失效理论
AI.method: 使用CME黄金期货（GC）在主要宏观经济发布期间的13.7百万笔MBO高频数据集，通过离散化Hawkes强度λ(t)量化算法取消级联，重构机构流动性虹吸的时间线，分析OBI极端偏斜与KAT条件的满足。
AI.findings: 算法取消级联是主动操纵机制而非防御反应；其将OBI推向极端偏斜（≤-0.85），制造满足KAT条件的微观结构真空，武器化连续时间模型的失败以对激进散户订单流执行钉扎陷阱；零售Delta脱钩在商品中是由确定性机械化事件驱动而非被动资本不对称的副产品。
AI.theory_contributions: 将连续时间做市模型的失效从理论缺陷提升为可被利用的微观结构操纵工具；扩展了KAT框架，将其从被动识别指标发展为主动触发条件；首次在经验层面证明零售Delta脱钩作为确定性事件的微观结构机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构识别和防范算法化流动性操纵提供量化指标（λ(t)级联检测、OBI极端阈值）；为散户投资者和做市商提供微观结构风险预警框架；为市场设计者改进LOB机制提供实证依据。

title: Economic Model Predictive Control for District Heating Networks with Forecasting of Uncertain Heat Demand
affiliations: Fraunhofer Gesellschaft - Fraunhofer Institute for Industrial Mathematics ITWM, Fraunhofer Gesellschaft - Fraunhofer Institute for Industrial Mathematics ITWM, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Fraunhofer Gesellschaft - Fraunhofer Institute for Industrial Mathematics ITWM and University of Konstanz

detail.title: Economic Model Predictive Control for District Heating Networks with Forecasting of Uncertain Heat Demand
detail.abstract: District heating networks (DHNs) offer significant potential for improving energy efficiencythrough optimization-based control. Lowering the source feed temperature reduces heat losses,but the feed temperature at consumers must remain above a prescribed minimum threshold. Thecooling of water in the network and, therefore, the consumer temperatures depend on demand-driven flow conditions. Because future heat demand is uncertain and forecast errors increasewith the prediction horizon, controls optimized using forecast data may violate the minimumtemperature constraint in practice. This study demonstrates the advantages of an model predictivecontrol (MPC) approach that combines demand forecasting, dynamic simulation, and repeatedre-optimization of the source feed temperature control signal in a DHN.Using the dynamic thermo-hydraulic network simulator AD Net Heat, we compare a 24-hour open-loop optimization with an MPC optimization strategy that re-optimizes the controlsignal hourly using updated demand forecasts. We identify an optimal MPC prediction horizonfor the considered network and evaluate both strategies on real demand data to quantifythe advantages of the MPC optimization strategy with respect to violations of the minimumtemperature constraint. For a representative day, the MPC optimization strategy reduces theduration of minimum-temperature violations at consumers by nearly one third and the maximumviolation by about one half compared with the open-loop optimization strategy. An evaluationover 30 consecutive days confirms a substantial reduction in severe violations of the minimumtemperature constraint at consumers. The results show that combining demand forecasting,dynamic simulation, and MPC improves the robustness of district heating operation underdemand uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了区域供热网络（DHN）中结合需求预测、动态仿真和模型预测控制（MPC）的优势。通过在供水温度控制信号上进行每小时重新优化，MPC策略相比24小时开环优化策略，在需求不确定条件下显著减少了消费者最低温度约束的违规持续时间（减少约三分之一）和最大违规程度（减少约一半），提高了区域供热运行的鲁棒性。
AI.research_question: 在需求不确定条件下，与开环优化相比，采用模型预测控制（MPC）策略能否减少区域供热网络中消费者最低温度约束的违规，并提高运行鲁棒性？
AI.motivation: 区域供热网络通过基于优化的控制可显著提高能效，但未来热需求具有不确定性且预测误差随预测时域增加而增大。基于预测数据优化的控制可能在实际中违反最低温度约束，影响消费者供热质量，因此需要更鲁棒的控制策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模型预测控制（MPC）理论、动态热-水力网络仿真、开环优化与闭环再优化对比框架
AI.method: 使用动态热-水力网络仿真器AD Net Heat，比较24小时开环优化策略与每小时利用更新需求预测重新优化控制信号的MPC策略。确定该网络的最优MPC预测时域，并在真实需求数据上评估两种策略的最低温度约束违规情况。
AI.findings: 1）MPC策略在代表性日期将消费者最低温度违规持续时间减少近三分之一，最大违规程度减少约一半；2）对连续30天的评估确认严重违规大幅减少；3）结合需求预测、动态仿真和MPC能提高区域供热在需求不确定性下的运行鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了MPC结合动态仿真在区域供热网络中的有效性，为闭环再优化策略相比开环优化在不确定需求下提高约束满足能力提供了定量证据，并提供了最优预测时域的辨识方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为区域供热运营者提供了一种鲁棒的控制策略框架，通过降低源供水温度同时保障消费者最低温度要求，可在提升能效的同时减少温度违规，具有实际部署价值。

title: Constraint satisfaction by projection rather than by reward: deep reinforcement learning for electric bus depot charging on a weak distribution feeder
affiliations: Newcastle University and University of Gujrat

detail.title: Constraint satisfaction by projection rather than by reward: deep reinforcement learning for electric bus depot charging on a weak distribution feeder
detail.abstract: Learning controllers for electric vehicle charging are usually taught to respect network limits through a penalty term added to the reward. The penalty is soft, so the constraint can still be violated during training and, less often but more seriously, after deployment. This paper reports a depot charging controller in which the network constraint is instead enforced by a closed-form projection applied to the action before it reaches the plant, and it quantifies what that choice is worth on a measured connection. The problem is posed as a two-pool constrained Markov decision process with separate deadlines for vehicles that stay overnight and vehicles that return at midday, and it is solved with a deep Q-network of 6165 parameters trained without any machine learning framework.On a measured 11 kV connection serving a 94-route institutional bus fleet in Gujrat, Pakistan, the proposed controller reduces daily charging cost by 45.0 percent against uncoordinated charging, from 340,788 to 187,335 PKR per day, and sits 4.4 percent above a perfect-foresight linear programming bound. The uncoordinated schedule breaches the statutory voltage floor six times a day. Every controller carrying the projection layer breaches it zero times across 40 held-out test days, eight independent training seeds, and nineteen hyperparameter settings, which is 38 separately trained networks.The ablation gives the paper its main result, and it is a negative one. With the projection layer active, an agent trained on a physics-informed reward and an agent trained on cost alone converge to the same policy and the same daily cost of 235,544 PKR because the voltage penalty is never incurred and therefore carries no gradient. Reward shaping for constraint satisfaction is redundant once a hard layer is present, and it is only when the layer is removed that shaping earns its place, cutting violations from 1.20 per day to zero at the cost of 34 kWh of undelivered energy. The practical implication is that effort spent tuning penalty weights is better spent on the projection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种带有闭环投影层的电动汽车充电控制器，通过硬约束（而非软惩罚）来保证电网电压限制，并在巴基斯坦古吉拉特94条线路的公交车队实测11kV连接线上验证，将日充电成本降低45%，且将电压违规次数从每天6次降至零，同时通过消融实验证明奖励塑形在硬投影层存在时是冗余的。
AI.research_question: 在电动汽车充电控制中，用闭环投影硬约束取代软惩罚项来保障电网功率限制，其工程价值和成本效益如何？奖励塑形（reward shaping）在硬约束机制下是否仍有必要？
AI.motivation: 传统充电控制器通过奖励函数中的惩罚项来约束电网限制，但惩罚是软性的，训练期间可能违规，部署后更严重。作者希望用闭环投影在动作到达系统前强制满足约束，并量化这一设计选择的实际价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两池约束马尔可夫决策过程（two-pool constrained MDP），分别针对过夜车辆和中午返回车辆设置充电截止期限；深度Q网络（DQN）。
AI.method: 构建两池约束MDP，采用仅6165参数的深度Q网络（不依赖任何机器学习框架）求解；在动作进入系统前施加闭环投影层以强制满足电压约束；在巴基斯坦古吉拉特94条线路公交车队实测11kV连接线上进行评估，包括40天留出测试、8个独立训练种子和19组超参数设置（共38个独立训练网络）以及消融实验。
AI.findings: （1）相比无协调充电，日充电成本降低45.0%（从340,788降至187,335 PKR/天），距完美预见线性规划上限仅差4.4%；（2）无协调调度每天违规电压下限6次，而带投影层的控制器在全部38个训练网络上违规次数为零；（3）消融实验为负面结果：投影层存在时，基于物理信息奖励和纯成本奖励的训练收敛到相同策略（235,544 PKR/天），电压惩罚不提供梯度因而不起作用；（4）仅当移除投影层时奖励塑形才体现价值，将违规从每天1.20次降至零，但代价是34 kWh未交付电能。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过消融实验证明：一旦硬约束层存在，面向约束满足的奖励塑形是冗余的（不提供梯度、不改变策略）；该结果重新界定了软惩罚与硬约束在约束MDP中的分工与取舍。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电动汽车充电控制提供了可在现场部署的实用方案，表明调优惩罚权重的精力应转而投入到投影层的设计上；在真实电力连接上验证了成本节省和零违规的工程可行性。

title: Data Analytics in Credit Risk Management and Accounts Receivable Collection Optimization: A Practical Approach for Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises

detail.title: Data Analytics in Credit Risk Management and Accounts Receivable Collection Optimization: A Practical Approach for Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises
detail.abstract: Credit risk management is one of the most critical areas of financial management for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), particularly in highly volatile economies. Extending credit sales and payment terms to customers, while a competitive tool for boosting sales, exposes firms to the risk of non-collection and cash-flow disruption. Drawing on the theoretical literature on credit risk and accounts receivable management — including the procyclical behavior of credit extension, credit risk in profit-and-loss-sharing contracts under Islamic banking, the relationship between down payments and default probability, and the role of low cost behavioral reminders — this paper proposes a practical, data-driven framework for analyzing this risk, built on a combination of traditional accounting indicators (such as Days Sales Outstanding and receivables aging schedules) and accessible data-analysis tools such as Excel and Python. The paper also examines the author’s practical experience executing an overdue-payments collection process at an Iranian installment-sales firm as an applied case study, accompanied by a critical analysis from the perspective of behavioral economics and debt-collection ethics. The findings show that the systematic use of data analysis, even with relatively simple and accessible tools, can meaningfully improve the identification of high-risk customers, and that the roots of much delinquent debt lie in initial credit-screening policy and its alignment with the economic cycle, not merely in the collection process itself. This paper will be of value to financial managers, accountants, and researchers interested in financial risk management and data analytics at small and medium-sized firms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于数据驱动的中小企业信用风险管理框架，结合传统会计指标（如DSO、应收账款账龄分析）与Excel/Python等易获取的数据分析工具，并以一家伊朗分期销售企业的逾期账款催收实践为案例，从行为经济学和债务催收伦理视角进行批判性分析。研究发现：即使使用相对简单的数据分析工具，也能显著改进高风险客户的识别；多数坏账根源在于初始信贷筛选政策及其与经济周期的匹配度，而非催收过程本身。
AI.research_question: 如何利用易于获取的数据分析工具（Excel和Python）结合传统会计指标，构建一个实用的中小企业信用风险管理框架，以改进高风险客户的识别和逾期债务管理？
AI.motivation: 中小企业信用风险管理在高度波动的经济环境中尤为关键，赊销虽能提升销售竞争力，但使企业面临款项无法收回和现金流中断的风险。现有理论文献丰富，但缺乏一个将传统会计指标与可及性数据分析工具相结合、可直接应用于中小企业实践的实用框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: （1）信用扩张的顺周期性理论；（2）伊斯兰银行盈亏共享契约（PLS）中的信用风险理论；（3）首付比例与违约概率的关系理论；（4）低成本行为提醒在债务催收中的作用理论。
AI.method: 论文采用理论综述与案例研究相结合的方法：首先构建基于传统会计指标（DSO、应收账款账龄表）和Excel/Python工具的信用风险分析框架；然后以一个伊朗分期销售企业的逾期账款催收实践作为应用案例，并从行为经济学和债务催收伦理角度进行批判性分析。
AI.findings: （1）即使使用相对简单且易获取的数据分析工具，系统性地进行数据分析也能有效改进高风险客户的识别；（2）大部分坏账的根源在于最初信贷筛选政策的设计及其与经济周期的匹配度，而非催收过程本身。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信用风险相关理论（包括顺周期性、PLS合约风险、首付与违约关系、行为提醒机制）整合为一个可操作的数据驱动分析框架，推进了理论向中小企业实践场景的转化；并通过案例批判分析深化了对债务催收行为经济学维度和伦理维度的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融经理、会计师和研究人员提供了一个利用Excel和Python等易获取工具即可落地的信用风险管理实用框架；通过伊朗企业的真实案例展示了该框架的应用过程及成效；强调信贷筛选政策与经济周期匹配的重要性，为中小企业优化信用政策提供了实践指导。

title: ISA-95 Ontologies for Digital Manufacturing Transformation Addressing Data Integration, Governance, and Industry 4.0 Challenges in Manufacturing

detail.title: ISA-95 Ontologies for Digital Manufacturing Transformation Addressing Data Integration, Governance, and Industry 4.0 Challenges in Manufacturing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no personal, financial, or other relationships that could have influenced, or could be perceived to have influenced, the research presented in this paper.

keywords: ISA-95 Ontologies for Digital Manufacturing Transformation ISA-95
IEC 62264 Knowledge Graph Ontology Semantic Interoperability Manufacturing Data Hub Industry 4.0 Digital Transformation MES

detail.abstract: Manufacturing enterprises pursuing digital transformation face persistent structural barriers that impede the effective deployment of intelligent, data-driven systems. These barriers include data silos across disparate operational systems, semantic heterogeneity between data models, brittle point-topoint integration architectures, and deficient governance frameworks. This paper presents a systematic examination of formal ontologies realised as knowledge graphs and grounded in the ISA-95 (IEC 62264) standard as a semantic foundation for Manufacturing Data Hubs. Through a comprehensive literature review and conceptual analysis, we demonstrate how ISA-95-based ontological models provide a unified conceptualisation of manufacturing entities, including equipment, materials, personnel, and processes, and their interrelationships. This framework enables semantic interoperability, improved data quality, end-to-end traceability, and advanced analytics in support of Industry 4.0 objectives. Key contributions include a structured mapping of ontological solutions to specific industrial data integration challenges, detailed architectural guidance for knowledge graph deployment, and a research agenda for future investigation. Findings indicate that standardised ISA-95 ontologies substantially reduce transformation risks, accelerate time-to-value for digital initiatives, and support the construction of scalable, datacentric manufacturing ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统审视了以ISA-95（IEC 62264）标准为基础、以知识图谱形式实现的形式本体论，将其作为制造数据中枢的语义基础。通过文献综述和概念分析，论证了基于ISA-95的本体模型能够统一制造实体（设备、物料、人员、流程）及其相互关系，实现语义互操作性、改善数据质量、端到端追溯和高级分析，从而支持工业4.0目标。
AI.research_question: 如何利用基于ISA-95标准的形式本体论（以知识图谱形式实现）解决制造企业数字化转型中面临的结构性障碍（数据孤岛、语义异构、脆弱的点对点集成架构、治理框架缺失）？
AI.motivation: 制造企业在数字化转型中面临数据孤岛、语义异构、点对点集成架构脆弱、治理框架缺失等持久性结构障碍，阻碍了智能数据驱动系统的有效部署。
AI.theoretical_framework: 形式本体论（Formal Ontology）、知识图谱（Knowledge Graph）、ISA-95（IEC 62264）标准、语义互操作性理论、工业4.0框架
AI.method: 综合性文献综述与概念分析
AI.findings: 标准化ISA-95本体论能显著降低转型风险、加速数字举措的价值实现时间，并支持构建可扩展的、以数据为中心的制造生态系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将本体论解决方案结构化映射到特定工业数据集成挑战；2) 提供知识图谱部署的详细架构指导；3) 提出未来研究议程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制造企业数字化转型提供基于ISA-95标准的知识图谱架构参考，帮助识别和解决数据集成痛点，降低实施风险并加速价值实现。

title: Stock Returns vs. Options Greeks: An Empirical Analysis of Weekly Option Returns

detail.title: Stock Returns vs. Options Greeks: An Empirical Analysis of Weekly Option Returns
detail.abstract: This study investigated whether stock returns and Greek options explain weekly option returns. The conclusion was formed by comparing the explanatory power of the stock returns, Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega, and implied volatility. 25 large-to mega-cap U.S. companies were observed over six weeks. Each option contract was at-the-money at the time of selection, April 5, 2026, and had the same expiration date (May 15, 2026). The option price, Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega, implied volatility, and the stock price were collected weekly and compared using regression analysis. In this specific sample, stock returns explained about 70.3% of the variation in option returns, Greeks only explained about 15%, and the model combining the two explained about 73.1%. When looking at the explanatory power of each of the Greeks individually, Delta had the highest statistically significant explanatory power among all of the other Greeks. Theta and Vega, on the other hand, yielded very little explanatory power for the variation in weekly option returns. Across each model, low-IV models outperformed high-IV models while predictability changed across maturity subdivisions. This was found because the coefficient stability deteriorated under certain conditions. This study concludes that realized stock returns were the dominant driver of weekly option returns and that the Greeks are more useful for risk management and option pricing than they are for explaining realized short-term returns. These findings challenge the assumption that Greeks are predictive of realized returns and suggest that they function primarily as pricing and risk-management tools instead of returnpredicting signals. Results should be interpreted in the context of a single expiration cycle during a low-volatility market period, which limits generalizability to different market environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过回归分析比较了股票收益率与希腊字母（Delta、Gamma、Theta、Vega）以及隐含波动率对每周期权收益率的解释力。结果显示，股票收益率解释了约70.3%的期权收益变异，希腊字母仅解释约15%，两者结合的模型解释了约73.1%。研究发现股票收益率是短期期权收益的主导驱动因素，希腊字母更适合作为定价和风险管理工具而非收益预测信号。
AI.research_question: 股票收益率和希腊字母（Delta、Gamma、Theta、Vega）及隐含波动率能否解释每周期权收益率？各自的解释力如何？
AI.motivation: 挑战"希腊字母能预测已实现收益"这一传统假设，检验希腊字母究竟是收益预测信号还是主要用于定价和风险管理的工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期权定价理论中希腊字母（Delta、Gamma、Theta、Vega）与隐含波动率作为期权收益解释变量的理论基础，辅以回归分析框架。
AI.method: 选取25家美国大型至超大型市值公司的平值期权，观察6周（2026年4月5日至5月15日到期），每周收集期权价格、希腊字母、隐含波动率及股票价格数据，采用回归分析进行比较。
AI.findings: （1）股票收益率解释了约70.3%的期权收益变异，希腊字母仅解释约15%，合并模型解释约73.1%；（2）希腊字母中Delta具有最高且统计显著的解释力，Theta和Vega解释力很低；（3）低隐含波动率模型优于高隐含波动率模型，且预测力随到期期限细分而变化；（4）系数稳定性在特定条件下恶化。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了希腊字母能够预测已实现短期收益的传统假设，提出希腊字母主要作为定价和风险管理工具而非收益预测信号，为期权收益驱动因素的理论认知提供了实证修正。
AI.practical_contributions: 为期权交易者提供实操启示：短期期权收益主要由标的股票收益驱动，希腊字母应主要用于风险管理和期权定价，而非作为短期收益预测信号；同时提示在不同隐含波动率和到期期限条件下预测力的差异性。

title: Unconscious Bias in Procurement Sourcing: How Cognitive Biases Influence Supplier Selection

detail.title: Unconscious Bias in Procurement Sourcing: How Cognitive Biases Influence Supplier Selection
detail.abstract:
What if the supplier that wins a sourcing event is not necessarily the supplier that was evaluated most objectively, but the supplier that felt most familiar, reliable, or safe?

Sourcing processes are designed to provide suppliers with a fair opportunity to compete and allow organizations to select the option that provides the best overall value. However, supplier selection is ultimately performed by people, and cognitive biases can influence evaluations even when procurement professionals perform their jobs with integrity. This paper examines four biases that can affect supplier selection: familiarity bias, availability bias, anchoring bias, and confirmation bias, with particular attention to the advantage that incumbent suppliers may have during competitive sourcing events. Previous supplier performance and established relationships are relevant information, but they can also influence how procurement professionals evaluate a supplier's current proposal. Drawing on research in behavioral decision-making and supplier selection, this paper discusses how these biases can affect sourcing decisions and proposes practical strategies to reduce their impact. These include bias-awareness training, structured evaluation criteria, independent and cross-functional evaluations, consideration of disconfirming evidence, and the use of technology as decision support. The goal is not to prevent incumbent suppliers from winning sourcing events. Rather, it is to ensure that the selected supplier wins because of the value demonstrated in the current sourcing process.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了采购人员在进行供应商选择时可能受到的四类认知偏差（熟悉度偏差、可得性偏差、锚定偏差和确认偏差），特别关注现有供应商在竞争性采购中可能享有的优势。论文提出了减少偏差影响的实用策略，以确保供应商是因为当前采购流程中展现的价值而非认知偏差而获胜。
AI.research_question: 认知偏差如何影响供应商选择过程，特别是现有供应商在竞争性采购事件中可能获得的不公平优势？如何减少这些偏差的影响？
AI.motivation: 采购流程旨在为供应商提供公平竞争机会并选择最优方案，但供应商选择最终由人执行，即使采购专业人员诚信履职，认知偏差仍可能影响评估结果，导致获胜供应商未必是最客观评估的供应商。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为决策理论（behavioral decision-making）和供应商选择研究；具体涵盖熟悉度偏差、可得性偏差、锚定偏差和确认偏差四种认知偏差理论。
AI.method: 基于行为决策和供应商选择文献的理论综述与概念性分析，提出实用策略建议。
AI.findings: 采购专业人员在供应商评估中可能受到熟悉度偏差、可得性偏差、锚定偏差和确认偏差的影响，现有供应商因历史表现和已有关系可能享有认知优势。论文提出了五项缓解策略：偏差意识培训、结构化评估标准、独立和跨职能评估、考虑反证证据、以及利用技术作为决策支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行为决策理论中的认知偏差框架系统性地应用于供应商选择情境，揭示了现有供应商优势的认知心理学机制，丰富了供应商选择领域的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为采购组织提供了可操作的偏差缓解策略，包括培训、评估流程设计和技术工具应用，帮助组织确保供应商选择结果反映真实价值而非认知偏差。

title: Digital Transformation Capacity and Sustainable Development in South Africa’s Fintech Entrepreneurial Ecosystem: A Critical Realist Framework
affiliations: , University of KwaZulu-Natal and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Digital Transformation Capacity and Sustainable Development in South Africa’s Fintech Entrepreneurial Ecosystem: A Critical Realist Framework
detail.abstract: Digital transformation scholarship increasingly recognises transformation as a strategic, continuous and socio-technical process whose outcomes depend on organisational and ecosystem conditions. Yet less is known about how those conditions combine to produce developmentally meaningful outcomes in emerging-economy fintech ecosystems. This conceptual article addresses that gap by developing a Critical Realist Digital Transformation Capacity Framework for South Africa’s fintech entrepreneurial ecosystem. Drawing on digital transformation, entrepreneurial ecosystem and capacity-development scholarship, the framework conceptualises three analytically distinct but interdependent mechanisms: institutional capacity, human capacity and policy capacity. Their interaction gives rise to digital transformation capacity, defined here as an ecosystem’s emergent ability to mobilise and recombine digital technologies, skills, institutional arrangements and policy instruments to reconfigure activities and sustain valued outcomes. Critical realism supplies the explanatory logic by distinguishing observable events from the deeper structures and causal mechanisms that generate them in open systems. The framework proposes that sustainable development outcomes—including financial inclusion, entrepreneurial participation, ecosystem resilience and broader economic participation—depend not on technology adoption alone, but on how these capacities are configured and activated in context. The article contributes to digital transformation research by connecting ecosystem coordination and capacity development to mechanism-based explanation, while providing a context-sensitive foundation for empirical investigation in South Africa and comparable emerging economies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个批判实在论数字转型能力框架，用于分析南非金融科技创业生态系统。该框架将制度能力、人力能力和政策能力三种机制进行概念化，认为其相互作用产生数字转型能力，进而影响金融包容性、创业参与、生态系统韧性等可持续发展成果。文章强调数字转型不是单纯的技术采纳，而是多种能力在特定情境中的配置与激活。
AI.research_question: 新兴经济体金融科技生态系统中，哪些条件的组合能够产生具有发展意义的结果？具体而言，组织与生态系统的条件如何结合起来产生数字转型能力？
AI.motivation: 现有数字转型研究已认识到转型是战略性、持续性的社会技术过程，其成果依赖于组织与生态系统条件，但对于这些条件如何组合以在新兴经济体金融科技生态系统中产生发展性成果的了解仍十分有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判实在论（Critical Realism）、数字转型理论、创业生态系统理论、能力发展理论
AI.method: 概念性文章，通过综合数字转型、创业生态系统和能力发展文献，运用批判实在论的解释逻辑构建理论框架。
AI.findings: 提出了数字转型能力框架，包含三种相互独立但相互依存的机制：制度能力、人力能力和政策能力。它们的相互作用产生数字转型能力，即生态系统调动和重组数字技术、技能、制度安排和政策工具以重构活动并维持有价值成果的涌现能力。可持续发展成果（金融包容性、创业参与、生态系统韧性、经济参与）取决于能力的配置与情境激活，而非单纯的技术采纳。
AI.theory_contributions: 将生态系统协调和能力发展与基于机制的解释联系起来，推进了数字转型研究；为新兴经济体提供了情境敏感的数字转型能力理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为南非及同类新兴经济体的数字转型实证调查提供了情境敏感的基础，有助于政策制定者和生态系统参与者理解如何配置和激活各类能力以促进可持续发展。

title: Who Scrutinises the Scrutinisers? Concentration, Private Moderation and the Failure of Presumptive Authority in PubPeer Commentary
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: Who Scrutinises the Scrutinisers? Concentration, Private Moderation and the Failure of Presumptive Authority in PubPeer Commentary
detail.abstract: Public post-publication commentary can acquire institutional consequences without acquiring the safeguards expected of a scientific review, regulatory decision or research-misconduct finding. This article examines that asymmetry through a quantitative reanalysis of José Luis Ortega's historical PubPeer sample and a documentary audit of PubPeer's current public rules, data-access arrangements, moderation statements, persistence policies and distribution services. Ortega reported 68,595 posts attributed to 26,456 users. Within that sample, 25 users—0.09%—produced 17.14% of posts; 577 users with at least ten posts represented 2.18% of users but produced 30.71% of posts. These figures establish marked concentration in the sampled 2019–2020 collection, not the current platform. A present day estimate cannot be independently reproduced from public search totals because the event unit, denominator, deletion and editing rules, account-to-person relationship and coverage of the visible index are not publicly specified. PubPeer's own documents sharpen rather than resolve the problem. The website states that it does not scientifically review comments and gives no warranty of their truth, while it also premoderates some accounts, assigns trust states, distributes alerts and plugins, supplies institutional dashboards, usually preserves comments after convincing replies or journal corrections, restricts automated collection and shares data with researchers, publishers and institutions, sometimes for a fee. Thus, practical consequence travels outward while the records needed to audit concentration, moderation, correction and role separation remain principally under private control. This consequence–auditability inversion defeats any presumption that a published or prolific comment is independent, expert or scientifically verified. Anonymity may protect a contributor's identity, but it is not a quality credential and need not be removed to reach that conclusion. The appropriate institutional rule is non-reliance: comments may be treated as source claims or investigative leads, but never as findings, corroboration by repetition or a substitute for competent examination, notice, response and reasoned decision. The evidence does not prove that prolific commentators are inaccurate, automated, coordinated or conflicted. It proves that the public record is insufficient to grant them, or the platform that selects and distributes their work, presumptive scientific or adjudicative authority.

AI.tldr: 本文通过定量重分析PubPeer的历史数据和对平台现行规则的文件审计，揭示了在线科研评论平台存在"后果-可审计性倒置"问题：评论能够产生制度性后果，但缺乏科学审查、监管决定或科研不端调查所应有的保障。作者提出制度上应当采取"不依赖原则"（non-reliance），即评论只能作为线索或来源声明，不能作为发现或独立证据。
AI.research_question: PubPeer平台上的公开后期发表评论能够产生制度性后果，但这些评论是否具备与之匹配的科学审查、监管和问责保障？平台评论的集中度、可审计性以及制度权威之间是否存在不对称性？
AI.motivation: 公众的发表后评论（post-publication commentary）可以产生制度性影响（如引发撤稿、机构调查等），但缺乏正式科学审查、监管决策或科研不端调查应有的程序保障，这种不对称性值得系统检视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于科学治理与问责制理论，分析公共评论平台的制度权威、可审计性（auditability）与科学证据质量标准之间的张力。
AI.method: 混合方法：（1）对José Luis Ortega历史PubPeer样本（68,595条帖子、26,456名用户）进行定量再分析；（2）对PubPeer现行公开规则、数据访问安排、审核声明、持久化政策和分发服务进行文件审计。
AI.findings: （1）2019-2020年样本中内容高度集中：25名用户（0.09%）产出17.14%的帖子；577名用户（2.18%）产出30.71%的帖子。（2）当前平台的集中度无法独立复现，因为事件单位、分母、删除和编辑规则、账户与人的关系及可见索引覆盖范围均未公开。（3）PubPeer自身规则显示：网站不进行科学审查、不保证评论真实性，但同时进行预审核、分配信任状态、分发警报和插件、提供机构仪表盘、通常保留评论、限制自动采集，并向研究人员/出版商/机构共享数据（有时收费）——后果向外流动，而审计记录留在私人控制之下。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"后果-可审计性倒置"（consequence–auditability inversion）概念，揭示私人平台行使公共制度功能时的治理缺陷；论证匿名不等于质量凭证，不需要移除匿名也能得出该结论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出制度性规则建议：采用"不依赖原则"（non-reliance），即评论只能作为来源声明或调查线索，不能作为发现、重复佐证或替代正式审查/通知/回应/合理决策的程序。

title: The Progressive Reversal
affiliations: Saint Mary's University, Canada

detail.title: The Progressive Reversal
detail.abstract: What if we take the idea of progressiveness quite literally? This paper develops a dynamic model of a Progressive Reversal. A progressive society devotes a rising but bounded share of output to virtue expenditure. Virtue expenditure accumulates into a stock of virtue, which can be converted into cultural-institutional capital (CIC) only in combination with complementary physical capacity through a Leontief production function. Output is conventionally produced using CIC and physical capital. At moderate levels of progressiveness, virtue accumulation builds CIC and generates an output dividend. As progressiveness continues, however, physical investment is crowded out and physical capital eventually becomes the binding input in CIC production. Virtue is then increasingly stranded because its complementary physical capital is missing. The same process that initially raises output consequently produces a reversal, eventually bringing the progressive society below the steady-state output of an otherwise identical non-progressive society. Consumption exhibits a similar reversal. The model thus identifies a physical-capacity bottleneck through which a socially valued and initially productive commitment can ultimately undermine the material basis of its own success.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个"进步性逆转"的动态模型，探讨一个进步社会将越来越多的产出份额投入美德支出，虽然初期能积累文化制度资本并提升产出，但随着物理投资被挤出，物理资本成为瓶颈，最终导致产出和消费反转，使进步社会低于同等非进步社会的稳态水平。
AI.research_question: 如果将进步性的理念从字面意义上理解——即一个社会持续增加对美德或社会价值支出的投入——这一过程最终会产生怎样的经济后果？是否会导致增长逆转？
AI.motivation: 已有文献多关注进步性（progressiveness）的积极效应，但尚未从动态视角分析持续增加的进步投入是否会因资源竞争而产生自我颠覆的后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态宏观增长模型；美德积累函数；Leontief生产函数（美德与物理产能的互补关系）；文化制度资本（CIC）生产函数；标准最终产出生产函数。
AI.method: 构建连续时间的动态优化模型，模拟进步社会中美德支出份额逐渐上升的路径，并与非进步社会对照，分析产出与消费的稳态与动态演化。
AI.findings: （1）在适度进步水平下，美德积累能构建文化制度资本并产生产出红利；（2）当进步性持续上升时，物理投资被挤出，物理资本成为CIC生产中的瓶颈；（3）美德因缺少互补的物理资本而日益被困（stranded）；（4）最初提升产出的过程最终产生逆转，进步社会的产出和消费低于同等非进步社会的稳态水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别了"物理产能瓶颈"机制：一个社会重视且初期有效的承诺最终可能削弱自身成功的物质基础；为进步性与经济增长关系提供了动态逆转的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供警示：持续增加对社会价值或美德投资的资源倾斜需警惕物理资本投资的挤出效应，避免因失衡导致长期增长逆转。

title: Watchdogs Watching Watchdogs: Public Conflict, Recursive Authority and the Failure of Independent Corroboration
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: Watchdogs Watching Watchdogs: Public Conflict, Recursive Authority and the Failure of Independent Corroboration

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial competing interests. The author has published critical analyses of post-publication-comment platforms, research-integrity commentators, journalism websites and related organisations. This intellectual position is disclosed so that readers can assess the argument against its cited evidence.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The article analyses public institutional roles and public professional publications. It does not attempt to identify anonymous contributors, disclose private contact details or infer private motives. Claims of coordination, corruption, unlawful harassment and causation were excluded where the public record did not establish them.

detail.abstract: PubPeer is a website for post-publication comments. Retraction Watch is a journalism website and database-producing organisation. For Better Science is an independently operated reporting and commentary website. COSIG is a contributorled guidance project. None of those descriptions establishes scientific, investigative or adjudicative authority. This article tests the stronger status frequently produced by visibility, repetition and institutional uptake: whether these actors qualify as independent corroborators or presumptive authorities when the same allegations, sources, participants and reputational signals circulate between them. On the public record examined here, they do not. Public disagreement does not cure source dependence, moderation opacity, role overlap or the absence of accountable adjudication.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了PubPeer、Retraction Watch、For Better Science和COSIG等学术监督平台是否因其可见性、重复性和制度采纳而获得独立佐证者或推定权威的地位。基于公开记录，这些平台并不具备此类地位，因为公开分歧无法弥补来源依赖、审核不透明、角色重叠及缺乏问责性裁决等问题。
AI.research_question: 当相同的指控、来源、参与者和声誉信号在这些平台之间循环传播时，这些学术监督机构是否能够成为独立的佐证者或推定权威？
AI.motivation: 这些平台通过可见性、重复传播和制度采纳获得了超越其原始描述的更强地位，但这种地位是否具有科学、调查或裁决的权威性值得检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 来源依赖理论、权威建构理论、声誉信号传播理论、问责性裁决框架
AI.method: 基于公开记录的定性分析，追踪指控、来源、参与者和声誉信号在多个平台间的传播循环
AI.findings: 这些平台不构成独立的佐证者或推定权威；公开分歧不能治愈来源依赖、审核不透明、角色重叠以及缺乏问责性裁决的根本缺陷
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"独立佐证者"和"推定权威"的判定标准，揭示多平台循环传播可能制造虚假的独立性和权威性表象，而非真正的独立性验证
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术界和公众评估学术监督平台的可靠性提供批判性框架，提醒不能仅依据平台的可见度和传播范围来判断其权威性

title: Generative Change Management: Foundational Concepts for Human-AI Hybrid Productivity in Organizations

detail.title: Generative Change Management: Foundational Concepts for Human-AI Hybrid Productivity in Organizations
detail.abstract:
The incorporation of generative artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming everyday work well beyond task automation. People increasingly work with systems capable of participating in analysis, creation, decision-making, and knowledge production. This transformation changes the professional relationship with AI, the organization of work, and the cultural frameworks through which organizations build relationships, distribute authority, recognize contributions, and produce meaning.

Generative Change Management (GChM) is proposed as a conceptual framework that grounds a methodological approach to three interdependent transformations resulting from the integration of human and AI capabilities: the redefinition of professional contribution, the design of new work architectures, and organizational coexistence with algorithmic intelligence. At the personal level, GChM addresses the relationship people establish with AI in developing their professional capabilities. At the operational level, it addresses hybrid production architectures that combine human capabilities with digital production units operating at different degrees of autonomy. At the cultural level, it addresses the development of hybrid organizational intelligence through new forms of symbolic-algorithmic linkage.

The GChM approach articulates analysis, design, and implementation as a core intervention cycle. Implementation generates experience that can be evaluated and converted into organizational learning, which then provides a basis for redesign. Through this recursive process, the integration of AI simultaneously transforms professional contribution, the organization of production, and the experience of belonging, trust, and cultural identification. GChM proposes that the articulation of these transformations can develop hybrid productivity as an organization-specific capability that is difficult to reproduce through access to technology alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"生成式变革管理"（GChM）作为概念框架，系统性地回应生成式人工智能融入工作场所后带来的三重相互依赖的变革——专业贡献的重新定义、新型工作架构的设计以及组织与算法智能的共存，并主张通过分析-设计-实施的递归干预循环，将混合生产力发展为组织特有的、难以仅靠技术获取复制的战略性能力。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能的融入如何从根本上改变专业贡献、工作架构和组织文化？组织应如何系统性管理这一三重转型过程以发展混合生产力？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI已超越任务自动化的范畴，深度参与分析、创造、决策和知识生产，重塑了人机专业关系、工作组织方式以及组织的文化框架（关系构建、权威分配、贡献认可和意义生产）。然而现有框架缺乏对这三重转型进行系统化理解和干预的方法论，亟需一个整合性概念框架来指导实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: GChM框架整合了三个层面的理论视角：个人层面的"人机专业能力发展关系"理论、操作层面的"混合生产架构"理论（人类能力与不同自治程度的数字生产单元结合）、文化层面的"混合组织智能"理论（符号-算法联结）。
AI.method: 提出GChM作为概念性框架和方法论框架，以分析-设计-实施为核心干预循环，通过递归过程将实施经验转化为组织学习并指导再设计，形成持续迭代的方法路径。
AI.findings: GChM框架认为，通过递归的干预循环，AI整合能够同时变革专业贡献、生产组织和归属感/信任/文化认同体验。这些转型的协同联动可以将混合生产力发展为组织特有的能力，该能力难以仅通过获取技术来复制。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解生成式AI的组织融入提供了系统化的多层面概念框架（个人/操作/文化），将"混合生产力"概念化为组织专用能力而非技术属性，补充了变革管理理论在算法智能时代的新维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织管理者提供了结构化的变革干预方法论（分析-设计-实施的递归循环），指导如何将AI整合转化为可持续的组织学习与能力建设，而非孤立的自动化部署。

title: Holding the Watchdog to Account: Reciprocal Accountability, Source Independence, and Reflexivity in Science-Integrity Journalism
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: Holding the Watchdog to Account: Reciprocal Accountability, Source Independence, and Reflexivity in Science-Integrity Journalism
detail.abstract: Fleerackers et al. (2026) report how 21 journalists describe research-integrity reporting, including story discovery, verification, right of reply, resource constraints, and reliance on specialist sources. This commentary critically appraises the fit between that interview design and the paper's broader normative conclusions. A document-based review of the published article, its author-contribution and conflict disclosures, cited platform policies, organisational materials, related empirical studies, and journalism ethics standards identifies five unresolved problems: self-reported rigor is treated too readily as evidence of performance; source discovery is not separated from independent corroboration; recruitment and interpretation involve structural role overlap that requires stronger reflexivity; the perspective and documentary record of people subjected to reporting are largely absent; and a proposed distributed monitoring system is not accompanied by an equivalent architecture of qualification, correction, complaint, and remedy. A reciprocal accountability framework is offered to test claimed authority by observable evidence rather than occupational identity or public visibility.

AI.tldr: 本文对Fleerackers等人关于记者描述科研诚信报道的研究进行批判性评论，指出其访谈设计与规范性结论之间存在五个未解决的问题，并提出"互惠问责框架"作为替代性检验标准。
AI.research_question: Fleerackers等人关于记者科研诚信报道的访谈研究设计与其更广泛的规范性结论之间是否匹配？
AI.motivation: 作者认为原研究将自我报告的真实性过快地视为表现证据，在来源发现、独立验证、角色重叠、被报道者视角以及分布式监控系统设计等方面存在方法论与规范性缺陷，亟需批判性审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 互惠问责框架（reciprocal accountability framework）；基于可观察证据而非职业身份或公共可见性来检验主张权威性的理论。
AI.method: 基于文档的审查方法，涵盖已发表文章、作者贡献与利益冲突披露、平台政策、组织材料、相关实证研究及新闻伦理标准。
AI.findings: 识别出五个未解决问题：（1）自我报告的真实性被过于轻易地视为表现证据；（2）来源发现未与独立佐证分离；（3）招募与解释存在结构性角色重叠，需要更强的反身性；（4）被报道者的视角与文献记录基本缺失；（5）提出的分布式监控系统缺乏相应的资格认定、更正、投诉与补救架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出互惠问责框架，主张以可观察证据而非职业身份或公共可见性来检验权威主张，为科研诚信报道研究提供新的理论评价标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科研诚信报道的实践改进提供具体方向，包括建立更严格的验证标准、纳入被报道者视角、以及完善分布式监控系统的问责与补救机制。

title: Embodied Humanity and Gender Identity: A Reformed Theological Evaluation of Transgender Medicine
affiliations: and University of Calabar, Calabar Nigeria

detail.title: Embodied Humanity and Gender Identity: A Reformed Theological Evaluation of Transgender Medicine

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Recent developments in transgender medicine have generated significant theological, ethical and pastoral debate within Christianity. While advances in endocrinology, psychology and surgical interventions have expanded treatment options for individuals experiencing gender dysphoria, these developments also raise fundamental questions concerning human identity, embodiment and the moral limits of medical intervention. This article offers a theological evaluation of transgender medicine by examining biblical anthropology, the doctrine of creation, the significance of embodied humanity and the relationship between biological sex and personal identity. Drawing upon Scripture, the Reformed confessional tradition, contemporary theological anthropology and current medical literature, the study argues that the human body is not an accidental or negotiable aspect of personhood but an integral component of God's creative intention. While affirming the dignity of every person as created in the image of God and recognizing the reality of psychological suffering associated with gender dysphoria, the article contends that medical interventions designed to alter the body's sexual characteristics require careful theological scrutiny. It concludes by proposing a pastoral ethic that combines doctrinal fidelity with compassion, emphasizing truth, human dignity and Christian care.

AI.tldr: 本文从基督教神学视角评估跨性别医学，基于圣经人类学、创造论教义和身体神学，论证身体是上帝创造意图的整体组成部分而非可协商的方面，主张对改变身体性别特征的医学干预需进行严格的神学审视，并提出结合教义忠诚与怜悯的牧养伦理。
AI.research_question: 跨性别医学在基督教神学框架下应如何被评估？身体的生物学性别与个人身份之间具有何种神学关系？
AI.motivation: 跨性别医学的快速发展在基督教内部引发了重大的神学、伦理和牧养辩论，需要系统性的神学回应来指导教会实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 圣经人类学、创造论教义、道成肉身/具身人类学（embodied humanity）、改革宗认信传统、当代神学人类学
AI.method: 神学文本分析，综合运用圣经经文、改革宗认信文献、当代神学人类学著作及当代医学文献进行跨学科评估
AI.findings: （1）人的身体不是人格中偶然或可协商的方面，而是上帝创造性意图的完整组成部分；（2）在肯定每个人作为上帝形象承载者的尊严和性别焦虑心理痛苦的同时，改变身体性别特征的医学干预需要严格的神学审视；（3）提出一种将教义忠诚与怜悯相结合的牧养伦理。
AI.theory_contributions: 为跨性别医学提供了系统的改革宗神学评估框架，将圣经人类学与当代医学议题进行神学整合，丰富了具身人类学与性别身份关系的理论思考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为基督徒群体应对跨性别医学议题提供了兼具教义立场与怜悯关怀的牧养伦理指导，平衡了真理、人性尊严与基督教关怀三个维度。

title: The Face of Retraction: Visual Individualisation, Status Compression and the Failure of Neutral Imagery in Retraction Watch
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: The Face of Retraction: Visual Individualisation, Status Compression and the Failure of Neutral Imagery in Retraction Watch

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial competing interests. The author has published critical analyses of post-publication-comment websites, research-integrity commentators, journalism websites and related organisations. This intellectual position is disclosed so that readers can test the conclusions against the cited record.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this article.

detail.abstract: Research-integrity reporting is usually evaluated through its words: headlines, allegations, findings, corrections and responses. The visual treatment of named researchers receives less scrutiny even though a portrait can give a distributed or unresolved controversy a stable individual face. This article conducts a structured documentary audit of 13 person-centred Retraction Watch stories published from March 2025 to July 2026, with webpage status checked through 22 August 2026. It records the procedural position reported at publication, visual type and source, whether the image supplies case evidence or only identity, whether responsibility is distributed, and whether a person-centred visual could be confirmed from the accessible page capture. Nine stories used a confirmed identifiable portrait, professional-profile image or social-media visual. In two, promotional or profile material performed a material evidentiary function; in the remaining seven, the visual primarily identified the person. One comparator used a stock/topic image and three accessible captures did not confirm an individualised visual. The purposive corpus cannot establish site-wide prevalence, audience effect, unlawful image use, discriminatory selection, malicious intent or measurable harm. It establishes a narrower failure of qualification. Retraction Watch makes materially different visual choices across stories with comparable professional consequences, while the public privacy and editorial-independence policies reviewed do not explain subject-image selection, proportionality, status thresholds, multi-actor fairness, later reassessment or removal. The article defines visual individualisation, responsibility compression, status compression and circulation persistence; distinguishes evidence from identification; and applies a seven-part qualification test to adverse person-centred imagery. Where a face contributes no material proof and no transparent rule justifies its use, the image should be treated as an editorial reputational anchor, not as neutral documentation. Journals, universities and other institutions should not import that association into formal decision-making or regard visual salience as corroboration.

AI.tldr: 本文对Retraction Watch在2025年3月至2026年7月期间发布的13篇以人物为中心的撤稿报道进行结构化文档审计，发现其中9篇使用了可确认的具名肖像，但多数图片仅起到身份识别而非证据作用。研究提出"视觉个体化""责任压缩""状态压缩""流通持久性"等概念，并设计七部分资格检验，结论是：当面部图像不提供实质证明且缺乏透明规则时，应将其视为编辑声誉锚点而非中立记录，机构不应将其引入正式决策或视为佐证。
AI.research_question: 在科研诚信报道中，被具名研究者的视觉呈现（肖像）是如何被选择的？这些图像在争议报道中承担何种功能（证据还是身份标识）？其使用是否存在编辑上的资格缺失问题？
AI.motivation: 科研诚信报道的审查通常聚焦于文字（标题、指控、发现、更正与回应），而对被具名研究者的视觉处理缺乏审视。然而一幅肖像可以将分散或未解决的争议赋予一个稳定的个体面孔，可能造成声誉影响，因此值得系统检视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出并定义了四个核心概念：视觉个体化（visual individualisation）、责任压缩（responsibility compression）、状态压缩（status compression）和流通持久性（circulation persistence），并区分了证据功能与身份识别功能，构建了七部分资格检验（seven-part qualification test）。
AI.method: 结构化文档审计：对2025年3月至2026年7月发布的13篇以人物为中心的Retraction Watch报道进行系统检视，记录报道时的程序地位、视觉类型与来源、图像是否提供案件证据或仅为身份识别、责任是否被分配，以及从可访问的网页快照（截至2026年8月22日）中能否确认人物中心视觉。采用有目的抽样（purposive corpus）。
AI.findings: 13篇报道中，9篇使用可确认的具名肖像、职业档案图像或社交媒体视觉；其中2篇中推广或档案材料承担了实质性证据功能，其余7篇视觉主要起身份识别作用；1篇使用库存/主题图像，3篇可访问快照未能确认个性化视觉。研究确认了"更窄的资格失败"：Retraction Watch在不同报道之间对可比较的职业后果作出了实质性不同的视觉选择，且公开的隐私与编辑独立性政策未能解释主题图像选择、比例性、状态门槛、多主体公平性、后续重新评估或移除等问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 定义了"视觉个体化""责任压缩""状态压缩""流通持久性"四个新概念；区分了证据图像与身份识别图像的功能差异；提出七部分资格检验框架，用于评估不利的人物中心图像是否具有正当性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为期刊、大学及其他机构提供实践警示：不应将未经资格检验的视觉显著性引入正式决策，不应将人物肖像视为事实的佐证；建议将不提供实质证明且缺乏透明规则的人物图像视为"编辑声誉锚点"而非中立文档，并呼吁编辑机构明确图像选择政策。

title: Optimal Influence in Markovian Opinion Networks
affiliations: Chulalongkorn University,  and National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Industrial & Systems Engineering

detail.title: Optimal Influence in Markovian Opinion Networks
detail.abstract: The proliferation of digital social networks has intensified ideological polarization and created new arenas for information warfare. We develop a mathematical framework for strategic influence competition between two (or more) opposing groups in a network of opinion setters, each represented by a disjoint set of influencers. For a randomly selected social media user, we model the evolving identity of the most influential opinion setter using a Markov chain. From the perspective of one group, we maximize the discounted cumulative probability that this opinion setter belongs to that group, capturing the tradeoff between immediate and long-term influence. The transition matrix serves as the decision variable and is constrained by finite manipulation budgets. Although the resulting problem appears intractable at first glance, we derive a convex, and in some cases linear, reformulation through suitable variable transformations. Experiments on real-world U.S. political datasets show that the proposed model can reverse the baseline influence outcome, enabling a group with initially weaker influence to achieve dominance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个数学框架，用于分析社交网络中两个对立群体之间的战略影响力竞争。通过马尔可夫链建模随机用户的意见领袖归属，以转移矩阵为决策变量、在有限操纵预算约束下最大化折现累积影响力概率。通过变量变换将看似棘手的优化问题转化为凸（甚至线性）问题，并在真实美国政治数据集上验证了模型能使初始弱势群体反转为优势。
AI.research_question: 在社交网络中，两个对立群体如何在有限的操纵预算约束下，通过优化影响力竞争策略来最大化其对随机用户的长期影响力？
AI.motivation: 数字社交网络的扩散加剧了意识形态极化，并催生了信息战的新战场。现有研究缺乏一个可计算的数学框架来系统分析对立群体之间的战略影响力竞争，特别是如何在有限资源下实现影响力的逆转。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马尔可夫链模型（用于刻画随机用户最受影响意见领袖的演化身份）、随机最优控制/动态规划（用于处理折现累积概率的最大化）、凸优化理论（用于问题重构与求解）
AI.method: 建立马尔可夫链模型描述用户对意见领袖的归属状态转移；将转移矩阵作为决策变量，施加有限操纵预算约束；通过适当的变量变换将原问题转化为凸优化或线性规划问题；使用真实美国政治数据集进行实验验证。
AI.findings: 在真实美国政治数据集上的实验表明，所提出的模型能够逆转基线的影影响力结果，使初始影响力较弱的群体实现主导地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为社交网络对立群体间的战略影响力竞争提供了严格的数学建模框架；将原本看似不可解的问题通过变量变换转化为凸（或线性）可解形式，为网络影响力竞争研究提供了理论工具；建立了有限预算约束下即时与长期影响力之间的权衡分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际的信息战、政治竞选和社交媒体影响力运营提供了可操作的策略优化工具；通过实证验证说明弱势群体可以通过优化策略实现影响力反转，对理解现实网络舆论竞争具有实践指导意义。

title: Modeling Mobility Resilience under Hurricane-Induced Disruptions: A First-Order Recovery Dynamics Approach
affiliations: FAMU-FSU College of Engineering, UNSW, Nanjing University of Science and Technology, Florida State University and Arizona State University (ASU) - School of Sustainable Engineering and the Built Environment

detail.title: Modeling Mobility Resilience under Hurricane-Induced Disruptions: A First-Order Recovery Dynamics Approach
detail.abstract: Understanding post-hurricane mobility recovery is essential for improving transportation resilience and post-disaster decision-making. This study develops a stage-based resilience framework and a first-order exponential recovery model using INRIX Trip Analytics data. Total trips and average travel distance are used to characterize travel demand and behavior. Four disruption-recovery stages and five resilience metrics, Survivability, Duration, Flexibility, Robustness, and Recovery Gain Ratio, are applied to Hurricanes Sally, Ian, Helene, and Milton in Florida. The recovery model requires only one free parameter, the recovery rate, providing an interpretable measure of restoration speed. Compared with Linear, Polynomial, Logistic, and Weibull models, it achieves competitive predictive performance with lower complexity and favorable information criteria. Results reveal substantial variation across storms and indicators, demonstrating that hurricane category alone does not determine mobility degradation or recovery. The framework offers a practical tool for resilience assessment, emergency management, and post-disaster recovery prioritization.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个基于阶段的韧性框架和一阶指数恢复模型，利用INRIX行程数据来分析佛罗里达州四场飓风（Sally、Ian、Helene、Milton）后的出行韧性。模型仅需一个自由参数（恢复率），在预测性能上与更复杂的模型相当但更简洁，为灾害后交通恢复评估提供了实用工具。
AI.research_question: 飓风过后交通出行韧性的恢复过程如何量化？如何构建一个简洁有效的恢复模型来评估不同飓风事件下的交通韧性差异？
AI.motivation: 理解飓风后出行恢复对于提升交通韧性和灾后决策至关重要，但现有研究缺乏统一的阶段性韧性框架和简洁可解释的恢复模型来系统评估不同飓风事件下的交通韧性表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于阶段的韧性框架（包含四个干扰-恢复阶段）、一阶指数恢复模型、五大韧性指标（生存能力、持续时间、灵活性、稳健性和恢复增益比）
AI.method: 利用INRIX行程分析数据，以总行程数和平均出行距离表征出行需求和行为；构建一阶指数恢复模型，通过恢复率单一参数衡量恢复速度；与线性、多项式、Logistic和Weibull模型进行对比验证预测性能。
AI.findings: 模型在预测性能上与其他复杂模型相当但复杂度更低，信息准则更优；不同风暴和指标间表现出显著变化，飓风等级并不能单独决定出行退化和恢复的程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的阶段性韧性框架和五维韧性指标体系，以及仅需单一参数的可解释恢复模型，丰富了灾害交通韧性量化的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韧性评估、应急管理和灾后恢复优先级排序提供了实用工具，有助于交通管理部门更好地制定灾后应对策略。

title: Load-Dependent Electrolyzer Modeling for Green Hydrogen Plant Planning and Operation with Physically Screened Renewable Scenarios
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Universidade Estadual de Campinas (UNICAMP) - Department of Systems and Energy

detail.title: Load-Dependent Electrolyzer Modeling for Green Hydrogen Plant Planning and Operation with Physically Screened Renewable Scenarios
detail.abstract: Green hydrogen plant planning and operation require electrolyzer (EL) models that capture load-dependent hydrogen conversion while remaining computationally tractable under renewable uncertainty. This paper develops a capacity-dependent bounded reduced-binary piecewise-linear (BRB-PWL) formulation with endogenous EL sizing by incorporating an endpoint-based affine underestimator into a linear reduced-binary model. Within the productive operating region, its bounds describe the convex hull of the adopted capacity-scaled PWL production graph in the common continuous variables without segment-selection binaries. Alternative EL formulations are evaluated in a stochastic mixed-integer linear programming framework using synchronized photovoltaic and wind representative weeks obtained from canonical K-medoids partitions, with scenario counts screened for physical fidelity. Plant designs from alternative scenario counts are assessed over the 104 original weeks using the exact segment-binary PWL formulation. Relative to five scenarios, six scenarios reduced average unmet hydrogen delivery by 67.91% and renewable curtailment by 14.46%, while designs from six to ten scenarios showed similar overall performance. In economic plant planning, BRB-PWL reproduced the design, objective value, and hydrogen-production schedule obtained with the exact segment-binary formulation while reducing solution time by 94.34%. Under binding hydrogen-sales limits, BRB-PWL reduced the expected and maximum envelope slack of the reduced-binary formulation by 84.81% and 86.54%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种容量相关的有界简化二元分段线性（BRB-PWL）公式，用于绿色氢气工厂的电解槽建模与规划，在保持计算可处理性的同时准确捕捉负载依赖的氢气转换效率，并通过随机混合整数线性规划框架验证其在经济规划中的高效性和准确性。
AI.research_question: 如何在绿色氢气工厂规划中建立既能准确捕捉电解槽负载依赖的氢气转换效率，又能在可再生能源不确定性下保持计算可处理性的电解槽模型？
AI.motivation: 绿色氢气工厂的规划和运行需要能够捕捉负载依赖氢气转换的电解槽模型，但同时要在可再生能源不确定性下保持计算可处理性，现有模型在这两方面存在权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分段线性逼近理论、混合整数线性规划（MILP）、随机规划、凸包理论
AI.method: 提出容量相关的有界简化二元分段线性（BRB-PWL）公式，将基于端点的仿射下界估计量整合进线性简化二元模型中，实现内生电解槽容量确定。在随机MILP框架中使用同步光伏和风电代表周（基于K-medoids分区）进行评估，并用精确的分段二元PWL公式对替代场景数量的设计方案在104个原始周上进行验证。
AI.findings: 1）相比五个场景，六个场景将平均未满足的氢气交付减少了67.91%，可再生能源弃电量减少了14.46%；2）六到十个场景的设计整体表现相似；3）BRB-PWL在复现精确分段二元公式的设计、目标值和氢气生产计划的同时，将求解时间减少了94.34%；4）在有约束的氢气销售限制下，BRB-PWL将简化二元公式的期望和最大包络松弛度分别减少了84.81%和86.54%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新的BRB-PWL公式，其边界在生产性运行区域内能够描述采用容量缩放PWL生产图在公共连续变量中的凸包，且无需分段选择二元变量，为电解槽建模提供了理论上的有效紧凑表示。
AI.practical_contributions: 为绿色氢气工厂规划提供了计算高效且准确的电解槽建模方法，显著降低求解时间的同时保持解决方案质量，并指导了随机场景数量的选择（六个场景较为合适），对实际工厂设计和运行决策具有直接应用价值。

title: Technical Indicator Combinations and Cross-Market Generalization: Evidence from Indian and U.S. Equities

detail.title: Technical Indicator Combinations and Cross-Market Generalization: Evidence from Indian and U.S. Equities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No external funding was received for this research, which was conducted independently. The author is an independent market researcher and active trader and may hold positions in securities appearing in the equity universes studied (broad current constituents of the NSE, S&P 500, and S&P MidCap 400 — 332, 415, and 300 names respectively, not a selected list; no security was chosen for inclusion on the basis of any position held). The author derives no commercial benefit from any data vendor, index provider, brokerage, or software product referenced in this study, and has no other competing financial interests to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research, which was conducted independently and without institutional support.

detail.abstract: We evaluate the complete space of one-to four-indicator combinations drawn from a 23-signal technical pool under two voting logics-21,528 distinct strategies-across three equity baskets spanning India and the United States over 2009-2026, varying only the universe. Applying Hansen's Superior Predictive Ability test to the full rule universe returns p = 1.00 in every basket: not one model has a positive mean excess return over its benchmark, so the test never has a candidate. But the conventional benchmark comparison is itself mis-specified: these are long/short books whose legs largely offset, with median market beta between-0.24 and +0.08-an order of magnitude below the benchmark's-so comparing them to a fully-invested benchmark measures cash drag, not skill. Performance is instead governed by exposure, which alone explains 76% of return variation. We therefore add an exposure-matched null: each position series is circularly shifted in time, preserving exposure while destroying timing. In both US baskets every combination tested falls below its own null median-technical timing there is value-destroying, not merely absent. In India combinations reach the 99th percentile, in selected and random samples alike. That edge is unexploitable: it requires ~91× annual turnover against a 14.24bps median breakeven. Two measurement choices materially affect published results: whether the risk-free rate is subtracted (with India's 6.6% rate, combinations beating the benchmark on Sharpe fall from 384 to zero) and which aggregation convention is used (which moves that count from zero to 3,368).

AI.tldr: 本文对源自23个技术指标的1-4个指标组合（21,528种策略）在印度和美国三个股票篮子中（2009-2026）进行全空间评估，发现传统基准比较存在严重错误设定——这些多空策略的净暴露远低于基准，导致比较衡量的是现金拖累而非技能。引入暴露匹配的零假设（时间循环平移）后，美国市场所有技术择时策略均低于零假设中位数（价值毁灭），而印度市场达到第99百分位，但该优势因~91倍年换手率与14.24bps的盈亏平衡成本而不可利用。此外，风险自由利率扣减与聚合方式等测量选择会显著改变发表结果。
AI.research_question: 在完整的技术指标组合空间中，基于均值的绩效比较是否存在错误设定？技术择时策略在印度和美国市场中是否真正具有价值？测量选择如何影响发表的结果？
AI.motivation: 以往研究通常基于有限的策略样本和传统基准比较评估技术择时策略，忽略了多空组合的暴露特征与基准不匹配的问题，导致结论可能有偏。本研究旨在通过穷尽策略空间并引入暴露匹配的零假设来重新审视技术择时的真实价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: Hansen优越预测能力检验（SPA test）；暴露匹配的时间循环平移零假设；多空策略暴露与基准的错配分析
AI.method: 从23个技术信号中穷举1-4个指标的21,528种策略组合，应用两种投票逻辑，在美国和印度三个股票篮子（2009-2026）中评估；使用Hansen SPA检验全规则空间；引入暴露匹配零假设（时间循环平移保留暴露但摧毁择时）；对比不同测量选择（风险自由率扣减、聚合惯例）对结果的影响。
AI.findings: （1）Hansen SPA检验在所有篮子均返回p=1.00，无一策略具有正超额均值回报；（2）传统基准比较存在错误设定：多空策略中位数市场贝塔介于-0.24至+0.08之间，比基准低一个数量级，暴露单独解释76%的回报方差；（3）暴露匹配零假设下，美国两个篮子所有组合均低于其零假设中位数——技术择时在美国是价值毁灭性的；（4）印度组合达到第99百分位（随机与选定样本一致），但需要~91倍年换手率，面对14.24bps的中位数盈亏平衡而不可利用；（5）测量选择影响巨大：是否扣减风险自由率使印度超越基准的策略从384降至0；聚合惯例使其从0增至3,368。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文指出传统基准比较在评估多空技术策略时的根本性错误设定，展示了暴露错配如何将现金拖累误判为策略无技能；提出暴露匹配的时间循环平移零假设作为更严格的反事实检验框架，为技术择时文献提供了更可靠的方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供了技术择时策略全空间的系统性评估结论：美国市场中技术择时策略不仅无效而且价值毁灭；印度市场虽存在统计显著但经济上不可利用的优势；警示研究者和实践者注意测量选择（风险自由率扣减、聚合惯例）对策略评估结论的实质性影响。

title: Bayesian-Driven Design Optimization of Organic Rankine Cycles for Waste HeatRecovery: A Nexus of Thermodynamics, Economics, and Life Cycle Assessment
affiliations: Bayburt University, Trabzon University and Hacettepe University

detail.title: Bayesian-Driven Design Optimization of Organic Rankine Cycles for Waste HeatRecovery: A Nexus of Thermodynamics, Economics, and Life Cycle Assessment
detail.abstract: The exhaust waste heat of a biogas engine operating at the Bayburt municipal solidwaste facility (T = 431 ◦C, p = 1.9 bar, m˙ = 2.181 kg/s) is reassessed within an organicRankine cycle (ORC) design framework guided by Bayesian optimization (BO).A TESPy-based steady-state thermodynamic simulation, a thermoeconomic analysisbuilt on the SPECO methodology, and a cradle-to-grave life cycle assessment (LCA) areunied under a single optimization problem. The weighted sum of six objectivesnetpower, total cost rate, payback period, sustainability index, avoided CO2 emissions,and GWP per kWhis optimized concurrently using Gaussian process regression witha Matérn kernel and the expected improvement acquisition function. Nine workinguids (Toluene, n-Pentane, CycloPentane, Cyclohexane, Heptane, p-Xylene, Benzene,Ethanol, Methanol) are evaluated with ten independent BO runs each. CycloPentanedelivers the highest composite score (0.687) with 162.47 kW of net power, 20.44% thermaleciency, and 48.01% system exergy eciency; Methanol provides the shortestinvestment turnover with a 3.39-year payback period, while Ethanol achieves the lowestclimate impact at 0.200 kgCO2-eq/kWh. Component-based exergy analysis showsthat 5873% of total exergy destruction concentrates in the evaporator, and the LCAcomponent breakdown indicates that turbine manufacturing accounts for 4060% of thetotal GWP. No single uid dominates across all six objectives, so the design decisionmust be tailored to the operator's energyeconomyenvironment priority prole.

AI.tldr: 本文针对土耳其Bayburt城市固体废弃物设施中沼气发动机的排气余热（431°C, 1.9 bar, 2.181 kg/s），在贝叶斯优化框架下重新评估了有机朗肯循环（ORC）设计。研究将TESPy稳态热力学模拟、基于SPECO方法的热经济分析和从摇篮到坟墓的生命周期评估统一为单一优化问题，使用高斯过程回归（Matérn核）和期望改进采集函数同时优化六个目标（净功率、总成本率、回收期、可持续性指数、避免的CO2排放和GWP/kWh）。评估了九种工质各十次独立运行，发现环戊烷综合得分最高（0.687），甲醇回收期最短（3.39年），乙醇气候影响最低（0.200 kgCO2-eq/kWh），且无单一工质能在所有目标上全面占优。
AI.research_question: 如何在贝叶斯优化框架下，为沼气发动机排气余热驱动的ORC系统选择最优工质和设计参数，以在热力学性能、经济性和环境影响之间实现多目标权衡？
AI.motivation: 城市固体废弃物设施中沼气发动机排放大量余热（431°C），具有显著的回收利用潜力。然而，ORC工质选择和设计参数优化涉及热力学、经济和环境的多维权衡，传统优化方法难以有效处理高维非线性空间，需要引入贝叶斯优化等先进的全局优化方法进行系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有机朗肯循环（ORC）热力学理论、SPECO（比能耗成本）热经济分析理论、生命周期评估（LCA）框架、贝叶斯优化（高斯过程回归+期望改进采集函数）
AI.method: 基于TESPy的稳态热力学模拟、SPECO方法的热经济分析、从摇篮到坟墓的生命周期评估（LCA）、贝叶斯优化（高斯过程回归+Matérn核+期望改进采集函数）、六目标加权和优化、九种工质各十次独立BO运行、组分级㶲分析
AI.findings: 1) 环戊烷综合得分最高（0.687），实现162.47 kW净功率、20.44%热效率和48.01%系统㶲效率；2) 甲醇回收期最短（3.39年）；3) 乙醇气候影响最低（0.200 kgCO2-eq/kWh）；4) 蒸发器集中了58-73%的总㶲损毁；5) 汽轮机制造占GWP总量的40-60%；6) 无单一工质在所有六目标上全面占优。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将贝叶斯优化应用于ORC多目标设计空间探索，实现了热力学、经济性和环境影响的统一优化框架；揭示了工质选择在多目标权衡中的非支配特征，为ORC工质筛选提供了方法论创新；通过组分级㶲和LCA分解分析，建立了ORC系统热力学损失与全生命周期环境影响之间的关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市固体废弃物沼气余热回收提供了具体的设计指导：环戊烷适合追求综合性能、甲醇适合快速投资回收、乙醇适合低碳排放场景；明确了蒸发器为系统主要优化改造目标；为运营方提供了基于能量-经济-环境优先级的工质选择决策指南。

title: Forecast-Driven Fuzzy Model Predictive Control Coordination for Efficient Power-to-Hydrogen Conversion in 48 V DC Microgrids
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Forecast-Driven Fuzzy Model Predictive Control Coordination for Efficient Power-to-Hydrogen Conversion in 48 V DC Microgrids
detail.abstract: The conversion of surplus photovoltaic energy into hydrogen through electrolysis is a key pathway for long-term storage in low-voltage DC microgrids, but its efficiency depends strongly on how electrical dispatch is coordinated with the part-load behavior of the electrolyzer. This study proposes a hierarchical multilevel energy management system (EMS) for a 48 V hydrogen-integrated DC microgrid that jointly optimizes electrical operation and power-to-hydrogen conversion. A nonlinear part-load efficiency model of a PEM electrolyzer, calibrated from experimental polarization data, is embedded within a predictive controller so that hydrogen production is scheduled during high-efficiency surplus windows. Three peer-to-peer dispatch strategies of increasing sophistication are compared: (A1) heuristic rule-based control, (A2) Takagi–Sugeno fuzzy control, and (A3) predictive fuzzy model predictive control (MPC) integrating 12-hour PV and load forecasts. To quantify the electrical–hydrogen coupling, three multi-energy indicators are introduced: Hydrogen Utilization Efficiency (HUE), Hydrogen Production Continuity Index (HPCI), and Energy Coupling Index (ECI).Over a 72-hour simulation of the LoCEL-H2 demonstrator, the predictive strategy A3 improves HUE from 0.41 to 0.58, HPCI from 0.63 to 0.76, and ECI from 0.38 to 0.51 relative to the heuristic baseline, while reducing renewable curtailment by 73%, deficit duration by 48%, SOC variance by 76%, and energy not supplied from 462 to 120 Wh. The results show that forecast-driven coordination transforms the EMS from reactive balancing into proactive multi-energy scheduling, enabling efficient and continuous electrical-to-hydrogen conversion.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种用于48V氢集成直流微电网的分层多级能量管理系统（EMS），将PEM电解槽非线性部分负荷效率模型嵌入预测控制器，实现电力调度与电制氢的联合优化。通过对比三种对等调度策略（启发式规则、T-S模糊控制、预测模糊MPC），证明基于预测的主动式多能源调度能显著提升氢能利用效率并减少可再生能源弃电。
AI.research_question: 如何协调低电压直流微电网中的电力调度与电解槽部分负荷行为，以高效地将富余光伏能量转化为氢能进行长期存储？
AI.motivation: 光伏富余能量通过电解制氢是低压直流微电网中长期储能的关键路径，但其效率高度依赖于电力调度与电解槽部分负荷特性的协调配合，现有研究缺乏对这一耦合关系的系统优化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于分层多级能量管理的架构理论，结合PEM电解槽非线性部分负荷效率模型、Takagi-Sugeno模糊控制理论和模型预测控制（MPC）理论。
AI.method: 通过实验极化数据标定PEM电解槽非线性效率模型，嵌入预测控制器；设计并对比三种调度策略（A1启发式规则控制、A2 T-S模糊控制、A3集成12小时PV与负荷预测的模糊MPC）；提出三个多能源耦合指标（HUE、HPCI、ECI）用于量化电-氢耦合效果；在LoCEL-H2演示平台上进行72小时仿真验证。
AI.findings: 预测性策略A3较启发式基线将HUE从0.41提升至0.58，HPCI从0.63提升至0.76，ECI从0.38提升至0.51；可再生能源弃电减少73%，缺电时间减少48%，SOC方差降低76%，未供电能量从462降至120 Wh。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"电-氢耦合"的系统化分析框架，引入三个多能源指标（HUE、HPCI、ECI）量化电力与氢能转换的协调程度；证明了预测驱动的协调机制能将能量管理系统从被动平衡转变为主动多能源调度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为低压直流微电网中氢能集成提供了可实现的EMS设计范式，通过预测模糊MPC与电解槽效率模型的结合，为工程实践提供了显著提升氢能转换效率、降低弃电和供电缺口的可行方案。

title: Caste Representation in Indian Policing: Implications for Crime Rate and Criminal Justice Outcomes

detail.title: Caste Representation in Indian Policing: Implications for Crime Rate and Criminal Justice Outcomes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that could be perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper examines whether Scheduled Caste (SC) representation within Indian state police forces affects reported crime and criminal justice outcomes for caste-based hate crimes. Using state-level panel data from 28 states and union territories between 2016 and 2023, I analyze whether the effects of representation vary across police ranks with different levels of authority. All specifications include state and year fixed effects, with standard errors clustered at the state level. Overall SC representation has no statistically significant effect on chargesheeting rates or case pendency. In contrast, a 10-percentage-point increase in SC representation at investigative and leadership ranks is associated with a 16-18% increase in reported crime rates, consistent with greater First Information Report (FIR) registration and improved access to justice; this effect is significant at the 5% level at investigative ranks and at the 10% level at leadership ranks. However, these gains do not translate into improved case resolution. SC representation at investigative ranks increases case pendency by 23% (p < 0.05), while representation at leadership ranks reduces chargesheeting rates by 9% (p < 0.10). SC representation among ground-level staff without investigative authority has no measurable effects. The results suggest that minority officers may use their discretion to register cases that might otherwise be dismissed, but institutional capacity constraints limit improvements in downstream criminal justice outcomes. Estimates are associational rather than causal; the paper discusses omitted-variable, reverse-causality and simultaneity concerns.

AI.tldr: 本文研究印度各邦警察部队中"表列种姓"（SC）代表性对种姓仇恨犯罪报案率及刑事司法结果的影响，发现调查职级和领导职级的SC警员比例提高会显著增加报案率（改善司法可及性），但受机构能力限制，并未转化为案件解决效率的提升。
AI.research_question: 印度邦警察部队中表列种姓（SC）代表性如何影响种姓仇恨犯罪的报案率和刑事司法结果？这种代表性效应是否因警衔（调查权、领导权）不同而有所差异？
AI.motivation: 种姓少数群体在执法机构中的代表性可能影响少数族裔的司法可及性和执法公平性，但已有研究缺乏对印度警察系统中代表性效应的系统实证检验，尤其是在不同警衔层次上的差异化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代表性官僚理论（representative bureaucracy）——少数群体官员在执法中可能利用自由裁量权改善少数群体的司法可及性；制度能力约束理论——即使报案增加，受制于资源与能力，案件解决率未必提升。
AI.method: 使用2016-2023年印度28个邦和联邦属地（state-level panel data）的面板数据，采用邦和年份双向固定效应模型（state and year fixed effects），标准误在邦层面聚类。按警衔层次（调查职级、领导职级、基层无调查权）分层检验代表性效应。
AI.findings: （1）整体SC代表性对指控率和案件积压无显著影响；（2）调查职级中SC代表比例每增加10个百分点，报案率提高16-18%（5%显著水平），领导职级在10%水平显著；（3）调查职级SC代表性使案件积压增加23%（p<0.05）；（4）领导职级SC代表性使指控率降低9%（p<0.10）；（5）基层无调查权职级无显著效应。结果仅具关联性而非因果性。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了代表性官僚理论的边界条件：表明少数群体官员的代表性效应取决于具体职级所赋予的自由裁量权大小；同时揭示了"代表性改善司法可及性"与"机构能力制约下游司法结果"之间的张力，为理解代表性官僚的制度约束提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及其他多元社会中的警察系统多元化政策提供实证依据：提高少数群体在调查和领导职级的代表性有助于改善受害者的报案渠道和司法可及性；但也提示政策制定者需同步加强警察机构的能力建设（如资源、训练、司法效率），否则报案增加只会加剧案件积压问题。

title: Promises Made, Promises Kept: The Influence of Ideological Contract Fulfillment in Student Teams
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Idaho State University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Promises Made, Promises Kept: The Influence of Ideological Contract Fulfillment in Student Teams
detail.abstract: Business schools increasingly articulate missions that help define institutional identity and attract purpose-driven students. Students, in turn, may interpret these missions as ideological psychological contracts with their institutions. When business schools that espouse missions also pursue apparently competing instrumental objectives, students may perceive a breach of those ideological commitments, weakening their engagement in the classroom. Conversely, when students perceive that their business school has fulfilled its ideological commitments, they are more likely to identify with their learning teams, invest effort and engage collaboratively with others in the classroom. Using a mixed-methods design, we conducted two studies: one with a sample of 221 undergraduate students in 70 student teams and the other with 114 MBA students in 27 student teams. We found that student perceptions of ideological contract fulfillment was associated with stronger team identification and higher team performance. Across both studies, ideological contract fulfillment was associated with stronger team identification and higher team performance. Qualitative responses revealed four distinct interpretations of the school’s mission, suggesting that students may agree that a school is fulfilling its ideological commitments even when they differ in how they understand the content of those commitments. We discuss the theoretical and practical implications of these findings.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过混合方法设计（两项研究：70个团队的221名本科生和27个团队的114名MBA学生），探讨商学院使命宣言如何被学生解读为意识形态心理契约，以及学生对意识形态契约履行的感知如何影响团队认同和团队绩效。研究发现，意识形态契约履行感知与更强的团队认同和更高的团队绩效相关；质性数据揭示学生对学校使命存在四种不同的解读方式，但即使理解不同，学生仍可能认为学校在履行其意识形态承诺。
AI.research_question: 商学院使命宣言如何被学生解读为意识形态心理契约？当商学院在追求使命的同时也追求看似冲突的工具性目标时，学生是否感知到意识形态契约的违背，进而削弱课堂参与度？反之，当学生感知到意识形态契约被履行时，是否更可能认同学习团队、投入努力并协作参与？
AI.motivation: 商学院越来越多地阐述使命宣言以定义制度认同并吸引具有目标导向的学生，但商学院在践行使命的同时也追求竞争性的工具性目标，这种张力可能导致学生感知到意识形态承诺的违背。现有研究对学生在课堂环境中如何解读和回应商学院使命、以及这种解读如何影响学习行为和团队绩效知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 意识形态心理契约理论（Ideological Psychological Contracts）；社会认同理论（团队认同）；心理契约违背理论
AI.method: 混合方法设计，包含两项研究：研究一采用221名本科生样本（70个学生团队），研究二采用114名MBA学生样本（27个学生团队）。结合定量分析（意识形态契约履行与团队认同、团队绩效的关系）和质性分析（学生对学校使命的解读）。
AI.findings: （1）学生感知到的意识形态契约履行与更强的团队认同和更高的团队绩效显著相关，该发现在本科生和MBA样本中均得到验证；（2）质性数据揭示了学生对学校使命的四种不同解读，表明即使学生对使命内容的理解存在差异，他们仍可能一致认为学校在履行其意识形态承诺。
AI.theory_contributions: 将意识形态心理契约概念从传统的员工-组织关系拓展到学生-商学院教育情境，揭示了使命宣言在课堂学习生态中的心理契约功能；阐明了意识形态契约履行感知对团队认同和团队绩效的促进作用；发现学生对同一使命可以存在多种差异化解读但感知到相同的契约履行，丰富了心理契约理论关于契约内容解释的讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商学院管理实践提供启示：商学院应重视使命宣言的承诺属性，意识到学生对使命的意识形态解读会影响其课堂参与和学习成效；商学院在追求工具性目标的同时需关注学生对意识形态承诺的感知，以避免意识形态契约违背削弱学生参与；研究也提示教育管理者理解学生对使命的多元化解读，并据此优化使命沟通和教学团队设计。

title: Stochastic Shortest Path Interdiction with Path-Only Feedback
affiliations: University of South Florida, University of Chile - Industrial Engineering and

detail.title: Stochastic Shortest Path Interdiction with Path-Only Feedback
detail.abstract: We study a sequential stochastic shortest-path interdiction problem in which an interdictor repeatedly blocks arcs to increase an evader's routing cost. Each period, a cost vector is drawn from a fixed, unknown distribution, and the evader observes the realized costs before routing; the interdictor observes only the evader's chosen path. We derive an instance-dependent logarithmic regret lower bound, computed through a semi-infinite information-allocation problem that admits an exact finite exponential-cone reformulation under regularity conditions. This informational censoring creates observational equivalence: distinct cost distributions can induce identical path observations under some interdiction actions. The resulting dominated information property means the actions needed to distinguish confounded environments are inferior in expected value, so pure posterior sampling and value-optimistic rules can fail to learn all relevant alternatives and incur linear regret. We propose Identifying-Exploration Greedy policies, which deliberately sample an identifying action set and achieve logarithmic regret on identifiable instances with a positive optimality gap. Experiments on constructed instances, generated networks, and a border-infiltration case study show when path-only learning succeeds, when it fails, and why deliberate information acquisition is essential for logarithmic regret.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个序贯随机最短路阻断问题，其中阻断者反复阻断弧段以增加逃避者的路由成本。每期成本向量从固定但未知的分布中抽取，逃避者观察实现成本后进行路由；阻断者仅观察逃避者选择的路径。研究发现信息审查导致观测等价性，使得纯后验采样和价值乐观规则可能无法学习所有相关备选方案而产生线性遗憾。作者提出识别性探索贪心策略，在具有正最优间隙的可识别实例上实现对数遗憾。
AI.research_question: 在序贯随机最短路阻断问题中，当阻断者仅能观察逃避者的路径选择（而非真实成本）时，如何在信息受限条件下设计策略以实现对数遗憾的在线学习？
AI.motivation: 传统的随机最短路问题中，通常假设学习者能够观察到完整的成本信息或至少部分成本信息。然而在实际应用中（如边境渗透、网络攻防等场景），阻断者只能观察到逃避者的路径选择，这种信息审查（informational censoring）会造成观测等价性问题，使得标准的多臂老虎机或后验采样方法可能失效，因此需要新的理论分析和策略设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: （1）序贯随机最短路阻断的在线学习框架；（2）半无限信息分配问题的指数锥重构；（3）观测等价性与支配信息性质（dominated information property）理论；（4）遗憾下界的信息论分析。
AI.method: 理论推导与算法设计相结合：首先通过半无限信息分配问题推导实例相关的对数遗憾下界，并在正则条件下证明其具有精确的有限指数锥重构形式；然后证明标准策略（纯后验采样和值乐观规则）在观测等价性下可能产生线性遗憾；最后提出识别性探索贪心（Identifying-Exploration Greedy）策略，并设计实验验证。
AI.findings: （1）推导了实例相关的对数遗憾下界；（2）证明了观测等价性导致的支配信息性质会使纯后验采样和值乐观规则产生线性遗憾；（3）提出的识别性探索贪心策略在可识别实例上实现对数遗憾；（4）实验表明路径仅观测在某些情况下可以成功学习，在某些情况下会失败，识别性信息获取对对数遗憾至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次系统地分析了序贯随机最短路阻断问题中路径观测信息受限下的学习理论；（2）揭示了支配信息性质（dominated information property）这一新的理论障碍，解释了为何传统乐观/采样方法在此类问题中失效；（3）给出了半无限信息分配问题的精确有限指数锥重构条件，为遗憾下界计算提供了可行的计算方法。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为网络阻断、边境渗透防御等实际场景提供了有效的在线学习策略（识别性探索贪心策略）；（2）指出了在实际部署中需要识别性信息获取以避免线性遗憾，具有明确的实践指导意义；（3）通过构造实例、生成网络和边境渗透案例研究验证了方法的适用性和局限性。

title: Reliable Enough to Punish: K-12 Surveillance AI and the Section 504 Evaluation the District Insists It Is Not Conducting

detail.title: Reliable Enough to Punish: K-12 Surveillance AI and the Section 504 Evaluation the District Insists It Is Not Conducting
detail.abstract: A majority of American public school students now pass their school days, and much of their time at home, inside software that reads what they type, watches what they search, and scores what it sees. The vendors call the products safety monitoring. One of them now assigns each child a wellness level. The districts that buy these systems treat their outputs as reliable when the output supports a suspension and treat the same outputs as too informal to count when the output would obligate the district to do anything. This Article argues that the second half of that position is no longer available to them. The argument proceeds from a fork the districts built for themselves. Section 504's child find and evaluation regulations oblige a district to evaluate any student it has reason to believe needs special education or related services because of disability, with notice and procedural safeguards attached. A district that disciplines a student on the strength of an algorithmic flag has stated, in its own records, that it believes the flag; a district that believes a flag describing self harm, emotional disturbance, or psychological crisis has acquired exactly the belief that triggers the evaluation duty it did not follow. The district may characterize its system as reliable or as unreliable. It may not select the characterization by consequence. Beneath the fork the Article locates three further failures. Continuous behavioral scoring directed at mental and psychological states is an evaluation under the Protection of Pupil Rights Amendment and bears every operative mark of a medical examination under the criteria courts already apply, no clinician required, no diagnosis required, the practical effect controlling. A scoring system that flags students for perceived psychological abnormality manufactures regarded as claimants at the scale of enrollment. And a compulsory education delivered only through monitored platforms denies meaningful access to the students the system systematically misreads, with students on the psychotic spectrum injured first and worst, because announced continuous surveillance removes the one proposition their treatment requires them to be able to test. The constitutional challenges now in the courts are failing on qualified immunity for want of precedent. The disability statutes have been clearly established for forty years, they run against the entity, and nobody has pled them.

AI.tldr: 本文论证美国公立学校对学生的算法安全监控系统（如行为评分、心理健康监测）产生的结果不能由学区选择性地采信——即当结果支持处分学生时视为可靠，当结果要求学区承担特教评估义务时视为不可靠。作者从《第504条康复法》的"儿童发现"与评估义务出发提出法律论据，并进一步指出此类持续行为评分构成PPRA下的评估、可能触发"被视为残障"主张、且对精神病谱系学生构成否定性伤害。
AI.research_question: 当学区的算法监控系统产生行为或心理健康预警时，学区能否选择性采信这些结果——既用于处分学生，又拒绝以此触发《第504条》规定的特殊教育评估义务？
AI.motivation: 美国大多数公立学校学生日常处于商业监控软件之中，学区在处分时采信算法输出、需承担义务时却称其"非正式不足采信"，形成前后矛盾的法律立场。作者旨在填补这一未被主张的残疾法律诉讼空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 《第504条康复法》（Section 504）的"儿童发现"（child find）与评估规定；《保护学生权利修正案》（PPRA）；"被视为残障"（regarded as）歧视理论；宪法第十四修正案的机会平等/有意义的准入（meaningful access）理论。
AI.method: 法律论证/法律理论分析：通过构建"学区自设两难"（fork）的论证结构，结合现有法定条文、司法标准与实际制度运行效果进行规范性法律分析。
AI.findings: 学区不能在处分与评估之间选择性采信算法输出；持续行为评分构成PPRA下的评估并具医疗检查的操作特征；此类系统制造大规模"被视为残障"索赔人；监控式教育对精神病谱系学生构成否定性伤害。残疾法规已明确建立四十年却无人援引。
AI.theory_contributions: ①构建了学区"自设两难"的法理论证框架，将算法输出的采信问题与第504条评估义务直接联结；②将PPRA"评估"与司法上的"医疗检查"标准扩展适用至算法行为评分；③将"被视为残障"理论与大规模算法筛查结合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为律师和学生权益倡导者提供可援引的既存法定途径（第504条、PPRA），绕开合格豁免障碍；指出针对学区实体的诉讼策略，弥补当下宪法诉讼屡败的空白。

title: Optimizing Operations, Financial Controls, and Digitalization in Pharmaceutical Manufacturing: An Empirical Investigation of Employee Perceptions and Process Drivers
affiliations: and

detail.title: Optimizing Operations, Financial Controls, and Digitalization in Pharmaceutical Manufacturing: An Empirical Investigation of Employee Perceptions and Process Drivers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author(s) declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: his study involved a structured survey of finance, accounting, and operations employees at Bruck Pharma Pvt. Ltd. Participation was voluntary and anonymous; all respondents provided informed consent prior to completing the survey, and individual responses were aggregated and de-identified before analysis.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study did not involve a clinical trial.

detail.abstract: This empirical study evaluates the operational and financial management framework within pharmaceutical manufacturing, focusing on process efficiency, internal financial controls, tax compliance, and digital systems integration. Drawing on N = 108 survey observations gathered from finance, accounting, and operations personnel at Bruck Pharma Pvt. Ltd., the study employs reliability analysis, principal component analysis (PCA), and multivariate ordinary least squares (OLS) regression to examine the relationship between key operational drivers and overall departmental effectiveness. The results indicate that internal financial controls (β = 0.342, p < 0.001), accounting software utilization (β = 0.285, p < 0.001), and invoice verification efficiency (β = 0.218, p = 0.004) are the strongest predictors of departmental performance, with the seven-predictor model explaining 68.4 per cent of the variance in effectiveness (R 2 = 0.684, Adjusted R 2 = 0.662, F(7,100) = 30.94, p < 0.001). Processautomation gaps and interdepartmental information silos emerge as the most frequently cited operational bottlenecks. By synthesizing these findings with the literature on working capital dynamics, digital transformation, compliance automation, and trade-policy frameworks, the study offers an evidence-based roadmap for pharmaceutical firms pursuing operational excellence.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于Bruck Pharma Pvt. Ltd.公司108份问卷数据，采用可靠性分析、主成分分析和多元OLS回归，评估制药制造企业的运营与财务管理框架。研究发现内部控制（β=0.342）、会计软件使用（β=0.285）和发票核验效率（β=0.218）是部门绩效的最强预测因子，七变量模型解释了68.4%的绩效方差。流程自动化缺口和部门间信息孤岛是最常被提及的运营瓶颈。
AI.research_question: 制药制造企业的运营与财务管理框架中，哪些关键运营驱动因素最能预测部门整体有效性？
AI.motivation: 制药行业面临复杂的运营与财务管理挑战，现有文献缺乏基于实证数据对流程效率、内部控制、税务合规与数字化系统整合之间关系的系统性评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于运营管理、财务内部控制、数字转型及贸易政策框架的综合性理论视角，结合营运资本动态与合规自动化的相关理论。
