Building on the Linguistic-Institutional Audit Framework, or LIAF (Singh, 2026), this work proposes the Spatial-Linguistic-Institutional Audit Framework (SLIAF), a four-phase methodology for auditing spatial AI systems. Grounded in the Capabilities Approach (Sen, 1999; Nussbaum, 2011) and critical spatial theory (Mattern, 2021), the paper examines how institutions deploy Digital Twins and physics engines as new proxy variables for governance, and how AI "Planners" threaten human cognitive and spatial agency. Two illustrative cases, a hypothetical smart-city pedestrian-flow audit and a consumer augmented-reality environment, demonstrate what SLIAF surfaces that a conventional technical audit would miss. The paper closes by situating these claims within the genuinely early stage of spatial-AI deployment, and by arguing that the rules governing simulated worlds must remain subject to human linguistic, moral, and institutional scrutiny.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI伦理危机的下一阶段将从语言操纵转向对模拟物理现实的操纵。作者基于Linguistic-Institutional Audit Framework（LIAF）提出扩展框架SLIAF（空间-语言-制度审计框架），用于审计具有空间智能的AI系统（如数字孪生、物理引擎、AI规划器），并通过两个案例展示该框架相对传统技术审计的增量价值。
AI.research_question: 当AI从文本大语言模型转向具有三维环境渲染、模拟和规划能力的"空间智能"系统时，传统的基于语言的伦理审计框架如何失效？需要什么样的新审计框架来应对空间AI引发的说服、信任与欺骗风险？
AI.motivation: 现有伦理审计聚焦于语言偏见、文本幻觉和语义还原论，但空间智能系统通过操纵模拟物理现实引入了一种全新的说服、信任与欺骗范式，这将是下一个AI伦理危机的核心来源，而现有框架无法捕捉此类风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: Linguistic-Institutional Audit Framework (LIAF)、Capabilities Approach（Sen, 1999; Nussbaum, 2011）、批判空间理论（Mattern, 2021）。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念性框架设计，含两个说明性案例分析：假设的智慧城市行人流审计和消费级增强现实环境。
AI.findings: SLIAF四阶段审计方法能够揭示传统技术审计遗漏的空间性风险，包括机构如何将数字孪生和物理引擎用作治理的代理变量，以及AI规划器对人类认知和空间能动性的威胁。当前空间AI部署仍处于早期阶段，但模拟世界的规则必须持续接受人类语言、道德和制度层面的审视。
AI.theory_contributions: 将伦理审计从语言学范式扩展至空间本体论层面，提出空间-语言-制度审计框架（SLIAF），填补了AI伦理审计在空间智能领域的理论空白，并将能力方法（Capabilities Approach）与批判空间理论引入AI治理研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和技术审计人员提供SLIAF四阶段方法论，可用于评估数字孪生、物理引擎和空间规划AI系统的伦理风险，辅助机构在设计、部署和监管空间AI时识别语言审计遗漏的空间性操纵与欺骗风险。

title: Digital Twins in Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Network Design and Management

detail.title: Digital Twins in Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Network Design and Management
detail.abstract:
This review brings together academic publications, official guidance, industry reports, government material and public company examples. It separates three things that are often mixed together in marketing language: a system that shows what is happening, a system that supports planning, and a true digital twin.

The evidence is stronger for digital twins used in processes, facilities, production planning and cold-chain monitoring than for full supply-chain network twins. One pharmaceutical distribution-center case shows that it is possible to monitor temperature and humidity in real time, detect issues and trace shipments [P9]. Biomanufacturing studies also describe step-by-step ways to build digital twins for production processes [P1–P3]. A 2026 pharma technology-transfer case shows how simulations can support resource decisions, but it also says more validation is needed in complex settings involving several organizations [P14].

The most directly relevant source is a 2026 ASME paper hosted by NIST on biopharmaceutical supply-chain digital twins. It says digital twins could support real-time monitoring, simulation and optimization. It also notes that public examples are limited and that data quality, data access, privacy, security and return on investment remain key gaps [N1].

General supply-chain research explains why digital twins can be useful: they can show the current state of a network, test different future scenarios and compare possible responses to disruptions [P4–P8]. At the same time, the evidence should not be overstated. Much of the literature is still focused on manufacturing, and there are still too few real-world case studies with measured business impact [P6].

LLMs and agents can make digital twins easier to use, but they do not remove the need for reliable data and validated models. Recent supply-chain research shows that agents can break tasks into steps, use tools and correct plans [P18]. Other research shows that agents still struggle with long, procedure-based tasks [P17]. In pharma, the most realistic model is an LLM or agent layer that helps users ask questions, build scenarios and run approved forecasting, simulation and optimization tools. It should not replace official systems of record or bypass quality and policy controls.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了关于供应链数字孪生的学术出版物、官方指南和行业报告，区分了"显示当前状态的系统"、"支持规划的系统"和"真正的数字孪生"三个概念。证据显示，数字孪生在流程、设施、生产计划和冷链监控方面的应用比全供应链网络孪生更有说服力。LLM和智能体可以增强数字孪生的可用性，但不能替代可靠数据和经过验证的模型。
AI.research_question: 在医药供应链中，数字孪生技术的证据基础是什么？LLM和智能体在此背景下扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 营销语言中经常混淆"显示系统"、"规划支持系统"和"真正数字孪生"三种不同概念，且数字孪生在供应链领域的实证证据有限，需要系统梳理文献以明确其实际应用边界和能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字孪生理论（区分实时监控系统、规划支持系统与完整数字孪生）；供应链网络管理理论；LLM/智能体辅助决策框架
AI.method: 文献综述/系统回顾，整合学术出版物、官方指南、行业报告、政府材料和公司案例。
AI.findings: 1) 数字孪生在流程、设施、生产规划和冷链监控方面的证据较强，但全供应链网络孪生证据不足；2) 制药领域已有实际案例表明实时温度湿度监控和批次追溯可行；3) 2026年ASME/NIST论文指出数据质量、数据访问、隐私、安全和投资回报率是关键缺口；4) LLM/智能体可增强数字孪生可用性，但无法替代可靠数据和验证过的模型；5) 最现实的模式是LLM作为用户与已验证工具之间的交互层。
AI.theory_contributions: 清晰区分了三个常被混淆的数字孪生概念层级；系统评估了数字孪生在不同供应链场景中的证据强度差异；明确了LLM/智能体在数字孪生架构中的合理定位边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制药企业提供了数字孪生技术应用的现实评估；指出LLM集成应以不绕过质量与政策控制为前提；为行业决策者识别了数据质量、隐私等关键实施瓶颈。

title: A deep learning-driven iterative scheme for high-dimensional HJB equations in portfolio selection with price impact
affiliations: University of International Business and Economics, The Chinese University of Hong Kong and Nankai University

detail.title: A deep learning-driven iterative scheme for high-dimensional HJB equations in portfolio selection with price impact
detail.abstract: In this paper, we conduct a study of the portfolio selection problem, incorporating both exogenous (proportional) and endogenous (resulting from liquidity risk, characterized by a stochastic process) transaction costs through the utility-based approach. We also consider the intrinsic relationship between these two types of costs. To address the associated nonlinear two-dimensional Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation, we propose an innovative deep learning-driven policy iteration scheme with three key advantages: i) it has the potential to address the curse of dimensionality; ii) it is adaptable to problems involving high-dimensional control spaces; iii) it eliminates truncation errors. The numerical analysis of the proposed scheme, including convergence analysis in a general setting, is also discussed. To illustrate the impact of these two types of transaction costs on portfolio choice, we conduct through numerical experiments using three typical utility functions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究同时包含外生（比例型）和内生（由流动性风险引起的随机过程型）交易成本的投资组合选择问题，并通过基于效用的方法考虑两类成本间的内在关系。针对由此产生的非线性二维HJB方程，提出了一种创新的深度学习驱动的策略迭代方案，该方案具有处理维数灾难、适应高维控制空间以及消除截断误差三大优势，并通过三种典型效用函数的数值实验验证了交易成本对投资组合选择的影响。
AI.research_question: 同时包含外生交易成本和内生交易成本（流动性风险）时，投资者应如何进行最优投资组合选择？如何有效求解由此产生的非线性二维HJB方程？
AI.motivation: 传统投资组合选择研究通常只考虑单一类型的交易成本，忽视了外生成本（如比例佣金）与内生成本（如市场流动性冲击导致的成本）之间的内在联系。此外，涉及两类交易成本时产生的二维HJB方程具有非线性特征，传统数值方法面临维数灾难、高维控制空间适应性差及截断误差等问题，亟需新的数值求解方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于效用的投资组合选择理论（utility-based approach）、随机流动性风险模型、Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman（HJB）方程、深度学习策略迭代方法（deep learning-driven policy iteration）
AI.method: 本文将交易成本分为外生（比例型）和内生（由流动性风险随机过程引起）两类，通过基于效用的方法构建投资组合选择模型，推导出非线性二维HJB方程。提出深度学习驱动的策略迭代方案进行求解，并进行收敛性分析和数值实验，采用三种典型效用函数验证方法的有效性。
AI.findings: 所提出的深度学习驱动的策略迭代方案能有效求解非线性二维HJB方程，具备解决维数灾难的潜力、适应高维控制空间的能力以及消除截断误差的优势；数值实验表明外生和内生两类交易成本对投资组合选择均有显著影响，且两类成本之间存在内在关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在投资组合选择框架中同时纳入外生和内生交易成本并考虑二者内在关系；提出深度学习驱动的策略迭代方案以求解二维非线性HJB方程，为高维金融优化问题提供了新的数值求解思路；补充了深度学习策略迭代方案的收敛性分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者在实际市场中同时面临手续费和流动性风险时的最优资产配置提供了理论依据和可操作的数值求解工具；所提出的算法可扩展至高维投资组合场景，具有实际应用潜力。

title: A two-stage cluster-autonomous P2P energy trading framework for secure and flexible distribution network operation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, North China Electric Power University and North China Electric Power University

detail.title: A two-stage cluster-autonomous P2P energy trading framework for secure and flexible distribution network operation
detail.abstract: Distributed negotiation-based peer-to-peer (P2P) energy trading offers a privacy-preserving paradigm for autonomous energy exchange in distribution networks. When such trading must interface with network dispatch, however, it confronts three coupled barriers: an information barrier between private trading data and the global electrical state required for security; an objective conflict between individual economy and system-wide security; and a timescale mismatch between day-ahead contracts and real-time deviations. Existing methods relax one barrier only at the expense of another—embedding security through global or operator-computed information, omitting network physics, or hedging in the day-ahead stage without real-time correction. This paper proposes a two-stage cluster-autonomous P2P trading and dispatch coordination mechanism for secure and flexible distribution network operation. The proposed mechanism uses clusters as autonomous coordination units: prosumer-level private information is retained within each cluster, while only boundary electrical quantities and cluster-level aggregated variables are exchanged for inter-cluster coordination. In the day-ahead stage, P2P trading, boundary security constraints, and regulation-capacity reservation are coordinated to form security-compatible contracts. In the real-time stage, source–load deviations are absorbed through the same cluster-autonomous structure, first within clusters and then through inter-cluster residual coordination, with the resulting adjustment cost allocated among participating clusters. Case studies on the IEEE 33-bus system show that the proposed mechanism increases P2P trading volume by 92%, reduces network-loss cost by about 9%, improves voltage security, absorbs a median 95% of real-time deviations, reduces imbalance cost by 94%, and raises the P2P contract-fulfillment rate to 91.8%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种两阶段集群自主P2P交易与调度协调机制，通过集群作为自治协调单元，解决分布式P2P电力交易与网络调度的信息壁垒、目标冲突和时间尺度不匹配三大耦合障碍。日前阶段协调P2P交易、边界安全约束与调节容量预留形成安全兼容合约；实时阶段通过集群内优先、集群间余量协调的方式吸收源荷偏差，并将调整成本在参与集群间分配。IEEE 33节点系统算例验证了该机制在提升交易量、改善电压安全、降低不平衡成本等方面的显著效果。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种既能保护交易隐私又能保障电网安全、且能应对日前合约与实时偏差时间尺度不匹配问题的分布式P2P能源交易与调度协调机制？
AI.motivation: 分布式协商的P2P能源交易与网络调度接口时面临三个耦合障碍：私有交易数据与全局电气状态间的信息壁垒、个体经济性与系统安全间的目标冲突、以及日前合约与实时偏差间的时间尺度不匹配。现有方法仅能缓解某一障碍却以牺牲其他障碍为代价，缺乏系统性解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集群自治协调理论、分布式P2P交易协商机制、两阶段（日前-实时）双层优化调度理论
AI.method: 提出两阶段集群自主协调机制：以集群为自治协调单元，产消者级私有信息保留在集群内部，仅交换边界电气量与集群级聚合变量；日前阶段协调P2P交易、边界安全约束和调节容量预留；实时阶段先集群内吸收偏差，再通过集群间余量协调，并采用成本分配机制分摊调节成本。通过IEEE 33节点系统进行算例验证。
AI.findings: 案例研究表明：该机制使P2P交易量提升92%，网络损耗成本约降低9%，改善电压安全，吸收实时偏差中位数达95%，不平衡成本降低94%，P2P合约履约率提升至91.8%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出集群作为自治协调单元的新范式，同时解决信息壁垒、目标冲突和时间尺度不匹配三大耦合障碍；构建了兼顾隐私保护与电网安全的分布式交易-调度协调理论框架；建立了日前-实时两阶段协同优化的方法论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为配电网中的P2P能源交易提供了可落地的工程实施方案；通过集群化架构实现在保护用户隐私的同时保障电网安全运行；提供了实时偏差吸收与成本分摊的机制设计，提升了P2P合约履约率和交易效率，降低了系统运行成本。

title: Proposing a data-driven IIoT decision-making framework to eliminate transaction errors: A quantitative evaluation of RFID-enabled supply chains
affiliations: Iran University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Proposing a data-driven IIoT decision-making framework to eliminate transaction errors: A quantitative evaluation of RFID-enabled supply chains
detail.abstract: Information and inventory flows are critically intertwined in supply chains, yet transaction errors frequently create discrepancies that undermine operational reliability. Within the IIoT ecosystem, RFID serves as the foundational sensing layer for real-time data capture and system integration. This study proposes a simulation‐based framework to analyze transaction errors in a two‐product newsvendor supply chain. Closed‐form optimal order quantities are derived by employing 10,000 paired Monte Carlo replications for error‐prone and error‐free scenarios, and two theoretical properties are proven: RFID adoption increases optimal order quantities by reducing uncertainty, and it becomes profitable when tag costs fall below a threshold determined by the profit differential. A comprehensive sensitivity analysis combines individual, simultaneous, and global regression‐based examinations. The global sensitivity analysis, based on Latin hypercube samples, reveals that the error rate is the dominant driver, with a Spearman rank correlation of 0.862 with the maximum allowable tag cost, compared with 0.495 for sale price and 0.107 for shortage cost. Standardized regression quantifies that the error rate explains 45.2% of the variance in allowable tag cost, followed by sale price (25.4%) and shortage cost (18.6%). The error‐price interaction is statistically significant, indicating super‐additive benefits for high‐value, error‐prone products. An evidence‐based managerial framework demonstrates that traceability‐driven RFID investment prevents capital tie‐up in obsolete stock and reduces revenue losses from unmet demand, directly contributing to supply chain economic sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个基于仿真的分析框架，研究两产品报童供应链中的交易错误问题。通过10,000次蒙特卡洛配对复制推导出闭合形式的最优订货量，证明了两个理论性质：RFID采用通过减少不确定性增加最优订货量，且当标签成本低于由利润差异决定的阈值时RFID采用有利可图。全面的敏感性分析（包括个体、同时和基于全局回归的分析）揭示了错误率是主导驱动因素（Spearman秩相关系数0.862），标准化回归显示错误率解释了允许标签成本方差的45.2%。基于证据的管理框架表明，可追溯性驱动的RFID投资可防止资本沉淀在过时库存中并减少需求未满足的收入损失，直接促进供应链经济可持续性。
AI.research_question: 在两产品报童供应链中，交易错误如何影响运营可靠性？RFID采用的盈利条件是什么？各因素（错误率、销售价格、缺货成本）对允许标签成本的相对影响程度如何？
AI.motivation: 信息流与库存流在供应链中紧密交织，但交易错误频繁造成差异，破坏运营可靠性。在工业物联网生态系统内，RFID作为基础感知层，需要系统性地理解其投资价值与交易错误之间的交互关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 报童模型理论、新闻供应商模型、模拟仿真框架、蒙特卡洛方法、拉丁超立方采样、Spearman秩相关、标准化回归分析
AI.method: 采用基于仿真的框架分析两产品报童供应链中的交易错误。使用10,000对配对蒙特卡洛复制分别运行错误易发和无错误场景以推导闭合形式最优订货量；结合个体、同时及基于全局回归的综合敏感性分析；全局敏感性基于拉丁超立方采样；使用Spearman秩相关和标准化回归量化各因素贡献。
AI.findings: 1) RFID采用通过减少不确定性增加最优订货量；2) 当标签成本低于由利润差异确定的阈值时，RFID有利可图；3) 错误率是主导驱动因素，与最大允许标签成本的Spearman秩相关系数为0.862；4) 销售价格相关性为0.495，缺货成本为0.107；5) 标准化回归显示错误率解释允许标签成本方差的45.2%，销售价格25.4%，缺货成本18.6%；6) 错误-价格交互作用统计显著，表明高价值、易错产品的超加性效益。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了两个理论性质：RFID采用增加最优订货量（通过减少不确定性），以及RFID盈利的标签成本阈值条件。发现错误率-价格交互作用的超加性效应，为高价值产品的RFID投资提供了理论依据。构建了错误驱动的敏感性排名体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供基于证据的管理框架，指导可追溯性驱动的RFID投资决策。证明RFID投资可防止资本沉淀于过时库存并减少需求未满足的收入损失，直接促进供应链经济可持续性。为管理者提供量化工具确定RFID投资的标签成本阈值。

title: A Dynamic Safety Margin Framework for Virtual Coupling Based on Transition-Induced Separation Loss and Operational Uncertainty
affiliations: Mahidol University - Faculty of Engineering and University of Leeds

detail.title: A Dynamic Safety Margin Framework for Virtual Coupling Based on Transition-Induced Separation Loss and Operational Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Existing VC approaches primarily rely on relative braking distance models and fixed safety margins. This study proposes a dynamic safety-margin framework for virtual coupling based on transition-induced separation loss and operational uncertainty. The framework first identifies train operational states using real-time relative speed and separation-distance conditions. A transition-induced separation-loss model is then developed to quantify temporary reductions in inter-train distance during coupling, virtual coupling, decoupling, and emergency operations. Furthermore, communication-delay variability and braking-performance uncertainty are incorporated through a probabilistic uncertainty-propagation approach to formulate a risk-adaptive safety margin. The resulting safety margin is integrated into the minimum safe separation distance and combined with state-dependent acceleration and braking control laws to ensure safe operation. The proposed methodology is evaluated using a high-speed railway simulation under nominal, emergency, and uncertainty scenarios. Results demonstrate that transition-induced separation losses increase probability of collision during critical state transitions. In all simulated scenarios, the actual separation distance remains above the dynamically calculated minimum safe distance, preventing overspeed and collision risks while accommodating heterogeneous train-performance characteristics. The findings demonstrate that the proposed framework enhances safety robustness and operational adaptability without imposing unnecessarily separation requirements supporting the practical implementation of future virtual coupling railway systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于过渡诱导分离损失和运行不确定性的动态安全裕度框架，用于虚拟联挂列车运行。该框架通过实时识别列车运行状态、量化过渡期间的分离损失，并结合通信延迟变异性和制动性能不确定性，构建风险自适应安全裕度，最终集成到最小安全间隔距离和控制律中。高速铁路仿真验证表明该框架在名义、应急和不确定场景下均能防止超速和碰撞风险，提升安全鲁棒性和运行适应性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过动态安全裕度框架解决虚拟联挂（VC）中传统相对制动距离模型和固定安全裕度无法充分应对过渡诱导分离损失和运行不确定性的问题？
AI.motivation: 现有虚拟联挂方法主要依赖相对制动距离模型和固定安全裕度，未能充分考虑列车在联挂、解挂、虚拟联挂及紧急操作等过渡状态下产生的临时性分离距离损失，也未纳入通信延迟变异和制动性能不确定性对安全间距的影响，亟需提出动态、风险自适应的安全裕度框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于过渡诱导分离损失模型、概率不确定性传播方法、风险自适应安全裕度理论以及状态依赖的加速度与制动控制律。
AI.method: 首先利用实时相对速度和分离距离条件识别列车运行状态；其次建立过渡诱导分离损失模型量化耦合、虚拟联挂、解挂和紧急操作期间列车间距的临时缩减；然后通过概率不确定性传播方法整合通信延迟变异性和制动性能不确定性，形成风险自适应安全裕度；最后将该裕度集成到最小安全分离距离中，并结合状态依赖的加减速控制律，在高速铁路仿真中评估其性能。
AI.findings: 过渡诱导的分离损失在关键状态转换期间增加了碰撞概率；在所有仿真场景下，实际分离距离始终高于动态计算的最小安全距离，有效防止了超速和碰撞风险，并能适应异构列车性能特征；同时框架在不施加不必要分离要求的前提下增强了安全鲁棒性和运行适应性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将过渡诱导分离损失和概率不确定性传播引入虚拟联挂安全裕度建模，构建了从运行状态识别、分离损失量化到风险自适应安全裕度计算的完整理论框架，突破传统固定安全裕度的局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为虚拟联挂铁路系统的实际工程实施提供了动态安全间距计算方法，能够在保证安全的前提下不额外增加列车分离要求，提高线路运行效率，支持异构列车性能环境下的安全协同运行。

title: Network Embedding-Based Analysis of Implicit Association Networks for China’s Coastal Ports
affiliations: South China University of Technology and South China University of Technology

detail.title: Network Embedding-Based Analysis of Implicit Association Networks for China’s Coastal Ports
detail.abstract: Ports are critical nodes in global shipping networks. Their interdependencies underpin the evolutionof regional port systems and the organization of supply chain networks. Existing studies typicallyrely on predefined indicators—such as geographic distance, vessel flows, and cargo throughput tocharacterize port relationships. While these metrics capture certain explicit interaction features, theyfail to comprehensively represent latent association structures driven by multidimensional factorswithin complex shipping networks. To address this gap, we propose a network embedding-basedframework for discovering and analyzing implicit port association networks. Taking 42 major portsacross China’s five coastal port clusters as the study subject, we utilize Automatic IdentificationSystem (AIS) vessel trajectory data to learn port network embeddings and construct an implicit association network. Building upon this foundation, we combine Social Network Analysis (SNA)and Logistic Quadratic Assignment Procedure (Logistic-QAP) driver analysis to reveal the structuralcharacteristics and formation mechanisms of the implicit port association network. The results indicatethat the implicit association network constructed via network embedding exhibits pronounced smallworld properties. It effectively preserves the original topological structure and spatial positionalrelationships while accurately capturing the structural equivalence and functional similarity formedthrough shipping interactions, thereby uncovering latent spatial associations that conventional network analysis fails to identify. Such implicit associations are not direct outcomes of individual shipping linksbut are jointly shaped by spatial proximity, shipping interaction intensity, and hinterland industrialstructure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于网络嵌入的框架，利用AIS船舶轨迹数据构建港口隐式关联网络，并结合社会网络分析和Logistic-QAP驱动分析，揭示中国五大沿海港口群42个主要港口之间的隐含空间关联结构及其形成机制。
AI.research_question: 如何发现和分析传统指标无法捕捉的港口间隐式关联网络，以及这些隐式关联的形成机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究依赖地理距离、船舶流量和货物吞吐量等预定义指标来表征港口关系，这些指标只能捕捉显性交互特征，无法全面反映复杂航运网络中由多维因素驱动的潜在关联结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络嵌入理论、社会网络分析（SNA）、Logistic二次指派程序（Logistic-QAP）
AI.method: 利用AIS船舶轨迹数据学习港口网络嵌入，构建隐式关联网络；结合社会网络分析（SNA）和Logistic-QAP驱动分析，揭示网络结构特征与形成机制。
AI.findings: 网络嵌入构建的隐式关联网络具有显著的小世界特性；能有效保留原始拓扑结构和空间位置关系，准确捕捉航运交互形成的结构对等性和功能相似性；隐式关联由空间邻近性、航运交互强度和腹地产业结构共同塑造，而非单一航运链接的直接结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出基于网络嵌入的港口隐式关联网络发现框架，弥补了传统指标在表征港口多维潜在关联方面的不足，拓展了港口关系研究的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为港口群规划、供应链网络组织和区域港口系统演化研究提供新的分析工具和方法支撑。

title: Supporting ICT4D Staff: Evidence of Organisational Practices from NGOs in East Africa
affiliations: The University of Manchester, The University of Manchester - Global Development Institute, The University of Manchester - Global Development Institute and The University of Manchester

detail.title: Supporting ICT4D Staff: Evidence of Organisational Practices from NGOs in East Africa
detail.abstract: This paper highlights the supportive role of organisational practices in harnessing the effort and commitment of ICT4D NGO staff. Drawing on the nonprofit and organisational literatures, we propose that supportive organisational practices in ICT4D NGOs (1) nurture mission congruence, (2) cultivate digital and non-digital capabilities, (3) offer and spotlight non-monetary rewards, and (4) provide socioemotional support for navigating work-related stressors. We explore these propositions in a field study involving 33 interviews across five NGOs in East Africa. For ICT4D and NGO managers, the paper offers suggestions on effective approaches for harnessing staff effort and commitment towards ICT4D goals. The study contributes to ICT4D research by providing a new construct – supportive organisational practices – which offers a new way of understanding how organisational contexts influence ICT4D actors.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨组织支持性实践如何帮助ICT4D非政府组织（NGO）激发员工努力与承诺。通过对东非五家NGO的33次访谈，研究发现支持性组织实践通过四种机制（培养使命一致性、培养数字化与非数字化能力、提供并彰显非货币奖励、提供社会情感支持）发挥作用，并提出了"支持性组织实践"这一新构念。
AI.research_question: ICT4D非政府组织中的支持性组织实践如何帮助激发和利用员工的努力与承诺以实现ICT4D目标？
AI.motivation: ICT4D NGO员工的努力与承诺对于实现组织目标至关重要，但现有研究对组织情境如何影响这些员工的积极性缺乏深入理解，需要探索组织层面的支持性实践机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非营利组织文献与组织管理文献，提出支持性组织实践的概念框架，涵盖使命一致性、能力培养、非货币奖励和社会情感支持四个维度。
AI.method: 实地研究（field study），对东非五家NGO进行33次深度访谈的定性研究。
AI.findings: 支持性组织实践通过四条路径发挥作用：(1)培养员工与组织使命的一致性；(2)培养数字化与非数字化能力；(3)提供并彰显非货币奖励；(4)为员工应对工作压力提供社会情感支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"支持性组织实践"（supportive organisational practices）这一新构念，为理解组织情境如何影响ICT4D行动者提供了新视角，丰富了ICT4D研究领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ICT4D和NGO管理者提供了激发员工努力与承诺、实现ICT4D目标的有效实践建议。

title: Expediting the Triage of Pathology-Proven Gastrointestinal Malignancies with the Clinical Alert Safety-Net System (CASS): A Derivation and Validation Study
affiliations: Peninsula Health, Peninsula Health, Peninsula Health, Peninsula Health, Peninsula Health, Peninsula Health, Peninsula Health, Monash University, Monash University and Peninsula Health

detail.title: Expediting the Triage of Pathology-Proven Gastrointestinal Malignancies with the Clinical Alert Safety-Net System (CASS): A Derivation and Validation Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The evaluation reported in this study was reviewed and approved as a Quality Assurance project by the Office for Research, Bayside Health (Peninsula), Victoria, Australia (Review Reference: QA/127231/PH-2026-524211(v2)). The project was determined to meet the requirements of the National Statement on Ethical Conduct in Human Research (NHMRC, 2023), the Australian Code for the Responsible Conduct of Research (NHMRC, 2018), and Ethical Considerations in Quality Assurance and Evaluation Activities (NHMRC, 2014).
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract:
Background: Manual reconciliation of post-endoscopy anatomical pathology is a critical vulnerability, risking delayed malignancy diagnosis. We introduce the Clinical Alert Safety-Net System (CASS), an open-source system that delivers high-risk results daily to a centralised inbox alongside established workflows, and report the derivation and validation of its first triage module, the CASS Gastrointestinal Module (GI-Module). 

Methods: This two-phase cohort study evaluated adult endoscopic episodes at a tertiary Australian healthcare network, with a 2024 retrospective derivation phase and a 2025 prospective validation phase; the unit of analysis was the patient-day episode. CASS was implemented within a widely used enterprise office suite (Microsoft 365); its GI-Module, an interchangeable three-keyword module (carcinoma, tumo*, lymphoma), was derived from the 2024 dataset. Diagnostic performance was assessed among episodes with a pathology report; timelines were compared using Wilcoxon rank-sum tests. 

Findings: Across the combined period, 8,463 adult episodes were evaluated (4,191 [49·5%] female). In the 2025 validation cohort (n=4,852; 3,221 with anatomical pathology, including 116 confirmed malignancies), the GI-Module achieved 100·0% sensitivity, 97·4% specificity, 58·9% positive predictive value, and 100·0% negative predictive value. Median administrative inbox delay for malignancies fell from 6·0 days (range 0–24) to 2·0 days (range 0–20; p<0·0001), while the laboratory phase was unchanged (p=0·68) and the reduction persisted when restricted to CASS-documented acknowledgements; among pathology-contingent malignancies median turnaround from procedure to specialist review fell from 14 to 10 days, a non-significant trend (p=0·18). 

Interpretation: CASS is a supplementary safety-net that significantly reduces administrative delay in acknowledging gastrointestinal malignancies; its GI-Module reliably triages reports documenting invasive GI malignancy for urgent review. CASS is defined by its architecture rather than any vendor: a scheduled daily sweep, deterministic module and centralised routing are reproducible in any equivalent enterprise or scripted environment, and re-targetable by substituting the module.

AI.tldr: 本研究介绍并验证了临床警报安全网系统（CASS）及其胃肠道模块（GI-Module），该系统通过每日集中收件箱自动分诊高危病理报告。在2025年前瞻性验证队列中（含116例确诊恶性肿瘤），GI-Module实现了100%灵敏度和97.4%特异性，并将恶性肿瘤的管理收件箱延迟从中位数6天降至2天，显著减少了消化道恶性肿瘤确认的行政延误。
AI.research_question: CASS系统能否通过自动化分诊减少内镜后解剖病理报告的管理性延迟，从而降低恶性肿瘤诊断延误的风险？其GI-Module的诊断性能如何？
AI.motivation: 手工协调内镜后解剖病理报告是关键的脆弱环节，可能导致恶性肿瘤诊断延误。现有工作流程缺乏自动化的安全网机制来确保高危病理结果被及时识别和跟进。
AI.theoretical_framework: 患者安全理论中的安全网（safety-net）概念，强调在现有工作流程之外建立冗余的保障机制以防止医疗差错和诊断延误。
AI.method: 两阶段队列研究：2024年回顾性推导阶段和2025年前瞻性验证阶段，在澳大利亚三级医疗网络中进行。以患者日（patient-day）为分析单元，评估成人内镜事件。CASS构建于Microsoft 365企业办公套件中，采用可替换的三关键词模块（carcinoma、tumo*、lymphoma）进行分诊。使用Wilcoxon秩和检验比较时间线。
AI.findings: 在2025年验证队列（n=4,852；其中3,221例有解剖病理报告，包含116例确诊恶性肿瘤）中，GI-Module实现了100%灵敏度、97.4%特异性、58.9%阳性预测值和100%阴性预测值。恶性肿瘤的中位管理收件箱延迟从6天降至2天（p<0.0001），实验室阶段时间不变（p=0.68），且限定于CASS记录的确认后该缩短仍然存在；从操作到专家审阅的中位周转时间从14天降至10天（p=0.18，不显著）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个架构定义型而非供应商绑定的安全网系统架构，包含定时每日扫描、确定性模块和集中路由三个核心组件，为患者安全领域提供了可复制的技术框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个开源、可在任何等效企业或脚本环境中复现的临床警报安全网系统，可显著减少恶性肿瘤确认的行政延迟（从6天降至2天），且通过替换模块可重新定向应用于其他临床领域，具有广泛的临床应用价值。

title: Gamified Challenges and Biodiversity Reporting on iNaturalist: A Quasi-Experimental Test of the Hedonic Model of System Adoption
affiliations: Griffith University, Griffith University and Griffith University

detail.title: Gamified Challenges and Biodiversity Reporting on iNaturalist: A Quasi-Experimental Test of the Hedonic Model of System Adoption
detail.abstract: Citizen science platforms such as iNaturalist depend on sustained public participation, yet contribution is dominated by a small minority of users and information alone rarely changes behaviour. This study tested whether a structured gamified challenge could increase biodiversity reporting, and whether any increase persisted once the challenges ceased. Twenty iNaturalist users were allocated to either a gamified condition (n = 10), which received ten weekly reporting challenges, or a non-gamified control condition (n = 10). Reporting was tracked objectively across 30 weeks in three ten-week phases, covering flora, land-based vertebrates, invertebrates and flying vertebrates, alongside repeated surveys measuring constructs from the Hedonic-Motivation System Adoption Model. Reporting in the gamified group rose significantly from baseline across all four taxa and exceeded the control group in every taxon. Reporting in the gamified declined once the challenges ended but, in no taxon, returned to baseline, while reporting in the gamified group went back down to baseline across all four taxon. Enjoyment was the attitude most closely associated with actual reporting, although stated intention was a weak predictor of subsequent behaviour. Gamified challenges can mobilise biodiversity reporting across taxa in the short term and may begin to establish the habits on which lasting participation depends.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过一项30周的准实验设计，检验结构化游戏化挑战能否提升iNaturalist公民科学平台上的生物多样性报告行为，以及这种提升在挑战结束后是否持续。研究将20名用户分为游戏化组（n=10）和非游戏化对照组（n=10），覆盖四大生物类群，结合重复调查测量享乐动机系统采纳模型（HMSAM）相关构念。结果显示游戏化组在四个类群上的报告量均显著高于基线和对照组，挑战结束后报告量下降但未回到基线，而享乐（愉悦感）是预测实际行为最密切的态度变量，口头意图对后续行为的预测力较弱。
AI.research_question: 一是有结构的游戏化挑战能否提升iNaturalist平台上的生物多样性报告行为；二是这种提升在挑战停止后能否持续存在（即是否形成新的参与习惯）。
AI.motivation: 公民科学平台（如iNaturalist）依赖持续的公众参与，但贡献高度集中于少数用户群体，且仅提供信息很少能改变行为。因此需要探索有效的干预手段（如游戏化挑战）来动员和维持参与。
AI.theoretical_framework: 享乐动机系统采纳模型（Hedonic-Motivation System Adoption Model, HMSAM），重点关注愉悦感（enjoyment）、意图（intention）等态度构念与实际行动之间的关系。
AI.method: 准实验设计：20名iNaturalist用户随机分配到游戏化组（n=10，接受十周每周报告挑战）和对照组（n=10）。追踪30周报告行为，分为三个十周阶段（基线期、干预期、干预后），涵盖四个生物类群（植物、陆生脊椎动物、无脊椎动物、飞行动物脊椎动物）。同时通过重复问卷调查测量HMSAM相关构念。
AI.findings: 游戏化组的报告量在干预期较基线显著上升，且在所有四个类群上均超过对照组；挑战结束后游戏化组报告量下降但未回到基线水平；对照组在所有类群上均回到基线水平。愉悦感是与实际报告行为关联最密切的态度变量，而陈述的意图对后续行为的预测力较弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 将HMSAM应用于公民科学参与情境，实证验证了愉悦感（享乐动机）比行为意图更能预测实际参与行为，丰富了游戏化与公民科学参与动机的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明游戏化挑战可以在短期内有效动员跨类群的生物多样性报告，并可能开始建立长期参与所依赖的习惯；为公民科学平台设计激励机制提供了实证依据。

title: Innovation in the Provision of Library Services in Universities in Zambia: Prospects and Possibilities
affiliations: Kapasa Makasa University, University of Zambia (UNZA), Mulungushi University, Copperbelt University and

detail.title: Innovation in the Provision of Library Services in Universities in Zambia: Prospects and Possibilities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declare that has no known personal or financial interests or relationships that could have influenced the research reported in any of my studies.

contentType.other: Not yet published - Paper present at the Conference

detail.abstract: The ease of accessibility of information due to technological innovations has presented challenges to libraries and librarians to look for more proactive ways of serving their users in order to remain relevant. For more than a decade, librarians in the SCECSAL region have devised and implemented innovative library services as evidenced by papers in conference proceedings stretching as far back as 2012. Contributions from libraries in Zambia were visibly absent, which raises a question whether there are no innovations in library services taking place in the country. In the wake of COVID-19, librarians in Zambia shared their innovations in offering library service during this crisis and beyond, which included use of email, tele-conferencing, and social media platforms such as Facebook, and WhatsApp to conduct orientations, register users and for Selective Dissemination of Information, to mention a few. This paper is based on a survey that was conducted to obtain a comprehensive picture of innovative library services that are currently prevalent in university libraries in Zambia. The results revealed that more than 90% of the libraries were offering innovative services, notable of which are: videos for library orientation, online registration of users, electronic book downloads from open source, library blog and plagiarism check. Challenges faced include, inadequate ICT infrastructure and technical know-how, financial constraints, and crippling staffing levels. In conclusion, the paper recommends that Library and Information Association of Zambia and the Zambian Library Consortium spearhead collaboration among public and private universities in skills exchange, and replication of best innovative services in all universities. These survey results are important because they provide a basis for university librarians in Zambia to collaborate for the benefit of their users. It also contributes to the literature on innovation in library services in the SCECSAL region.

AI.tldr: 本文基于一项调查研究，系统梳理了赞比亚大学图书馆当前的创新服务现状。研究发现超过90%的图书馆提供创新服务（如视频导览、在线用户注册、开源电子书下载、图书馆博客、查重服务等），同时面临ICT基础设施不足、技术人才缺乏、资金紧张和人员不足等挑战。论文建议赞比亚图书馆与信息协会和赞比亚图书馆联盟牵头推动公私大学间的技能交流和最佳创新服务推广。
AI.research_question: 赞比亚大学图书馆当前提供哪些创新服务？面临哪些挑战？如何促进这些创新服务的推广与协作？
AI.motivation: 在SCECSAL（东非、中非和南部非洲图书馆与信息协会）地区，赞比亚图书馆在创新服务方面的贡献长期缺席（会议论文集可追溯至2012年），这引发了对该国是否存在图书馆服务创新的疑问。COVID-19疫情期间赞比亚图书馆员的创新实践为该研究提供了契机，促使作者开展系统调查以全面了解现状。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文未明确提出特定的理论框架，主要基于图书馆服务创新的实践视角，以SCECSAL区域图书馆创新服务的已有记载为参照背景进行实证调查。
AI.method: 采用调查研究法（survey），对赞比亚大学图书馆进行问卷调查，以获取创新图书馆服务的全面图景。
AI.findings: （1）超过90%的赞比亚大学图书馆提供创新服务，包括：图书馆导览视频、用户在线注册、开源电子书下载、图书馆博客和查重（plagiarism check）服务等；（2）主要挑战包括：ICT基础设施不足、技术知识欠缺、资金约束以及严重的人员配置不足；（3）COVID-19期间图书馆员利用电子邮件、远程会议、Facebook和WhatsApp等平台开展新生导览、用户注册和选择性信息传播（SDI）等服务。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了赞比亚在SCECSAL区域图书馆创新服务文献中的空白，为区域图书馆服务创新研究提供了来自赞比亚的实证数据和案例，丰富了图书馆创新服务在发展中国家背景下的研究文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为赞比亚大学图书馆员之间的协作提供了决策依据；建议赞比亚图书馆与信息协会（LIAZ）和赞比亚图书馆联盟牵头，促进公立与私立大学之间的技能交流和最佳创新服务的复制推广，最终惠及图书馆用户。

title: Verified-source Evidence for LLM-based Smishing Detection: A Reproducible Extension and Evaluation of SmishX

detail.title: Verified-source Evidence for LLM-based Smishing Detection: A Reproducible Extension and Evaluation of SmishX
detail.abstract: SmishX [6] showed that pairing an LLM with link-and brand-context retrieval improves explainable SMS-phishing detection, but its released detector treats brand verification as a raw search-engine query and has no mechanism for checking what an impersonated organization actually says about the request it is being accused of making. We faithfully reproduce SmishX's detection pipeline (P0) and evaluate two extensions on a 283-message cohort (34 legitimate, 133 smishing, 116 spam): a corrected evidence packet that fixes how failed link collection is presented to the model, and an added retrieval layer for firstparty and known-campaign evidence (P1). On the 267 cases scored by all three adopted systems, P1 dominates P0 on all six metrics measured (recall 96.6%→99.1%, specificity 67.6%→73.5%, MCC 0.668→0.804), and the head-to-head comparison narrowly misses conventional significance (McNemar exact, matched n = 267, p = 0.057). An ablation isolating the packet fix alone accounts for most of the gain and is significant (p = 0.006); the added evidentiary retrieval's marginal contribution over that corrected baseline is not (p = 0.69). We report this as an honest, partially-negative result rather than a validated win, disclose a deviation from a predeclared analysis protocol, flag that the headline cohort blends two differently-scoped sampling waves, and note that a predeclared blinded audit found neither system's stated reasoning fully evidence-supported. This draft also corrects a significance value mislabeled in an earlier version of this paper (Appendix D).

AI.tldr: 本文忠实复现了SmishX的短信钓鱼检测管线（P0），并评估了两个扩展：修正证据包（修复链接收集失败时的呈现方式）和增加第一方/已知活动证据检索层（P1）。在283条信息队列上，P1在全部六项指标上优于P0（召回率96.6%→99.1%，特异度67.6%→73.5%，MCC 0.668→0.804），但头对头比较接近但未达常规显著性（p=0.057）。消融实验表明，证据包修正单独解释了大部分增益且显著（p=0.006），而新增检索层的边际贡献不显著（p=0.69）。作者诚实地报告了这一部分阴性结果。
AI.research_question: SmishX的短信钓鱼检测管线中，修正证据包（修复失败的链接收集呈现方式）和增加第一方/已知活动证据检索层能否在忠实复现的基础上提升检测性能？
AI.motivation: SmishX将LLM与链接和品牌上下文检索配对用于可解释的短信钓鱼检测，但其发布的检测器将品牌验证作为原始搜索引擎查询处理，缺乏检查被冒充组织实际所说内容的机制。已有方法存在证据处理和技术缺陷，需要改进和验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于LLM的可解释短信钓鱼检测框架，结合链接检索和品牌上下文检索，以及证据包构建和证据检索层的理论。
AI.method: 忠实复现SmishX检测管线（P0），评估两个扩展：（1）修正证据包，修复失败链接收集的呈现方式；（2）增加第一方和已知活动证据检索层（P1）。在283条信息队列（34条合法、133条短信钓鱼、116条垃圾邮件）上进行评估，采用六项指标和McNemar精确检验进行显著性分析。
AI.findings: 在267个由三个系统评分的案例中，P1在所有六项指标上优于P0（召回率96.6%→99.1%，特异度67.6%→73.5%，MCC 0.668→0.804），但头对头比较接近未达常规显著性（McNemar精确，n=267，p=0.057）。消融实验显示，仅证据包修正就占大部分增益且显著（p=0.006）；新增检索层在修正基线之上的边际贡献不显著（p=0.69）。预设的盲审发现两个系统所述的推理均未完全得到证据支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个部分阴性的诚实研究结果，表明证据包的修正（而非额外的检索层）是提升性能的关键因素，为LLM驱动的钓鱼检测系统设计提供了实证依据；同时强调了研究透明度（偏差披露、协议偏离声明、盲审）在AI安全研究中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为短信钓鱼检测系统的实际部署提供了改进方向（证据包的正确修正），同时提醒实践者注意：额外的证据检索层可能不带来显著增益；研究报告中透明披露局限性（如队列混合不同采样波次、推理未被完全证据支持）对实际应用的可信度评估具有重要参考价值。

title: Production-scale multimodal retrieval-augmented generation for networkoperations: Evaluation and measurement pitfalls
affiliations: University of Prishtina, University of Prishtina, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Production-scale multimodal retrieval-augmented generation for networkoperations: Evaluation and measurement pitfalls
detail.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds large language models for network operations, but published telecom RAG is evaluated offline on single, public, text-only corpora, leaving the production case unaddressed. We report a hybrid multimodal RAG platform in production at a global digital-infrastructure operator: dense-sparse retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion and cross-encoder reranking, 1536-dimensional multimodal embeddings, an authoritative asset-graph grounding layer, and asynchronous warm-standby geo-replication, over 334,818 vector points from eight sources of which 11.7% are images. We contribute a production-derived benchmark stratified by answerability, a context-aware LLM-judge protocol whose failure modes we measure directly, component ablations, and systems results. We also report its most latency-sensitive consumer, an always-listening spoken-avatar assistant on two 2017-class edge GPUs that self-personalizes its own edge models. Our central finding concerns measurement. An answer-only LLM judge is systematically wrong on groundedness, scoring unanswerable questions above answerable ones. A context-aware judge removes that shortcut but introduces another: a system that retrieves badly refuses rather than inventing, and a refusal is trivially well grounded, so judged groundedness runs backwards against gold-label retrieval quality (Spearman -0.89 across configurations spanning an elevenfold range in Recall@1). Groundedness cannot separate a correct refusal from a correct grounded answer, so refusal rates must accompany it. Rankings are also unstable across judge families (Kendall τ = 0.10), so we report the retrieval benefit we measure, +0.25 relevance over closed-book generation, as judge-specific. Finally, a production corpus decays silently unless per-source ingestionfreshness is monitored, and wide-area round-trips are a small fraction of any interactive response.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一个在生产环境中运行的混合多模态检索增强生成（RAG）平台，服务于全球数字基础设施运营商。平台采用稠密-稀疏检索、互惠排名融合、交叉编码器重排、1536维多模态嵌入、权威资产图谱接地层以及异步温备异地复制，覆盖来自8个数据源的334,818个向量点（其中11.7%为图像）。作者还贡献了基于可回答性分层的生产基准、上下文感知的LLM评审协议、组件消融实验和系统结果，并报告了其最延迟敏感的用户——一个在2017年款边缘GPU上运行的始终监听语音头像助手。
AI.research_question: 生产环境中的电信RAG系统与离线评估结果存在哪些差异？如何正确评估生产级RAG系统的检索质量与接地性（groundedness）？
AI.motivation: 已发表的电信RAG研究仅在离线、单一、公开、纯文本语料库上进行评估，未解决生产环境中的实际问题。RAG已被用于接地大型语言模型进行网络运营，但缺乏生产环境下的评估方法和基准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 检索增强生成（RAG）、多模态嵌入、稠密-稀疏混合检索、互惠排名融合（RRF）、交叉编码器重排、LLM评审（LLM-judge）、接地性（groundedness）评估
AI.method: 构建生产级混合多模态RAG平台，包含8个数据源的334,818个向量点；开发生产衍生的分层基准测试；提出上下文感知LLM评审协议并直接测量其失败模式；进行组件消融实验和系统性能报告。
AI.findings: 1) 仅看答案的LLM评审在接地性判断上系统性错误，将不可回答问题评分高于可回答问题；2) 上下文感知评审虽消除了这个捷径，但引入了新问题——检索质量差的系统倾向于拒绝而非编造，而拒绝天然容易被视为"良好接地"，导致判断的接地性与金标准检索质量呈负相关（Spearman -0.89）；3) 接地性无法区分正确拒绝与正确接地回答，必须配合拒绝率使用；4) 不同评审家族间排名不稳定（Kendall τ = 0.10）；5) 生产语料库若不对各来源摄取新鲜度进行监控会静默劣化；6) 广域往返延迟仅占交互响应的一小部分。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了LLM评审协议在接地性评估中的系统性缺陷和捷径行为，证明接地性指标必须与拒绝率结合使用才能正确评估RAG系统；指出检索收益的测量结果具有评审者特异性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了生产级混合多模态RAG平台的完整架构参考，包括检索策略、嵌入方案、接地层和地理复制方案；贡献了生产衍生的分层评估基准和经过验证的LLM评审协议；报告了在2017年类边缘GPU上部署始终监听语音助手的实践经验；提出了生产语料库需监控各来源摄取新鲜度的运营建议。

title: DP-Net: A Dual-Path Network for Zero-Calibration Cross-Subject SSVEP Decoding Under Short Time Windows
affiliations: North China University of Science and Technology, North China University of Science and Technology, North China University of Science and Technology, North China University of Science and Technology, North China University of Science and Technology, North China University of Science and Technology, North China University of Science and Technology and North China University of Science and Technology

detail.title: DP-Net: A Dual-Path Network for Zero-Calibration Cross-Subject SSVEP Decoding Under Short Time Windows
detail.abstract: Zero-calibration cross-subject steady-state visual evoked potential brain–computer interfaces (SSVEP-BCIs) support plug-and-play interaction, yet short-window decoding for unseen users remains difficult because of inter-subject variability, source-to-target shifts, and limited frequency-discriminative evidence. This study proposes DP-Net, a dual-path network for zero-calibration cross-subject SSVEP decoding under short time windows. DP-Net integrates a data-driven neural path (DDNP) with a template-guided analytical path (TGAP). DDNP learns nonlinear spatiotemporal representations through cross-electrode spatial filtering, multi-scale temporal modeling, and global self-attention. TGAP derives template-similarity scores from standard harmonic and source-domain empirical templates using QR/SVD. An analytical score preservation module (ASPM) retains three score types for fusion. The feature vectors are concatenated, batch-normalized, and classified by an MLP. DP-Net was evaluated on the Benchmark and BETA datasets under subject-level leave-one-subject-out cross-validation. Among the six reproduced baselines, DP-Net achieved higher mean accuracy–ITR performance in most tested windows, particularly from 0.2 to 0.6 s. At 0.6 s, DP-Net achieved 65.48% accuracy and 140.06 bits/min on Benchmark, and 47.01% accuracy and 83.11 bits/min on BETA. Ablation, fusion, and feature-intervention analyses indicated complementary contributions from DDNP and TGAP. The results support the use of template-derived scores with learned EEG representations for short-window zero-calibration cross-subject SSVEP decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DP-Net，一种用于零校准跨受试者短时窗SSVEP解码的双路径网络，结合数据驱动神经路径（DDNP）和模板引导分析路径（TGAP），在Benchmark和BETA数据集上实现了优于六个基线方法的准确率和信息传输率（ITR）。
AI.research_question: 如何在短时窗条件下实现零校准的跨受试者SSVEP脑机接口解码？
AI.motivation: 零校准跨受试者SSVEP-BCI支持即插即用交互，但短时窗解码对未见过用户仍面临挑战，主要障碍包括受试者间变异性、源到目标域的偏移以及有限的频率判别证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双路径架构思想：数据驱动神经网络路径与模板引导分析路径的互补融合；基于学习表征与模板相似度得分的联合解码框架。
AI.method: DP-Net包含两条路径：（1）数据驱动神经路径（DDNP），通过跨电极空间滤波、多尺度时间建模和全局自注意力学习非线性时空表征；（2）模板引导分析路径（TGAP），利用标准谐波和源域经验模板通过QR/SVD计算模板相似度得分；分析得分保留模块（ASPM）保留三种得分类型用于融合，特征向量经拼接、批归一化后由MLP分类。
AI.findings: 在Benchmark和BETA数据集上采用留一受试者交叉验证，DP-Net在大多数测试时窗（特别是0.2-0.6秒）优于六个复现的基线方法。在0.6秒时窗下，Benchmark上达到65.48%准确率和140.06 bits/min，BETA上达到47.01%准确率和83.11 bits/min。消融、融合和特征干预分析表明DDNP与TGAP具有互补贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了模板派生得分与学习型EEG表征相结合的有效性，为短时窗零校准跨受试者SSVEP解码提供了新的方法论框架，揭示了数据驱动与知识驱动（模板引导）路径的互补机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为SSVEP-BCI系统提供了无需校准即可快速部署的即插即用解码方案，支持更短的命令响应时间（短至0.2-0.6秒），可提升实际应用中的交互效率。

title: The Impact of Digital Entrepreneurship on Resident Income and the Urban-Rural Income Gap: Evidence from Chinese Counties
affiliations: Inner Mongolia University, Beijing Normal University and Beijing Normal University

detail.title: The Impact of Digital Entrepreneurship on Resident Income and the Urban-Rural Income Gap: Evidence from Chinese Counties
detail.abstract: Driven by the digital economy, digital entrepreneurship is reshaping income distribution patterns. Utilizing panel data from 2,232 Chinese counties (2008–2022) and 196 million business registration records, this paper examines the effects of digital entrepreneurship on resident income and the urban-rural income gap. Our findings indicate: (1) Digital entrepreneurship significantly raises residents' income but simultaneously widens the urban-rural income gap. (2) Mechanism analysis reveals that digital entrepreneurship effectively enhances residents' income by promoting employment, stimulating regional technological innovation, and optimizing regional industrial structure. However, owing to the pronounced urban-rural digital divide, digital entrepreneurship generates "technological bias" and "factor agglomeration" effects that disproportionately favor urban residents, ultimately leading to a wider income gap. (3) Unlike digital entrepreneurship, traditional entrepreneurship can raise residents' income while narrowing the urban-rural gap, though its income-enhancing effect is relatively limited. (4) The impact of the digital economy on the income gap primarily originates from digital industrialization, as reflected in digital entrepreneurial activities. Furthermore, moderated by platform effects, data factor allocation effects, and digital inclusive effects, the impacts of digital entrepreneurship and the digital economy on the income gap exhibit certain differences.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2008-2022年中国2,232个县级面板数据和1.96亿条工商注册记录，发现数字创业在提高居民收入的同时会扩大城乡收入差距，其机制包括促进就业、技术创新和产业结构优化，但城乡数字鸿沟导致数字创业产生偏向城市居民的技术偏向效应和要素集聚效应，从而拉大收入差距；与数字创业不同，传统创业能在提高收入的同时缩小城乡差距，但增收效应有限。
AI.research_question: 数字创业如何影响居民收入及城乡收入差距？其作用机制和边界条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 数字经济时代数字创业正在重塑收入分配格局，但现有研究对数字创业与居民收入及城乡收入差距之间的关系缺乏系统的县级层面证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字创业理论、城乡二元经济理论、技术偏向型技术进步理论、要素集聚理论、数字鸿沟理论
AI.method: 利用2008-2022年中国2,232个县的面板数据及1.96亿条工商注册记录，采用面板回归等计量方法进行实证分析，并通过机制分析和异质性分析检验作用路径。
AI.findings: （1）数字创业显著提高居民收入但同时扩大城乡收入差距；（2）数字创业通过促进就业、技术创新和优化产业结构来提高居民收入，但因城乡数字鸿沟产生偏向城市居民的技术偏向和要素集聚效应而扩大收入差距；（3）传统创业可提高收入并缩小城乡差距，但增收效应有限；（4）数字经济对收入差距的影响主要源自数字产业化，且平台效应、数据要素配置效应和数字普惠效应等具有调节作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了数字创业对居民收入和城乡收入差距的双重影响及其作用机制，丰富了数字创业与收入分配领域的理论研究，区分了数字创业与传统创业在收入分配效应上的差异，深化了对数字经济影响收入差距渠道的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府制定数字经济政策、缩小城乡收入差距提供实证依据和政策启示，尤其是如何在推动数字创业的同时通过弥合数字鸿沟、发挥平台效应和数字普惠效应来平衡区域发展。

title: Long-term distributional effects of carbon pricing– A novel modeling approach
affiliations: , RWI - Leibniz Institute for Economic Research, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Bochum University of Applied Sciences

detail.title: Long-term distributional effects of carbon pricing– A novel modeling approach
detail.abstract: In this paper, we present a new methodological approach to assess the prospective long-term distributional impacts of carbon pricing under heterogeneous technology adjustment and alternative price trajectories. We link an energy systems model with a micro-simulation model based on random forests to simulate household-level cost burdens of two stylized carbon price paths in the German heating and transportation sectors through 2040. Using data-driven projections of technology adoption, the model suggests that carbon pricing initially generates regressive cost burdens, which can be substantially mitigated through lump sum revenue recycling. However, heterogeneous adoption rates give rise to pronounced within-income dispersion for both price paths, particularly among low income households, where a subset remains net burdened even after redistribution. When adoption in multi-family homes is assumed to be slower – reflecting structural barriers– distributional outcomes become relatively more regressive. Comparing price trajectories, a higher carbon price path implies higher average burdens in 2030, followed by declining costs as investments in climate-neutral technologies accumulate, whereas a lower price path produces a flatter but morepersistent burden profile through 2040. Overall, the framework highlights how assumptions about technology diffusion and price design critically shape the projected distributional consequences of carbon pricing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的方法论框架，将能源系统模型与基于随机森林的微观模拟模型相结合，评估碳定价在德国供暖和交通部门到2040年的长期分配影响。研究发现碳定价最初产生累退性成本负担，可通过一次性收入返还缓解，但异质性技术采纳导致低收入家庭内部出现显著分化，部分家庭即使在再分配后仍为净负担者。
AI.research_question: 在异质性技术调整和替代价格路径下，碳定价对家庭的长期分配影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究往往忽视技术采纳的异质性以及不同碳价路径对家庭负担分配的影响，需要一种能够捕捉微观家庭差异的长期评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源系统模型与微观模拟模型（基于随机森林）的耦合框架，关注碳定价的分配效应（累进/累退性）与技术扩散异质性。
AI.method: 将能源系统模型与基于随机森林的微观模拟模型相链接，模拟两种碳价路径下德国家庭在供暖和交通部门的成本负担至2040年。
AI.findings: 1) 碳定价初始产生累退性负担，一次性收入返还可显著缓解；2) 异质性采纳率导致收入组内部明显分化，低收入家庭中有子集在再分配后仍为净负担者；3) 多户住宅采纳较慢（结构性障碍）使分配结果更累退；4) 较高碳价路径在2030年平均负担更高但随后下降，较低碳价路径负担更平缓但更持久。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合能源系统模型与数据驱动的微观模拟的新方法论框架，揭示了技术扩散假设与碳价设计如何共同塑造碳定价的长期分配后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了碳定价分配效应的前瞻性评估工具，强调收入返还设计、结构性障碍缓解（如多户住宅改造）以及碳价路径选择对分配公平性的关键影响。

title: Agent-based modeling of data trading and pricing
affiliations: School of Economics and Management, Beihang University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and

detail.title: Agent-based modeling of data trading and pricing
detail.abstract: The tension between data utilization and consumer privacy protection has emerged as a central concern in the digital economy. This paper investigates whether competition in data markets can serve as an effective mechanism for improving market efficiency and welfare outcomes. We develop a competitive framework consisting of a product market and a Continuous Double Auction (CDA)-based data market including consumers, producers, and data intermediaries. To capture decentralized trading and heterogeneous participant behavior, we employ an agent-based simulation approach and analyze sixteen scenarios under different data access regimes and behavioral rules. The results show that a competitive data market can improve consumer welfare while allowing producers to maintain positive profitability. Specifically, competition constrains the amount of accessible data and increases the effective cost of data acquisition, thereby mitigating excessive data exploitation associated with privacy disclosure. These findings provide practical implications for data market design and consumer privacy regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过基于代理的仿真方法，研究了竞争性数据市场（结合产品市场与连续双向拍卖数据市场）能否作为改善市场效率和消费者福利的有效机制。研究发现，竞争性数据市场可以提升消费者福利，同时保持生产者正利润，并通过约束数据可获取量和提高数据获取的有效成本来缓解隐私过度披露问题。
AI.research_question: 竞争性数据市场能否作为改善市场效率和福利结果的有效机制？具体而言，数据市场的竞争如何影响消费者福利、生产者利润以及隐私保护？
AI.motivation: 数字经济中数据利用与消费者隐私保护之间存在紧张关系，需要探索新的机制来平衡二者。竞争性数据市场是否可以作为替代性治理机制来改善市场效率和福利结果，这一问题尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于竞争性市场理论、数据市场设计理论以及连续双向拍卖（CDA）机制理论，结合代理主体行为建模框架。
AI.method: 构建包含产品市场和基于连续双向拍卖（CDA）的数据市场的竞争性分析框架，涵盖消费者、生产者和数据中介三类主体。采用基于代理的仿真方法，分析不同数据访问制度和行为规则下的十六种情景。
AI.findings: 竞争性数据市场能够提升消费者福利，同时允许生产者维持正盈利能力。具体而言，竞争约束了可获取数据的数量，并提高了数据获取的有效成本，从而缓解了与隐私披露相关的过度数据利用问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数据市场竞争作为隐私保护机制提供了理论证据，扩展了数据市场设计与消费者隐私保护的理论框架，揭示了竞争机制如何通过价格和数量约束来缓解数据过度利用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据市场设计和消费者隐私监管提供了实践启示，表明竞争性数据市场可作为监管手段的补充或替代方案。

title: Degrowth in Business School Curriculum: An Examination of AACSB-Accredited Schools in Germany
affiliations: Munich Business School, Munich Business School and Degrowth Institute

detail.title: Degrowth in Business School Curriculum: An Examination of AACSB-Accredited Schools in Germany
detail.abstract: Business schools play a critical role in shaping the values and capabilities of future decision-makers, yet their curricula remain largely anchored in growth-oriented paradigms increasingly incompatible with planetary boundaries. As ecological degradation intensifies, degrowth, which is the planned and equitable downscaling of production and consumption, has emerged as an alternative framework. However, its integration into mainstream business education remains empirically unclear.This study examines how degrowth is positioned within AACSB-accredited business school curricula in Germany and identifies barriers and opportunities shaping its inclusion. Using a mixed qualitative approach, the study combines content analysis of publicly available curriculum documents from 14 AACSB-accredited institutions with semi-structured interviews with five expert stakeholders.Findings show that degrowth was entirely absent from formal curriculum documentation, while sustainability was predominantly framed through reformist, business-case approaches. Sustainability content was often elective and more common at the bachelor’s level; at postgraduate level, it was typically offered as a separate specialisation. Interviews identified barriers including conceptual ambiguity, faculty expertise gaps, growth-oriented institutional norms, and politicisation. Opportunities include student demand, faculty agency, accreditation flexibility, and adjacent frameworks as entry points.The study provides empirical insight into institutional, discursive, and structural conditions shaping the integration of post-growth perspectives in business education.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察了德国AACSB认证商学院课程中"去增长"（degrowth）理念的融入情况。通过对14所认证机构的课程文件进行内容分析，并结合对5位专家利益相关者的半结构化访谈，研究发现去增长在正式课程文件中完全缺席，可持续性主要通过改良主义的商业案例框架呈现，且多为选修课。研究识别了概念模糊、师资专业知识缺口、增长导向的制度规范和政治化等障碍，以及学生需求、教师能动性、认证灵活性和相邻框架等机遇。
AI.research_question: 去增长理念如何在德国AACSB认证商学院的课程中被定位？哪些障碍和机遇塑造了其纳入过程？
AI.motivation: 商学院在塑造未来决策者的价值观和能力方面发挥关键作用，但其课程仍以增长导向范式为主，与地球生态边界日益不相容。尽管去增长作为一种替代框架已经出现，但其融入主流商业教育的实证情况仍不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 去增长（degrowth）理论框架，即可持续发展教育中改良主义（reformist）与转型（transformative）路径的区分，以及商业案例（business-case）方法框架。
AI.method: 混合质性研究方法：对14所AACSB认证机构的公开课程文件进行内容分析，结合对5位专家利益相关者的半结构化访谈。
AI.findings: 去增长在正式课程文件中完全缺席；可持续性主要通过改良主义的商业案例框架呈现；可持续性内容多为选修课，在本科阶段更常见，研究生阶段通常作为独立专业方向提供。障碍包括概念模糊、师资专业知识缺口、增长导向的制度规范和政治化；机遇包括学生需求、教师能动性、认证灵活性和相邻框架作为切入点。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解塑造后增长视角在商业教育中融入的制度性、话语性和结构性条件提供了实证洞察，填补了去增长在主流商业教育中实证研究空白的文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商学院课程设计者和政策制定者识别了去增长融入课程的具体障碍和可行切入点，有助于推动商业教育向生态可持续方向转型。
